========== FILE: ws/stage8/slides/build_topic_tex.py ==========

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate short standalone Beamer sources, one per official Module 1-8 topic.

Also writes one short overview deck per official module, to pair with the
already-generated overview videos.

Usage (from the repository root or from this folder):
    python3 stage8/slides/build_topic_tex.py

Module-length decks in this folder (M1_*.tex ... M8_*.tex) are a separate
product and are not overwritten by this script. Regenerate those with
build_tex.py.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
CATALOG = ROOT / "stage8" / "catalog" / "topic_frames.json"
OUT_ROOT = HERE / "topics"
OFFICIAL_FRAMES_JSON = ROOT / "stage8" / "hk_official_frames.json"

# Import shared escaping / hour formatting from the module-deck generator.
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from build_tex import SLUG, bullets, esc, hours_s  # noqa: E402

def load_official_frames() -> dict:
    if not OFFICIAL_FRAMES_JSON.exists():
        return {}
    return json.loads(OFFICIAL_FRAMES_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf8"))


OFFICIAL_FRAMES = load_official_frames()

# Safety net for older catalog extracts. v10.7-dev already says 231 topics
# on the Topic 1.1 bridge. Official reportable units remain Modules 1-8
# (153 topics). Do not call Module 9 official (H1 open).
STALE = (
    (
        "every one of the 177 topics",
        "every one of the 231 topics on this site",
    ),
    (
        "the 177 topics",
        "the 231 topics on this site",
    ),
)


def refresh(s: str) -> str:
    if not s:
        return s
    out = str(s)
    for a, b in STALE:
        out = out.replace(a, b)
    return out


def slug_title(title: str, limit: int = 60) -> str:
    import unicodedata
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title or "")
    s = "".join(ch for ch in s if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", s).strip("_")
    return (s or "topic")[:limit]


def topic_filename(tid: str, title: str) -> str:
    return f"T-{tid}_{slug_title(title)}.tex"


def unit_label(unit) -> str:
    if not unit:
        return ""
    if isinstance(unit, dict):
        uid = unit.get("id") or ""
        ut = unit.get("title") or ""
        if uid and ut:
            return f"{uid}: {ut}"
        return uid or ut
    return str(unit)


def split_subs_text(text: str) -> list[str]:
    if not text:
        return []
    parts = re.split(r"\s*;\s*", text)
    if len(parts) == 1:
        parts = re.split(r",\s+", text)
    return [p.strip() for p in parts if p and p.strip()]


PREAMBLE = r"""\documentclass[aspectratio=169,11pt]{beamer}
%% FlippedStat short topic deck -- %(kind)s %(label)s (English).
%% Compile from stage8/slides/topics/M%(mod)s/ (theme is two levels up):
%%   pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode %(file)s
%%   pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode %(file)s
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[english]{babel}
\makeatletter
\def\input@path{{../../theme/}}
\makeatother
\usetheme{FlippedStat}
\renewcommand{\FSmodulenumber}{%(mod)s}

\title{%(title)s}
\subtitle{%(subtitle)s}
\author{FlippedStat course team}
\institute{The Chinese University of Hong Kong\\[0.3em]
\textit{Self-paced resource. This draft is not itself an institutional approval.}}
\date{2026-11-18}

\begin{document}
\frame{\titlepage}
"""


CLOSING_HOWTO = r"""\begin{itemize}
  \item Open the matching page on the FlippedStat site and work the checks there.
  \item Official hours, KPIs, licences, placement cut scores and certificate wording stay on the site and are not redefined here.
  \item English only in this pass. Do not add a crest or lockup that would imply CUHK has approved this draft.
\end{itemize}
"""


def begin(kind: str, label: str, mod: int, fname: str, title: str, subtitle: str) -> list[str]:
    return [
        PREAMBLE
        % {
            "kind": kind,
            "label": esc(label),
            "mod": mod,
            "file": fname,
            "title": title,  # already escaped by caller
            "subtitle": subtitle,
        }
    ]


def frame_count(parts: list[str]) -> int:
    text = "".join(parts)
    return text.count(r"\frame{\titlepage}") + len(re.findall(r"\\begin\{frame\}", text))


def write_topic(mod: dict, topic: dict, nxt: dict | None, out_path: Path) -> int:
    n = mod["n"]
    tid = topic["id"]
    title = topic.get("title") or tid
    fr = topic.get("frames") or {}
    unit = unit_label(topic.get("unit"))
    hash_ = topic.get("hash") or f"#t/{tid}"

    parts = begin(
        "topic",
        tid,
        n,
        out_path.name,
        esc(f"{tid}: {title}"),
        esc(f"Short teaching slides -- Module {n}: {mod['title']}"),
    )
    parts.append("\\section{" + esc(tid) + " " + esc(title) + "}\n")

    # 1. This topic (meta)
    parts.append("\\begin{frame}{" + esc(tid) + ": " + esc(title) + "}\n")
    meta = [f"Official topic on Module {n} ({mod['title']})."]
    if unit:
        meta.append("Unit: " + unit + ".")
    if topic.get("essential"):
        meta.append("Essential topic on the official map.")
    hrs = hours_s(topic.get("hours"))
    if hrs:
        meta.append("Scheduled study time on the map: " + hrs + ".")
    if topic.get("activity"):
        meta.append("Activity type: " + str(topic["activity"]) + ".")
    parts.append("{\\small " + esc(" ".join(meta)) + "}\n\n")
    parts.append(
        "Work the checks on the site at {\\color{FSteal}\\texttt{"
        + esc(hash_)
        + "}}.\n"
    )
    parts.append("\\end{frame}\n\n")

    # 2. Why we open here
    bridge = refresh(fr.get("bridge") or "")
    if bridge.strip():
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Why we open here}\n")
        parts.append("\\begin{block}{The opening move}\n")
        parts.append(esc(bridge) + "\n")
        parts.append("\\end{block}\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    # 3. Linked outcomes
    if topic.get("ilos"):
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Linked learning outcomes}\n")
        parts.append(bullets(topic["ilos"], 6))
        parts.append("\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    # 4. The idea
    concept = refresh(fr.get("concept") or "")
    if concept.strip():
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{The idea, in brief}\n")
        parts.append("{\\footnotesize Condensed from the FlippedStat topic page; paraphrase for teaching, not a verbatim extract.}\n")
        parts.append("\\begin{block}{The idea}\n")
        parts.append(esc(concept) + "\n")
        parts.append("\\end{block}\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    # 5. How to read it
    interp = fr.get("interp") or []
    if isinstance(interp, str):
        interp = [interp] if interp.strip() else []
    interp = [refresh(x) for x in interp if x and str(x).strip()]
    if interp:
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{How to read it}\n")
        parts.append("\\begin{block}{Reading the result}\n")
        parts.append(bullets(interp, 5))
        parts.append("\n\\end{block}\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    # 5b. Official Hong Kong data or labelled-synthetic illustration (waves 1-5), if this topic has one.
    # These frames are stored in stage8/hk_official_frames.json so regeneration
    # does not drop hand-reviewed official-data slides.
    if tid in OFFICIAL_FRAMES:
        frame = OFFICIAL_FRAMES[tid].rstrip() + "\n\n"
        parts.append(frame)

    # 6. Common mistakes

    pitfalls = fr.get("pitfalls") or []
    if isinstance(pitfalls, str):
        pitfalls = [pitfalls] if pitfalls.strip() else []
    pitfalls = [refresh(x) for x in pitfalls if x and str(x).strip()]
    if pitfalls:
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Common mistakes}\n")
        parts.append("\\begin{alertblock}{Watch for}\n")
        parts.append(bullets(pitfalls, 5))
        parts.append("\n\\end{alertblock}\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    # 7. Subtopics / companion outline
    subs = topic.get("subs") or []
    outline = split_subs_text(topic.get("subs_text") or "")
    if subs:
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}[allowframebreaks]{Subtopics}\n")
        parts.append("{\\small Official subtopic list. Worked examples and checks stay on the site.}\n")
        parts.append("\\begin{itemize}\n")
        for s in subs:
            parts.append("  \\item \\textbf{" + esc(s.get("no") or "") + "} " + esc(s.get("title") or "") + "\n")
        parts.append("\\end{itemize}\n\\end{frame}\n\n")
    elif outline:
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{What you will work through}\n")
        parts.append("{\\small Outline taken from the official topic record. This short deck does not invent worked numbers.}\n")
        parts.append(bullets(outline, 8))
        parts.append("\n\\end{frame}\n\n")
    elif not (concept.strip() or interp or pitfalls or (fr.get("summary") or "").strip()):
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{On the site}\n")
        parts.append(
            "Teaching frames were thin in the extracted lesson fields for this topic, "
            "so the FlippedStat page is the source of depth. Open {\\color{FSteal}\\texttt{"
            + esc(hash_)
            + "}} for the worked path and verification steps.\n"
        )
        parts.append("\\end{frame}\n\n")

    # 8. Take-away
    summary = refresh(fr.get("summary") or "")
    if isinstance(summary, list):
        summary = " ".join(str(x) for x in summary if x)
    if summary.strip():
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Take-away}\n")
        parts.append("\\begin{exampleblock}{A short close}\n")
        parts.append(esc(summary) + "\n")
        parts.append("\\end{exampleblock}\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    # Closing check / next step
    parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Check / next step}\n")
    parts.append("\\begin{exampleblock}{Before you leave this topic}\n")
    parts.append("\\begin{itemize}\n")
    parts.append("  \\item Reopen {\\color{FSteal}\\texttt{" + esc(hash_) + "}} and complete the checks on the site.\n")
    if nxt:
        parts.append(
            "  \\item Next official topic in this module: \\textbf{"
            + esc(nxt["id"])
            + "} "
            + esc(nxt.get("title") or "")
            + ".\n"
        )
    else:
        parts.append("  \\item This is the last official topic in Module~" + str(n) + ".\n")
    parts.append("  \\item Official hours, KPIs, licences, placement cut scores and certificate wording are not redefined in these slides.\n")
    parts.append("\\end{itemize}\n\\end{exampleblock}\n")
    parts.append("\\end{frame}\n\n\\end{document}\n")

    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path.write_text("".join(parts), encoding="utf8")
    return frame_count(parts)


def write_overview(mod: dict, out_path: Path) -> int:
    n = mod["n"]
    topics = mod["topics"]
    first = topics[0] if topics else None
    parts = begin(
        "overview",
        f"M{n}",
        n,
        out_path.name,
        esc(f"Module {n}: {mod['title']}"),
        esc("Short overview slides -- FlippedStat draft"),
    )
    parts.append("\\section{Module " + str(n) + " overview}\n")

    parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Learning outcomes}\n")
    parts.append("{\\small Official outcomes for Module~" + str(n) + ".}\n")
    parts.append(bullets(mod.get("outcomes") or [], 6))
    parts.append("\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    parts.append("\\begin{frame}[allowframebreaks]{Official topics}\n")
    parts.append(
        "{\\small %d official topics on Module~%d. A module is complete when at least 80\\%% of its topics are marked done on the site.}\n"
        % (len(topics), n)
    )
    parts.append("\\begin{itemize}\n")
    for t in topics:
        flag = " {\\color{FSteal}\\textbf{(essential)}}" if t.get("essential") else ""
        hrs = hours_s(t.get("hours"))
        hrs = f" [{esc(hrs)}]" if hrs else ""
        parts.append(f"  \\item \\textbf{{{esc(t['id'])}}} {esc(t['title'])}{hrs}{flag}\n")
    parts.append("\\end{itemize}\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    if mod.get("essential"):
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Essential topics}\n")
        parts.append("{\\small These topics are marked essential on the official module map.}\n")
        parts.append(bullets(mod.get("essential") or [], 12))
        parts.append("\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    official_in_mod = [tp["id"] for tp in topics if tp["id"] in OFFICIAL_FRAMES]
    if official_in_mod:
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Hong Kong official-data illustrations}\n")
        parts.append("{\\footnotesize Official extracts already used on this module's short topic decks. Worked numbers are FlippedStat calculations unless a line says they are official published totals. Not a legal sign-off.}\n")
        parts.append("\\begin{itemize}\n")
        for oid in official_in_mod:
            title = next((tp.get("title") or "" for tp in topics if tp["id"] == oid), "")
            parts.append("  \\item \\textbf{" + esc(oid) + "} " + esc(title) + "\n")
        parts.append("\\end{itemize}\n\\end{frame}\n\n")

    if mod.get("checks"):
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Checks in this module}\n")
        parts.append(esc(mod["checks"]) + "\n")
        parts.append("\\end{frame}\n\n")

    if mod.get("note"):
        parts.append("\\begin{frame}[allowframebreaks]{Module note}\n")
        parts.append("{\\small " + esc(mod["note"]) + "}\n")
        parts.append("\\end{frame}\n\n")

    parts.append("\\begin{frame}{How this module is used}\n")
    parts.append(
        "{\\small Official reportable units are Modules 1--8. This short deck is a self-paced overview, "
        "to pair with the module overview video scaffold.}\n"
    )
    parts.append(CLOSING_HOWTO)
    parts.append("\\end{frame}\n\n")

    parts.append("\\begin{frame}{Check / next step}\n")
    parts.append("\\begin{exampleblock}{Start the module}\n")
    parts.append("\\begin{itemize}\n")
    if n == 1:
        parts.append(
            "  \\item Topic 1.1 includes the 20-item placement test at {\\color{FSteal}\\texttt{\\#placement}}. "
            "The test is available on the site; placement cut scores still await academic approval (H3), so routing stays advisory.\n"
        )
    if first:
        parts.append(
            "  \\item Open the first official topic: \\textbf{"
            + esc(first["id"])
            + "} "
            + esc(first.get("title") or "")
            + " at {\\color{FSteal}\\texttt{"
            + esc(first.get("hash") or f"#t/{first['id']}")
            + "}}.\n"
        )
    parts.append("  \\item Official hours, KPIs, licences, placement cut scores and certificate wording are not redefined in these slides.\n")
    parts.append("\\end{itemize}\n\\end{exampleblock}\n")
    parts.append("\\end{frame}\n\n\\end{document}\n")

    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path.write_text("".join(parts), encoding="utf8")
    return frame_count(parts)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--catalog", type=Path, default=CATALOG)
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=OUT_ROOT)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    data = json.loads(args.catalog.read_text(encoding="utf8"))
    args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    rows = []
    n_topic = 0
    n_ov = 0
    for mod in data["modules"]:
        if mod["n"] > 8:
            # Official folder is Modules 1-8 only. Module 9 is optional/unapproved (H1).
            continue
        slug = SLUG[mod["n"]]
        folder = args.out / f"M{mod['n']}"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        ov_name = f"M{mod['n']}_overview.tex"
        ov_path = folder / ov_name
        nframes = write_overview(mod, ov_path)
        rel = ov_path.relative_to(ROOT)
        rows.append(
            {
                "topic_id": f"M{mod['n']}-OV",
                "title": f"Module {mod['n']} overview: {mod['title']}",
                "module": mod["n"],
                "kind": "overview",
                "tex_path": str(rel).replace("\\", "/"),
                "frame_count": nframes,
                "compile_status": "not compiled",
            }
        )
        n_ov += 1
        print("wrote", rel, "frames", nframes)

        topics = mod["topics"]
        for i, t in enumerate(topics):
            nxt = topics[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(topics) else None
            fname = topic_filename(t["id"], t.get("title") or t["id"])
            path = folder / fname
            nframes = write_topic(mod, t, nxt, path)
            rel = path.relative_to(ROOT)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "topic_id": t["id"],
                    "title": t.get("title") or t["id"],
                    "module": mod["n"],
                    "kind": "topic",
                    "tex_path": str(rel).replace("\\", "/"),
                    "frame_count": nframes,
                    "compile_status": "not compiled",
                }
            )
            n_topic += 1
            print("wrote", rel, "frames", nframes)

    # Remove leftover .tex from earlier filename slugs, but never touch
    # files outside the topics/ tree and never the module-length decks.
    wanted = {ROOT / r["tex_path"] for r in rows}
    for old in args.out.rglob("*.tex"):
        if old.resolve() not in {p.resolve() for p in wanted}:
            old.unlink()
            print("removed leftover", old.relative_to(ROOT))

    man_csv = args.out / "manifest.csv"
    man_json = args.out / "manifest.json"
    fields = ["topic_id", "title", "module", "kind", "tex_path", "frame_count", "compile_status"]
    with man_csv.open("w", encoding="utf8", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields)
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)
    man_json.write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf8")
    print("done", n_topic, "topic decks,", n_ov, "overview decks")
    print("manifest", man_csv.relative_to(ROOT))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

========== END FILE: ws/stage8/slides/build_topic_tex.py ==========

#!/bin/sh
# Compile FlippedStat Beamer modules. Requires pdflatex or xelatex + beamer.
# Usage: sh compile_slides.sh
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
ENGINE=""
if command -v pdflatex >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ENGINE="pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode"
elif command -v xelatex >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ENGINE="xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode"
else
  echo "No TeX engine found. Install TeX Live with Beamer, then run:"
  echo "  pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode M1_Statistical_Thinking.tex"
  echo "  pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode M1_Statistical_Thinking.tex"
  exit 1
fi
for f in M1_Statistical_Thinking.tex M2_Descriptive_Statistics.tex \
         M3_Probability_Distributions.tex M4_Estimation_Hypothesis_Testing.tex \
         M5_Correlation_Regression.tex M6_Research_Design_Nonparametric.tex \
         M7_Time_Series_Forecasting.tex M8_Responsible_Ethical_AI.tex
do
  echo "=== $f ==="
  $ENGINE "$f"
  $ENGINE "$f"
done
echo "PDFs written in $(pwd)"

========== FILE: ws/stage8/slides/compile_topic_slides.sh ==========

#!/bin/sh
# Compile short FlippedStat per-topic Beamer decks.
# Usage:
#   sh compile_topic_slides.sh                 # all official topic + overview decks
#   sh compile_topic_slides.sh sample          # one overview + one rich topic + one thin topic
#   sh compile_topic_slides.sh M1/T-1.1_Course_map_and_placement.tex
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
ENGINE=""
if command -v pdflatex >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ENGINE="pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode"
elif command -v xelatex >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ENGINE="xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode"
else
  echo "No TeX engine found. Install TeX Live with Beamer, then run this script again."
  echo "A typical Debian/Ubuntu install is:"
  echo "  sudo apt-get install texlive-latex-recommended texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended"
  exit 1
fi

run_one() {
  rel="$1"
  dir=$(dirname "$rel")
  base=$(basename "$rel")
  echo "=== $rel ==="
  (cd "$dir" && $ENGINE "$base" >/tmp/fs_topic_tex_compile.log 2>&1 && $ENGINE "$base" >/tmp/fs_topic_tex_compile.log 2>&1) || {
    echo "COMPILE FAILED: $rel"
    tail -n 40 /tmp/fs_topic_tex_compile.log
    return 1
  }
}

SAMPLE="topics/M1/M1_overview.tex topics/M1/T-1.1_Course_map_and_placement.tex topics/M6/T-C4.1_Case_study_do_stents_prevent_strokes.tex"

if [ "${1:-}" = "sample" ]; then
  set -- $SAMPLE
elif [ -n "${1:-}" ]; then
  :
else
  # all official decks listed in the manifest
  set -- $(python3 -c "import csv; print(' '.join(r['tex_path'].split('stage8/slides/',1)[-1] if 'stage8/slides/' in r['tex_path'] else 'topics/'+r['tex_path'].split('topics/',1)[-1] for r in csv.DictReader(open('topics/manifest.csv'))))")
fi

fail=0
for f in "$@"; do
  case "$f" in
    topics/*) rel="$f" ;;
    *) rel="topics/$f" ;;
  esac
  run_one "$rel" || fail=$((fail+1))
done
if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "$fail compile failure(s)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "PDFs written beside the .tex sources under topics/"

========== END FILE: ws/stage8/slides/compile_topic_slides.sh ==========


========== FILE: ws/stage8/slides/fix_unicode_tex.py ==========

"""Apply unicode_fold.fold() to every Beamer .tex under stage8/slides (idempotent)."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from unicode_fold import fold
root = Path(__file__).parent
changed = 0
for f in sorted(root.glob("**/*.tex")):
    t = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    new = "".join(l if l.lstrip().startswith("%") else fold(l) for l in t.splitlines(True))
    if new != t:
        f.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8"); changed += 1
print(f"files changed: {changed}")

========== END FILE: ws/stage8/slides/fix_unicode_tex.py ==========

========== FILE: ws/stage8/slides/unicode_fold.py ==========

"""Fold Unicode math glyphs that pdflatex + inputenc[utf8] cannot typeset.

Added 2026-11-18 (Copilot, v10.9-dev slide pass). Wording unchanged; only glyph
encoding changes (n₁ -> n$_{1}$, p̂ -> $\\hat{p}$, √n -> $\\sqrt{n}$).
Used by build_tex.esc() and by fix_unicode_tex.py for existing .tex files.
"""
import re

MATH = {
    "₀": "_{0}", "₁": "_{1}", "₂": "_{2}", "₃": "_{3}", "ₖ": "_{k}", "ₙ": "_{n}",
    "ᵢ": "_{i}", "₋": "_{-}", "ₙ₋₁": "_{n-1}", "ₐ": r"_{\alpha/2}",
    "ᵐ": "^{m}", "ᵏ": "^{k}",
    "√": r"\sqrt{}", "∩": r"\cap ", "∪": r"\cup ", "Σ": r"\Sigma ",
    "Δ": r"\Delta ", "ε": r"\varepsilon ", "η": r"\eta ",
    "ȳ": r"\bar{y}", "ŷ": r"\hat{y}",
}
COMBINING = {"\u0302": r"\hat", "\u0304": r"\bar"}
TEXT = {"\u2019": "'", "\u2014": "---"}


def fold(s: str) -> str:
    for k, v in TEXT.items():
        s = s.replace(k, v)
    for comb, acc in COMBINING.items():  # "$\theta$̂" -> "$\hat{\theta}$"
        s = re.sub(r"\$(\\[A-Za-z]+)\$" + comb, lambda m: "$" + acc + "{" + m.group(1) + "}$", s)
    s = re.sub(r"₁₋(?:α|\$\\alpha\$)/₂", "₁₋ₐ", s)  # z₁₋α/₂
    out, math, i = [], False, 0
    while i < len(s):
        ch = s[i]
        if ch == "$" and (i == 0 or s[i - 1] != "\\"):
            math = not math; out.append(ch); i += 1; continue
        rep, step = None, 1
        if i + 1 < len(s) and s[i + 1] in COMBINING:
            rep = COMBINING[s[i + 1]] + "{" + ch + "}"; step = 2
        elif s.startswith("ₙ₋₁", i):
            rep = MATH["ₙ₋₁"]; step = 3
        elif ch in MATH:
            rep = MATH[ch]
        if rep is None:
            out.append(ch); i += 1; continue
        out.append(rep if math else "$" + rep + "$"); i += step
    s = "".join(out)
    s = re.sub(r"(?<!\\)\$\$", "", s)  # "$\chi$$^{2}$" -> "$\chi^{2}$"
    while True:  # _{1}_{-} -> _{1-}
        t = re.sub(r"_\{([^{}]*)\}_\{([^{}]*)\}", r"_{\1\2}", s)
        t = re.sub(r"\^\{([^{}]*)\}\^\{([^{}]*)\}", r"^{\1\2}", t)
        if t == s: break
        s = t
    s = re.sub(r"\\sqrt\{\}\$([A-Za-z0-9]+)", r"\\sqrt{\1}$", s)
    return s.replace(r"\sqrt{}", r"\surd ")

========== END FILE: ws/stage8/slides/unicode_fold.py ==========


========== FILE: ws/tools/a11y98.py ==========

"""Stage 7 (WP8): automated WCAG 2.2 AA audit with axe-core 4.10.2 (MPL-2.0, vendored in tools/vendor) + custom checks.
Usage: python tools/a11y98.py <html> <out.json> [routes|all]
Per route: axe violations (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa tags) with nodes; reflow at 320 px; 200% zoom (640 px);
keyboard: first 40 Tab stops have a visible focus indicator and are not obscured; reduced-motion respected."""
import sys, json, asyncio, pathlib
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
HTML, OUT = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
AXE = open('tools/vendor/axe-4.10.2.min.js', encoding='utf8').read()
SAMPLE = ['a11y', 'home', 'modules', 'm/1', 'm/8', 'pathways', 'tiers', 'map', 'ledger', 'lib', 'books', 'about', 'status', 'licence', 'release',
          'assess', 'assess/3/pre', 'm8kit', 'm8kit/quiz', 'm8kit/survey/pre', 'm8kit/lab', 'm8kit/disclose', 'search/regression',
          't/1.2', 't/3.3', 't/5.9', 't/7.6', 't/8.1', 't/10.3', 't/12.2', 't/13.6', 't/E2.7', 't/E3.4', 't/E5.6', 't/E5.12', 't/C1.1', 't/C3.1', 'u/W4']
async def main():
    mode = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 'sample'
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome')
        pg = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
        await pg.goto(pathlib.Path(HTML).resolve().as_uri(), timeout=180000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(3500)
        await pg.add_script_tag(content=AXE)
        routes = SAMPLE if mode == 'sample' else (await pg.evaluate("FS.units.flatMap(u=>u.topics.map(t=>'t/'+t.no))") if mode == 'all' else mode.split(','))
        res = {}
        for r in routes:
            await pg.set_viewport_size({'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
            await pg.evaluate(f"location.hash='#{r}'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1300)
            await pg.evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500); await pg.evaluate("window.scrollTo(0,0)"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            ax = await pg.evaluate("""async () => { const r = await axe.run(document, {runOnly: {type: 'tag', values: ['wcag2a','wcag2aa','wcag21a','wcag21aa','wcag22aa']}, resultTypes: ['violations']});
              return r.violations.map(v => ({id: v.id, impact: v.impact, help: v.help, tags: v.tags.filter(t => /^wcag\\d/.test(t)), n: v.nodes.length,
                nodes: v.nodes.slice(0, 4).map(n => ({t: n.target.join(' '), h: n.html.slice(0, 160), s: (n.failureSummary || '').slice(0, 200)}))})); }""")
            kb = await pg.evaluate("""async () => { document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur(); return true; }""")
            stops = []
            for _ in range(0 if mode == 'all' else 40):
                await pg.keyboard.press('Tab')
                stops.append(await pg.evaluate("""() => { const e = document.activeElement; if (!e || e === document.body) return null; const cs = getComputedStyle(e), r = e.getBoundingClientRect();
                  const vis = (cs.outlineStyle !== 'none' && parseFloat(cs.outlineWidth) > 0) || cs.boxShadow !== 'none' || e.matches(':focus-visible') && (cs.outlineStyle !== 'none' || cs.boxShadow !== 'none');
                  const top = document.elementFromPoint(Math.min(innerWidth - 1, Math.max(0, r.left + r.width / 2)), Math.min(innerHeight - 1, Math.max(0, r.top + Math.min(r.height / 2, 8))));
                  return {tag: e.tagName, txt: (e.innerText || e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.value || '').slice(0, 40), outline: vis, size: [Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)],
                          obscured: r.bottom > 0 && r.top < innerHeight && top && !e.contains(top) && !top.contains(e)}; }"""))
            flow = {}
            for w in (320, 640):
                await pg.set_viewport_size({'width': w, 'height': 800}); await pg.wait_for_timeout(500)
                flow[w] = await pg.evaluate("""() => { const W = document.documentElement.clientWidth; const off = [...document.querySelectorAll('#main *')].filter(e => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!r.width) return false;
                    let p = e.parentElement; while (p && p.id !== 'main') { const o = getComputedStyle(p).overflowX; if (o === 'auto' || o === 'scroll' || o === 'hidden') return false; p = p.parentElement; } return r.right > W + 1; });
                  return {page_scroll: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > W + 1, offenders: off.slice(0, 5).map(e => e.tagName + '.' + (typeof e.className === 'string' ? e.className : '') + ' ' + Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().right))}; }""")
            res[r] = dict(axe=ax, keyboard=[s for s in stops if s], reflow=flow)
            print(r, 'axe', sum(v['n'] for v in ax), [v['id'] for v in ax], 'reflow320', flow[320]['page_scroll'], flow[320]['offenders'][:2], flush=True)
        await b.close()
    json.dump(res, open(OUT, 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=0)

"""Collect every distinct colour-contrast failure (fg, bg, size, selector class) across routes. Usage: python tools/a11y_contrast.py <html> <out.json> [all]"""
import sys, json, asyncio, pathlib
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
sys.argv += [''] * 2
HTML, OUT, MODE = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
AXE = open('tools/vendor/axe-4.10.2.min.js', encoding='utf8').read()
import importlib.util; spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('a', 'tools/a11y98.py')
SAMPLE = ['home', 'modules', 'm/1', 'm/8', 'pathways', 'tiers', 'map', 'ledger', 'lib', 'books', 'about', 'status', 'licence', 'release', 'assess', 'assess/3/pre',
          'm8kit', 'm8kit/quiz', 'm8kit/survey/pre', 'm8kit/lab', 'm8kit/disclose', 'search/regression', 'u/W4', 'u/E5']
async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome')
        pg = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
        await pg.goto(pathlib.Path(HTML).resolve().as_uri(), timeout=180000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(3500); await pg.add_script_tag(content=AXE)
        tops = await pg.evaluate("FS.units.flatMap(u=>u.topics.map(t=>'t/'+t.no))")
        routes = SAMPLE + (tops if MODE == 'all' else tops[::6])
        agg = {}; per = {}
        for r in routes:
            await pg.evaluate(f"location.hash='#{r}'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(900)
            v = await pg.evaluate("""async () => { const r = await axe.run('#main, nav, header, footer', {runOnly: {type: 'rule', values: ['color-contrast']}, resultTypes: ['violations']});
              const out = []; r.violations.forEach(v => v.nodes.forEach(n => { const d = (n.any[0] || {}).data || {}; const el = document.querySelector(n.target[0]);
                out.push([d.fgColor, d.bgColor, d.contrastRatio, d.fontSize, d.fontWeight, el ? (el.className && typeof el.className === 'string' ? el.className : el.tagName) + ' < ' + (el.parentElement ? (typeof el.parentElement.className === 'string' ? el.parentElement.className : '') : '') : n.target[0]]); })); return out; }""")
            per[r] = len(v)
            for fg, bg, cr, fs, fw, cls in v:
                k = f'{fg}|{bg}'; a = agg.setdefault(k, {'fg': fg, 'bg': bg, 'ratio': cr, 'n': 0, 'cls': {}, 'size': fs, 'weight': fw}); a['n'] += 1; a['cls'][cls[:70]] = a['cls'].get(cls[:70], 0) + 1
        await b.close()
    json.dump({'pairs': agg, 'per_route': per}, open(OUT, 'w'), indent=0)
    print(len(routes), 'routes;', sum(per.values()), 'nodes;', len(agg), 'colour pairs')
    for k, a in sorted(agg.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]['n']): print(a['n'], a['fg'], a['bg'], a['ratio'], a['size'], a['weight'], list(a['cls'].items())[:3])
asyncio.run(main())

========== FILE: ws/tools/a11y_palette.py ==========

"""Compute the minimal darkening of each failing palette colour so that its contrast is ≥ 4.6:1 against white and against every
light tint it is used on (and white text on it ≥ 4.6:1). Output: content/a11y_palette.json (old → new)."""
import json
def lum(h):
    c = [int(h[i:i + 2], 16) / 255 for i in (0, 2, 4)]
    c = [x / 12.92 if x <= 0.03928 else ((x + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4 for x in c]
    return 0.2126 * c[0] + 0.7152 * c[1] + 0.0722 * c[2]
def ratio(a, b): la, lb = sorted((lum(a), lum(b)), reverse=True); return (la + 0.05) / (lb + 0.05)
BG = ['ffffff', 'eaf2ff', 'eef8f9', 'f0f3f8', 'fff4ec', 'ecf8ef', 'e4f4ea', 'f4f8f7', 'f3f7fa', 'fff3df', 'fff1d6', 'f6f7fb']
FAIL = ['78909c', '2f8f9d', 'b8862f', '2f9e44', 'e8590c', '1f6feb', '4f7cac', '2e7d4f', '2e8b57', 'b26b00', '3d8b5a', '6b7a90', 'e65100', '7a5ea8', '7a4a00', '5b6676']
out = {}
for h in FAIL:
    f = 1.0; cur = h
    while min(ratio(cur, b) for b in BG) < 4.6 and f > 0.2:
        f -= 0.01; cur = ''.join(f'{max(0, round(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) * f)):02x}' for i in (0, 2, 4))
    out[h] = dict(new=cur, before=round(min(ratio(h, b) for b in BG), 2), after=round(min(ratio(cur, b) for b in BG), 2))
json.dump(out, open('content/a11y_palette.json', 'w'), indent=1)
for k, v in out.items(): print(k, '→', v['new'], v['before'], '→', v['after'])

========== END FILE: ws/tools/a11y_palette.py ==========

"""Headless pass over every topic page of v9.3: console/page errors and rendering counts. Output logs/full_check_v9.3.txt"""
import sys, json, asyncio, pathlib
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome')
        pg = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900}); errs = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e))); pg.on('console', lambda m: errs.append(m.text) if m.type == 'error' else None)
        await pg.goto(pathlib.Path('build/FlippedStat_v9.3_standalone.html').resolve().as_uri(), timeout=180000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(3500)
        tops = await pg.evaluate("FS.units.flatMap(u=>u.topics.map(t=>t.no))")
        out = []; bad = 0
        for t in tops:
            n0 = len(errs); await pg.evaluate(f"location.hash='#t/{t}'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(700)
            info = await pg.evaluate("() => ({c: document.querySelector('#main').innerText.length, l: document.querySelectorAll('article.lesson').length, raw: /\\\\\\(|\\\\\\[/.test(document.querySelector('#main').innerText)})")
            e = errs[n0:]; bad += bool(e) or info['c'] < 300
            out.append(f"{'FAIL' if e or info['c']<300 else 'ok'}\t{t}\tchars {info['c']}\tlessons {info['l']}\t{'; '.join(e)[:200]}")
        await b.close()
    open('logs/full_check_v9.3.txt', 'w').write(f'v9.3 full headless pass: {len(tops)} topic pages, {bad} with errors or empty\n' + '\n'.join(out) + '\n')
    print(len(tops), 'pages', bad, 'bad')
asyncio.run(main())

========== FILE: ws/tools/arith_audit.py ==========

"""Stage 3g: arithmetic audit of Week 1, electives E1–E4 and clinics C2–C4 (lesson cards, topic content, “Learn it in depth” stages).
Finds simple stated calculations and recomputes them: a op b = c (op in + − × / ÷), e^x = c, k of n (p%), 1 − p = q, √x = c.
A flag means the printed result differs from the recomputation beyond the rounding of the printed value. Output: logs/arith_audit_v9.4.md"""
import json, re, math, sys
s = open(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'build/FlippedStat_v9.3_standalone.html', encoding='utf8').read()
g = lambda n: json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(s, s.index(f'window.{n}=') + len(f'window.{n}='))[0]
FS, FA = g('FS'), g('FSA_DATA')
UNITS = ('W1', 'E1', 'E2', 'E3', 'E4', 'C2', 'C3', 'C4')
import os
SCOPE = os.environ.get('SCOPE', 'part')
keep = (lambda no: True) if SCOPE == 'all' else (lambda no: any(no.startswith(p) for p in ('1.', 'E1.', 'E2.', 'E3.', 'E4.', 'C2.', 'C3.', 'C4.')))
texts = []
def walk(o, where):
    if isinstance(o, str): texts.append((where, re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', o)))
    elif isinstance(o, list): [walk(x, where) for x in o]
    elif isinstance(o, dict): [walk(v, where) for k, v in o.items() if k not in ('src', 'fig', 'emb', 'viz', 'comesback')]
for no, L in FS['lessons'].items():
    if keep(no): walk(L, 'L:' + no)
for no, C in FS['content'].items():
    if keep(no): walk(C, 'C:' + no)
for no, A in FA['lessons'].items():
    if keep(no): walk(A, 'A:' + no)
NUM = r'(−?-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)'
def f(x): return float(x.replace(',', '').replace('−', '-'))
def tol(c): d = len(c.split('.')[1]) if '.' in c else 0; return 0.5 * 10 ** -d + 1e-9
flags, checked = [], 0
pat = re.compile(NUM + r'\s*([+\-−×x*/÷])\s*' + NUM + r'\s*=\s*' + NUM + r'(\s*%)?(?!\s*[×x*/÷+])')
for w, t in texts:
    t2 = t.replace('\u2009', ' ').replace('\xa0', ' ')
    for m in pat.finditer(t2):
        a, op, b, c, pc = m.groups()
        pre = t2[max(0, m.start() - 2):m.start()]
        if re.search(r'[\d.)/^+\-−×x*÷]', pre.strip()[-1:] or ''):  # part of a longer expression; skip
            continue
        try: A, B, Cc = f(a), f(b), f(c)
        except ValueError: continue
        r = {'+': A + B, '-': A - B, '−': A - B, '×': A * B, 'x': A * B, '*': A * B, '/': A / B if B else math.nan, '÷': A / B if B else math.nan}[op]
        if pc: r *= 100
        checked += 1
        if abs(r - Cc) > max(tol(c), abs(Cc) * 0.005):
            flags.append((w, m.group(0), round(r, 6), t2[max(0, m.start() - 70):m.end() + 40]))
    for m in re.finditer(r'e\^?\{?\s*(−?-?\d*\.?\d+)\s*\}?\s*=\s*' + NUM, t2):
        x, c = m.groups(); checked += 1; r = math.exp(f(x))
        if abs(r - f(c)) > max(tol(c), abs(f(c)) * 0.005): flags.append((w, m.group(0), round(r, 6), t2[max(0, m.start() - 70):m.end() + 40]))
    for m in re.finditer(r'\b(\d+) (?:of|out of) (\d[\d,]*)\s*\(\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%\)', t2):
        k, n, p = m.groups(); checked += 1; r = 100 * f(k) / f(n)
        if abs(r - f(p)) > tol(p) + 1e-9: flags.append((w, m.group(0), round(r, 3), t2[max(0, m.start() - 70):m.end() + 40]))
    for m in re.finditer(r'√\s*\(?\s*' + NUM + r'\s*\)?\s*=\s*' + NUM, t2):
        x, c = m.groups(); checked += 1; r = math.sqrt(f(x))
        if abs(r - f(c)) > max(tol(c), abs(f(c)) * 0.005): flags.append((w, m.group(0), round(r, 6), t2[max(0, m.start() - 70):m.end() + 40]))
out = [f'# Arithmetic audit (stage 3g) — Week 1, E1–E4, C2–C4\n\nStated calculations recomputed: **{checked}**. Flags: **{len(flags)}**.\n',
       '| Where | Printed | Recomputed | Context |', '|---|---|---|---|']
out += [f'| {w} | `{e}` | {r} | {ctx.replace("|", "/")} |' for w, e, r, ctx in flags]
open(os.environ.get('OUT', 'logs/arith_audit_v9.4.md'), 'w', encoding='utf8').write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')
print(checked, 'checked;', len(flags), 'flags')
for x in flags: print(x[0], '|', x[1], '| recomputed', x[2], '|', x[3][:150])

========== END FILE: ws/tools/arith_audit.py ==========

"""v10.0-dev -> v10.1-dev: inject the optional in-browser R engine (WebR).
Does not modify build/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html or
build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html.
Usage: python tools/assemble_v101dev.py
"""
import json, sys, os, base64, urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path

SRC = 'build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html'
OUT = 'build/FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html'
LOG = []

def js(o):
    return json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False).replace('</', '<\\/')

def collect_csvs(html):
    files = {}
    rev = Path('build/rev90_files.json')
    if rev.exists():
        for k, v in json.loads(rev.read_text(encoding='utf8')).items():
            if k.endswith('.csv'):
                files[k] = v
    i = html.find('window.FSR_DATA=')
    if i < 0:
        raise SystemExit('FSR_DATA not found in source HTML')
    j = html.find(',"dl":', i)
    if j < 0:
        raise SystemExit('FSR_DATA.dl not found')
    k = html.find('{', j)
    obj, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(html[k:])
    for k, v in obj.items():
        add_file(files, k, v)
    # E5 time-series CSVs live in a separate "files" object (plain text, not data: URLs).
    start = 0
    while True:
        i = html.find('"files":{', start)
        if i < 0:
            break
        try:
            blob, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(html[i + 8:])
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            start = i + 1
            continue
        if isinstance(blob, dict) and any(str(k).endswith('.csv') for k in blob):
            for k, v in blob.items():
                add_file(files, k, v)
        start = i + 1
    return files

def add_file(files, k, v):
    if not str(k).endswith('.csv') or not isinstance(v, str):
        return
    if v.startswith('data:'):
        header, payload = v.split(',', 1)
        if 'base64' in header:
            text = base64.b64decode(payload).decode('utf-8')
        else:
            text = urllib.parse.unquote(payload)
        files[k] = text
    else:
        files[k] = v

s = open(SRC, encoding='utf8').read()

        raise SystemExit(f'patch anchor found {c}x (expected {n}): {a[:120]}')
    s = s.replace(a, b)
    LOG.append('- patched: ' + a[:90].replace('\n', ' '))

"""v10.1-dev -> v10.2-dev: labelled ModernDive-inspired interactives (FSINT).
Does not modify build/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html,
build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html, or
build/FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html.
Usage: python tools/assemble_v102dev.py
"""
import csv, io, json, os
from pathlib import Path

SRC = "build/FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html"
OUT = "build/FlippedStat_v10.2-dev_standalone.html"
LOG = []

def js(o):
    return json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False).replace("</", "<\\/")

def load_csvs():
    rev = json.loads(Path("build/rev90_files.json").read_text(encoding="utf8"))
    sleep_raw = []
    sleep_clean = []
    for line in rev["sleep_column.csv"].splitlines()[1:]:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        val = line.split(",", 1)[1].strip()
        sleep_raw.append(val)
        if val == "" or val.upper() == "NA":
            continue
        try:
            x = float(val)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if x != -99:
            sleep_clean.append(x)
    sat = []
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(rev["satisfaction300.csv"]))
    for row in reader:
        try:
            x = float(row["study_hours_week"])
            y = float(row["satisfaction"])
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        fac = (row.get("faculty") or "").strip()
        if not fac:
            continue
        sat.append({"x": x, "y": y, "g": fac})
    return {
        "sleep": sleep_raw,
        "sleep_clean": sleep_clean,
        "sat": sat,
        "source_files": ["sleep_column.csv", "satisfaction300.csv"],
    }
