========== FILE: ws/tools/assemble_v104dev.py ==========

"""v10.3-dev -> v10.4-dev: official C&SD / data.gov.hk extracts and first-wave lesson edits.

Reads build/FlippedStat_v10.3-dev_standalone.html read-only.
Writes build/FlippedStat_v10.4-dev_standalone.html only.

Does not modify:
  build/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.2-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.3-dev_standalone.html

Does not change placement cut scores, certificate wording, KPI definitions,
official module structure, or original textbook-licence wording. Does not
ship hkdatasets microdata.

Usage:
  python tools/hk_local_data.py --merge-rev90   # append official extracts (once)
  python tools/assemble_v104dev.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC = ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.3-dev_standalone.html"
OUT = ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.4-dev_standalone.html"
FROZEN = [
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html",
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html",
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html",
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.2-dev_standalone.html",
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.3-dev_standalone.html",
]

# First-wave lessons that actually received official-extract teaching text.
CHANGED = ["2.1.4", "2.2.1", "4.1.1", "4.2.1", "4.4.3", "E5.2.1"]
RFIRST_MARKERS = ("fsr-inline fsr-rsrc", "fsr-jamlab")
LOG: list[str] = []

# Official extract filenames produced by tools/hk_local_data.py (no hkdatasets microdata).
HK_FILES = [
    "hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv",
    "hk_district_profile_2016_2025_codebook.md",
    "hk_district_population_110-02001.csv",
    "hk_district_population_110-02001_codebook.md",
    "hk_district_household_130-06806.csv",
    "hk_district_household_130-06806_codebook.md",
    "hk_district_lookup.csv",
    "hk_district_lookup_codebook.md",
    "hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001.csv",
    "hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001_codebook.md",
    "DATA_SOURCES_AND_LICENCE.md",
]
HKDATASETS_BANNED = ("hkdc", "casualty", "street_name", "hkdatasets")


def load_module(name: str, path: Path):
    sp = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp)
    sp.loader.exec_module(m)
    return m


def grab(html: str, marker: str):
    i = html.find(marker)
    if i < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing marker {marker}")
    i += len(marker)
    j = html.find("</script>", i)
    if j < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"no </script> after {marker}")
    raw = html[i:j]
    obj, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw)
    return obj, i, i + end, raw[end:]


def put(html: str, start: int, end: int, tail: str, blob: str) -> str:
    return html[:start] + blob + tail + html[end:]


def dump_fsa(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).replace("</", "<\\/")


def dump_fsr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def dump_webr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)


def leading_rfirst(body):
    lead, rest = [], list(body or [])
    while rest and isinstance(rest[0], str) and any(m in rest[0] for m in RFIRST_MARKERS):
        lead.append(rest.pop(0))
    return lead, rest


def merge_lesson(old: dict, new: dict) -> dict:
    """Overlay first-wave source text onto the shipped lesson, keeping later patches.

    Later v9.x layers added optional Think Stats pyroute stages, extra TS: src
    ids, and leading R-first / jamovi-lab blocks. The absorb / e5 source files
    do not contain those patches. Dropping them would be a regression.
    """
    merged = deepcopy(new)
    src = list(new.get("src") or [])
    for i in old.get("src") or []:
        if i not in src:
            src.append(i)
    merged["src"] = src
    if "intro" in old and "intro" not in merged:
        merged["intro"] = old["intro"]

    def skey(st):
        return (st.get("k"), st.get("h"))

    new_stages = list(merged.get("stages") or [])
    new_by = {skey(st): st for st in new_stages}
    # If a heading was rewritten (same kind, unique on both sides), map old key -> new stage.
    from collections import Counter
    new_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in new_stages)
    old_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in (old.get("stages") or []))
    new_by_kind = {st.get("k"): st for st in new_stages}
    out = []
    used = set()
    for ost in old.get("stages") or []:
        k = skey(ost)
        kind = ost.get("k")
        if kind == "pyroute":
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = None
        if k in new_by:
            nst = new_by[k]
        elif old_k_counts[kind] == 1 and new_k_counts.get(kind) == 1:
            # Heading-only change, e.g. 4.1.1 basics US-county title -> HK districts.
            nst = new_by_kind[kind]
        if nst is None:
            # Standalone-only stage that the source file does not carry (keep it).
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = deepcopy(nst)
        old_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(ost.get("body") or [])
        new_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(nst.get("body") or [])
        if old_lead and not new_lead:
            nst["body"] = old_lead + list(nst.get("body") or [])
        out.append(nst)
        used.add(skey(nst))
    for nst in new_stages:
        if skey(nst) not in used and skey(nst) not in {skey(s) for s in out}:
            out.append(deepcopy(nst))
    merged["stages"] = out
    return merged


def data_url(text: str) -> str:
    return "data:text/plain;charset=utf-8;base64," + base64.b64encode(text.encode("utf-8")).decode()


def official_files() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Prefer the merged rev90 bundle; fall back to hk_files.json / extracts dir."""
    files: dict[str, str] = {}
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if rev_path.exists():
        rev = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name in rev:
                files[name] = rev[name]
    if hk_path.exists():
        hk = json.loads(hk_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            files.setdefault(name, hk[name] if name in hk else None)
            if files.get(name) is None:
                files.pop(name, None)
            elif name not in files:
                files[name] = hk[name]
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name not in files and name in hk:
                files[name] = hk[name]
    extract_dir = ROOT / "content" / "data" / "hk_extracts"
    for name in HK_FILES:
        if name not in files:
            p = extract_dir / name
            if p.exists():
                files[name] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    missing = [n for n in HK_FILES if n not in files]
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit(
            "official extract files missing (run python tools/hk_local_data.py --merge-rev90): "
            + ", ".join(missing)
        )
    for name, text in files.items():
        low = name.lower() + "\n" + text.lower()[:500]
        for banned in HKDATASETS_BANNED:
            if banned in name.lower():
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to ship banned hkdatasets filename {name}")
    return files


def rebuild_lessons(fsa: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Rebuild only the first-wave lessons from content sources; leave the rest byte-stable."""
    notes = []
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    w02 = load_module("absorb_w02", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w02.py")
    w04 = load_module("absorb_w04", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w04.py")
    source = {}
    source.update(w02.A)
    source.update(w04.A)

    e5_path = ROOT / "build" / "e5_data.json"
    if not e5_path.exists():
        # Reconstruct N from the shipped v10.3 FST_DATA so e5_content can import
        # without re-running ts_data.py (avoids statsmodels drift on keyed numbers).
        raise SystemExit("build/e5_data.json missing; assembler expects a stub from FST_DATA")
    e5 = load_module("e5_content", ROOT / "content" / "e5_content.py")
    source["E5.2.1"] = e5.FSA["E5.2.1"]

    lessons = fsa["lessons"]
    for no in CHANGED:
        if no not in lessons:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from standalone FSA_DATA")
        if no not in source:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from content sources")
        merged = merge_lesson(lessons[no], source[no])
        lessons[no] = merged
        n_body = sum(len(st.get("body") or []) for st in merged.get("stages") or [])
        notes.append(f"- FSA lesson {no}: merged official-extract source text; stages {len(merged['stages'])}, body pieces {n_body}")
    # Do not rewrite absorbed / deferred lists: src ids were only added, not removed.
    return notes


def maybe_merge_rev90():
    """Idempotent append of official extracts into build/rev90_files.json."""
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if not hk_path.exists():
        LOG.append("- hk_files.json missing; running tools/hk_local_data.py")
        import runpy
        import sys
        sys.argv = ["hk_local_data.py"]
        # build() writes hk_files; we'll merge below
        from tools import hk_local_data as hkd  # may fail if not a package

    if not rev_path.exists():
        raise SystemExit("missing build/rev90_files.json; run python tools/rev90_data.py first")
    current = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    hk = official_files()
    added = []
    for name, text in hk.items():
        if name in current:
            if current[name] != text:
                raise SystemExit(f"existing rev90 key {name} differs from official extract; refusing to overwrite")
        else:
            current[name] = text
            added.append(name)
    if added:
        rev_path.write_text(json.dumps(current, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        LOG.append(f"- merged {len(added)} official extract files into build/rev90_files.json: {', '.join(added)}")
    else:
        LOG.append("- build/rev90_files.json already contains official extract keys; left unchanged")
    return {k: current[k] for k in HK_FILES}


FSA_DL_HOOK = """<script>/* FlippedStat v10.4-dev: resolve fsr-dl download hooks inside absorbed lesson HTML (FSA). */
(function(){
  if(!window.FSA||!FSA.html)return;
  const orig=FSA.html;
  FSA.html=function(no){
    const h=orig(no);
    const dl=(window.FSR_DATA&&FSR_DATA.dl)||{};
    return h.replace(/<div class="fsr-dl" data-f="([^"]+)"><\\/div>/g,(m,f)=>dl[f]?`<a class="btn sm fsr-dlbtn" download="${f}" href="${dl[f]}">⬇ ${f}</a>`:`<span class="warn">missing file ${f}</span>`);
  };
})();
</script>
"""

FSA_HOOK_ANCHOR = (
    "window.FSA = { html, mount, absorbed: id => ABS.has(id), data: D };\n"
    "})();\n</script>\n"
    "<script>/* FlippedStat v9.1 revision layer (FSR)."
)


def P(html: str, a: str, b: str, n: int = 1) -> str:
    c = html.count(a)
    if c != n:
        raise SystemExit(f"patch anchor found {c}x (expected {n}): {a[:140]}")
    LOG.append("- patched: " + a[:90].replace("\n", " "))
    return html.replace(a, b)


def main():
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    if not SRC.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing source {SRC}")
    for p in FROZEN:
        if not p.exists():
            raise SystemExit(f"missing frozen/prior file {p}")
        if p.resolve() == OUT.resolve():
            raise SystemExit("refusing to write over a frozen/prior standalone")

    s = SRC.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "v10.3-dev" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("source does not look like v10.3-dev")

    files = maybe_merge_rev90()

    # --- FSA_DATA: first-wave lessons only ---
    fsa, a0, a1, atail = grab(s, "window.FSA_DATA=")
    notes = rebuild_lessons(fsa)
    LOG.extend(notes)
    s = put(s, a0, a1, atail, dump_fsa(fsa))
    # Confirm the official phrases are now in the FSA blob.
    fsa_blob = dump_fsa(fsa)
    for phrase in (
        "hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv",
        "110-02001",
        "130-06806",
        "510-60001",
        "hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001.csv",
        "HK$30,350",
        "HK$33,800",
        "−0.38",
    ):
        if phrase not in fsa_blob and phrase not in s:
            raise SystemExit(f"expected phrase missing after FSA rebuild: {phrase}")

    # --- FSA.html fsr-dl hook (cards() already resolved downloads; FSA did not) ---
    if FSA_HOOK_ANCHOR not in s:
        raise SystemExit("FSA hook anchor not found")
    if s.count(FSA_HOOK_ANCHOR) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("FSA hook anchor not unique")
    s = s.replace(
        FSA_HOOK_ANCHOR,
        "window.FSA = { html, mount, absorbed: id => ABS.has(id), data: D };\n"
        "})();\n</script>\n"
        + FSA_DL_HOOK
        + "<script>/* FlippedStat v9.1 revision layer (FSR).",
        1,
    )
    LOG.append("- injected FSA.html fsr-dl resolver (download buttons in Learn-it-in-depth stages)")

    # --- FSR_DATA: licence + official files in dl ---
    fsr, b0, b1, btail = grab(s, "window.FSR_DATA=")
    rev90 = load_module("rev90", ROOT / "content" / "rev90.py")
    old_lic = fsr["licence"]
    new_lic = rev90.LICENCE
    if not new_lic.startswith(old_lic):
        raise SystemExit("new rev90.LICENCE does not start with the shipped textbook-licence wording")
    fsr["licence"] = new_lic
    LOG.append(f"- FSR licence: appended official-extract attribution ({len(old_lic)} → {len(new_lic)} chars); original wording kept as prefix")
    added_dl = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        url = data_url(text)
        if name in fsr["dl"]:
            if fsr["dl"][name] != url:
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to overwrite existing FSR_DATA.dl key {name}")
        else:
            fsr["dl"][name] = url
            added_dl.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSR_DATA.dl added: " + (", ".join(added_dl) if added_dl else "(already present)"))
    s = put(s, b0, b1, btail, dump_fsr(fsr))

    # --- FSWEBR_DATA: mount official CSVs for the live R engine (do not overwrite existing keys) ---
    webr, c0, c1, ctail = grab(s, "window.FSWEBR_DATA=")
    added_w = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        if not name.endswith(".csv"):
            continue
        if name in webr:
            if webr[name] != text:
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to overwrite existing FSWEBR_DATA key {name}")
        else:
            webr[name] = text
            added_w.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSWEBR_DATA added CSVs: " + (", ".join(added_w) if added_w else "(already present)"))
    s = put(s, c0, c1, ctail, dump_webr(webr))

    # --- Version labels. Leave earlier history rows in place. ---
    s = P(s, "FlippedStat v10.3-dev · AI-assisted", "FlippedStat v10.4-dev · AI-assisted")
    s = P(s, 'FlippedStat v10.3-dev · <a href="#release">', 'FlippedStat v10.4-dev · <a href="#release">')
    s = P(
        s,
        "This file is a development build: <b>v10.3-dev</b>.",
        "This file is a development build: <b>v10.4-dev</b>.",
    )
    s = P(
        s,
        " · Standalone edition v10.3-dev (2026-11-18) · Opens from disk without a network connection — course content works fully offline. The optional live R engine (WebR) downloads from webr.r-wasm.org when you first run R (about 30 MB, plus any packages). Labelled supplementary interactives (#interactives) also run from this file. Copilot labs need a CUHK sign-in; progress and a private study-time log are saved in this browser only.",
        " · Standalone edition v10.4-dev (2026-11-18) · Opens from disk without a network connection — course content works fully offline. The optional live R engine (WebR) downloads from webr.r-wasm.org when you first run R (about 30 MB, plus any packages). Labelled supplementary interactives (#interactives) also run from this file. Copilot labs need a CUHK sign-in; progress and a private study-time log are saved in this browser only. Official C&amp;SD / DATA.GOV.HK teaching extracts are bundled for Topics 2.1, 2.2, 4.1, 4.2, 4.4 and E5.2.",
    )

    REL = (
        "<tr><td>10.4-dev</td><td>2026-11-18</td><td>Development build on v10.3-dev (the last closed public release remains v9.9). "
        "Mounts licence-labelled official extracts from the Census and Statistics Department (C&amp;SD website / DATA.GOV.HK), "
        "retrieved 18 Nov 2026: 2016 and 2025 mid-year land population (table 110-02001), district household income (table 130-06806), "
        "a joined 18-district teaching profile, and the Composite CPI monthly series (table 510-60001, Jan 2015–Sep 2026). "
        "First-wave lesson text on Topics 2.1, 2.2, 4.1, 4.2, 4.4 and E5.2 uses these extracts. "
        "Worked numbers on the 18-row profile (10 districts gained mid-year land population 2016–2025, 8 lost; "
        "median of 2025 district median incomes HK$30,350 vs HK$33,800; IQRs HK$5,600 vs HK$11,650; Pearson r(income, density) = −0.38) "
        "are FlippedStat calculations, not official C&amp;SD statistics. "
        "The licence page states C&amp;SD IP Rights Notice and DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use (attribution; modifications indicated; "
        "maps/graphics excluded; no endorsement). Existing synthetic Hong Kong examples and their keys are unchanged. "
        "hkdatasets microdata is not shipped. Official modules, hours, KPIs, placement cut scores, certificate wording "
        "and the core textbook licence wording are unchanged. WebR and the ModernDive-inspired interactives layer "
        "(CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, labelled supplement) are unchanged.</td></tr>"
    )
    k2 = s.index("<tr><td>10.3-dev</td>")
    s = s[:k2] + REL + s[k2:]
    LOG.append("- release history: 10.4-dev row added")

    # Safety: later attributions and human-approval wording still present.
    if "moderndive.com" not in s or "webr.r-wasm.org" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("WebR or ModernDive attribution missing after patches")
    if "creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("ModernDive CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 link missing")
    if "C&amp;SD Intellectual Property Rights Notice" not in s and "C&SD Intellectual Property Rights Notice" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("C&SD IP Rights Notice missing from licence text")
    if "DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use missing from licence text")
    if "does not imply endorsement" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("no-endorsement wording missing")
    if "Cut scores await academic approval" not in s and "cut scores await academic approval" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("H3 cut-score wording missing")
    if "Certificate wording and signatory await approval" not in s and "certificate wording" not in s.lower():
        raise SystemExit("H6 certificate wording missing")
    if "</script>" in "".join(files.values()):
        # file bodies are in JSON / data URLs; still flag if a raw closer slipped in unescaped in FSA hook only
        pass
    for banned in ("clinicaltrial.csv",):
        # not a ban — just do not invent; no check needed
        pass
    if "councillor" in s.lower() and "hkdatasets" in s and "not shipped" not in s:
        # The licence page mentions hkdatasets and says they are not shipped; that is intended.
        pass

    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if OUT.resolve() in {p.resolve() for p in FROZEN}:
        raise SystemExit("refusing to overwrite a frozen/prior standalone")
    OUT.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
    log_path = ROOT / "logs" / "v10.4-dev_assemble_log.md"
    log_path.write_text("# FlippedStat v10.4-dev — assemble log\n\n" + "\n".join(LOG) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(OUT, len(s))
    print("\n".join(LOG))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

========== END FILE: ws/tools/assemble_v104dev.py ==========


========== FILE: ws/tools/assemble_v105dev.py ==========

"""v10.4-dev -> v10.5-dev: second-wave official-extract lesson text (Topics 1.3, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6).

Reads build/FlippedStat_v10.4-dev_standalone.html read-only.
Writes build/FlippedStat_v10.5-dev_standalone.html only.

Does not modify:
  build/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.2-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.3-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.4-dev_standalone.html

Does not change placement cut scores, certificate wording, KPI definitions,
official module structure, or original textbook-licence wording. Does not
ship hkdatasets microdata.

Usage:
  python tools/hk_local_data.py --merge-rev90   # append official extracts (once)
  python tools/assemble_v105dev.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC = ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.4-dev_standalone.html"
OUT = ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.5-dev_standalone.html"
FROZEN = [
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html",
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html",
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html",
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.2-dev_standalone.html",
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.3-dev_standalone.html",
    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.4-dev_standalone.html",
]

# First-wave lessons that actually received official-extract teaching text.
CHANGED = ["1.3.1", "1.3.2", "3.1.1", "3.1.2", "3.1.3", "3.3.1", "3.3.2", "3.4.1", "3.4.3", "3.4.4", "3.5.1", "3.6.1", "3.6.2"]
RFIRST_MARKERS = ("fsr-inline fsr-rsrc", "fsr-jamlab")
LOG: list[str] = []

# Official extract filenames produced by tools/hk_local_data.py (no hkdatasets microdata).
HK_FILES = [
    "hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv",
    "hk_district_profile_2016_2025_codebook.md",
    "hk_district_population_110-02001.csv",
    "hk_district_population_110-02001_codebook.md",
    "hk_district_household_130-06806.csv",
    "hk_district_household_130-06806_codebook.md",
    "hk_district_lookup.csv",
    "hk_district_lookup_codebook.md",
    "hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001.csv",
    "hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001_codebook.md",
    "DATA_SOURCES_AND_LICENCE.md",
]
HKDATASETS_BANNED = ("hkdc", "casualty", "street_name", "hkdatasets")


def load_module(name: str, path: Path):
    sp = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp)
    sp.loader.exec_module(m)
    return m


def grab(html: str, marker: str):
    i = html.find(marker)
    if i < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing marker {marker}")
    i += len(marker)
    j = html.find("</script>", i)
    if j < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"no </script> after {marker}")
    raw = html[i:j]
    obj, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw)
    return obj, i, i + end, raw[end:]


def put(html: str, start: int, end: int, tail: str, blob: str) -> str:
    return html[:start] + blob + tail + html[end:]


def dump_fsa(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).replace("</", "<\\/")


def dump_fsr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def dump_webr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)


def leading_rfirst(body):
    lead, rest = [], list(body or [])
    while rest and isinstance(rest[0], str) and any(m in rest[0] for m in RFIRST_MARKERS):
        lead.append(rest.pop(0))
    return lead, rest


def merge_lesson(old: dict, new: dict) -> dict:
    """Overlay first-wave source text onto the shipped lesson, keeping later patches.

    Later v9.x layers added optional Think Stats pyroute stages, extra TS: src
    ids, and leading R-first / jamovi-lab blocks. The absorb / e5 source files
    do not contain those patches. Dropping them would be a regression.
    """
    merged = deepcopy(new)
    src = list(new.get("src") or [])
    for i in old.get("src") or []:
        if i not in src:
            src.append(i)
    merged["src"] = src
    if "intro" in old and "intro" not in merged:
        merged["intro"] = old["intro"]

    def skey(st):
        return (st.get("k"), st.get("h"))

    new_stages = list(merged.get("stages") or [])
    new_by = {skey(st): st for st in new_stages}
    # If a heading was rewritten (same kind, unique on both sides), map old key -> new stage.
    from collections import Counter
    new_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in new_stages)
    old_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in (old.get("stages") or []))
    new_by_kind = {st.get("k"): st for st in new_stages}
    out = []
    used = set()
    for ost in old.get("stages") or []:
        k = skey(ost)
        kind = ost.get("k")
        if kind == "pyroute":
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = None
        if k in new_by:
            nst = new_by[k]
        elif old_k_counts[kind] == 1 and new_k_counts.get(kind) == 1:
            # Heading-only change, e.g. 4.1.1 basics US-county title -> HK districts.
            nst = new_by_kind[kind]
        if nst is None:
            # Standalone-only stage that the source file does not carry (keep it).
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = deepcopy(nst)
        old_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(ost.get("body") or [])
        new_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(nst.get("body") or [])
        if old_lead and not new_lead:
            nst["body"] = old_lead + list(nst.get("body") or [])
        out.append(nst)
        used.add(skey(nst))
    for nst in new_stages:
        if skey(nst) not in used and skey(nst) not in {skey(s) for s in out}:
            out.append(deepcopy(nst))
    merged["stages"] = out
    return merged


def data_url(text: str) -> str:
    return "data:text/plain;charset=utf-8;base64," + base64.b64encode(text.encode("utf-8")).decode()


def official_files() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Prefer the merged rev90 bundle; fall back to hk_files.json / extracts dir."""
    files: dict[str, str] = {}
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if rev_path.exists():
        rev = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name in rev:
                files[name] = rev[name]
    if hk_path.exists():
        hk = json.loads(hk_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            files.setdefault(name, hk[name] if name in hk else None)
            if files.get(name) is None:
                files.pop(name, None)
            elif name not in files:
                files[name] = hk[name]
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name not in files and name in hk:
                files[name] = hk[name]
    extract_dir = ROOT / "content" / "data" / "hk_extracts"
    for name in HK_FILES:
        if name not in files:
            p = extract_dir / name
            if p.exists():
                files[name] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    missing = [n for n in HK_FILES if n not in files]
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit(
            "official extract files missing (run python tools/hk_local_data.py --merge-rev90): "
            + ", ".join(missing)
        )
    for name, text in files.items():
        low = name.lower() + "\n" + text.lower()[:500]
        for banned in HKDATASETS_BANNED:
            if banned in name.lower():
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to ship banned hkdatasets filename {name}")
    return files


def rebuild_lessons(fsa: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Rebuild only the second-wave lessons from content sources; leave the rest byte-stable."""
    notes = []
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    w01 = load_module("absorb_w01", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w01.py")
    w03 = load_module("absorb_w03", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w03.py")
    source = {}
    source.update(w01.A)
    source.update(w03.A)

    lessons = fsa["lessons"]
    for no in CHANGED:
        if no not in lessons:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from standalone FSA_DATA")
        if no not in source:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from content sources")
        merged = merge_lesson(lessons[no], source[no])
        lessons[no] = merged
        n_body = sum(len(st.get("body") or []) for st in merged.get("stages") or [])
        notes.append(f"- FSA lesson {no}: merged official-extract source text; stages {len(merged['stages'])}, body pieces {n_body}")
    # Do not rewrite absorbed / deferred lists: src ids were only added, not removed.
    return notes


def maybe_merge_rev90():
    """Idempotent append of official extracts into build/rev90_files.json."""
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if not hk_path.exists():
        LOG.append("- hk_files.json missing; running tools/hk_local_data.py")
        import runpy
        import sys
        sys.argv = ["hk_local_data.py"]
        # build() writes hk_files; we'll merge below
        from tools import hk_local_data as hkd  # may fail if not a package

    if not rev_path.exists():
        raise SystemExit("missing build/rev90_files.json; run python tools/rev90_data.py first")
    current = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    hk = official_files()
    added = []
    for name, text in hk.items():
        if name in current:
            if current[name] != text:
                current[name] = text
                added.append(name + " (refreshed)")
        else:
            current[name] = text
            added.append(name)
    if added:
        rev_path.write_text(json.dumps(current, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        LOG.append(f"- official extract keys in build/rev90_files.json: {', '.join(added)}")
    else:
        LOG.append("- build/rev90_files.json already contains matching official extract keys; left unchanged")
    return {k: current[k] for k in HK_FILES}


FSA_DL_HOOK = """<script>/* FlippedStat v10.4-dev: resolve fsr-dl download hooks inside absorbed lesson HTML (FSA). */
(function(){
  if(!window.FSA||!FSA.html)return;
  const orig=FSA.html;
  FSA.html=function(no){
    const h=orig(no);
    const dl=(window.FSR_DATA&&FSR_DATA.dl)||{};
    return h.replace(/<div class="fsr-dl" data-f="([^"]+)"><\\/div>/g,(m,f)=>dl[f]?`<a class="btn sm fsr-dlbtn" download="${f}" href="${dl[f]}">⬇ ${f}</a>`:`<span class="warn">missing file ${f}</span>`);
  };
})();
</script>
"""

FSA_HOOK_ANCHOR = (
    "window.FSA = { html, mount, absorbed: id => ABS.has(id), data: D };\n"
    "})();\n</script>\n"
    "<script>/* FlippedStat v9.1 revision layer (FSR)."
)


def P(html: str, a: str, b: str, n: int = 1) -> str:
    c = html.count(a)
    if c != n:
        raise SystemExit(f"patch anchor found {c}x (expected {n}): {a[:140]}")
    LOG.append("- patched: " + a[:90].replace("\n", " "))
    return html.replace(a, b)


def main():
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    if not SRC.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing source {SRC}")
    for p in FROZEN:
        if not p.exists():
            raise SystemExit(f"missing frozen/prior file {p}")
        if p.resolve() == OUT.resolve():
            raise SystemExit("refusing to write over a frozen/prior standalone")

    s = SRC.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "v10.4-dev" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("source does not look like v10.4-dev")

    files = maybe_merge_rev90()

    # --- FSA_DATA: first-wave lessons only ---
    fsa, a0, a1, atail = grab(s, "window.FSA_DATA=")
    notes = rebuild_lessons(fsa)
    LOG.extend(notes)
    s = put(s, a0, a1, atail, dump_fsa(fsa))
    # Confirm the official phrases are now in the FSA blob.
    fsa_blob = dump_fsa(fsa)
    for phrase in (
        "hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv",
        "110-02001",
        "130-06806",
        "510-60001",
        "hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001.csv",
        "HK$30,350",
        "HK$33,800",
        "−0.38",
        "HK$31,844",
        "HK$26,200",
        "15.5%",
        "+2.15",
        "7,497.8",
    ):
        if phrase not in fsa_blob and phrase not in s:
            raise SystemExit(f"expected phrase missing after FSA rebuild: {phrase}")

    # --- FSA.html fsr-dl hook: already injected in v10.4-dev; do not inject twice ---
    if "resolve fsr-dl download hooks inside absorbed lesson HTML" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("expected v10.4-dev FSA.html fsr-dl resolver missing from source standalone")
    LOG.append("- FSA.html fsr-dl resolver already present in v10.4-dev; left in place")

    # --- FSR_DATA: licence + official files in dl ---
    fsr, b0, b1, btail = grab(s, "window.FSR_DATA=")
    rev90 = load_module("rev90", ROOT / "content" / "rev90.py")
    old_lic = fsr["licence"]
    new_lic = rev90.LICENCE
    if old_lic == new_lic:
        LOG.append("- FSR licence already includes official-extract attribution; left unchanged")
    elif new_lic.startswith(old_lic):
        fsr["licence"] = new_lic
        LOG.append(f"- FSR licence: appended official-extract attribution ({len(old_lic)} → {len(new_lic)} chars); original wording kept as prefix")
    else:
        # v10.4 already appended a prefix-compatible licence; require exact match to current source wording.
        raise SystemExit("rev90.LICENCE does not match or extend the shipped licence wording")
    added_dl = []
    refreshed_dl = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        url = data_url(text)
        if name in fsr["dl"]:
            if fsr["dl"][name] != url:
                # Official codebook text may have been extended in this wave; refresh only official extract keys.
                fsr["dl"][name] = url
                refreshed_dl.append(name)
        else:
            fsr["dl"][name] = url
            added_dl.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSR_DATA.dl added: " + (", ".join(added_dl) if added_dl else "(none)"))
    LOG.append("- FSR_DATA.dl refreshed: " + (", ".join(refreshed_dl) if refreshed_dl else "(none)"))
    s = put(s, b0, b1, btail, dump_fsr(fsr))

    # --- FSWEBR_DATA: mount official CSVs for the live R engine (do not overwrite existing keys) ---
    webr, c0, c1, ctail = grab(s, "window.FSWEBR_DATA=")
    added_w = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        if not name.endswith(".csv"):
            continue
        if name in webr:
            if webr[name] != text:
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to overwrite existing FSWEBR_DATA key {name}")
        else:
            webr[name] = text
            added_w.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSWEBR_DATA added CSVs: " + (", ".join(added_w) if added_w else "(already present)"))
    s = put(s, c0, c1, ctail, dump_webr(webr))

    # --- Version labels. Leave earlier history rows in place. ---
    s = P(s, "FlippedStat v10.4-dev · AI-assisted", "FlippedStat v10.5-dev · AI-assisted")
    s = P(s, 'FlippedStat v10.4-dev · <a href="#release">', 'FlippedStat v10.5-dev · <a href="#release">')
    s = P(
        s,
        "This file is a development build: <b>v10.4-dev</b>.",
        "This file is a development build: <b>v10.5-dev</b>.",
    )
    s = P(
        s,
        " · Standalone edition v10.4-dev (2026-11-18) · Opens from disk without a network connection — course content works fully offline. The optional live R engine (WebR) downloads from webr.r-wasm.org when you first run R (about 30 MB, plus any packages). Labelled supplementary interactives (#interactives) also run from this file. Copilot labs need a CUHK sign-in; progress and a private study-time log are saved in this browser only. Official C&amp;SD / DATA.GOV.HK teaching extracts are bundled for Topics 2.1, 2.2, 4.1, 4.2, 4.4 and E5.2.",
        " · Standalone edition v10.5-dev (2026-11-18) · Opens from disk without a network connection — course content works fully offline. The optional live R engine (WebR) downloads from webr.r-wasm.org when you first run R (about 30 MB, plus any packages). Labelled supplementary interactives (#interactives) also run from this file. Copilot labs need a CUHK sign-in; progress and a private study-time log are saved in this browser only. Official C&amp;SD / DATA.GOV.HK teaching extracts are bundled for Topics 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 4.1, 4.2, 4.4 and E5.2.",
    )

    REL = (
        "<tr><td>10.5-dev</td><td>2026-11-18</td><td>Development build on v10.4-dev (the last closed public release remains v9.9). "
        "Second-wave lesson text on Topics 1.3, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5 and 3.6 reuses the already-mounted official C&amp;SD extracts "
        "(tables 110-02001 and 130-06806; 18-district teaching profile). "
        "Additional FlippedStat calculations on those official figures, not official C&amp;SD statistics: "
        "Hong Kong Island is 4/18 districts (22.2%) but 15.5% of the official 2025 mid-year land population "
        "(official region total 1,162.4 of 7,497.8 thousand); New Territories 9/18 districts (50%) but 54.6% "
        "(official region total 4,092.7 thousand); five-number summary of the 18 official 2025 district median incomes "
        "HK$24,900 / 26,200 / 31,000 / 34,200 / 45,000, IQR HK$8,000, no Tukey outliers; "
        "mean of the 18 district medians HK$31,844 (sample SD HK$6,121) versus the official all-household median HK$30,000; "
        "z-scores (sample SD) Central and Western income +2.15, Kwun Tong income −1.13, Kwun Tong density +2.07, Islands density −1.00; "
        "11 of 18 incomes within one sample SD of the mean, 17 of 18 within two. "
        "First-wave Topics 2.1, 2.2, 4.1, 4.2, 4.4 and E5.2 are unchanged from v10.4-dev. "
        "Existing synthetic Hong Kong examples and their keys are unchanged. "
        "hkdatasets microdata is not shipped. Official modules, hours, KPIs, placement cut scores, certificate wording "
        "and the core textbook licence wording are unchanged.</td></tr>"
    )
    k2 = s.index("<tr><td>10.4-dev</td>")
    s = s[:k2] + REL + s[k2:]
    LOG.append("- release history: 10.5-dev row added")

    # Safety: later attributions and human-approval wording still present.
    if "moderndive.com" not in s or "webr.r-wasm.org" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("WebR or ModernDive attribution missing after patches")
    if "creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("ModernDive CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 link missing")
    if "C&amp;SD Intellectual Property Rights Notice" not in s and "C&SD Intellectual Property Rights Notice" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("C&SD IP Rights Notice missing from licence text")
    if "DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use missing from licence text")
    if "does not imply endorsement" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("no-endorsement wording missing")
    if "Cut scores await academic approval" not in s and "cut scores await academic approval" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("H3 cut-score wording missing")
    if "Certificate wording and signatory await approval" not in s and "certificate wording" not in s.lower():
        raise SystemExit("H6 certificate wording missing")
    if "</script>" in "".join(files.values()):
        # file bodies are in JSON / data URLs; still flag if a raw closer slipped in unescaped in FSA hook only
        pass
    for banned in ("clinicaltrial.csv",):
        # not a ban — just do not invent; no check needed
        pass
    if "councillor" in s.lower() and "hkdatasets" in s and "not shipped" not in s:
        # The licence page mentions hkdatasets and says they are not shipped; that is intended.
        pass

    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if OUT.resolve() in {p.resolve() for p in FROZEN}:
        raise SystemExit("refusing to overwrite a frozen/prior standalone")
    OUT.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
    log_path = ROOT / "logs" / "v10.5-dev_assemble_log.md"
    log_path.write_text("# FlippedStat v10.5-dev — assemble log\n\n" + "\n".join(LOG) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(OUT, len(s))
    print("\n".join(LOG))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

========== FILE: ws/tools/assemble_v106dev.py ==========

"""v10.5-dev -> v10.6-dev: third-wave official-extract lesson text (Topics 4.3, 6.3, 6.5).

Reads build/FlippedStat_v10.5-dev_standalone.html read-only.
Writes build/FlippedStat_v10.6-dev_standalone.html only.

Does not modify:
  build/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.2-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.3-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.4-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.5-dev_standalone.html

Does not change placement cut scores, certificate wording, KPI definitions,
official module structure, or original textbook-licence wording. Does not
ship hkdatasets microdata.

Usage:
  python tools/hk_local_data.py --merge-rev90   # append official extracts (once)
  python tools/hk_local_data.py --refresh-official  # add new official extracts
  python tools/assemble_v106dev.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC = ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.5-dev_standalone.html"

def load_module(name: str, path: Path):
    sp = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp)
    sp.loader.exec_module(m)
    return m


def grab(html: str, marker: str):
    i = html.find(marker)
    if i < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing marker {marker}")
    i += len(marker)
    j = html.find("</script>", i)
    if j < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"no </script> after {marker}")
    raw = html[i:j]
    obj, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw)
    return obj, i, i + end, raw[end:]


def put(html: str, start: int, end: int, tail: str, blob: str) -> str:
    return html[:start] + blob + tail + html[end:]


def dump_fsa(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).replace("</", "<\\/")


def dump_fsr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def dump_webr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)


def leading_rfirst(body):
    lead, rest = [], list(body or [])
    while rest and isinstance(rest[0], str) and any(m in rest[0] for m in RFIRST_MARKERS):
        lead.append(rest.pop(0))
    return lead, rest


def merge_lesson(old: dict, new: dict) -> dict:
    """Overlay first-wave source text onto the shipped lesson, keeping later patches.

    Later v9.x layers added optional Think Stats pyroute stages, extra TS: src
    ids, and leading R-first / jamovi-lab blocks. The absorb / e5 source files
    do not contain those patches. Dropping them would be a regression.
    """
    merged = deepcopy(new)
    src = list(new.get("src") or [])
    for i in old.get("src") or []:
        if i not in src:
            src.append(i)
    merged["src"] = src
    if "intro" in old and "intro" not in merged:
        merged["intro"] = old["intro"]

    def skey(st):
        return (st.get("k"), st.get("h"))

    new_stages = list(merged.get("stages") or [])
    new_by = {skey(st): st for st in new_stages}
    # If a heading was rewritten (same kind, unique on both sides), map old key -> new stage.
    from collections import Counter
    new_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in new_stages)
    old_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in (old.get("stages") or []))
    new_by_kind = {st.get("k"): st for st in new_stages}
    out = []
    used = set()
    for ost in old.get("stages") or []:
        k = skey(ost)
        kind = ost.get("k")
        if kind == "pyroute":
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = None
        if k in new_by:
            nst = new_by[k]
        elif old_k_counts[kind] == 1 and new_k_counts.get(kind) == 1:
            # Heading-only change, e.g. 4.1.1 basics US-county title -> HK districts.
            nst = new_by_kind[kind]
        if nst is None:
            # Standalone-only stage that the source file does not carry (keep it).
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = deepcopy(nst)
        old_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(ost.get("body") or [])
        new_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(nst.get("body") or [])
        if old_lead and not new_lead:
            nst["body"] = old_lead + list(nst.get("body") or [])
        out.append(nst)
        used.add(skey(nst))
    for nst in new_stages:
        if skey(nst) not in used and skey(nst) not in {skey(s) for s in out}:
            out.append(deepcopy(nst))
    merged["stages"] = out
    return merged


def data_url(text: str) -> str:
    return "data:text/plain;charset=utf-8;base64," + base64.b64encode(text.encode("utf-8")).decode()


def official_files() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Prefer the merged rev90 bundle; fall back to hk_files.json / extracts dir."""
    files: dict[str, str] = {}
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if rev_path.exists():
        rev = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name in rev:
                files[name] = rev[name]
    if hk_path.exists():
        hk = json.loads(hk_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            files.setdefault(name, hk[name] if name in hk else None)
            if files.get(name) is None:
                files.pop(name, None)
            elif name not in files:
                files[name] = hk[name]
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name not in files and name in hk:
                files[name] = hk[name]
    extract_dir = ROOT / "content" / "data" / "hk_extracts"
    for name in HK_FILES:
        if name not in files:
            p = extract_dir / name
            if p.exists():
                files[name] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    missing = [n for n in HK_FILES if n not in files]
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit(
            "official extract files missing (run python tools/hk_local_data.py --merge-rev90): "
            + ", ".join(missing)
        )
    for name, text in files.items():
        low = name.lower() + "\n" + text.lower()[:500]
        for banned in HKDATASETS_BANNED:
            if banned in name.lower():
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to ship banned hkdatasets filename {name}")
    return files


def rebuild_lessons(fsa: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Rebuild only the third-wave lessons from content sources; leave the rest byte-stable."""
    notes = []
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    w04 = load_module("absorb_w04", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w04.py")
    w06 = load_module("absorb_w06", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w06.py")
    source = {}
    source.update(w04.A)
    source.update(w06.A)

    lessons = fsa["lessons"]
    for no in CHANGED:
        if no not in lessons:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from standalone FSA_DATA")
        if no not in source:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from content sources")
        merged = merge_lesson(lessons[no], source[no])
        lessons[no] = merged
        n_body = sum(len(st.get("body") or []) for st in merged.get("stages") or [])
        notes.append(f"- FSA lesson {no}: merged official-extract source text; stages {len(merged['stages'])}, body pieces {n_body}")
    # Do not rewrite absorbed / deferred lists: src ids were only added, not removed.
    return notes


def maybe_merge_rev90():
    """Idempotent append of official extracts into build/rev90_files.json."""
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if not hk_path.exists():
        LOG.append("- hk_files.json missing; running tools/hk_local_data.py")
        import runpy
        import sys
        sys.argv = ["hk_local_data.py"]
        # build() writes hk_files; we'll merge below
        from tools import hk_local_data as hkd  # may fail if not a package

    if not rev_path.exists():
        raise SystemExit("missing build/rev90_files.json; run python tools/rev90_data.py first")
    current = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    hk = official_files()
    added = []
    for name, text in hk.items():
        if name in current:
            if current[name] != text:
                current[name] = text
                added.append(name + " (refreshed)")
        else:
            current[name] = text
            added.append(name)
    if added:
        rev_path.write_text(json.dumps(current, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        LOG.append(f"- official extract keys in build/rev90_files.json: {', '.join(added)}")
    else:
        LOG.append("- build/rev90_files.json already contains matching official extract keys; left unchanged")
    return {k: current[k] for k in HK_FILES}


FSA_DL_HOOK = """<script>/* FlippedStat v10.4-dev: resolve fsr-dl download hooks inside absorbed lesson HTML (FSA). */
(function(){
  if(!window.FSA||!FSA.html)return;
  const orig=FSA.html;
  FSA.html=function(no){
    const h=orig(no);
    const dl=(window.FSR_DATA&&FSR_DATA.dl)||{};
    return h.replace(/<div class="fsr-dl" data-f="([^"]+)"><\\/div>/g,(m,f)=>dl[f]?`<a class="btn sm fsr-dlbtn" download="${f}" href="${dl[f]}">⬇ ${f}</a>`:`<span class="warn">missing file ${f}</span>`);
  };
})();
</script>
"""

FSA_HOOK_ANCHOR = (
    "window.FSA = { html, mount, absorbed: id => ABS.has(id), data: D };\n"
    "})();\n</script>\n"
    "<script>/* FlippedStat v9.1 revision layer (FSR)."
)


def P(html: str, a: str, b: str, n: int = 1) -> str:
    c = html.count(a)
    if c != n:
        raise SystemExit(f"patch anchor found {c}x (expected {n}): {a[:140]}")
    LOG.append("- patched: " + a[:90].replace("\n", " "))
    return html.replace(a, b)


def main():
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    if not SRC.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing source {SRC}")
    for p in FROZEN:
        if not p.exists():
            raise SystemExit(f"missing frozen/prior file {p}")
        if p.resolve() == OUT.resolve():
            raise SystemExit("refusing to write over a frozen/prior standalone")

    s = SRC.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "v10.5-dev" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("source does not look like v10.5-dev")
    if "<tr><td>10.6-dev</td>" in s:
        raise SystemExit("source already contains a 10.6-dev release row")

    files = maybe_merge_rev90()

    # --- FSA_DATA: third-wave lessons only ---
    fsa, a0, a1, atail = grab(s, "window.FSA_DATA=")
    notes = rebuild_lessons(fsa)
    LOG.extend(notes)
    s = put(s, a0, a1, atail, dump_fsa(fsa))
    # Confirm the official phrases are now in the FSA blob.
    fsa_blob = dump_fsa(fsa)
    for phrase in (
        "hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv",
        "110-02001",
        "130-06806",
        "510-60001",
        "hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001.csv",
        "HK$30,350",
        "HK$33,800",
        "−0.38",
        "HK$31,844",
        "HK$26,200",
        "15.5%",
        "+2.15",
        "7,497.8",
        "hk_hko_daily_rainfall_HKO_2016_2025.csv",
        "425.0",
        "hk_hko_jja_lightning_days_2016_2025.csv",
        "17.17",
        "115-01012A",
        "hk_hko_daily_mean_temp_HKO_2016_2025.csv",
        "29.23",
        "68.8%",
    ):
        if phrase not in fsa_blob and phrase not in s:
            raise SystemExit(f"expected phrase missing after FSA rebuild: {phrase}")

    # --- FSA.html fsr-dl hook: already injected in v10.4-dev; do not inject twice ---
    if "resolve fsr-dl download hooks inside absorbed lesson HTML" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("expected v10.4-dev FSA.html fsr-dl resolver missing from source standalone")
    LOG.append("- FSA.html fsr-dl resolver already present in v10.4-dev; left in place")

    # --- FSR_DATA: licence + official files in dl ---
    fsr, b0, b1, btail = grab(s, "window.FSR_DATA=")
    rev90 = load_module("rev90", ROOT / "content" / "rev90.py")
    old_lic = fsr["licence"]
    new_lic = rev90.LICENCE
    if old_lic == new_lic:
        LOG.append("- FSR licence already includes official-extract attribution; left unchanged")
    elif new_lic.startswith(old_lic):
        fsr["licence"] = new_lic
        LOG.append(f"- FSR licence: appended official-extract attribution ({len(old_lic)} → {len(new_lic)} chars); original wording kept as prefix")
    else:
        # v10.4 already appended a prefix-compatible licence; require exact match to current source wording.
        raise SystemExit("rev90.LICENCE does not match or extend the shipped licence wording")
    added_dl = []
    refreshed_dl = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        url = data_url(text)
        if name in fsr["dl"]:
            if fsr["dl"][name] != url:
                # Official codebook text may have been extended in this wave; refresh only official extract keys.
                fsr["dl"][name] = url
                refreshed_dl.append(name)
        else:
            fsr["dl"][name] = url
            added_dl.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSR_DATA.dl added: " + (", ".join(added_dl) if added_dl else "(none)"))
    LOG.append("- FSR_DATA.dl refreshed: " + (", ".join(refreshed_dl) if refreshed_dl else "(none)"))
    s = put(s, b0, b1, btail, dump_fsr(fsr))

    # --- FSWEBR_DATA: mount official CSVs for the live R engine (do not overwrite existing keys) ---
    webr, c0, c1, ctail = grab(s, "window.FSWEBR_DATA=")
    added_w = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        if not name.endswith(".csv"):
            continue
        if name in webr:
            if webr[name] != text:
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to overwrite existing FSWEBR_DATA key {name}")
        else:
            webr[name] = text
            added_w.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSWEBR_DATA added CSVs: " + (", ".join(added_w) if added_w else "(already present)"))
    s = put(s, c0, c1, ctail, dump_webr(webr))

    # --- Version labels. Leave earlier history rows in place. ---
    s = P(s, "FlippedStat v10.5-dev · AI-assisted", "FlippedStat v10.6-dev · AI-assisted")
    s = P(s, 'FlippedStat v10.5-dev · <a href="#release">', 'FlippedStat v10.6-dev · <a href="#release">')
    s = P(
        s,
        "This file is a development build: <b>v10.5-dev</b>.",
        "This file is a development build: <b>v10.6-dev</b>.",
    )
    s = P(
        s,
        " · Standalone edition v10.5-dev (2026-11-18) · Opens from disk without a network connection — course content works fully offline. The optional live R engine (WebR) downloads from webr.r-wasm.org when you first run R (about 30 MB, plus any packages). Labelled supplementary interactives (#interactives) also run from this file. Copilot labs need a CUHK sign-in; progress and a private study-time log are saved in this browser only. Official C&amp;SD / DATA.GOV.HK teaching extracts are bundled for Topics 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 4.1, 4.2, 4.4 and E5.2.",
        " · Standalone edition v10.6-dev (2026-11-18) · Opens from disk without a network connection — course content works fully offline. The optional live R engine (WebR) downloads from webr.r-wasm.org when you first run R (about 30 MB, plus any packages). Labelled supplementary interactives (#interactives) also run from this file. Copilot labs need a CUHK sign-in; progress and a private study-time log are saved in this browser only. Official C&amp;SD / Hong Kong Observatory / DATA.GOV.HK teaching extracts are bundled for Topics 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 6.3, 6.5 and E5.2.",
    )

    REL = (
        "<tr><td>10.6-dev</td><td>2026-11-18</td><td>Development build on v10.5-dev (the last closed public release remains v9.9). "
        "Third-wave official extracts: Hong Kong Observatory daily rainfall, daily mean temperature and daily cloud-to-ground lightning counts "
        "(DATA.GOV.HK open data, 2016–2025 teaching subsets) and C&amp;SD table 115-01012A monthly live-birth totals (1976–2025). "
        "Lesson text on Topics 4.3, 6.3 and 6.5 now uses those official series as the student-facing illustrations; book figures are labelled and retained. "
        "FlippedStat calculations on official figures, not official HKO or C&amp;SD statistics: among 1,477 measurable wet days, min 0.1 mm, max 425.0 mm (8 September 2023), "
        "mean 16.73 mm, median 4.3 mm; after log10, Pearson skew −0.14. "
        "June–August daily mean temperatures (n = 920): mean 29.23 °C, median 29.50 °C, sample SD 1.35 °C; "
        "633/920 (68.8%) within one sample SD, 875/920 (95.1%) within two, 918/920 (99.8%) within three — a course illustration, not a claim of exact normality. "
        "Thirty June–August monthly counts of days with at least one official cloud-to-ground lightning record: mean 17.17, sample variance 18.35 (variance/mean 1.07); a FlippedStat derivation. "
        "Official annual live births 60,856 (2016) and 31,053 (2025) are quoted as a changing-rate caution, not as a Poisson fit. "
        "Earlier official-extract topics and their keys are unchanged from v10.5-dev. "
        "Existing synthetic Hong Kong examples and their keys are unchanged. "
        "hkdatasets microdata is not shipped. Official modules, hours, KPIs, placement cut scores, certificate wording "
        "and the core textbook licence wording are unchanged.</td></tr>"
    )
    k2 = s.index("<tr><td>10.5-dev</td>")
    s = s[:k2] + REL + s[k2:]
    LOG.append("- release history: 10.6-dev row added")

    # Safety: later attributions and human-approval wording still present.
    if "moderndive.com" not in s or "webr.r-wasm.org" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("WebR or ModernDive attribution missing after patches")
    if "creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("ModernDive CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 link missing")
    if "C&amp;SD Intellectual Property Rights Notice" not in s and "C&SD Intellectual Property Rights Notice" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("C&SD IP Rights Notice missing from licence text")
    if "DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use missing from licence text")
    if "does not imply endorsement" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("no-endorsement wording missing")
    if "Cut scores await academic approval" not in s and "cut scores await academic approval" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("H3 cut-score wording missing")
    if "Certificate wording and signatory await approval" not in s and "certificate wording" not in s.lower():
        raise SystemExit("H6 certificate wording missing")
    if "</script>" in "".join(files.values()):
        # file bodies are in JSON / data URLs; still flag if a raw closer slipped in unescaped in FSA hook only
        pass
    for banned in ("clinicaltrial.csv",):
        # not a ban — just do not invent; no check needed
        pass
    if "councillor" in s.lower() and "hkdatasets" in s and "not shipped" not in s:
        # The licence page mentions hkdatasets and says they are not shipped; that is intended.
        pass

    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if OUT.resolve() in {p.resolve() for p in FROZEN}:
        raise SystemExit("refusing to overwrite a frozen/prior standalone")
    OUT.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
    log_path = ROOT / "logs" / "v10.6-dev_assemble_log.md"
    log_path.write_text("# FlippedStat v10.6-dev — assemble log\n\n" + "\n".join(LOG) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(OUT, len(s))
    print("\n".join(LOG))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

========== FILE: ws/tools/assemble_v107dev.py ==========

"""v10.6-dev -> v10.7-dev: wave-4 labelled official-extract parallels (Topics 9.7, 10.3, 10.6, 11.4).

Reads build/FlippedStat_v10.6-dev_standalone.html read-only.
Writes build/FlippedStat_v10.7-dev_standalone.html only.

Does not modify:
  build/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.2-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.3-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.4-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.5-dev_standalone.html
  build/FlippedStat_v10.6-dev_standalone.html

Does not change placement cut scores, certificate wording, KPI definitions,
official module structure, or original textbook-licence wording. Does not
ship hkdatasets microdata.

Usage:
  python tools/hk_local_data.py --merge-rev90   # append official extracts (once)

  python tools/assemble_v107dev.py

    ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.6-dev_standalone.html",
]

# First-wave lessons that actually received official-extract teaching text.
CHANGED = ["9.7.3", "10.3.4", "10.6.1", "11.4.3"]

# Official extract filenames produced by tools/hk_local_data.py (no hkdatasets microdata).

    "hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv",
    "hk_district_profile_2016_2025_codebook.md",
    "hk_district_population_110-02001.csv",

    "hk_district_lookup.csv",

    "hk_hko_jja_lightning_days_2016_2025.csv",
