    "hk_live_births_monthly_115-01012A.csv",
    "hk_live_births_monthly_115-01012A_codebook.md",
]
HKDATASETS_BANNED = ("hkdc", "casualty", "street_name", "hkdatasets")


def load_module(name: str, path: Path):
    sp = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp)
    sp.loader.exec_module(m)
    return m


def grab(html: str, marker: str):
    i = html.find(marker)
    if i < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing marker {marker}")
    i += len(marker)
    j = html.find("</script>", i)
    if j < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"no </script> after {marker}")
    raw = html[i:j]
    obj, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw)
    return obj, i, i + end, raw[end:]


def put(html: str, start: int, end: int, tail: str, blob: str) -> str:
    return html[:start] + blob + tail + html[end:]


def dump_fsa(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).replace("</", "<\\/")


def dump_fsr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def dump_webr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)


def leading_rfirst(body):
    lead, rest = [], list(body or [])
    while rest and isinstance(rest[0], str) and any(m in rest[0] for m in RFIRST_MARKERS):
        lead.append(rest.pop(0))
    return lead, rest


def merge_lesson(old: dict, new: dict) -> dict:
    """Overlay first-wave source text onto the shipped lesson, keeping later patches.

    Later v9.x layers added optional Think Stats pyroute stages, extra TS: src
    ids, and leading R-first / jamovi-lab blocks. The absorb / e5 source files
    do not contain those patches. Dropping them would be a regression.
    """
    merged = deepcopy(new)
    src = list(new.get("src") or [])
    for i in old.get("src") or []:
        if i not in src:
            src.append(i)
    merged["src"] = src
    if "intro" in old and "intro" not in merged:
        merged["intro"] = old["intro"]

    def skey(st):
        return (st.get("k"), st.get("h"))

    new_stages = list(merged.get("stages") or [])
    new_by = {skey(st): st for st in new_stages}
    # If a heading was rewritten (same kind, unique on both sides), map old key -> new stage.
    from collections import Counter
    new_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in new_stages)
    old_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in (old.get("stages") or []))
    new_by_kind = {st.get("k"): st for st in new_stages}
    out = []
    used = set()
    for ost in old.get("stages") or []:
        k = skey(ost)
        kind = ost.get("k")
        if kind == "pyroute":
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = None
        if k in new_by:
            nst = new_by[k]
        elif old_k_counts[kind] == 1 and new_k_counts.get(kind) == 1:
            # Heading-only change, e.g. 4.1.1 basics US-county title -> HK districts.
            nst = new_by_kind[kind]
        if nst is None:
            # Standalone-only stage that the source file does not carry (keep it).
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = deepcopy(nst)
        old_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(ost.get("body") or [])
        new_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(nst.get("body") or [])
        if old_lead and not new_lead:
            nst["body"] = old_lead + list(nst.get("body") or [])
        out.append(nst)
        used.add(skey(nst))
    for nst in new_stages:
        if skey(nst) not in used and skey(nst) not in {skey(s) for s in out}:
            out.append(deepcopy(nst))
    merged["stages"] = out
    return merged


def data_url(text: str) -> str:
    return "data:text/plain;charset=utf-8;base64," + base64.b64encode(text.encode("utf-8")).decode()


def official_files() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Prefer the merged rev90 bundle; fall back to hk_files.json / extracts dir."""
    files: dict[str, str] = {}
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if rev_path.exists():
        rev = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name in rev:
                files[name] = rev[name]
    if hk_path.exists():
        hk = json.loads(hk_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            files.setdefault(name, hk[name] if name in hk else None)
            if files.get(name) is None:
                files.pop(name, None)
            elif name not in files:
                files[name] = hk[name]
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name not in files and name in hk:
                files[name] = hk[name]
    extract_dir = ROOT / "content" / "data" / "hk_extracts"
    for name in HK_FILES:
        if name not in files:
            p = extract_dir / name
            if p.exists():
                files[name] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    missing = [n for n in HK_FILES if n not in files]
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit(
            "official extract files missing (run python tools/hk_local_data.py --merge-rev90): "
            + ", ".join(missing)
        )
    for name, text in files.items():
        low = name.lower() + "\n" + text.lower()[:500]
        for banned in HKDATASETS_BANNED:
            if banned in name.lower():
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to ship banned hkdatasets filename {name}")
    return files


def rebuild_lessons(fsa: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Rebuild only the wave-4 supplemented lessons from content sources; leave the rest byte-stable."""
    notes = []
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    w09 = load_module("absorb_w09", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w09.py")
    w10 = load_module("absorb_w10", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w10.py")
    w11 = load_module("absorb_w11", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w11.py")
    source = {}
    source.update(w09.A)
    source.update(w10.A)
    source.update(w11.A)

    lessons = fsa["lessons"]
    for no in CHANGED:
        if no not in lessons:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from standalone FSA_DATA")
        if no not in source:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from content sources")
        merged = merge_lesson(lessons[no], source[no])
        lessons[no] = merged
        n_body = sum(len(st.get("body") or []) for st in merged.get("stages") or [])
        notes.append(f"- FSA lesson {no}: merged wave-4 official-extract parallel text; stages {len(merged['stages'])}, body pieces {n_body}")
    # Do not rewrite absorbed / deferred lists: src ids were only added, not removed.
    return notes


def maybe_merge_rev90():
    """Idempotent append of official extracts into build/rev90_files.json."""
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if not hk_path.exists():
        LOG.append("- hk_files.json missing; running tools/hk_local_data.py")
        import runpy
        import sys
        sys.argv = ["hk_local_data.py"]
        # build() writes hk_files; we'll merge below
        from tools import hk_local_data as hkd  # may fail if not a package

    if not rev_path.exists():
        raise SystemExit("missing build/rev90_files.json; run python tools/rev90_data.py first")
    current = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    hk = official_files()
    added = []
    for name, text in hk.items():
        if name in current:
            if current[name] != text:
                current[name] = text
                added.append(name + " (refreshed)")
        else:
            current[name] = text
            added.append(name)
    if added:
        rev_path.write_text(json.dumps(current, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        LOG.append(f"- official extract keys in build/rev90_files.json: {', '.join(added)}")
    else:
        LOG.append("- build/rev90_files.json already contains matching official extract keys; left unchanged")
    return {k: current[k] for k in HK_FILES}


FSA_DL_HOOK = """<script>/* FlippedStat v10.4-dev: resolve fsr-dl download hooks inside absorbed lesson HTML (FSA). */
(function(){
  if(!window.FSA||!FSA.html)return;
  const orig=FSA.html;
  FSA.html=function(no){
    const h=orig(no);
    const dl=(window.FSR_DATA&&FSR_DATA.dl)||{};
    return h.replace(/<div class="fsr-dl" data-f="([^"]+)"><\\/div>/g,(m,f)=>dl[f]?`<a class="btn sm fsr-dlbtn" download="${f}" href="${dl[f]}">⬇ ${f}</a>`:`<span class="warn">missing file ${f}</span>`);
  };
})();
</script>
"""

FSA_HOOK_ANCHOR = (
    "window.FSA = { html, mount, absorbed: id => ABS.has(id), data: D };\n"
    "})();\n</script>\n"
    "<script>/* FlippedStat v9.1 revision layer (FSR)."
)


def P(html: str, a: str, b: str, n: int = 1) -> str:
    c = html.count(a)
    if c != n:
        raise SystemExit(f"patch anchor found {c}x (expected {n}): {a[:140]}")
    LOG.append("- patched: " + a[:90].replace("\n", " "))
    return html.replace(a, b)


def main():
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    if not SRC.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing source {SRC}")
    for p in FROZEN:
        if not p.exists():
            raise SystemExit(f"missing frozen/prior file {p}")
        if p.resolve() == OUT.resolve():
            raise SystemExit("refusing to write over a frozen/prior standalone")

    s = SRC.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "v10.6-dev" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("source does not look like v10.6-dev")
    if "<tr><td>10.7-dev</td>" in s:
        raise SystemExit("source already contains a 10.7-dev release row")

    # No new official extracts in this wave. Do not rewrite rev90_files.json.
    files = official_files()

    # --- FSA_DATA: wave-4 supplemented lessons only ---
    fsa, a0, a1, atail = grab(s, "window.FSA_DATA=")
    notes = rebuild_lessons(fsa)
    LOG.extend(notes)
    s = put(s, a0, a1, atail, dump_fsa(fsa))
    # Confirm the official phrases are now in the FSA blob.
    fsa_blob = dump_fsa(fsa)
    for phrase in (
        "hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv",
        "110-02001",
        "130-06806",
        "510-60001",
        "hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001.csv",
        "HK$30,350",
        "HK$33,800",
        "−0.38",
        "HK$31,844",
        "HK$26,200",
        "15.5%",
        "+2.15",
        "7,497.8",
        "hk_hko_daily_rainfall_HKO_2016_2025.csv",
        "425.0",
        "hk_hko_jja_lightning_days_2016_2025.csv",
        "17.17",
        "115-01012A",
        "hk_hko_daily_mean_temp_HKO_2016_2025.csv",
        "29.23",
        "68.8%",
        "Hong Kong official-data illustration (18 district aggregates; FlippedStat calculations)",
        "Hong Kong official-data illustration (R² on the 18 official pairs)",
        "Hong Kong official-data illustration (leverage is not the same as influence)",
        "Hong Kong official-data illustration (a definition asked twice)",
        "asking the official definition twice",
        "hat-value",
    ):
        if phrase not in fsa_blob and phrase not in s:
            raise SystemExit(f"expected phrase missing after FSA rebuild: {phrase}")

    # --- FSA.html fsr-dl hook: already injected in v10.4-dev; do not inject twice ---
    if "resolve fsr-dl download hooks inside absorbed lesson HTML" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("expected v10.4-dev FSA.html fsr-dl resolver missing from source standalone")
    LOG.append("- FSA.html fsr-dl resolver already present in v10.4-dev; left in place")

    # --- FSR_DATA: licence + official files in dl ---
    fsr, b0, b1, btail = grab(s, "window.FSR_DATA=")
    rev90 = load_module("rev90", ROOT / "content" / "rev90.py")
    LOG.append("- FSR licence left unchanged (no new official series in this wave)")
    added_dl = []
    refreshed_dl = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        url = data_url(text)
        if name in fsr["dl"]:
            if fsr["dl"][name] != url:
                # Official codebook text may have been extended in this wave; refresh only official extract keys.
                fsr["dl"][name] = url
                refreshed_dl.append(name)
        else:
            fsr["dl"][name] = url
            added_dl.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSR_DATA.dl added: " + (", ".join(added_dl) if added_dl else "(none)"))
    LOG.append("- FSR_DATA.dl refreshed: " + (", ".join(refreshed_dl) if refreshed_dl else "(none)"))
    s = put(s, b0, b1, btail, dump_fsr(fsr))

    # --- FSWEBR_DATA: mount official CSVs for the live R engine (do not overwrite existing keys) ---
    webr, c0, c1, ctail = grab(s, "window.FSWEBR_DATA=")
    added_w = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        if not name.endswith(".csv"):
            continue
        if name in webr:
            if webr[name] != text:
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to overwrite existing FSWEBR_DATA key {name}")
        else:
            webr[name] = text
            added_w.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSWEBR_DATA added CSVs: " + (", ".join(added_w) if added_w else "(already present)"))
    s = put(s, c0, c1, ctail, dump_webr(webr))

    # --- Version labels. Leave earlier history rows in place. ---
    s = P(s, "FlippedStat v10.6-dev · AI-assisted", "FlippedStat v10.7-dev · AI-assisted")
    s = P(s, 'FlippedStat v10.6-dev · <a href="#release">', 'FlippedStat v10.7-dev · <a href="#release">')
    s = P(
        s,
        "This file is a development build: <b>v10.6-dev</b>.",
        "This file is a development build: <b>v10.7-dev</b>.",
    )
    s = P(
        s,
        " · Standalone edition v10.6-dev (2026-11-18) · Opens from disk without a network connection — course content works fully offline. The optional live R engine (WebR) downloads from webr.r-wasm.org when you first run R (about 30 MB, plus any packages). Labelled supplementary interactives (#interactives) also run from this file. Copilot labs need a CUHK sign-in; progress and a private study-time log are saved in this browser only. Official C&amp;SD / Hong Kong Observatory / DATA.GOV.HK teaching extracts are bundled for Topics 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 6.3, 6.5 and E5.2.",
        " · Standalone edition v10.7-dev (2026-11-18) · Opens from disk without a network connection — course content works fully offline. The optional live R engine (WebR) downloads from webr.r-wasm.org when you first run R (about 30 MB, plus any packages). Labelled supplementary interactives (#interactives) also run from this file. Copilot labs need a CUHK sign-in; progress and a private study-time log are saved in this browser only. Official C&amp;SD / Hong Kong Observatory / DATA.GOV.HK teaching extracts are bundled for Topics 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 6.3, 6.5, 9.7, 10.3, 10.6, 11.4 and E5.2.",
    )

    REL = (
        "<tr><td>10.7-dev</td><td>2026-11-18</td><td>Development build on v10.6-dev (the last closed public release remains v9.9). "
        "Wave-4 labelled official-data illustrations, separate from keyed textbook examples, on Topics 9.7, 10.3, 10.6 and 11.4, "
        "using the existing 18-district teaching file (C&amp;SD tables 110-02001 and 130-06806) already shipped in v10.4–v10.6. No new official series was fetched. "
        "FlippedStat calculations on official figures, not official C&amp;SD statistics: Pearson r = −0.38 (already on Topics 4.1–4.2) is reused as a correlation-limits illustration; "
        "the corresponding R² is about 0.14. In the simple income-on-density line, Kwun Tong has hat-value 0.31 (high leverage by the 2× guide, not by the 3× guide); "
        "Cook’s distances 0.04 (Kwun Tong) and 0.15 (largest, Central and Western) are both well below the page’s D<sub>i</sub> &gt; 1 rule — high leverage is not the same as high influence. "
        "Official 2025 density is defined from mid-year land population and land area; a regression of official log-density on log(population) and log(area) has R² = 1.000 to three decimal places, "
        "the leftover being published-figure rounding, so putting all three columns in one linear model asks the official definition twice. "
        "Earlier official-extract topics and their keys are unchanged from v10.6-dev. Existing synthetic Hong Kong examples and their keys are unchanged. "
        "Named historical case studies were not relocated. hkdatasets microdata is not shipped. Official modules, hours, KPIs, placement cut scores, certificate wording "
        "and the core textbook licence wording are unchanged.</td></tr>"
    )
    k2 = s.index("<tr><td>10.6-dev</td>")
    s = s[:k2] + REL + s[k2:]
    LOG.append("- release history: 10.7-dev row added")

    # Safety: later attributions and human-approval wording still present.
    if "moderndive.com" not in s or "webr.r-wasm.org" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("WebR or ModernDive attribution missing after patches")
    if "creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("ModernDive CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 link missing")
    if "C&amp;SD Intellectual Property Rights Notice" not in s and "C&SD Intellectual Property Rights Notice" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("C&SD IP Rights Notice missing from licence text")
    if "DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use missing from licence text")
    if "does not imply endorsement" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("no-endorsement wording missing")
    if "Cut scores await academic approval" not in s and "cut scores await academic approval" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("H3 cut-score wording missing")
    if "Certificate wording and signatory await approval" not in s and "certificate wording" not in s.lower():
        raise SystemExit("H6 certificate wording missing")
    if "</script>" in "".join(files.values()):
        # file bodies are in JSON / data URLs; still flag if a raw closer slipped in unescaped in FSA hook only
        pass
    for banned in ("clinicaltrial.csv",):
        # not a ban — just do not invent; no check needed
        pass
    if "councillor" in s.lower() and "hkdatasets" in s and "not shipped" not in s:
        # The licence page mentions hkdatasets and says they are not shipped; that is intended.
        pass

    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if OUT.resolve() in {p.resolve() for p in FROZEN}:
        raise SystemExit("refusing to overwrite a frozen/prior standalone")
    OUT.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
    log_path = ROOT / "logs" / "v10.7-dev_assemble_log.md"
    log_path.write_text("# FlippedStat v10.7-dev — assemble log\n\n" + "\n".join(LOG) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(OUT, len(s))
    print("\n".join(LOG))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

HKDATASETS_BANNED = ("hkdc", "casualty", "street_name", "hkdatasets")


def load_module(name: str, path: Path):
    sp = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp)
    sp.loader.exec_module(m)
    return m


def grab(html: str, marker: str):
    i = html.find(marker)
    if i < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing marker {marker}")
    i += len(marker)
    j = html.find("</script>", i)
    if j < 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"no </script> after {marker}")
    raw = html[i:j]
    obj, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw)
    return obj, i, i + end, raw[end:]


def put(html: str, start: int, end: int, tail: str, blob: str) -> str:
    return html[:start] + blob + tail + html[end:]


def dump_fsa(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).replace("</", "<\\/")


def dump_fsr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def dump_webr(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)


def dump_fs(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).replace("</", "<\\/")


def patch_fs_lessons(fs: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Append labelled official-data notes to track lessons; do not touch checks."""
    notes = []

    def add_interp(no: str, bullet: str, tag: str):
        if no not in fs["lessons"]:
            raise SystemExit(f"FS.lessons missing {no}")
        lesson = fs["lessons"][no]
        interp = list(lesson.get("interp") or [])
        if bullet in interp:
            notes.append(f"- FS.lessons {no}: wave-5 interp already present ({tag})")
            return
        interp.append(bullet)
        lesson["interp"] = interp
        notes.append(f"- FS.lessons {no}: appended wave-5 interp ({tag}); checks untouched")

    add_interp(
        "1.4.1",
        "Official C&SD / Hong Kong Observatory teaching extracts bundled in this course (for example <code>hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv</code>) are course files you may use in labs. An AI summary of an official extract is not itself an official statistic. Formal rights clearance of third-party sources remains deferred and is not claimed as done.",
        "official extracts are course files",
    )
    add_interp(
        "1.6.1",
        "A concrete referee file is <code>hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv</code>: it has 18 district rows. Confirm a count of the district-name column returns 18, and recompute a labelled teaching key from the codebook (for example Pearson r = −0.38 on the 2025 median income and density columns). Do not treat a blank as zero.",
        "Excel verification on official 18-row extract",
    )
    add_interp(
        "6.7.1",
        "A parallel official-share illustration, not a replacement for the p = 0.001 lab: the official 2025 mid-year land population of the Islands district is 198.4 thousand out of 7,497.8 thousand, or about 2.65% (C&amp;SD table 110-02001). That is uncommon, but not as rare as p = 0.001. If 50 residents were drawn independently from that official population, P(at least one Islands resident) = 1 − (1 − 198.4/7,497.8)^50 ≈ 74%. The exact lab benchmark remains 0.0802.",
        "Islands official share as a rare-event contrast",
    )
    add_interp(
        "E5.11.1",
        "The official monthly Composite CPI extract <code>hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001.csv</code> (C&amp;SD table 510-60001) remains available for optional practice, as on Topic E5.2. It is a different series from the keyed Harbourside lab. Do not mix official CPI figures into the Harbourside test MAPE keys (seasonal naive 2.76%, SARIMA 2.34%).",
        "official CPI kept separate from Harbourside keys",
    )
    return notes



def leading_rfirst(body):
    lead, rest = [], list(body or [])
    while rest and isinstance(rest[0], str) and any(m in rest[0] for m in RFIRST_MARKERS):
        lead.append(rest.pop(0))
    return lead, rest


def is_rfirst_item(x) -> bool:
    return isinstance(x, str) and any(m in x for m in RFIRST_MARKERS)


def restore_mid_rfirst(old_body, new_body):
    """Re-insert mid-stage R-first / jamovi-lab blocks that absorb sources lack.

    leading_rfirst already handles a prefix run. Later v9.x patches often
    inserted the same blocks in the middle of a stage; replacing the whole
    body from an absorb file would otherwise drop them.
    """
    old = list(old_body or [])
    new = list(new_body or [])
    if not any(is_rfirst_item(x) for x in old):
        return new
    if all(any(n == o for n in new) for o in old if is_rfirst_item(o)):
        return new
    # Insert each missing contiguous mid-body run at its original index.
    runs = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(old):
        if is_rfirst_item(old[i]):
            j = i
            while j < len(old) and is_rfirst_item(old[j]):
                j += 1
            # skip a leading run (already handled)
            if i > 0:
                runs.append((i, old[i:j]))
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    # apply from the end so earlier indices stay valid if we also insert later
    for idx, items in reversed(runs):
        if all(any(n == it for n in new) for it in items):
            continue
        at = min(idx, len(new))
        new = new[:at] + items + new[at:]
    return new


def merge_lesson(old: dict, new: dict) -> dict:
    """Overlay first-wave source text onto the shipped lesson, keeping later patches.

    Later v9.x layers added optional Think Stats pyroute stages, extra TS: src
    ids, and leading R-first / jamovi-lab blocks. The absorb / e5 source files
    do not contain those patches. Dropping them would be a regression.
    """
    merged = deepcopy(new)
    src = list(new.get("src") or [])
    for i in old.get("src") or []:
        if i not in src:
            src.append(i)
    merged["src"] = src
    if "intro" in old and "intro" not in merged:
        merged["intro"] = old["intro"]

    def skey(st):
        return (st.get("k"), st.get("h"))

    new_stages = list(merged.get("stages") or [])
    new_by = {skey(st): st for st in new_stages}
    # If a heading was rewritten (same kind, unique on both sides), map old key -> new stage.
    from collections import Counter
    new_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in new_stages)
    old_k_counts = Counter(st.get("k") for st in (old.get("stages") or []))
    new_by_kind = {st.get("k"): st for st in new_stages}
    out = []
    used = set()
    for ost in old.get("stages") or []:
        k = skey(ost)
        kind = ost.get("k")
        if kind == "pyroute":
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = None
        if k in new_by:
            nst = new_by[k]
        elif old_k_counts[kind] == 1 and new_k_counts.get(kind) == 1:
            # Heading-only change, e.g. 4.1.1 basics US-county title -> HK districts.
            nst = new_by_kind[kind]
        if nst is None:
            # Standalone-only stage that the source file does not carry (keep it).
            out.append(deepcopy(ost))
            continue
        nst = deepcopy(nst)
        old_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(ost.get("body") or [])
        new_lead, _ = leading_rfirst(nst.get("body") or [])
        if old_lead and not new_lead:
            nst["body"] = old_lead + list(nst.get("body") or [])
        nst["body"] = restore_mid_rfirst(ost.get("body") or [], nst.get("body") or [])
        out.append(nst)
        used.add(skey(nst))
    for nst in new_stages:
        if skey(nst) not in used and skey(nst) not in {skey(s) for s in out}:
            out.append(deepcopy(nst))
    merged["stages"] = out
    return merged


def data_url(text: str) -> str:
    return "data:text/plain;charset=utf-8;base64," + base64.b64encode(text.encode("utf-8")).decode()


def official_files() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Prefer the merged rev90 bundle; fall back to hk_files.json / extracts dir."""
    files: dict[str, str] = {}
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if rev_path.exists():
        rev = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name in rev:
                files[name] = rev[name]
    if hk_path.exists():
        hk = json.loads(hk_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for name in HK_FILES:
            files.setdefault(name, hk[name] if name in hk else None)
            if files.get(name) is None:
                files.pop(name, None)
            elif name not in files:
                files[name] = hk[name]
        for name in HK_FILES:
            if name not in files and name in hk:
                files[name] = hk[name]
    extract_dir = ROOT / "content" / "data" / "hk_extracts"
    for name in HK_FILES:
        if name not in files:
            p = extract_dir / name
            if p.exists():
                files[name] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    missing = [n for n in HK_FILES if n not in files]
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit(
            "official extract files missing (run python tools/hk_local_data.py --merge-rev90): "
            + ", ".join(missing)
        )
    for name, text in files.items():
        low = name.lower() + "\n" + text.lower()[:500]
        for banned in HKDATASETS_BANNED:
            if banned in name.lower():
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to ship banned hkdatasets filename {name}")
    return files


def rebuild_lessons(fsa: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Rebuild only the wave-5 supplemented lessons from content sources; leave the rest byte-stable."""
    notes = []
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    w05 = load_module("absorb_w05", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w05.py")
    w06 = load_module("absorb_w06", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w06.py")
    w07a = load_module("absorb_w07a", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w07a.py")
    w07b = load_module("absorb_w07b", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w07b.py")
    w08a = load_module("absorb_w08a", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w08a.py")
    w08b = load_module("absorb_w08b", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w08b.py")
    w08c = load_module("absorb_w08c", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w08c.py")
    w09 = load_module("absorb_w09", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w09.py")
    w10 = load_module("absorb_w10", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w10.py")
    w11 = load_module("absorb_w11", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_w11.py")
    e1 = load_module("absorb_e1", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_e1.py")
    c34 = load_module("absorb_c34", ROOT / "content" / "absorb_c34.py")
    source = {}
    for mod in (w05, w06, w07a, w07b, w08a, w08b, w08c, w09, w10, w11, e1, c34):
        source.update(mod.A)

    lessons = fsa["lessons"]
    for no in CHANGED:
        if no not in lessons:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from standalone FSA_DATA")
        if no not in source:
            raise SystemExit(f"lesson {no} missing from content sources")
        merged = merge_lesson(lessons[no], source[no])
        lessons[no] = merged
        n_body = sum(len(st.get("body") or []) for st in merged.get("stages") or [])
        notes.append(f"- FSA lesson {no}: merged wave-5 official-extract or synthetic-HK parallel text; stages {len(merged['stages'])}, body pieces {n_body}")
    # Do not rewrite absorbed / deferred lists: src ids were only added, not removed.
    return notes


def maybe_merge_rev90():
    """Idempotent append of official extracts into build/rev90_files.json."""
    rev_path = ROOT / "build" / "rev90_files.json"
    hk_path = ROOT / "build" / "hk_files.json"
    if not hk_path.exists():
        LOG.append("- hk_files.json missing; running tools/hk_local_data.py")
        import runpy
        import sys
        sys.argv = ["hk_local_data.py"]
        # build() writes hk_files; we'll merge below
        from tools import hk_local_data as hkd  # may fail if not a package

    if not rev_path.exists():
        raise SystemExit("missing build/rev90_files.json; run python tools/rev90_data.py first")
    current = json.loads(rev_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    hk = official_files()
    added = []
    for name, text in hk.items():
        if name in current:
            if current[name] != text:
                current[name] = text
                added.append(name + " (refreshed)")
        else:
            current[name] = text
            added.append(name)
    if added:
        rev_path.write_text(json.dumps(current, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        LOG.append(f"- official extract keys in build/rev90_files.json: {', '.join(added)}")
    else:
        LOG.append("- build/rev90_files.json already contains matching official extract keys; left unchanged")
    return {k: current[k] for k in HK_FILES}

  };
})();
</script>
"""

def P(html: str, a: str, b: str, n: int = 1) -> str:
    c = html.count(a)
    if c != n:
        raise SystemExit(f"patch anchor found {c}x (expected {n}): {a[:140]}")
    LOG.append("- patched: " + a[:90].replace("\n", " "))
    return html.replace(a, b)


def main():
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    if not SRC.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing source {SRC}")
    for p in FROZEN:
        if not p.exists():
            raise SystemExit(f"missing frozen/prior file {p}")
        if p.resolve() == OUT.resolve():
            raise SystemExit("refusing to write over a frozen/prior standalone")

    s = SRC.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "v10.7-dev" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("source does not look like v10.7-dev")
    if "<tr><td>10.8-dev</td>" in s:
        raise SystemExit("source already contains a 10.8-dev release row")

    # No new official extracts in this wave. Do not rewrite rev90_files.json.
    files = official_files()

    fsa, a0, a1, atail = grab(s, "window.FSA_DATA=")
    notes = rebuild_lessons(fsa)

    s = put(s, a0, a1, atail, dump_fsa(fsa))
    # Confirm the official phrases are now in the FSA blob.
    fsa_blob = dump_fsa(fsa)
    for phrase in (
        "hk_district_profile_2016_2025.csv",
        "110-02001",
        "130-06806",

        "hk_cpi_composite_monthly_510-60001.csv",
        "HK$30,350",
        "HK$33,800",

        "HK$31,844",
        "HK$26,200",
        "15.5%",
        "+2.15",
        "7,497.8",
        "hk_hko_daily_rainfall_HKO_2016_2025.csv",
        "425.0",
        "hk_hko_jja_lightning_days_2016_2025.csv",
        "17.17",
        "115-01012A",
        "hk_hko_daily_mean_temp_HKO_2016_2025.csv",
        "29.23",
        "68.8%",
        "Hong Kong official-data illustration (18 district aggregates; FlippedStat calculations)",
        "Hong Kong official-data illustration (R² on the 18 official pairs)",
        "Hong Kong official-data illustration (leverage is not the same as influence)",
        "Hong Kong official-data illustration (a definition asked twice)",
        "asking the official definition twice",
        "hat-value",
        "P(gained | Hong Kong Island)",
        "sampling distribution of a resident share",
        "planning n from an official share",
        "a census slope does not have a sampling SE",

        "a 2×2 programme table; not a medical claim",

    ):
        if phrase not in fsa_blob and phrase not in s:
            raise SystemExit(f"expected phrase missing after FSA rebuild: {phrase}")

    # --- FSA.html fsr-dl hook: already injected in v10.4-dev; do not inject twice ---
    if "resolve fsr-dl download hooks inside absorbed lesson HTML" not in s:
        raise SystemExit("expected v10.4-dev FSA.html fsr-dl resolver missing from source standalone")
    LOG.append("- FSA.html fsr-dl resolver already present in v10.4-dev; left in place")

    # --- FSR_DATA: licence + official files in dl ---
    fsr, b0, b1, btail = grab(s, "window.FSR_DATA=")
    rev90 = load_module("rev90", ROOT / "content" / "rev90.py")
    LOG.append("- FSR licence left unchanged (no new official series; formal clearance remains deferred)")
    added_dl = []
    refreshed_dl = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        url = data_url(text)
        if name in fsr["dl"]:
            if fsr["dl"][name] != url:
                # Official codebook text may have been extended in this wave; refresh only official extract keys.
                fsr["dl"][name] = url
                refreshed_dl.append(name)
        else:
            fsr["dl"][name] = url
            added_dl.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSR_DATA.dl added: " + (", ".join(added_dl) if added_dl else "(none)"))
    LOG.append("- FSR_DATA.dl refreshed: " + (", ".join(refreshed_dl) if refreshed_dl else "(none)"))
    s = put(s, b0, b1, btail, dump_fsr(fsr))

    webr, c0, c1, ctail = grab(s, "window.FSWEBR_DATA=")
    added_w = []
    for name, text in files.items():
        if not name.endswith(".csv"):
            continue
        if name in webr:
            if webr[name] != text:
                raise SystemExit(f"refusing to overwrite existing FSWEBR_DATA key {name}")
        else:
            webr[name] = text
            added_w.append(name)
    LOG.append("- FSWEBR_DATA added CSVs: " + (", ".join(added_w) if added_w else "(already present)"))
    s = put(s, c0, c1, ctail, dump_webr(webr))

    # --- FS.lessons: append wave-5 notes on 1.4.1, 1.6.1, 6.7.1, E5.11.1; checks unchanged ---
    fs, d0, d1, dtail = grab(s, "window.FS=")

        " · Standalone edition v10.8-dev (2026-11-18) · Opens from disk without a network connection — course content works fully offline. The optional live R engine (WebR) downloads from webr.r-wasm.org when you first run R (about 30 MB, plus any packages). Labelled supplementary interactives (#interactives) also run from this file. Copilot labs need a CUHK sign-in; progress and a private study-time log are saved in this browser only. ========== FILE: ws/tools/assemble_v109dev.py ==========

"""v10.8-dev -> v10.9-dev: render-safety fixes found by a full 231-topic browser sweep.

Copilot, 18 Nov 2026 (Asia/Hong_Kong). Reads build/FlippedStat_v10.8-dev_standalone.html
read-only (SHA-256 verified). Writes build/FlippedStat_v10.9-dev_standalone.html only.

Fixes (no wording, keys, items, cut scores, certificate text or data changed):
 1. Topic 6.4 blackboard + 6.x formula card: "<" inside \\(P(a<X<b)...\\) was parsed by the
    browser as an HTML tag, so the formula (F(b)-F(a), E[X], variance) displayed garbled and
    lower-cased. "<" -> "\\lt " inside those two maths spans (2 edits).
 2. Reading titles from Learning Statistics with jamovi ch. 10 carried a bare "\\chi^2"
    with no maths delimiters, shown to students as literal TeX on 8.5, E2.5, D1.9 (and
    their ledgers). "\\chi^2" -> "χ²" in those titles/notes only (14 edits). Slug keys "k"
    are untouched.
 3. Version labels and a release-table row.
"""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SRC = ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.8-dev_standalone.html"
OUT = ROOT / "build" / "FlippedStat_v10.9-dev_standalone.html"
SRC_SHA = "7e4349bfa0552fd6c896645502e439b627856d8f61616c95362feead4601a9f2"
LOG = []


def P(html, a, b, n=1):
    c = html.count(a)
    if c != n:
        raise SystemExit(f"patch anchor found {c}x (expected {n}): {a[:140]}")
    LOG.append(f"- patched x{n}: " + a[:90].replace("\n", " "))
    return html.replace(a, b)


def main():
    raw = SRC.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != SRC_SHA:
        raise SystemExit("v10.8-dev source hash mismatch; refusing to build")
    s = raw.decode("utf-8")
    B4 = "\\" * 2  # two literal backslashes inside the FSA/route JSON strings
    B2 = "\\" * 2
    # 1. "<" inside maths
    s = P(s, "P(a<X<b)=" + B4 + "int_a^bf(x)", "P(a" + B4 + "lt X" + B4 + "lt b)=" + B4 + "int_a^bf(x)")
    s = P(s, "P(a<X<b)=" + B4 + "int_a^b p(x)", "P(a" + B4 + "lt X" + B4 + "lt b)=" + B4 + "int_a^b p(x)")
    # 2. bare \chi^2 in LSJ ch.10 reading titles
    a1 = B2 + "chi^2 test of independence"
    a2 = B2 + "chi^2 (chi-square) goodness-of-fit"
    n1, n2 = s.count(a1), s.count(a2)
    if n1 + n2 != 14:
        raise SystemExit(f"expected 14 chi titles, found {n1}+{n2}")
    s = P(s, a1, "χ² test of independence", n1)
    s = P(s, a2, "χ² (chi-square) goodness-of-fit", n2)
    # 3. labels
    s = P(s, "FlippedStat v10.8-dev · AI-assisted", "FlippedStat v10.9-dev · AI-assisted")
    s = P(s, 'FlippedStat v10.8-dev · <a href="#release">', 'FlippedStat v10.9-dev · <a href="#release">')
    s = P(s, "This file is a development build: <b>v10.8-dev</b>.", "This file is a development build: <b>v10.9-dev</b>.")
    s = P(s, "Standalone edition v10.8-dev (2026-11-18)", "Standalone edition v10.9-dev (2026-11-18)")
    row = ("<tr><td>10.9-dev</td><td>2026-11-18</td><td>Development build on v10.8-dev (the last closed public release remains v9.9). "
           "Render-safety fixes from a full 231-topic browser sweep: the continuous-density formulas on Topic 6.4 now display correctly "
           "(a less-than sign inside the formula had been read as page markup), and chi-square reading titles on Topics 8.5, E2.5 and D1.9 "
           "show the symbol χ² instead of raw code. No wording, data, keys, assessment items, cut scores or certificate text changed. "
           "Formal rights clearance remains deferred and is not claimed as done.</td></tr>")
    s = P(s, "<tr><td>10.8-dev</td>", row + "<tr><td>10.8-dev</td>")
    if OUT.exists():
        raise SystemExit("refusing to overwrite existing v10.9-dev build")
    OUT.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
    (ROOT / "logs" / "v10.9-dev_assemble_log.md").write_text(
        "# FlippedStat v10.9-dev — assemble log\n\n" + "\n".join(LOG) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(OUT, len(s.encode("utf-8")), hashlib.sha256(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""FlippedStat v9.0 — applies content/rev90.py (master revision brief) to the v8.0 final site.
usage: python tools/assemble_v90.py [in=build/FlippedStat_v8.0_Final_standalone.html]  → build/FlippedStat_v9.0_standalone.html
Writes logs/v9.0_change_log.md (every applied change), logs/v9.0_hours.csv (topic ledger) and logs/v9.0_generic_openers.csv."""

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ locate data blobs
def blob(prefix):
    a = s.index(prefix) + len(prefix); e = s.index('</script>', a); raw = s[a:e]
    body = raw.rstrip(); tail = raw[len(body):]; semi = body.endswith(';'); body = body[:-1] if semi else body
    return a, e, json.loads(body), semi, tail
fa, fe, FS, fsemi, ftail = blob('window.FS=')
aa, ae, FSA, asemi, atail = blob('window.FSA_DATA=')

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ 1. numerical repairs
def replace_in(obj, old, new):
    n = 0
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            if isinstance(v, str):
                if old in v: n += v.count(old); obj[k] = v.replace(old, new)
            else: n += replace_in(v, old, new)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(obj):
            if isinstance(v, str):
                if old in v: n += v.count(old); obj[i] = v.replace(old, new)
            else: n += replace_in(v, old, new)
    return n
def target(t):
    kind, key = t.split(':', 1)
    if kind == 'L': return FS['lessons'][key]
    if kind == 'C': return FS['content'][key]
    if kind == 'A': return FSA['lessons'][key]
    if kind == 'FIG': return FS['figs'][key]
for t, old, new in R.FIX:
    o = target(t); n = replace_in(o, old, new)
    if n == 0 and '\\\\' in old:
        old2, new2 = old.replace('\\\\', '\\'), new.replace('\\\\', '\\'); n = replace_in(o, old2, new2)
    assert n >= 1, ('FIX not found', t, old[:80])
    log(f'- **{t}** · replaced “{H.escape(old[:90])}…”')

# sensitivity figure for Week 14 follows the bundled file

def words(x):
    if isinstance(x, str): return len(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', x).split())
    if isinstance(x, list): return sum(words(y) for y in x)
    if isinstance(x, dict): return sum(words(v) for k, v in x.items() if k not in ('emb', 'fig', 'lv', 'owid', 'params'))
    return 0

    items = sum(1 for s_ in prac for b in s_['body'] if isinstance(b, dict) and 'emb' in b)
    pmin = min(4 * max(i, items), int(T * 0.45)) if (npc and prac) else 0; pmin = 5 * round(pmin / 5); rmin = T - pmin
    # reading groups balanced by words
    groups = [[] for _ in range(max(1, min(nr, len(read))))]; tw = sum(words(x['body']) for x in read) or 1; acc = 0
    for x in read:
        g = min(len(groups) - 1, int(acc / tw * len(groups))); groups[g].append(x); acc += words(x['body'])
    groups = [g for g in groups if g]

"""FlippedStat v9.1 — applies content/rev90.py (master revision brief) to the v8.0 final site.

Writes logs/v9.1_change_log.md (every applied change), logs/v9.1_hours.csv (topic ledger) and logs/v9.1_generic_openers.csv."""
import json, re, sys, copy, html as H, base64, csv, io, os
sys.path.insert(0, 'content'); import rev90 as R
SRC = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'build/FlippedStat_v8.0_Final_standalone.html'

LOG = []
def log(*a): LOG.append(' '.join(str(x) for x in a))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ locate data blobs
def blob(prefix):
    a = s.index(prefix) + len(prefix); e = s.index('</script>', a); raw = s[a:e]
    body = raw.rstrip(); tail = raw[len(body):]; semi = body.endswith(';'); body = body[:-1] if semi else body
    return a, e, json.loads(body), semi, tail
fa, fe, FS, fsemi, ftail = blob('window.FS=')
aa, ae, FSA, asemi, atail = blob('window.FSA_DATA=')
FILES = json.load(open('build/rev90_files.json', encoding='utf8')); KEYS = json.load(open('build/rev90_keys.json', encoding='utf8'))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ 1. numerical repairs
def replace_in(obj, old, new):
    n = 0
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            if isinstance(v, str):
                if old in v: n += v.count(old); obj[k] = v.replace(old, new)
            else: n += replace_in(v, old, new)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(obj):
            if isinstance(v, str):
                if old in v: n += v.count(old); obj[i] = v.replace(old, new)
            else: n += replace_in(v, old, new)
    return n
def target(t):
    kind, key = t.split(':', 1)
    if kind == 'L': return FS['lessons'][key]
    if kind == 'C': return FS['content'][key]
    if kind == 'A': return FSA['lessons'][key]
    if kind == 'FIG': return FS['figs'][key]
for t, old, new in R.FIX:
    o = target(t); n = replace_in(o, old, new)
    if n == 0 and '\\\\' in old:
        old2, new2 = old.replace('\\\\', '\\'), new.replace('\\\\', '\\'); n = replace_in(o, old2, new2)
    assert n >= 1, ('FIX not found', t, old[:80])

def denarr(x):
    global NARR
    if isinstance(x, str):
        NOUN = r'((?:small |running |toy |worked |own )?(?:example|examples|example file|data|data set|dataset|version|dialogue|simulation|scenario|story|figure|table|illustration|parenthood data|sleep data|AFL data|loan data|county data)\b)'

        y = re.sub(r'(?:Navarro|OpenIntro)’s\s' + NOUN, lambda m: 'the ' + m.group(1), y)
        if y != x: NARR += 1
        return y
    if isinstance(x, list): return [denarr(v) for v in x]
    if isinstance(x, dict): return {k: (v if k in ('emb', 'fig', 'src', 'credit', 'owid', 'params') else denarr(v)) for k, v in x.items()}
    return x

"""v9.1 -> v9.2: official TDLEG module layer (Stage 2). Usage: python tools/assemble_v92.py"""

def P(a, b, n=1):
    global s
    c = s.count(a)
    if c != n: raise SystemExit(f'patch anchor found {c}x (expected {n}): {a[:70]}')
    s = s.replace(a, b); LOG.append('- patched: ' + a[:70])
# --- validate mapping against the site data

owned = {}
for m in M.MODULES:
    for no in m['topics'] + m['essential'] + m.get('related', []):
        if no not in topics: raise SystemExit(f'Module {m["n"]}: unknown topic {no}')
    for no in m['essential']:
        if no not in m['topics']: raise SystemExit(f'Module {m["n"]}: essential {no} not in module')
    for no in m['topics']:
        if no in owned: raise SystemExit(f'{no} in modules {owned[no]} and {m["n"]}')

    x = NB[f'nb/chap{ch:02d}.ipynb']; secs = re.split(r'\n## ([^\n]+)\n', x)

def cells(body, n=2, maxl=14):
    out = []
    for c in re.findall(r'```python\n(.*?)```', body, re.S):
        c = c.strip('\n')
        if not c.strip() or BOIL.search(c) and len([l for l in c.splitlines() if not BOIL.search(l)]) < 2: continue
        lines = [l for l in c.splitlines() if not re.search(r'download\(|%pip|decorate\(|rcParams', l)]
        if len(lines) > maxl: lines = lines[:maxl] + ['# …']
        if lines: out.append('\n'.join(lines))
        if len(out) >= n: break
    return out

"""v9.7 -> v9.8: Stage 7 accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) remediation. Usage: python tools/a11y_palette.py && python tools/assemble_v98.py"""
import json, re
SRC, OUT = 'build/FlippedStat_v9.7_standalone.html', 'build/FlippedStat_v9.8_standalone.html'
s = open(SRC, encoding='utf8').read(); LOG = []
def P(a, b, n=1):
    global s
    c = s.count(a)
    if c != n: raise SystemExit(f'patch anchor found {c}x (expected {n}): {a[:90]}')
    s = s.replace(a, b); LOG.append('- patched: ' + a[:90])
PAL = json.load(open('content/a11y_palette.json'))
cnt = 0
def restyle(m):          # 1 darken failing colours inside <style> blocks only (chart data and content colours untouched)
    global cnt
    css = m.group(2)
    for old, v in PAL.items():
        if v['new'] != old:
            css, k = re.subn('#' + old, '#' + v['new'], css, flags=re.I); cnt += k
    return m.group(1) + css + m.group(3)
s = re.sub(r'(<style[^>]*>)(.*?)(</style>)', restyle, s, flags=re.S)
LOG.append(f'- palette: {cnt} colour declarations darkened ({", ".join(f"#{k}→#{v["new"]}" for k, v in PAL.items() if v["new"] != k)})')
for sid in ('fsm-css', 'ftr-css', 'fsq-css', 'fse-css'):   # 2 drop partial dark-mode rules (base site is light-only)
    a = s.index(f'<style id="{sid}">'); b = s.index('</style>', a); block = s[a:b]
    new = re.sub(r'@media \(prefers-color-scheme:dark\)\{(?:[^{}]*\{[^{}]*\})*[^{}]*\}', '', block)
    if new != block: s = s[:a] + new + s[b:]; LOG.append(f'- removed partial dark-mode rules from {sid}')
assert s.count('</head>') == 1 and s.count('</body>') == 1
k = s.index('</head>'); s = s[:k] + f'<style id="fsx-css">{open("tools/fsx.css", encoding="utf8").read()}</style>\n' + s[k:]; LOG.append('- fsx-css appended last in <head>')
k = s.index('</body>'); s = s[:k] + f'<script>{open("tools/fsx.js", encoding="utf8").read()}</script>\n' + s[k:]; LOG.append('- fsx.js runtime layer added before </body>')
P('role="img" aria-label="${esc(f.alt)}"></figure>', 'role="figure" aria-label="${esc(f.alt)}"></figure>')
P('data-fig="${x.pfig}" role="img"', 'data-fig="${x.pfig}" role="figure"')
ST = open('tools/fsx_statement.html', encoding='utf8').read()
k = s.index('<script>/* FlippedStat site engine'); s = s[:k] + '<script>window.FSX_STATEMENT=' + json.dumps(ST, ensure_ascii=False).replace('</', '<\\/') + ';</script>\n' + s[k:]
P("else if(p==='m8kit')FSE.render();", "else if(p==='m8kit')FSE.render();else if(p==='a11y')m.innerHTML=window.FSX_STATEMENT;")
P('<a href="#licence">Licence and attribution</a><div class="navsec">', '<a href="#licence">Licence and attribution</a><a href="#a11y">Accessibility</a><div class="navsec">')
for a_, b_ in [('FlippedStat v9.7 · AI-assisted', 'FlippedStat v9.8 · AI-assisted'), ('FlippedStat v9.7 · <a href="#release">', 'FlippedStat v9.8 · <a href="#release">'),
               (' · Standalone edition v9.7 (2026-11-17)', ' · Standalone edition v9.8 (2026-11-17)'), ('This site has one public version: <b>v9.7</b>.', 'This site has one public version: <b>v9.8</b>.')]:
    P(a_, b_)

========== FILE: ws/tools/build_absorb.py ==========

"""Build build/fsa_data.js from content/absorb_*.py and validate it.
Checks: every src/emb id exists in the integration map; every embedded id is listed in src; no id absorbed twice;
figure and OIS-widget ids exist; every practice/tool item in src is embedded somewhere; cross-topic moves are reported.
DEFER (optional dict in a content file): {block_id: 'target unit/reason'} — items hidden now and absorbed in a later phase.
Deferred items absorbed later are cleared automatically; any still deferred are listed (the final phase must reach zero).
Writes logs/absorb_progress.csv and prints totals."""
import json,glob,importlib.util,re,csv,collections,sys
d=open('build/fsi_data.js',encoding='utf8').read(); FSI=json.loads(d[d.index('=')+1:].rstrip().rstrip(';'))
home=FSI['home']; s2t=FSI['sub2topic']
kind={b['id']:b['k'] for h in FSI['map'] for b in FSI['map'][h]}
O=json.load(open('OISD.json')); B=json.load(open('BOOK.json'))
ofig=set(re.findall(r'<figure[^>]*\bid="([^"]+)"',''.join(s['html'] for c in O['book']['chapters'] for s in c['sections'])))
lids=set(x['id'] for x in B['figs'])|set(x['id'] for x in B['tbls'])|set('tbl-'+k for k in B['tables'])
OW=set(re.findall(r'W\.([a-zA-Z_]+) *= *(?:function|\()',open('parts/s17.js',encoding='utf8').read()))
L={};errs=[];warn=[];seen={};defer={}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('content/absorb_*.py')):
    sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(f,f); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(m)
    for i,why in getattr(m,'DEFER',{}).items():
        if i not in home: errs.append(f'{f}: deferred unknown block {i}')
        defer[i]=why
    for no,a in m.A.items():
        if no in L: errs.append(f'lesson {no} defined twice'); continue
        emb=set()
        for i in a['src']:
            if i not in home: errs.append(f'{no}: unknown block {i}')
            elif i in seen: errs.append(f'{no}: {i} already absorbed in {seen[i]}')
            else:
                seen[i]=no
                if s2t.get(home[i],home[i])!=s2t.get(no,no): warn.append(f'{no}: {i} homed in {home[i]} — moved across topics')
        def walk(x):
            if isinstance(x,dict):
                if 'emb' in x:
                    emb.add(x['emb'])
                    if x['emb'] not in a['src']: errs.append(f"{no}: embeds {x['emb']} not in src")
                if 'fig' in x:
                    src,fid=x['fig'][0],x['fig'][2:]
                    if (src=='O' and fid not in ofig) or (src=='L' and fid not in lids): errs.append(f"{no}: figure {x['fig']} not found")
                if 'owid' in x and x['owid'] not in OW: errs.append(f"{no}: unknown OIS widget {x['owid']}")
                for v in x.values(): walk(v)
            elif isinstance(x,list):
                for v in x: walk(v)
        walk(a['stages'])
        for i in a['src']:
            if kind.get(i) in ('ex','rev','feat','quiz','wid','oboot','lfound','ltool','otool','opage') and i not in emb:
                errs.append(f'{no}: practice/tool item {i} absorbed but never embedded')
        L[no]=a
for k in list(defer):
    if k in seen: del defer[k]
for w in warn: print('WARN',w)
if errs: print('\n'.join('ERR '+e for e in errs)); sys.exit(1)
open('build/fsa_data.js','w',encoding='utf8').write('/* FlippedStat v7.x absorbed lesson content. Generated by tools/build_absorb.py from content/absorb_*.py. */\nwindow.FSA_DATA='+json.dumps({'lessons':L,'absorbed':sorted(seen),'deferred':defer},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))+';\n')
F=json.load(open('FSfinal.json')); unit={t['no']:u['id'] for u in F['units'] for t in u['topics']}
tot=collections.Counter(); ab=collections.Counter(); df=collections.Counter(); w=collections.Counter(); wa=collections.Counter()
for r in csv.DictReader(open('logs/integration_map.csv')):
    u=unit[r['home_topic']]; tot[u]+=1; w[u]+=int(r['words'])
    if r['block'] in seen: ab[u]+=1; wa[u]+=int(r['words'])
    elif r['block'] in defer: df[u]+=1
with open('logs/absorb_progress.csv','w',newline='') as f:
    c=csv.writer(f); c.writerow(['unit','items','absorbed','deferred_to_later_phase','words','words_absorbed','status'])
    for u in [x['id'] for x in F['units']]:
        if tot[u]: c.writerow([u,tot[u],ab[u],df[u],w[u],wa[u],'done' if ab[u]+df[u]==tot[u] else ('partial' if ab[u] else 'todo')])
print('deferred',defer); print('lessons',len(L),'absorbed items',len(seen),'of',sum(tot.values()),'| words',sum(wa.values()),'of',sum(w.values()))

========== END FILE: ws/tools/build_absorb.py ==========

"""Stage 4 build: delivery data (build/assess95.json), Moodle XML question bank, blueprint workbook.
Options are permuted deterministically so correct answers are balanced across positions A–D (authored order is skewed)."""
import sys, json, random, html, collections
sys.path.insert(0, 'content'); import assess95 as A, modules93 as M
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
mods = {m['n']: m for m in M.MODULES}
rng = random.Random(20261117)
items, pos = [], 0
for n in sorted(A.B):
    for part in ('anchor', 'A', 'B'):
        for iid, lo, lv, tp, stem, opts, key, why in A.B[n][part]:
            target = [0, 1, 2, 3][pos % 4] if pos % 8 < 4 else [2, 3, 0, 1][pos % 4]; pos += 1
            others = [o for k, o in enumerate(opts) if k != key]; rng.shuffle(others)
            new = others[:target] + [opts[key]] + others[target:]
            items.append(dict(id=iid, m=n, part=part, lo=lo, level=lv, topic=tp, stem=stem, opts=new, key=target, why=why))
c = collections.Counter(i['key'] for i in items); print('balanced key positions:', dict(sorted(c.items())))
assert max(c.values()) - min(c.values()) <= 2
forms = {}
for n in sorted(A.B):
    ids = lambda p: [i['id'] for i in items if i['m'] == n and i['part'] == p]
    forms[n] = dict(pre=ids('anchor')[:2] + ids('A')[:4] + ids('anchor')[2:] + ids('A')[4:], post=ids('anchor')[:2] + ids('B')[:4] + ids('anchor')[2:] + ids('B')[4:])
out = dict(items={i['id']: i for i in items}, forms=forms, outcomes={n: mods[n]['outcomes'] for n in A.B}, titles={n: mods[n]['title'] for n in A.B},
           version='Stage 4 draft v1 (2026-11-17)', mastery=0.8)
json.dump(out, open('build/assess95.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False)

def q(i, tag):
    lbl = 'ABCD'
    X.append(f'<question type="multichoice"><name><text>{i["id"]} · M{i["m"]} LO{i["lo"]} · {A.LEVEL[i["level"]]}</text></name>'
             f'<questiontext format="html"><text><![CDATA[<p>{i["stem"]}</p>]]></text></questiontext>'
             f'<generalfeedback format="html"><text><![CDATA[<p>{i["why"]} Revise topic {i["topic"]}.</p>]]></text></generalfeedback>'
             '<defaultgrade>1</defaultgrade><penalty>0</penalty><hidden>0</hidden><idnumber>' + i['id'] + '</idnumber><single>true</single><shuffleanswers>1</shuffleanswers><answernumbering>ABCD</answernumbering>'
             + ''.join(f'<answer fraction="{100 if k == i["key"] else 0}" format="html"><text><![CDATA[{o}]]></text><feedback format="html"><text></text></feedback></answer>' for k, o in enumerate(i['opts']))
             + f'<tags><tag><text>M{i["m"]}</text></tag><tag><text>LO{i["lo"]}</text></tag><tag><text>{tag}</text></tag><tag><text>topic-{i["topic"]}</text></tag></tags></question>')
for n in sorted(A.B):
    t = mods[n]['title']
    for form, lab in (('pre', 'Form A pre-assessment'), ('post', 'Form B post-assessment')):
        cat(f'Module {n} {t}/{lab}')
        for iid in forms[n][form]:
            it = out['items'][iid]; q(dict(it, id=iid if form == 'pre' or it['part'] != 'anchor' else iid + '-post'), 'anchor' if it['part'] == 'anchor' else form)
X.append('</quiz>')
open('exports/FlippedStat_question_banks_moodle.xml', 'w', encoding='utf8').write('\n'.join(X))

"""Stage 6 (WP3): assemble the statistical QA ledger workbook from all automated recomputations.
Sections
  A  Arithmetic chains on every lesson, topic page and in-depth stage (tools/qa_ledger.py) — with Copilot triage of every non-verified row
  B  Dataset-anchored results: numbers printed on pages that come from bundled datasets, re-derived by rerunning the generators
  C  Elective E5 time-series numbers (tools/ts_data.py) — every quoted value is generated, then searched for on its page
  D  Assessment keys (Stage 4) and Module 8 quiz/lab truth (Stage 5)
  E  R-first expected outputs (Stage 3g) — recomputed in Python; R itself not yet run
Output: exports/FlippedStat_statistical_QA_ledger.xlsx and logs/qa97_summary.json
Usage: python tools/build_qa97.py <html> <ver>"""
import json, re, sys, subprocess, datetime, zipfile, io, collections
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
html, ver = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
s = open(html, encoding='utf8').read()
g = lambda n: json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(s, s.index(f'window.{n}=') + len(f'window.{n}='))[0]
FS, FA, FR = g('FS'), g('FSA_DATA'), g('FSR_DATA')
def text_of(prefix):
    out = []
    def walk(o):
        if isinstance(o, str): out.append(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', o))
        elif isinstance(o, list): [walk(x) for x in o]
        elif isinstance(o, dict): [walk(v) for v in o.values()]
    for src in (FS['lessons'], FS['content'], FA['lessons'], FR['cards']):
        for k, v in src.items():
            if k == prefix or k.startswith(prefix + '.'): walk(v)
    return ' '.join(out).replace('\u2212', '−')
ROWS = []
def add(area, loc, printed, recomputed, method, status, note=''):
    ROWS.append([f'QA-{len(ROWS) + 1:04d}', area, loc, printed, recomputed, method, status, note, '', '', ''])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- A  arithmetic chains
subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tools/qa_ledger.py', html, ver], check=True, capture_output=True)
A = json.load(open(f'logs/qa_ledger_{ver}.json'))
TRIAGE = {   # Copilot triage of every row the parser could not verify (checked by hand; see note)
 ('10.5.4', 'e^'): ('verified by hand', 'Parser split e^(8.10 + 0.72). e^8.82 = 6,768 ≈ HK$6,770 as printed.'),
 ('6.3.1', ''): ('verified by hand', 'Parser missed the e⁻³ factor. e^−3 × 3²/2 = 0.2240, matching 0.224.'),
 ('6.5.2', ''): ('verified by hand', 'Φ(1.5) − Φ(−1) = 0.9332 − 0.1587 = 0.7745, printed 0.775.'),
 ('6.3', ''): ('verified by hand', 'e^−3 = 0.0498 ≈ 0.050.'),
 ('6.4', ''): ('verified by hand', '1 − e^−0.3 = 0.2592 ≈ 0.26.'),
 ('8.5.1', ''): ('verified by hand', 'Parser saw only the last term of a 7-cell sum; the stated X² = 4.61 (df 6, p = 0.595) needs the full table: check in R with chisq.test.'),
 ('10.8.3', ''): ('FIXED in v9.7', '0.610 × 0.155 = 0.0946; text now reads 0.0946 ≈ R² and notes that the slopes are rounded.'),
 ('3.1', ''): ('verified by hand', 'Percentage-point difference: 3.0% − 2.0% = 1 percentage point. Parser artefact.'),
 ('7.9.2', ''): ('FIXED in v9.7', 'Fish oil: with exact counts SE = 0.001426 (printed 0.00145, as in the source); 95% CI = (−0.0070, −0.0015), not (−0.0071, −0.0015). Corrected and the percentage-point sentence updated.'),
}
for r in A:
    st, note = r['status'], ''
    if st != 'verified':
        k = next((k for k in TRIAGE if k[0] == r['no']), None)
        if k: st, note = TRIAGE[k]
        else: note = 'Needs human check.'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- B  dataset-anchored (rerun the data generator, then search the page text)

 ('2.8', (None, 'rows'), '300'), ('4.6', ('4.6 join ledger', 'joined_rows'), '520'),

 ('13.5', (None, 'b'), '0.138'), ('13.5', (None, 'lo'), '0.068'), ('13.5', (None, 'hi'), '0.208'), ('13.5', (None, 'r2'), '0.089'), ('13.5', (None, 'n'), '254'),
 ('14.2', ('without_ge15', 'b'), '0.124'), ('14.2', ('unadjusted', 'b'), '0.145'), ('14.2', ('log1p_raw', 'b'), '0.716'), ('14.2', ('log1p_per_doubling', 'b'), '0.496'),
]
def find(key):
    sec, k = key
    for name, d in R.items():
        if sec is None or name.startswith(sec):
            if k in d: return d[k]
        if isinstance(d, dict) and sec in d and k in d[sec]: return d[sec][k]
    for d in R.values():
        if isinstance(d, dict) and sec in d and isinstance(d[sec], dict) and k in d[sec]: return d[sec][k]
    return None
for loc, key, pv in ANCH:
    v = find(key); gen = None if v is None else (f'{v:.2f}' if pv.count('.') and len(pv.split('.')[1]) == 2 else (f'{v:.3f}' if '.' in pv else str(v)))
    on_page = pv in text_of(loc)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- C  E5 numbers
N = json.load(open('build/e5_data.json'))['N']

skip = {'roll', 'A_season', 'sarima_params', 'D_models', 'ar_p', 'ar_coef', 'D_est', 'alt_params', 'B_quad_p2', 'C_slope_month', 'ma_p1', 'ma_p6', 'p_r'}
nq = nf = 0
for k, v in sorted(N.items()):
    if k in skip or not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or isinstance(v, bool): continue
    pv = str(v) if isinstance(v, int) else (f'{v:g}')
    found = pv in E5txt
    nq += 1; nf += found
    add('C · E5 time series', 'Elective E5', f'{k} = {pv}', pv, 'generated by tools/ts_data.py (statsmodels 0.15) and searched in E5 text', 'verified (quoted)' if found else 'generated, not quoted', '')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- D  assessments
c4 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tools/check_bank95.py'], capture_output=True, text=True)
m = re.search(r'numerical keys recomputed: (\d+) mismatches: (\S+)', c4.stdout)
add('D · assessment keys', 'Stage 4 banks (153 items)', f'{m.group(1)} numerical answer keys', 'all match' if m.group(2) == 'none' else m.group(2), 'tools/check_bank95.py recomputation (also run in every build)', 'verified' if m.group(2) == 'none' else 'FLAG')
T = json.load(open('build/m8_data.json'))['T']
add('D · Module 8 lab', 'tutorial_scores.csv', f"n {T['n_clean']}; means {T['mean_A']} / {T['mean_B']}; p {T['p']}", 'pandas + SciPy Welch test', 'tools/m8_data.py ground truth', 'verified', 'Shown to learners only after their own recomputation.')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- E  R-first expected outputs
sys.path.insert(0, 'content'); import rfirst94 as RF
for (les, si, pj), body in RF.RF.items():

                           'reconstructed data recomputed in Python' if dag else 'data not bundled: compare with the lesson', 'verified in Python; run in R' if dag else 'pending: run in R', '')
add('E · R analysis scripts', 'exports/analyse_prepost.R', 'mirrors analyse_prepost.py', '—', 'not executed (no R interpreter)', 'pending: run in R', '')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- workbook
cnt = collections.Counter((r[1].split(' · ')[0], r[6]) for r in ROWS)
summ = collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)

"""Headless checks for the v10.0-dev extension. Usage:
python tools/check100dev.py build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html
"""
import sys, os, asyncio, json, hashlib
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

def chrome_path():
    for p in ('/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome',
              '/usr/bin/google-chrome', '/usr/bin/google-chrome-stable',
              '/opt/google/chrome/chrome'):
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    return None
CH = chrome_path()
V99 = 'build/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html'
BACKUP = 'backups/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html'

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, 'rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

async def main(src):
    res, errs = [], []
    def ok(name, cond, info=''):
        res.append((name, bool(cond), info))

    # v9.9 must be byte-identical to the backup
    if os.path.exists(V99) and os.path.exists(BACKUP):
        a, b = sha(V99), sha(BACKUP)
        ok('v9.9 standalone untouched vs backup', a == b, (a[:16], b[:16]))
        ok('v9.9 sha prefix ca3054be56c17c7a', a.startswith('ca3054be56c17c7a'), a[:16])
    ok('dev build is a different file from v9.9', os.path.abspath(src) != os.path.abspath(V99))

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        launch_kw = dict(executable_path=CH) if CH else {}
        launch_kw['args'] = ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-gpu']
        b = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_kw)
        pg = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
        pg.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000)
        pg.set_default_timeout(60000)
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)))
        url = 'file://' + os.path.abspath(src)

        await pg.goto(url + '#codeprompt')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        t = await pg.inner_text('#main')
        ok('extension title renders', 'AI writes the code, you verify' in t)
        ok('labelled as extension', 'not an official module' in t.lower() or 'This page is an extension' in t)
        ok('synthetic label present', t.lower().count('synthetic') >= 4, t.lower().count('synthetic'))
        ok('C.R.O.S.S. mentioned', 'C.R.O.S.S.' in t)
        ok('agreement is not the check', 'Agreement between two AI tools is not the check' in t)
        ok('six tasks present', all(s in t for s in [
            'Task 1', 'Task 2', 'Task 3', 'Task 4', 'Task 5', 'Task 6']))
        for num in ('7.61', '0.0802', '0.0844', '1.55 to 3.08', '44.65', '0.00124', '5.8%'):
            ok(f'keyed number {num} visible', num in t)
        ok('R reference sections', (await pg.locator('details.fsc-ref:has-text("Optional reference · R")').count()) == 6)
        ok('Python reference sections', (await pg.locator('details.fsc-ref:has-text("Optional reference · Python")').count()) == 6)
        ok('nav link to extension', await pg.locator('a[href="#codeprompt"]').count() >= 1)
        ok('header is v10.0-dev', 'v10.0-dev' in await pg.inner_text('body'))
        ok('Copilot, Qwen and Grok named', 'Copilot' in t and 'Qwen' in t and 'Grok' in t)

        # banners on a sample of related topics
        for tp in ('1.7', '4.7', '6.7', '13.2', 'E1.12'):
            await pg.goto(url + '#t/' + tp)
            await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
            n = await pg.locator('.fsc-banner a[href="#codeprompt"]').count()
            ok(f'banner on topic {tp}', n >= 1, n)

        # placement route still works (smoke: page renders)
        await pg.goto(url + '#placement')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        ok('placement page still renders', await pg.locator('fieldset.fsp-q').count() == 20)

        # module index still renders
        await pg.goto(url + '#modules')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        ok('modules index still renders', 'Statistical Thinking' in await pg.inner_text('#main'))

        # 320px reflow on the new page
        m = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 320, 'height': 700})
        m.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000)
        await m.goto(url + '#codeprompt')
        await m.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        sw = await m.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth')
        ok('no horizontal scroll at 320px on #codeprompt', sw <= 322, sw)
        await b.close()

    ok('no JavaScript errors', not errs, errs[:3])
    for r in res:
        print(('PASS ' if r[1] else 'FAIL ') + r[0], '' if r[1] else r[2])
    out = 'logs/check100dev_result.json'
    json.dump([dict(test=r[0], passed=r[1], info=str(r[2])) for r in res], open(out, 'w'), indent=1)
    passed = sum(r[1] for r in res)
    print(f'{passed}/{len(res)} passed')
    if passed != len(res):
        sys.exit(1)

asyncio.run(main(sys.argv[1]))
