"""Headless checks for the v10.1-dev WebR increment. Usage:
python tools/check101dev.py build/FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html
"""
import sys, os, asyncio, json, hashlib, urllib.request
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

def chrome_path():
    for p in ('/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome',
              '/usr/bin/google-chrome', '/usr/bin/google-chrome-stable',
              '/opt/google/chrome/chrome'):
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    return None
CH = chrome_path()
V99 = 'build/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html'
BACKUP = 'backups/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html'
V100 = 'build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html'
V99_SHA = 'ca3054be56c17c7a0f996c49a0eb3ddec86c8eaba869cf46e5f8a8ae0b542651'
V100_SHA = '9f3675d6719244df22e663f28b0b870bf5f7b7efb9ddd7eedfec3a693953a97b'
V100_SIZE = 19316315

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, 'rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def webr_reachable():
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            'https://webr.r-wasm.org/latest/webr.mjs', method='HEAD')
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
            return 200 <= r.status < 400
    except Exception as e:
        return False

async def main(src):
    res, errs, webr_reqs = [], [], []
    def ok(name, cond, info=''):
        res.append((name, bool(cond), info))

    if os.path.exists(V99):
        a = sha(V99)
        ok('v9.9 sha is ca3054be56c17c7a…', a == V99_SHA, a)
        if os.path.exists(BACKUP):
            b = sha(BACKUP)
            ok('v9.9 standalone untouched vs backup', a == b, (a[:16], b[:16]))
    if os.path.exists(V100):
        c = sha(V100)
        ok('v10.0-dev sha unchanged', c == V100_SHA, c)
        ok('v10.0-dev size unchanged', os.path.getsize(V100) == V100_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V100))
    ok('dev build is a different file from v9.9 and v10.0-dev',
       os.path.abspath(src) not in (os.path.abspath(V99), os.path.abspath(V100)))

    raw = open(src, encoding='utf8').read()
    ok('build contains FSWEBR namespace', 'window.FSWEBR' in raw or 'window.FSWEBR =' in raw or 'FSWEBR' in raw)
    ok('build contains FSWEBR_DATA', 'window.FSWEBR_DATA' in raw)
    ok('build does not leak RENG / MD_R / md_r_server / ModernDive class names',
       all(tok not in raw for tok in ('RENG', 'MD_R', 'md_r_server', 'class="rbtn"', "id='rbtn'"))
       and 'ModernDive' not in raw)
    ok('ChannelType.PostMessage is used', 'ChannelType.PostMessage' in raw or 'channelType' in raw)
    ok('WebR is lazy-loaded from webr.r-wasm.org, not vendored',
       'webr.r-wasm.org/latest/' in raw and 'webr.mjs' in raw
       and raw.count('webr.r-wasm.org') >= 1
       and 'mod.WebR' in raw)
    ok('header button id is present in the script', 'fswebr-btn' in raw)
    ok('footer mentions optional WebR and offline content',
       'optional live R engine' in raw and 'course content works fully offline' in raw.lower())
    ok('licence page attributes WebR', 'docs.r-wasm.org' in raw and 'webr.r-wasm.org' in raw)
    for fn in ('sleep_column.csv', 'survey300.csv', 'wellbeing300.csv',
               'satisfaction300.csv', 'harbourside_demand.csv'):
        ok(f'FSWEBR_DATA includes {fn}', f'"{fn}"' in raw)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        launch_kw = dict(executable_path=CH) if CH else {}
        launch_kw['args'] = ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-gpu']
        b = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_kw)

        # --- load, no WebR fetch yet, no JS errors ---
        pg = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
        pg.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000)
        pg.set_default_timeout(60000)
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)))
        async def on_req(req):
            u = req.url
            if 'webr.r-wasm.org' in u or u.endswith('webr.mjs'):
                webr_reqs.append(u)
        pg.on('request', on_req)
        url = 'file://' + os.path.abspath(src)

        await pg.goto(url + '#codeprompt')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        ok('no WebR network request on initial load', not webr_reqs, webr_reqs[:3])
        ok('header WebR button present', await pg.locator('#fswebr-btn').count() == 1)
        t = await pg.inner_text('#main')
        ok('extension title renders', 'AI writes the code, you verify' in t)
        ok('WebR note on #codeprompt', 'webr.r-wasm.org' in t and 'Run' in t)
        n_r = await pg.locator('#main details.fsc-ref[data-fswebr="1"] .fswebr-run').count()
        n_py = await pg.locator('details.fsc-ref:has-text("Optional reference · Python") .fswebr-run').count()
        ok('#codeprompt has 6 decorated R listings', n_r == 6, n_r)
        ok('Python reference blocks are not decorated', n_py == 0, n_py)
        ok('header is v10.1-dev', 'v10.1-dev' in await pg.inner_text('body'))
        ok('buttons have accessible names', await pg.locator('#main .fswebr-run[aria-label]').count() == 6)

        # banners
        await pg.goto(url + '#t/1.7')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        bt = await pg.inner_text('#main')
        ok('topic 1.7 banner mentions in-browser R', 'WebR' in bt or 'run in this browser' in bt.lower())
        await pg.goto(url + '#t/4.7')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        bt = await pg.inner_text('#main')
        ok('topic 4.7 banner mentions in-browser recompute', 'browser' in bt.lower())

        # a lesson with R call cards (sleep column lives on topic 2.2)
        await pg.goto(url + '#t/2.2')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        n22 = await pg.locator('#main .fsr-r [data-fswebr="1"] .fswebr-run').count()
        ok('topic 2.2 decorates at least one R call', n22 >= 1, n22)
        # Excel snippets inside .fsr-r must not get their own Run button
        excel_run = await pg.locator('#main .fsr-r > div:has-text("Excel") .fswebr-run').count()
        ok('Excel snippets in R call cards are not decorated', excel_run == 0, excel_run)

        # another page with several R-first blocks
        await pg.goto(url + '#t/E1.5')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        n_e = await pg.locator('#main .fsr-r [data-fswebr="1"] .fswebr-run').count()
        ok('topic E1.5 decorates R-first calls', n_e >= 1, n_e)

        # placement and modules still render
        await pg.goto(url + '#placement')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        ok('placement page still renders', await pg.locator('fieldset.fsp-q').count() == 20)
        await pg.goto(url + '#modules')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        ok('modules index still renders', 'Statistical Thinking' in await pg.inner_text('#main'))

        # licence attribution visible
        await pg.goto(url + '#licence')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        lt = await pg.inner_text('#main')
        ok('licence page shows WebR attribution', 'WebR' in lt and 'webr.r-wasm.org' in lt)

        # 320px reflow
        m = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 320, 'height': 700})
        m.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000)
        await m.goto(url + '#codeprompt')
        await m.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        sw = await m.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth')
        ok('no horizontal scroll at 320px on #codeprompt', sw <= 322, sw)
        ok('header button visible at 320px', await m.locator('#fswebr-btn').count() == 1)

        # Offline content: block the network, content still renders, no JS errors required for view
        off_errs = []
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
        opg = await ctx.new_page()
        opg.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000)
        opg.on('pageerror', lambda e: off_errs.append(str(e)))
        await opg.route('https://webr.r-wasm.org/**', lambda route: route.abort())
        await opg.goto(url + '#codeprompt')
        await opg.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        ot = await opg.inner_text('#main')
        ok('offline (WebR blocked): #codeprompt still renders', 'AI writes the code, you verify' in ot)
        await opg.goto(url + '#t/2.2')
        await opg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        ok('offline (WebR blocked): topic 2.2 still renders',
           await opg.locator('#main').count() == 1 and len(await opg.inner_text('#main')) > 200)
        ok('offline (WebR blocked): no JS errors before a Run', not off_errs, off_errs[:3])
        await ctx.close()

        live_ok = False
        live_info = 'skipped: webr.r-wasm.org not reachable from this environment'
        if webr_reachable():
            live_info = 'attempted'
            try:
                # Fresh page so we can watch a real download
                lpg = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
                lpg.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000)
                lpg.set_default_timeout(240000)
                await lpg.goto(url + '#codeprompt')
                await lpg.wait_for_timeout(2000)
                result = await lpg.evaluate("""async () => {
                  const add = await window.FSWEBR.runR('1+1');
                  const sleep = await window.FSWEBR.runR(
                    'd <- read.csv(\"sleep_column.csv\"); sleep <- d$sleep_h; sleep[sleep == -99] <- NA; round(mean(sleep, na.rm=TRUE), 2)'
                  );
                  return {add, sleep, state: window.FSWEBR.state()};
                }""")
                add_txt = (result.get('add') or {}).get('text') or ''
                sleep_txt = (result.get('sleep') or {}).get('text') or ''
                add_ok = (result.get('add') or {}).get('status') == 'ok' and '2' in add_txt
                sleep_ok = (result.get('sleep') or {}).get('status') == 'ok' and '7.61' in sleep_txt
                live_ok = bool(add_ok and sleep_ok)
                live_info = {
                    'add_status': (result.get('add') or {}).get('status'),
                    'add_text': add_txt[:200],
                    'sleep_status': (result.get('sleep') or {}).get('status'),
                    'sleep_text': sleep_txt[:300],
                    'state': result.get('state')
                }
                await lpg.close()
            except Exception as e:
                live_ok = False
                live_info = 'live eval error: ' + repr(e)
        ok('live WebR smoke test (1+1 and sleep_column mean 7.61)', live_ok, live_info)

        await b.close()

    load_errs = [e for e in errs if 'webr' not in e.lower()]
    ok('no JavaScript errors on load before WebR is fetched', not load_errs, load_errs[:3])

    for r in res:
        print(('PASS ' if r[1] else 'FAIL ') + r[0], '' if r[1] else r[2])
    out = 'logs/check101dev_result.json'
    json.dump([dict(test=r[0], passed=r[1], info=str(r[2])) for r in res], open(out, 'w'), indent=1)
    passed = sum(r[1] for r in res)
    print(f'{passed}/{len(res)} passed')
    if passed != len(res):
        sys.exit(1)

asyncio.run(main(sys.argv[1]))

"""Headless checks for the v10.2-dev interactives increment. Usage:
python tools/check102dev.py build/FlippedStat_v10.2-dev_standalone.html
"""
import sys, os, asyncio, json, hashlib
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

def chrome_path():
    for p in ("/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome",
              "/usr/bin/google-chrome", "/usr/bin/google-chrome-stable",
              "/opt/google/chrome/chrome"):
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    return None

CH = chrome_path()
V99 = "build/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html"
BACKUP = "backups/FlippedStat_v9.9_standalone.html"
V100 = "build/FlippedStat_v10.0-dev_standalone.html"
V101 = "build/FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html"
V99_SHA = "ca3054be56c17c7a0f996c49a0eb3ddec86c8eaba869cf46e5f8a8ae0b542651"
V100_SHA = "9f3675d6719244df22e663f28b0b870bf5f7b7efb9ddd7eedfec3a693953a97b"
V101_SHA = "d4d55051c0a6a3cfe9d2b9063311845cad9540da6449d84fc73c4a1b577c488e"
V100_SIZE = 19316315
V101_SIZE = 19403441

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

async def main(src):
    res, errs = [], []
    def ok(name, cond, info=""):
        res.append((name, bool(cond), info))

    if os.path.exists(V99):
        a = sha(V99)
        ok("v9.9 sha is ca3054be56c17c7a…", a == V99_SHA, a)
        if os.path.exists(BACKUP):
            b = sha(BACKUP)
            ok("v9.9 standalone untouched vs backup", a == b, (a[:16], b[:16]))
    if os.path.exists(V100):
        c = sha(V100)
        ok("v10.0-dev sha unchanged", c == V100_SHA, c)
        ok("v10.0-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V100) == V100_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V100))
    if os.path.exists(V101):
        d = sha(V101)
        ok("v10.1-dev sha unchanged", d == V101_SHA, d)
        ok("v10.1-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V101) == V101_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V101))
    ok(
        "dev build is a different file from frozen predecessors",
        os.path.abspath(src)
        not in (os.path.abspath(V99), os.path.abspath(V100), os.path.abspath(V101)),
    )

    raw = open(src, encoding="utf8").read()
    ok("build contains FSINT namespace", "window.FSINT" in raw or "FSINT.render" in raw)
    ok("build contains FSINT_DATA", "window.FSINT_DATA" in raw)
    ok("WebR / #codeprompt still present", "window.FSWEBR" in raw or "FSWEBR" in raw)
    ok("FSCP / #codeprompt still present", "window.FSCP" in raw or "FSCP.render" in raw)
    ok("does not vendor the ModernDive sample HTML or MD_R / md_r_server class names",
       all(tok not in raw for tok in ("MD_R", "md_r_server", 'class="rbtn"', "id='rbtn'", "RENG")))
    ok("does not embed pennies / tidyverse-first ModernDive datasets",
       "pennies" not in raw.lower() and "babynames" not in raw.lower())
    ok("licence attributes ModernDive CC BY-NC-SA 4.0",
       "moderndive.com" in raw and "creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0" in raw
       and "Ismay" in raw and "Valdivia" in raw)
    ok("header / title is v10.2-dev", "v10.2-dev" in raw)
    ok("sleep_column values are mounted", '"sleep_clean"' in raw and '"sleep"' in raw)
    ok("satisfaction300 complete cases are mounted", '"sat"' in raw)

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        launch_kw = dict(executable_path=CH) if CH else {}
        launch_kw["args"] = ["--no-sandbox", "--disable-gpu"]
        b = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_kw)
        pg = await b.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900})
        pg.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000)
        pg.set_default_timeout(60000)
        pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: errs.append(str(e)))
        url = "file://" + os.path.abspath(src)

        await pg.goto(url + "#interactives")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        t = await pg.inner_text("#main")
        ok("#interactives title renders", "Try the interactive" in t)
        ok("#interactives states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and ModernDive attribution",
           "CC BY-NC-SA 4.0" in t and "moderndive.com" in t.lower() or "ModernDive" in t)
        ok("header is v10.2-dev", "v10.2-dev" in await pg.inner_text("body"))
        n_w = await pg.locator("#main .fsint-widget").count()
        ok("six widgets render", n_w == 6, n_w)
        n_c = await pg.locator("#main .fsint-widget canvas").count()
        ok("each widget has a canvas", n_c == 6, n_c)
        # Missing-codes live numbers
        await pg.locator('#fsint-miss button[data-act="kept"]').click()
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
        miss = await pg.inner_text("#fsint-miss .fsint-readout")
        ok("missing-codes widget shows keyed 2.53 and n = 105",
           "2.53" in miss and "105" in miss, miss[:240])
        await pg.locator('#fsint-miss button[data-act="clean"]').click()
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
        miss2 = await pg.inner_text("#fsint-miss .fsint-readout")
        ok("missing-codes widget shows keyed 7.61 and n = 100",
           "7.61" in miss2 and "100" in miss2, miss2[:240])

        # Lurking variable computes an r
        lurk = await pg.inner_text("#fsint-lurk .fsint-readout")
        ok("lurking-variable widget reports an overall r and n",
           "r" in lurk and "n =" in lurk, lurk[:240])

        # Banners
        await pg.goto(url + "#t/2.2")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        ok("topic 2.2 shows a Try the interactive banner",
           await pg.locator("#main .fsint-banner").count() == 1)
        await pg.goto(url + "#t/7.2")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        ok("topic 7.2 shows a Try the interactive banner",
           await pg.locator("#main .fsint-banner").count() == 1)
        await pg.goto(url + "#t/7.6")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        ok("topic 7.6 shows a Try the interactive banner",
           await pg.locator("#main .fsint-banner").count() == 1)
        await pg.goto(url + "#t/8.2")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        ok("topic 8.2 shows a Try the interactive banner",
           await pg.locator("#main .fsint-banner").count() == 1)
        await pg.goto(url + "#t/9.7")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        ok("topic 9.7 shows a Try the interactive banner",
           await pg.locator("#main .fsint-banner").count() == 1)

        # Previous layers still present
        await pg.goto(url + "#codeprompt")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        ct = await pg.inner_text("#main")
        ok("#codeprompt still renders", "AI writes the code, you verify" in ct)
        ok("WebR header button still present", await pg.locator("#fswebr-btn").count() == 1)
        await pg.goto(url + "#placement")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        ok("placement page still renders", await pg.locator("fieldset.fsp-q").count() == 20)
        await pg.goto(url + "#licence")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        lt = await pg.inner_text("#main")
        ok("licence page shows supplementary CC BY-NC-SA attribution",
           "ModernDive" in lt and "CC BY-NC-SA" in lt and "moderndive.com" in lt.lower())
        ok("licence page still attributes WebR", "WebR" in lt and "webr.r-wasm.org" in lt)

        # 320px reflow
        m = await b.new_page(viewport={"width": 320, "height": 700})
        m.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000)
        await m.goto(url + "#interactives")
        await m.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        sw = await m.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
        ok("no horizontal scroll at 320px on #interactives", sw <= 322, sw)
        ok("widgets still present at 320px", await m.locator(".fsint-widget").count() == 6)

        await b.close()

    ok("no JavaScript errors", not errs, errs[:4])
    for r in res:
        print(("PASS " if r[1] else "FAIL ") + r[0], "" if r[1] else r[2])
    out = "logs/check102dev_result.json"
    json.dump([dict(test=r[0], passed=r[1], info=str(r[2])) for r in res], open(out, "w"), indent=1)
    passed = sum(r[1] for r in res)
    print(f"{passed}/{len(res)} passed")
    if passed != len(res):
        sys.exit(1)

asyncio.run(main(sys.argv[1]))

V101_SIZE = 19403441

            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

       and "72 rows dropped by a listwise default" in raw)
    ok("sleep_column values are mounted", '"sleep_clean"' in raw and '"sleep"' in raw)
    ok("satisfaction300 complete cases are mounted", '"sat"' in raw)

    async with async_playwright() as p:

        ok("topic 1.1 has a link to #placement",
           await pg.locator('#main a[href="#placement"]').count() >= 1)

        await pg.goto(url + "#interactives")

        t = await pg.inner_text("#main")
        ok("#interactives title renders", "Try the interactive" in t)
        ok("#interactives states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and ModernDive attribution",
           "CC BY-NC-SA 4.0" in t and ("moderndive.com" in t.lower() or "ModernDive" in t))
        n_w = await pg.locator("#main .fsint-widget").count()
        ok("six widgets render", n_w == 6, n_w)
        n_c = await pg.locator("#main .fsint-widget canvas").count()

        await pg.locator('#fsint-miss button[data-act="kept"]').click()

        ok("missing-codes widget shows keyed 2.53 and n = 105",
           "2.53" in miss and "105" in miss, miss[:240])
        await pg.locator('#fsint-miss button[data-act="clean"]').click()
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
        miss2 = await pg.inner_text("#fsint-miss .fsint-readout")

        t132 = await pg.inner_text("#main")

        await pg.goto(url + "#codeprompt")

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

async def main(src):
    res, errs = [], []
    def ok(name, cond, info=""):
        res.append((name, bool(cond), info))

    if os.path.exists(V99):
        a = sha(V99)
        ok("v9.9 sha is ca3054be56c17c7a…", a == V99_SHA, a)
        if os.path.exists(BACKUP):
            b = sha(BACKUP)
            ok("v9.9 standalone untouched vs backup", a == b, (a[:16], b[:16]))
    if os.path.exists(V100):
        c = sha(V100)
        ok("v10.0-dev sha unchanged", c == V100_SHA, c)
        ok("v10.0-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V100) == V100_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V100))
    if os.path.exists(V101):
        d = sha(V101)
        ok("v10.1-dev sha unchanged", d == V101_SHA, d)
        ok("v10.1-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V101) == V101_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V101))
    if os.path.exists(V102):
        ehash = sha(V102)
        ok("v10.2-dev sha unchanged", ehash == V102_SHA, ehash)
        ok("v10.2-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V102) == V102_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V102))
    if os.path.exists(V103):
        fhash = sha(V103)
        ok("v10.3-dev sha unchanged", fhash == V103_SHA, fhash)
        ok("v10.3-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V103) == V103_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V103))
    frozen = (V99, V100, V101, V102, V103)
    ok(
        "dev build is a different file from frozen predecessors",
        os.path.abspath(src) not in map(os.path.abspath, frozen),
    )
    ok("v10.4-dev file exists", os.path.exists(src), src)

    raw = open(src, encoding="utf8").read()
    ok("header / title is v10.4-dev", "v10.4-dev" in raw)
    ok("release history still records 10.3-dev", "<tr><td>10.3-dev</td>" in raw)
    ok("release history has 10.4-dev row", "<tr><td>10.4-dev</td>" in raw)
    ok("stale 177-topics bridge removed", "every one of the 177 topics" not in raw)
    ok("topic 1.1 bridge states 231 topics on this site",
       "every one of the 231 topics on this site" in raw)
    ok("FS.placement.implemented is true",
       "FS.placement = { implemented: true" in raw)
    ok("no student-facing 'Placement test: not implemented.'",
       "Placement test: not implemented." not in raw)
    ok("build contains FSINT namespace", "window.FSINT" in raw or "FSINT.render" in raw)
    ok("build contains FSINT_DATA", "window.FSINT_DATA" in raw)
    ok("WebR / #codeprompt still present", "window.FSWEBR" in raw or "FSWEBR" in raw)
    ok("FSCP / #codeprompt still present", "window.FSCP" in raw or "FSCP.render" in raw)
    ok("does not vendor the ModernDive sample HTML or MD_R / md_r_server class names",
       all(tok not in raw for tok in ("MD_R", "md_r_server", 'class="rbtn"', "id='rbtn'", "RENG")))
    ok("licence attributes ModernDive CC BY-NC-SA 4.0",

       and "Ismay" in raw and "Valdivia" in raw)
    ok("13.2 keyed ledger numbers still present",
       "satisfaction present for 289" in raw and "mean(dat$satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE)    # 3.97" in raw

       and "72 rows dropped by a listwise default" in raw)
    ok("sleep_column values are mounted", '"sleep_clean"' in raw and '"sleep"' in raw)
    ok("satisfaction300 complete cases are mounted", '"sat"' in raw)

    # Official extracts mounted (filenames in the standalone HTML or FSR/WebR JSON).
    for fn in EXTRACT_NAMES:
        ok(f"official extract filename present: {fn}", fn in raw)
    ok("table id 110-02001 present", "110-02001" in raw)
    ok("table id 130-06806 present", "130-06806" in raw)
    ok("table id 510-60001 present", "510-60001" in raw)
    ok("no hkdatasets microdata filenames shipped",
       all(tok not in raw.lower() for tok in ("hkdc.csv", "casualty", "street_name"))
       or ("not shipped" in raw and "hkdatasets" in raw))

    # First-wave lesson phrases in the standalone source (FSA_DATA).

       "110-02001" in raw and "130-06806" in raw)
    ok("topic 4.1 worked medians HK$30,350 and HK$33,800",

    ok("licence has DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use", "DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use" in raw)
    ok("licence states no endorsement", "does not imply endorsement" in raw)
    ok("licence excludes official maps/graphics",
       "maps" in raw.lower() and ("graphics" in raw.lower() or "photographs" in raw.lower()))
    ok("licence says hkdatasets microdata not shipped",
       "hkdatasets" in raw and "not shipped" in raw)
    ok("original OpenIntro licence row still present",
       "OpenIntro Statistics" in raw and "CC BY-SA 3.0" in raw)
    ok("original jamovi licence row still present",

    passed = sum(r[1] for r in res)
    print(f"{passed}/{len(res)} passed")
    if passed != len(res):

asyncio.run(main(sys.argv[1]))

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

async def main(src):
    res, errs = [], []
    def ok(name, cond, info=""):
        res.append((name, bool(cond), info))

    if os.path.exists(V99):
        a = sha(V99)
        ok("v9.9 sha is ca3054be56c17c7a…", a == V99_SHA, a)
        if os.path.exists(BACKUP):
            b = sha(BACKUP)
            ok("v9.9 standalone untouched vs backup", a == b, (a[:16], b[:16]))
    if os.path.exists(V100):
        c = sha(V100)
        ok("v10.0-dev sha unchanged", c == V100_SHA, c)
        ok("v10.0-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V100) == V100_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V100))
    if os.path.exists(V101):
        d = sha(V101)
        ok("v10.1-dev sha unchanged", d == V101_SHA, d)
        ok("v10.1-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V101) == V101_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V101))
    if os.path.exists(V102):
        ehash = sha(V102)
        ok("v10.2-dev sha unchanged", ehash == V102_SHA, ehash)

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

async def main(src):
    res, errs = [], []
    def ok(name, cond, info=""):
        res.append((name, bool(cond), info))

    if os.path.exists(V99):
        a = sha(V99)
        ok("v9.9 sha is ca3054be56c17c7a…", a == V99_SHA, a)
        if os.path.exists(BACKUP):
            b = sha(BACKUP)
            ok("v9.9 standalone untouched vs backup", a == b, (a[:16], b[:16]))
    if os.path.exists(V100):
        c = sha(V100)
        ok("v10.0-dev sha unchanged", c == V100_SHA, c)
        ok("v10.0-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V100) == V100_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V100))
    if os.path.exists(V101):
        d = sha(V101)
        ok("v10.1-dev sha unchanged", d == V101_SHA, d)
        ok("v10.1-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V101) == V101_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V101))
    if os.path.exists(V102):
        ehash = sha(V102)
        ok("v10.2-dev sha unchanged", ehash == V102_SHA, ehash)
        ok("v10.2-dev size unchanged", os.path.getsize(V102) == V102_SIZE, os.path.getsize(V102))

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

async def main(src):
    res, errs = [], []
    def ok(name, cond, info=""):
        res.append((name, bool(cond), info))

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

        nbb = await pg.evaluate("""() => { for (const d of document.querySelectorAll('#main details')) {
            if (d.innerText.includes('interested in the maths')) return d.querySelectorAll('mjx-container').length; } return -1; }""")
        ok("6.4 blackboard renders all 4 formulas (P(a<X<b), f=F', E[X], variance)", nbb == 4, nbb)
        for tid in ("8.5", "E2.5", "D1.9"):
            await pg.goto(url + "#t/" + tid); await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
            tt = await pg.inner_text("#main")
            ok(tid + " shows chi-square reading title as symbol, no raw TeX", "\u03c7\u00b2" in tt and "\\chi^2" not in tt)

        m = await b.new_page(viewport={"width": 320, "height": 700})
        m.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000)
        await m.goto(url + "#assess")
        await m.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        sw = await m.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
        ok("no horizontal scroll at 320px on #assess", sw <= 322, sw)
        await m.goto(url + "#interactives")
        await m.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        sw2 = await m.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
        ok("no horizontal scroll at 320px on #interactives", sw2 <= 322, sw2)
        ok("widgets still present at 320px", await m.locator(".fsint-widget").count() == 6)

        await b.close()

    ok("no JavaScript errors", not errs, errs[:4])
    for r in res:
        print(("PASS " if r[1] else "FAIL ") + r[0], "" if r[1] else r[2])
    out = "logs/check109dev_result.json"
    json.dump([dict(test=r[0], passed=r[1], info=str(r[2])) for r in res], open(out, "w"), indent=1)
    passed = sum(r[1] for r in res)
    print(f"{passed}/{len(res)} passed")
    if passed != len(res):
        sys.exit(1)

asyncio.run(main(sys.argv[1]))

========== FILE: ws/tools/check109dev_light.py ==========

"""v10.9-dev LIGHT checker for low-memory sandboxes (Copilot, 2026-11-18).

Why: in the Copilot sandbox, headless Chromium closes the 20 MB page after a few topic visits
with step-reveal clicks — the UNCHANGED v10.8-dev build fails the same way, so this is an
environment limit, not a regression. The full tools/check109dev.py remains the release gate
and must be run on a normal machine.

What this proves instead:
 A. Frozen v10.8-dev hash unchanged; v10.9-dev rebuilds byte-identically from v10.8-dev with
    tools/assemble_v109dev.py logic (so v10.9 = v10.8 + exactly the listed patches).
 B. Static: old defective strings gone, new strings present, labels updated, H3/H6 wording kept.
 C. Browser (fresh page per check): 6.4 blackboard renders 4 formulas, no attribute garbage;
    8.5 / E2.5 / D1.9 show χ² and no raw \\chi^2; header shows v10.9-dev; no JS page errors.
Usage: python tools/check109dev_light.py
"""
import asyncio, hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
V108 = ROOT / "build/FlippedStat_v10.8-dev_standalone.html"
V109 = ROOT / "build/FlippedStat_v10.9-dev_standalone.html"
V108_SHA = "7e4349bfa0552fd6c896645502e439b627856d8f61616c95362feead4601a9f2"
CH = "/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome"
R = []
def ok(n, c, info=""): R.append((n, bool(c), info))
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def part_a():
    ok("A1 v10.8-dev frozen hash unchanged", sha(V108) == V108_SHA)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("asm", ROOT / "tools/assemble_v109dev.py")
    asm = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(asm)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        out = Path(td) / "v109.html"; asm.OUT = out
        logp = Path(td) / "logs"; logp.mkdir()
        real_root = asm.ROOT; asm.ROOT = Path(td)
        try:
            asm.main()
        finally:
            asm.ROOT = real_root
        ok("A2 v10.9-dev rebuilds byte-identically from v10.8-dev", sha(out) == sha(V109), sha(V109)[:16])
    ok("A3 v10.8-dev still unchanged after rebuild", sha(V108) == V108_SHA)

def part_b():
    s = V109.read_text(encoding="utf-8"); o = V108.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    B4 = "\\\\"
    ok("B1 '<' removed from 6.4 maths spans", s.count("P(a<X<b)=" + B4 + "int_a^b") == 0 and o.count("P(a<X<b)=" + B4 + "int_a^b") == 2)
    ok("B2 \\lt form present twice", s.count("P(a" + B4 + "lt X" + B4 + "lt b)=") == 2)
    ok("B3 bare \\chi^2 reading titles gone (14 in v10.8-dev)",
       s.count(B4 + "chi^2 test of independence") + s.count(B4 + "chi^2 (chi-square) goodness-of-fit") == 0
       and o.count(B4 + "chi^2 test of independence") + o.count(B4 + "chi^2 (chi-square) goodness-of-fit") == 14)
    ok("B4 χ² titles present (14)", s.count("χ² test of independence") + s.count("χ² (chi-square) goodness-of-fit")
       - o.count("χ² test of independence") - o.count("χ² (chi-square) goodness-of-fit") == 14)
    ok("B5 release row for 10.9-dev added once", s.count("<tr><td>10.9-dev</td>") == 1)
    ok("B6 H3 cut-score wording unchanged", s.lower().count("cut scores await academic approval") == o.lower().count("cut scores await academic approval") > 0)
    ok("B7 H6 certificate wording unchanged", s.count("Certificate wording and signatory await approval") == o.count("Certificate wording and signatory await approval"))
    ok("B8 size delta small (only patches)", 0 < V109.stat().st_size - V108.stat().st_size < 2000, V109.stat().st_size - V108.stat().st_size)

async def one(b, url, h, wait, fn):
    pg = await b.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900}); pg.set_default_navigation_timeout(180000); pg.set_default_timeout(60000)
    errs = []; pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: errs.append(str(e)))
    try:
        await pg.goto(url + h); await pg.wait_for_timeout(wait)
        await fn(pg)
        ok(f"C {h} no JS page errors", not errs, errs[:2])
    finally:
        await pg.close()

async def part_c():
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    url = "file://" + str(V109)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        kw = dict(args=["--no-sandbox", "--disable-gpu"])
        if os.path.exists(CH): kw["executable_path"] = CH
        b = await p.chromium.launch(**kw)
        async def c64(pg):
            h = await pg.inner_html("#main")
            ok("C1 6.4 blackboard not split into HTML attributes", 'and=""' not in h and "e[x]=" not in h)
            n = await pg.evaluate("""() => { for (const d of document.querySelectorAll('#main details')) {
              if (d.innerText.includes('interested in the maths')) return d.querySelectorAll('mjx-container').length; } return -1; }""")
            ok("C2 6.4 blackboard renders 4 formulas", n == 4, n)
            ok("C3 header shows v10.9-dev", "v10.9-dev" in await pg.inner_text("body"))
        await one(b, url, "#t/6.4", 5000, c64)
        for tid in ("8.5", "E2.5", "D1.9"):
            async def cx(pg, tid=tid):
                t = await pg.inner_text("#main")
                ok(f"C4 {tid} shows χ², no raw \\chi^2", "\u03c7\u00b2" in t and "\\chi^2" not in t)
            await one(b, url, "#t/" + tid, 3500, cx)
        await b.close()

def main():
    part_a(); part_b()
    try:
        asyncio.run(part_c())
    except Exception as e:
        ok("C browser section completed", False, str(e)[:200])
    for n, c, i in R: print(("PASS " if c else "FAIL ") + n, "" if c else i)
    print(f"{sum(c for _, c, _ in R)}/{len(R)} passed")
    json.dump([dict(test=n, passed=c, info=str(i)) for n, c, i in R], open(ROOT / "logs/check109dev_light_results.json", "w"), indent=1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

========== END FILE: ws/tools/check109dev_light.py ==========

"""Headless check of v9.2 new routes + sample of existing routes. Usage: python tools/check92.py [html]"""
import sys, json, asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
HTML = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'build/FlippedStat_v9.2_standalone.html'
ROUTES = ['home', 'modules', 'pathways'] + [f'm/{i}' for i in range(1, 9)] + ['t/1.2', 't/8.1', 't/13.6', 't/E3.4', 'licence', 'release', 'status']
async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome')
        pg = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
        errs = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)))
        pg.on('console', lambda m: errs.append(m.text) if m.type == 'error' else None)
        import pathlib
        await pg.goto(pathlib.Path(HTML).resolve().as_uri(), timeout=120000)
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        await pg.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('fs:done', JSON.stringify(['1.2','1.3','1.5','1.9','2.3']))")
        res = []
        for r in ROUTES:
            n0 = len(errs)
            await pg.evaluate(f"location.hash='#{r}'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
            txt = await pg.inner_text('#main')
            bad = [w for w in ['undefined', 'NaN', '[object Object]'] if w in txt]
            res.append(dict(route=r, chars=len(txt), errors=errs[n0:], bad=bad, head=txt[:90].replace('\n', ' ')))
        await pg.set_viewport_size({'width': 320, 'height': 800})
        await pg.evaluate("location.hash='#m/1'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        ov = await pg.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth>document.documentElement.clientWidth+1")
        await pg.screenshot(path='logs/v9.2_m1_320px.png')
        await pg.set_viewport_size({'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
        await pg.evaluate("location.hash='#modules'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        await pg.screenshot(path='logs/v9.2_modules.png')
        await b.close()
    for x in res: print(x['route'], x['chars'], 'ERR' if x['errors'] else 'ok', x['bad'] or '', '|', x['head'])
    print('page-level horizontal overflow at 320px on #m/1:', ov)
    json.dump(res, open('logs/v9.2_check.json', 'w'), indent=1)
    if any(x['errors'] or x['bad'] or x['chars'] < 200 for x in res): sys.exit(1)
asyncio.run(main())

import sys, json, asyncio, pathlib
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
HTML = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'build/FlippedStat_v9.3_standalone.html'
E5 = [f'E5.{i}' for i in range(1, 14)]
OTHER = ['home', 'modules', 'pathways', 'tiers', 'm/7', 'm/9', 'u/E5', 'map', 'ledger', 'licence', 'release', 'status', 't/1.2', 't/8.1', 't/E3.4', 't/13.6', 'search/seasonal']
async def main():

        b = await p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome')
        pg = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
        errs = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append('PAGEERROR ' + str(e)))
        pg.on('console', lambda m: errs.append(m.text) if m.type == 'error' else None)
        await pg.goto(pathlib.Path(HTML).resolve().as_uri(), timeout=180000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        res = []
        for r in ['t/' + x for x in E5] + OTHER:

            await pg.evaluate(f"location.hash='#{r}'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1800)
            await pg.evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
            info = await pg.evaluate("""() => { const m = document.querySelector('#main'); const t = m.innerText;
              return { chars: t.length, bad: ['undefined', 'NaN', '[object Object]', 'Figure not found', 'could not be drawn'].filter(w => [...m.querySelectorAll('.readout, figcaption, .fsacap, .fsr-brk, .ftr-mix, table')].some(e => e.innerText.includes(w)) || t.includes('[object Object]') && w === '[object Object]'),
                svgs: m.querySelectorAll('svg.plot').length, plotly: m.querySelectorAll('.plotly-host[data-done]').length, hosts: m.querySelectorAll('.plotly-host').length,
                lessons: m.querySelectorAll('article.lesson').length, fsa: m.querySelectorAll('.fsa').length, tiers: m.querySelectorAll('[data-tier]').length,
                subtier: m.querySelectorAll('article.lesson[data-subtier]').length, lab: !!m.querySelector('#labhost svg'), quiz: m.querySelectorAll('#quizhost .q, #quizhost [class*=q]').length,
                head: t.slice(0, 80).replace(/\\n/g, ' ') }; }""")
            info.update(route=r, errors=errs[n0:]); res.append(info)
        # tier switch on E5.8 (contains I and X subtopics)
        await pg.evaluate("location.hash='#t/E5.8'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1800)
        vis = {}
        for lv in ['X', 'I', 'F']:
            await pg.evaluate(f"FTR.setLevel('{lv}')"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
            vis[lv] = await pg.evaluate("""() => [...document.querySelectorAll('article.lesson')].map(a => [a.querySelector('.sid').textContent, a.dataset.subtier, a.querySelector('.concept') ? a.querySelector('.concept').offsetParent !== null : null, [...a.querySelectorAll('.ftr-bar')].filter(b => b.offsetParent).length])""")
        await pg.evaluate("FTR.setLevel('X')")
        # widget interactions
        await pg.evaluate("location.hash='#t/E5.6'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1800)
        w = await pg.evaluate("""() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('.lviz select')]; const out = []; const sel = s.find(x => [...x.options].some(o => o.value === 'sarima'));
          for (const v of ['snaive', 'naive', 'mean', 'decomp', 'sarima']) { sel.value = v; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); out.push(sel.closest('.lviz').querySelector('.readout').innerText.slice(0, 160)); } return out; }""")
        await pg.evaluate("location.hash='#t/E5.12'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1800)
        lab = await pg.evaluate("""() => { const host = document.querySelector('#labhost'); const out = []; host.querySelectorAll('.wctl button').forEach(b => { b.click(); out.push(host.querySelector('.readout').innerText.slice(0, 120)); }); return out; }""")
        await pg.screenshot(path='logs/v9.3_E5.12.png', full_page=False)
        await pg.evaluate("location.hash='#t/E5.4'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)

    bad = 0

        await pg.screenshot(path='logs/v9.5_pre_result.png')
        await b.close()

"""Validate the Stage 4 item banks: structure, parallel forms, LO coverage, topic routing, and recompute every numerical key."""
import sys, json, math, collections
sys.path.insert(0, 'content'); import assess95 as A, modules93 as M
from scipy import stats
import numpy as np
s = open('build/FlippedStat_v9.4_standalone.html', encoding='utf8').read()
FS = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(s, s.index('window.FS=') + 10)[0]
topics = {t['no'] for u in FS['units'] for t in u['topics']}
mods = {m['n']: m for m in M.MODULES}
err, ids = [], set()
for n, bk in A.B.items():
    m = mods[n]; nlo = len(m['outcomes'])
    assert len(bk['anchor']) == 3 and len(bk['A']) == 7 and len(bk['B']) == 7, n
    for part in ('anchor', 'A', 'B'):
        for it in bk[part]:
            iid, lo, lv, tp, stem, opts, key, why = it
            if iid in ids: err.append(f'dup {iid}')
            ids.add(iid)
            if not 1 <= lo <= nlo: err.append(f'{iid} lo {lo}>{nlo}')
            if lv not in 'RAE': err.append(f'{iid} level')
            if tp not in topics: err.append(f'{iid} topic {tp}')
            if tp not in m['topics'] and tp not in m.get('related', []): err.append(f'{iid} topic {tp} outside module {n}')
            if len(opts) != 4 or len(set(opts)) != 4: err.append(f'{iid} options')
            if not 0 <= key < 4: err.append(f'{iid} key')
    for a, b in zip(bk['A'], bk['B']):
        if (a[1], a[2]) != (b[1], b[2]): err.append(f'parallel mismatch {a[0]} {a[1:3]} vs {b[0]} {b[1:3]}')
    for form in ('A', 'B'):
        los = {it[1] for it in bk['anchor'] + bk[form]}
        miss = set(range(1, nlo + 1)) - los
        if miss: err.append(f'M{n} form {form} misses LO {sorted(miss)}')
print('structure errors:', err or 'none'); print('items:', len(ids))
# ---- numerical keys recomputed independently
sd = lambda x: float(np.std(x, ddof=1))
NUM = {
 'M2-K1': (np.median([2, 3, 3, 4, 18]), 3), 'M2-A1': (sd([2, 4, 6]), 2), 'M2-B1': (sd([1, 3, 5, 7]), 2.58), 'M2-A3': (30 - 12, 18), 'M2-B3': (22 + 1.5 * 12, 40),
 'M3-K1': (0.3 * 0.5, 0.15), 'M3-K2': (0.01 * .9 / (0.01 * .9 + 0.99 * .05), 0.15), 'M3-K3': (math.sqrt(.12 * .88 / 1000), 0.01),
 'M3-A1': (.4 + .5 - .2, .7), 'M3-B1': (.5 + .4 - .1, .8), 'M3-A2': (30 / 60, .5), 'M3-B2': (20 / 80, .25),
 'M3-A4': (math.sqrt(10 * .25), 1.58), 'M3-B4': (math.sqrt(20 * .2 * .8), 1.79), 'M3-A5': (stats.norm.sf(130, 100, 15), .023), 'M3-B5': (stats.norm.cdf(30, 50, 10), .023),
 'M3-A7': (math.sqrt(1000 / 4000), .5), 'M3-B7': (math.sqrt(.25 / 2500), .01), 'M9-B2': (3 / 4, .75),
 'M4-A1': (12 / 6, 2), 'M4-B1': (20 / 10, 2), 'M4-A6': (20 * .05, 1), 'M4-B6': (.05 / 10, .005),
 'M5-A2': (50 - 2 * 10, 30), 'M5-B2': (12 + .5 * 40, 32), 'M5-K2': (math.sqrt(.64), .8),
 'M7-A3': ((10 / 110 * 0 + .1 + .1) / 2, .1), 'M7-B3': ((5 + 5 + 10) / 3, 6.67), 'M7-B2': (3900 - 3600, 300), 'M7-B5': (4050 - 3960, 90),
 'M9-K1': (math.exp(.69), 2), 'M9-A1': (.2 / .1, 2), 'M9-A2': (.2 / .8, .25), 'M9-B1': (math.ceil(1 / .15), 7),
}
bad = [(k, round(v, 4), w) for k, (v, w) in NUM.items() if abs(v - w) > max(0.006, abs(w) * 0.02)]
# confirm the stated MAPE in M7-A3 using actual-denominator definition
assert abs(np.mean([abs(110 - 100) / 100, abs(90 - 100) / 100]) - .1) < 1e-12

# ---- key position balance (delivery shuffles options, but report the authored distribution)
c = collections.Counter(it[6] for bk in A.B.values() for p in ('anchor', 'A', 'B') for it in bk[p])
lv = collections.Counter(it[2] for bk in A.B.values() for p in ('anchor', 'A', 'B') for it in bk[p])

sys.exit(1 if err or bad else 0)

"""Print full source text for a list of block ids (any unit). usage: python tools/dump_ids.py ID1 ID2 ... > out.txt"""
import json,re,html,sys,csv
O=json.load(open('OISD.json')); B=json.load(open('BOOK.json')); X=json.load(open('EXTRA.json'))
t=lambda s:re.sub(r'Next step ▶ ◀ Back Show all 0 / \d+ |Try it, then check ','',re.sub(r'\s+',' ',html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s or ''))).strip())
def ois(key):
    c=int(key.split('.')[0]); secs=O['book']['chapters'][c-1]['sections']
    for s in secs:
        if key==s['num']: return s['html'].split('<h3 class="bk-h3"')[0]
    for s in secs:
        for p in s['html'].split('<h3 class="bk-h3"')[1:]:
            if '<span class="num">'+key+'</span>' in p: return p
def lsj(ch,sid):
    c=[x for x in B['chapters'] if str(x['num'])==ch][0]; out='';on=sid=='_intro'
    for p in re.split(r'(?=<h[23][ >])',c['html']):
        m=re.match(r'^<h([23])\b[^>]*?\bid="([^"]+)"',p)
        if m:
            if on and out: break
            on=m.group(2)==sid
        if on: out+=p
    return out
ex={}
for c in O['book']['chapters']:
    for s in c['sections']:
        for e in s['ex']: ex[e['id']]=e
    for e in c['review']: ex[e['id']]=e
A={c['num']:c for c in O['auth']['chapters']}
for b in sys.argv[1:]:
    print(f"\n===== {b}")
    if b.startswith('O:'): h=ois(b[2:]); print(t(h)); print('FIGS',re.findall(r'<figure[^>]*id="([^"]+)"',h))
    elif b.startswith('L:'): ch,sid=b[2:].split('/',1); h=lsj(ch,sid); print(t(h)); print('FIGS',re.findall(r'data-id="([^"]+)"',h))
    elif b.startswith('OX:'): print(t(ex[b[3:]]['html'])[:1200])
    elif b.startswith(('LX:','LQ:')): k,ch,i=b.split(':'); print(X[ch]['ex' if k=='LX' else 'quiz'][int(i)][:800])
    elif b.startswith('OF:'): _,c,i=b.split(':'); print(json.dumps(A[int(c)]['featured'][int(i)],ensure_ascii=False)[:800])
    elif b.startswith('OQ:'): _,c,i=b.split(':'); print(json.dumps(A[int(c)]['quiz'][int(i)],ensure_ascii=False)[:400])

========== FILE: ws/tools/export_text_bundle.py ==========

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile FlippedStat text, scripts and code into one Markdown file.

Excludes binaries, standalone HTML, and designated third-party book/manual dumps.
Run from anywhere; paths are resolved relative to the workspace root.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import mimetypes
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/workspace/flippedstat_v99")
DEFAULT_OUT = Path("/workspace/FlippedStat_all_text_outputs_2026-11-18.md")

INCLUDE_SUFFIXES = {
    ".md", ".py", ".tex", ".sty", ".vtt", ".txt", ".csv", ".json", ".yml", ".yaml",
    ".sh", ".js", ".css", ".r", ".R", ".xml", ".bib", ".gift", ".rst", ".ini",
    ".cfg", ".toml", ".html",  # only small html; large standalones excluded by rule
}

SKIP_DIR_NAMES = {
    "__pycache__", ".git", "node_modules", ".venv", "venv",
}

# Paths relative to ROOT that must never be inlined (copyrighted or vendor dumps,
# or generated standalones already exported separately).
EXCLUDE_PREFIXES = (
    "sources/Think_Stats_Third_Edition_KB.txt",
    "sources/moderndive_webr_ref/",
    "sources/openshot_agent_cli/",
    "build/",
    "backups/",
    "src.html",
)
EXCLUDE_NAMES = {
    "FlippedStat_all_text_outputs_2026-11-18.md",
}
EXCLUDE_SUFFIXES = {
    ".osp", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".webp", ".pdf", ".zip",
    ".woff", ".woff2", ".ttf", ".otf", ".eot", ".mp4", ".mov", ".wav",
    ".mp3", ".bin", ".pickle", ".pkl", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".pptx",
}

# Do not inline huge generated HTML even if it sits outside build/
MAX_INLINE_HTML_BYTES = 200_000
MAX_INLINE_BYTES = 2_000_000  # per file safety cap (textbook dump is 2.1 MB)


def is_excluded(rel: Path) -> str | None:
    posix = rel.as_posix()
    if rel.name in EXCLUDE_NAMES:
        return "bundle output itself"
    for pref in EXCLUDE_PREFIXES:
        if posix == pref.rstrip("/") or posix.startswith(pref):
            return f"excluded prefix {pref}"
    if rel.suffix.lower() in EXCLUDE_SUFFIXES:
        return f"binary/office suffix {rel.suffix}"
    if rel.suffix.lower() == ".html" and posix.endswith("_standalone.html"):
        return "standalone HTML (exported separately)"
    return None


def should_consider(path: Path) -> bool:
    if not path.is_file():
        return False
    if any(part in SKIP_DIR_NAMES for part in path.parts):
        return False
    suf = path.suffix
    if suf.lower() in INCLUDE_SUFFIXES or suf == "":
        # empty suffix: only if it looks like text and is small; skip by default
        return suf.lower() in INCLUDE_SUFFIXES
    return False


def fence_for(text: str) -> str:
    longest = 0
    run = 0
    for ch in text:
        if ch == "`":
            run += 1
            longest = max(longest, run)
        else:
            run = 0
    n = max(3, longest + 1)
    return "`" * n


def lang_for(path: Path) -> str:
    return {
        ".py": "python",
        ".js": "javascript",
        ".css": "css",
        ".sh": "bash",
        ".r": "r",
        ".R": "r",
        ".tex": "latex",
        ".sty": "latex",
        ".md": "markdown",
        ".json": "json",
        ".csv": "csv",
        ".xml": "xml",
        ".yml": "yaml",
        ".yaml": "yaml",
        ".vtt": "vtt",
        ".html": "html",
        ".toml": "toml",
        ".ini": "ini",
        ".bib": "bibtex",
    }.get(path.suffix, "")


def iter_files() -> list[Path]:
    files = []
    for p in ROOT.rglob("*"):
        if not should_consider(p):
            continue
        files.append(p)
    files.sort(key=lambda p: p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
    return files


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUT)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    out: Path = args.out

    included = []
    skipped = []  # (rel, reason, size)
    listed_binaries = []

    # Also catalogue binary/standalone files for the index, without inlining.
    for p in ROOT.rglob("*"):
        if not p.is_file() or any(part in SKIP_DIR_NAMES for part in p.parts):
            continue
        rel = p.relative_to(ROOT)
        reason = is_excluded(rel)
        if reason:
            skipped.append((rel.as_posix(), reason, p.stat().st_size))
            continue
        if should_consider(p):
            included.append(p)

    included.sort(key=lambda p: p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
    skipped.sort()

    parts: list[str] = []
    parts.append("# FlippedStat compiled text, scripts and code")
    parts.append("")
    parts.append("Generated on 18 November 2026, Asia/Hong_Kong (UTC+8), by `tools/export_text_bundle.py`.")
    parts.append("Workspace root: `/workspace/flippedstat_v99/`.")
    parts.append("Current tip: `build/FlippedStat_v10.8-dev_standalone.html`")
    parts.append("SHA-256 `7e4349bfa0552fd6c896645502e439b627856d8f61616c95362feead4601a9f2` (20,452,306 bytes).")
    parts.append("")
    parts.append("Standalone HTML and binary media are **not** inlined here; they are listed under Exclusions.")
    parts.append("Designated-textbook dumps and third-party manual excerpts under `sources/` are excluded so this bundle does not paste copyrighted book or vendor text. Formal rights clearance remains deferred and is not claimed as done.")
    parts.append("")

    # Pre-scan sizes / skip oversized
    inline_rows = []
    inlined_bytes = 0
    for p in included:
        rel = p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        sz = p.stat().st_size
        if sz > MAX_INLINE_BYTES:
            skipped.append((rel, f"over {MAX_INLINE_BYTES} byte inline cap", sz))
            continue
        if p.suffix.lower() == ".html" and sz > MAX_INLINE_HTML_BYTES:
            skipped.append((rel, f"HTML over {MAX_INLINE_HTML_BYTES} bytes", sz))
            continue
        try:
            text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            skipped.append((rel, "not valid UTF-8", sz))
            continue
        inline_rows.append((rel, sz, p, text))
        inlined_bytes += sz

    skipped.sort()
    parts.append("## Bundle index")
    parts.append("")
    parts.append(f"- Files inlined: **{len(inline_rows)}**")
    parts.append(f"- Characters of source inlined (approx. bytes): **{inlined_bytes:,}**")
    parts.append(f"- Paths excluded or not inlined: **{len(skipped)}**")
    parts.append("")
    parts.append("### Inlined files")
    parts.append("")
    for i, (rel, sz, _p, _t) in enumerate(inline_rows, 1):
        anchor = rel.replace("/", "-")
        parts.append(f"{i}. [`{rel}`](#{anchor}) ({sz:,} bytes)")
    parts.append("")
    parts.append("### Exclusions and non-inlined paths")
    parts.append("")
    parts.append("| Path | Reason | Bytes |")
    parts.append("|---|---|---:|")
    for rel, reason, sz in skipped:
        parts.append(f"| `{rel}` | {reason} | {sz:,} |")
    parts.append("")
    parts.append("---")
    parts.append("")

    for rel, sz, p, text in inline_rows:
        anchor = rel.replace("/", "-")
        parts.append(f"## `{rel}`")
        parts.append(f"<a id=\"{anchor}\"></a>")
        parts.append("")
        parts.append(f"Size: {sz:,} bytes.")
        parts.append("")
        fence = fence_for(text)
        lang = lang_for(p)
        parts.append(f"{fence}{lang}")
        if text.endswith("\n"):
            parts.append(text[:-1])
        else:
            parts.append(text)
        parts.append(fence)
        parts.append("")

    body = "\n".join(parts)
    if not body.endswith("\n"):
        body += "\n"
    # append a trailing checksum of the body before the checksum line
    digest = hashlib.sha256(body.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    body += f"\n---\n\nSHA-256 of this Markdown file *above this line*: `{digest}`\n"
    # The on-disk file hash will differ because of the final line; also write a sidecar
    out.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
    file_hash = hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    print(f"Wrote {out}")
    print(f"bytes {out.stat().st_size}")
    print(f"inlined {len(inline_rows)} files, {inlined_bytes} source bytes")
    print(f"excluded {len(skipped)}")
    print(f"sha256 {file_hash}")
    sidecar = out.with_suffix(".sha256")
    sidecar.write_text(f"{file_hash}  {out.name}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    # also copy into exports
    exp = ROOT / "exports" / out.name
    if exp.resolve() != out.resolve():
        exp.write_bytes(out.read_bytes())
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

========== END FILE: ws/tools/export_text_bundle.py ==========

========== FILE: ws/tools/extract_stage8_catalog.py ==========

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extract official module/topic titles and short teaching frames from the
v10.7-dev standalone (read-only). Writes stage8/catalog/*.json.
Does not modify any build HTML. Prefer v10.7-dev; fall back to v10.1-dev
only if v10.7-dev is absent. If v10.8-dev appears, prefer that.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import html as htmlmod
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "stage8" / "catalog"

def resolve_src() -> Path:
    for name in (
        "FlippedStat_v10.8-dev_standalone.html",
        "FlippedStat_v10.7-dev_standalone.html",
        "FlippedStat_v10.1-dev_standalone.html",
    ):
        p = ROOT / "build" / name
        if p.exists():
            return p
    raise SystemExit("no supported standalone HTML found under build/")

SRC = resolve_src()

# Official module map actually used from v9.3 onward (content/modules93.py).
# Imported from source so this catalog stays aligned with the site.
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from content.modules93 import MODULES, COMPLETION  # noqa: E402

TAG_RE = re.compile(r"<[^>]+>")
WS_RE = re.compile(r"\s+")


def strip_html(s: str) -> str:
    if not s:
        return ""
    if not isinstance(s, str):
        s = str(s)
    s = htmlmod.unescape(s)
    s = TAG_RE.sub(" ", s)
    s = WS_RE.sub(" ", s).strip()
    return s


def shorten(s: str, n: int = 420) -> str:
    s = strip_html(s)
    if len(s) <= n:
        return s
    cut = s[: n + 1]
    sp = cut.rfind(" ")
    if sp > n * 0.6:
        cut = cut[:sp]
    return cut.rstrip(" ,;:") + "…"


def as_list(val):
    if val is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(val, list):
        return val
    return [val]


def parse_fs(html: str) -> dict:
    i = html.find("window.FS=")
    if i < 0:
        raise SystemExit("window.FS= not found in source HTML")
    obj, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(html[i + len("window.FS=") :])
    return obj


def first_lessons(lessons: dict, topic_id: str):
    """Return lesson dicts for this topic, ordered by sub-id."""
    items = []
    prefix = topic_id + "."
    for k, v in lessons.items():
        if k.startswith(prefix) and k[len(prefix) :].replace(".", "").isdigit():
            items.append((k, v))
        elif k == topic_id and isinstance(v, dict):
            items.append((k, v))
    items.sort(key=lambda kv: kv[0])
    return items


def _collect_frames(items, limits):
    concept = ""
    bridge = ""
    interp = []
    summary = ""
    pitfalls = []
    for _, v in items:
        if not isinstance(v, dict):
            continue
        if not concept and v.get("concept"):
            concept = shorten(v["concept"], limits["concept"])
        if not bridge and v.get("bridge"):
            bridge = shorten(v["bridge"], limits["bridge"])
        if not interp:
            for line in as_list(v.get("interp")):
                tx = shorten(line, limits["interp"])
                if tx:
                    interp.append(tx)
                if len(interp) >= limits["n_interp"]:
                    break
        if not summary and v.get("summary"):
            summary = shorten(v["summary"] if isinstance(v["summary"], str) else " ".join(as_list(v["summary"])), limits["summary"])
        if not pitfalls:
            for line in as_list(v.get("pitfalls")):
                tx = shorten(line, limits["pitfall"])
                if tx:
                    pitfalls.append(tx)
                if len(pitfalls) >= limits["n_pitfalls"]:
                    break
        if concept and interp and (summary or pitfalls):
            break
    return {
        "concept": concept,
        "bridge": bridge,
        "interp": interp,
        "summary": summary,
        "pitfalls": pitfalls,
    }


def frames_for(lessons: dict, topic_id: str) -> dict:
    items = first_lessons(lessons, topic_id)
    short = _collect_frames(items, {
        "concept": 420, "bridge": 280, "interp": 220, "summary": 280,
        "pitfall": 200, "n_interp": 3, "n_pitfalls": 3,
    })
    # Longer, still truncated, copies for video-script drafting only.
    script = _collect_frames(items, {
        "concept": 900, "bridge": 500, "interp": 420, "summary": 500,
        "pitfall": 320, "n_interp": 5, "n_pitfalls": 4,
    })
    short["frames_script"] = script
    return short


def main():
    html = SRC.read_text(encoding="utf8")
    fs = parse_fs(html)
    topic_index = {}
    unit_of = {}
    for u in fs["units"]:
        for t in u.get("topics", []):
            topic_index[t["no"]] = t
            unit_of[t["no"]] = {"id": u["id"], "title": u["title"]}
    ilos_by_topic = {}
    for u in fs["units"]:
        for ilo in u.get("ilos", []):
            for tid in re.split(r"\s*,\s*", ilo.get("topics") or ""):
                if tid:
                    ilos_by_topic.setdefault(tid, []).append(strip_html(ilo.get("text") or ""))

    lessons = fs.get("lessons") or {}
    modules_out = []
    missing = []
    counts = {}
    for m in MODULES:
        topics_out = []
        for tid in m["topics"]:
            t = topic_index.get(tid)
            if not t:
                missing.append(tid)
                topics_out.append({"id": tid, "title": tid, "missing_in_site": True})
                continue
            topics_out.append({
                "id": tid,
                "title": t.get("title") or tid,
                "hours": t.get("hours"),
                "activity": t.get("activity") or "",
                "subs_text": t.get("subs_text") or "",
                "subs": [{"no": s["no"], "title": s.get("title") or ""} for s in t.get("subs") or []],
                "essential": tid in set(m.get("essential") or []),
                "unit": unit_of.get(tid),
                "ilos": ilos_by_topic.get(tid, []),
                "frames": frames_for(lessons, tid),
                "hash": f"#t/{tid}",
            })
        counts[m["n"]] = len(topics_out)
        modules_out.append({
            "n": m["n"],
            "title": m["title"],
            "proposal": m.get("proposal") or "",
            "tier": m.get("tier") or "",
            "outcomes": list(m.get("outcomes") or []),
            "essential": list(m.get("essential") or []),
            "checks": m.get("checks") or "",
            "note": m.get("note") or "",
            "related": list(m.get("related") or []),
            "topics": topics_out,
        })

    official = [m for m in modules_out if m["n"] <= 8]
    n_topics_18 = sum(len(m["topics"]) for m in official)
    payload = {
        "source_html": str(SRC.relative_to(ROOT)),  # actual file used
        "module_map": "content/modules93.py",
        "completion_rule": COMPLETION,
        "counts": {
            "modules_1_to_8": 8,
            "official_topics_modules_1_to_8": n_topics_18,
            "module_9_topics_optional": len(modules_out[8]["topics"]) if len(modules_out) > 8 else 0,
            "per_module": counts,
        },
        "modules": modules_out,
    }
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out = OUT_DIR / "topic_frames.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf8")
    print(f"wrote {out} topics_1_8={n_topics_18} missing={missing}")
    if missing:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

========== END FILE: ws/tools/extract_stage8_catalog.py ==========

/* FlippedStat v10.0-dev — FSC: #codeprompt extension and banners on related topics. */
(function () {
  const D = window.FSCP_DATA || {};
  function render() {
    const main = document.getElementById('main');
    if (!main) return;
    main.innerHTML = D.page || '<p>Missing FSCP_DATA.</p>';
    const t = location.hash.split('#')[1] || '';
    const id = t.indexOf('fsc-t') >= 0 ? t.replace(/^codeprompt\/?/, '') : '';
    if (id && document.getElementById(id)) document.getElementById(id).scrollIntoView();
  }
  function banner() {
    const m = location.hash.match(/^#t\/(.+)$/);
    if (!m) return;
    const key = decodeURIComponent(m[1]);
    const text = (D.banners || {})[key];
    const h1 = document.querySelector('#main h1');
    if (!text || !h1 || document.querySelector('.fsc-banner')) return;
    h1.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',
      '<div class="fsc-banner"><b>AI writes the code, you verify:</b> ' + text +
      ' <a class="btn sm" href="#codeprompt">Open the extension ▶</a></div>');
  }
  window.FSCP = { render: render, banner: banner };
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', function () { setTimeout(banner, 0); });
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { setTimeout(banner, 0); });
})();

/* FlippedStat v9.6 Module 8 kit (FSE): KPI 3.1 hallucination quiz, KPI 3.2 confidence survey, three-tool lab, AI-use disclosure.
   Data: window.FSE_DATA (tools/assemble_v96.py from content/m8kit.py and build/m8_data.json). Saved in this browser only (fs:m8). */
(function () {
'use strict';
const D = window.FSE_DATA; if (!D) return;
const KEY = 'fs:m8', e = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
const load = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) || {}; } catch (x) { return {}; } };
const save = o => localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(o));
function st() { const s = load(); if (!s.pid) { let p = ''; try { p = (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('fs:assess')) || {}).pid || ''; } catch (x) {} s.pid = p || 'anon-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8); }
  s.quiz = s.quiz || []; s.survey = s.survey || []; s.lab = s.lab || {}; s.disc = s.disc || {}; save(s); return s; }
const last = (arr, f) => arr.filter(f).sort((a, b) => b.t - a.t)[0];
const head = (t, sub) => `<section class="wrap prose fse"><p><a href="#m8kit">◀ Module 8 kit</a> · <a href="#m/8">Module 8 page</a></p><h1>${t}</h1>${sub ? `<p class="lead">${sub}</p>` : ''}`;
const formal = '<div class="statusnote" role="note"><b>Formative on this site.</b> Saved in this browser only; the answers are in the page. The TDLEG KPI evidence comes from the same instruments delivered through CUHK Moodle.</div>';

function index() {
  const S = st(), q = last(S.quiz, () => 1), pre = last(S.survey, x => x.form === 'pre'), post = last(S.survey, x => x.form === 'post');
  const row = (t, href, status) => `<tr><td><a href="${href}">${t}</a></td><td>${status}</td></tr>`;
  return head('Module 8 kit: responsible AI in statistics', 'Four activities that complete Module 8 and provide the evidence for TDLEG Deliverable 3.') + formal +
  `<ol class="fse-steps"><li><b>Start of Module 8:</b> confidence survey (before).</li><li><b>During:</b> the three-tool comparison lab (with topic 13.2) and the AI-use statement (with topic 13.3).</li><li><b>End:</b> the 10-question hallucination quiz, then the confidence survey (after).</li></ol>
