  ${row('1 · Confidence survey — before', '#m8kit/survey/pre', pre ? 'done ' + new Date(pre.t).toLocaleDateString() : '<span class="pill st-gap">not started</span>')}
  ${row('2 · Three-tool comparison lab', '#m8kit/lab', S.lab.checked ? 'checked' : (S.lab.rows ? 'in progress' : '<span class="pill st-gap">not started</span>'))}
  ${row('3 · AI-use statement', '#m8kit/disclose', S.disc.tools ? 'drafted' : '<span class="pill st-gap">not started</span>')}
  ${row('4 · Hallucination quiz (10 questions)', '#m8kit/quiz', q ? `${q.score}/10` : '<span class="pill st-gap">not started</span>')}
  ${row('5 · Confidence survey — after', '#m8kit/survey/post', post ? 'done ' + new Date(post.t).toLocaleDateString() : (pre ? '<span class="pill">after the quiz</span>' : '<span class="muted">take “before” first</span>'))}</table>
  <p><button type="button" class="btn" id="fse-csv">⬇ Export my Module 8 responses (CSV)</button></p><p class="muted">Study code: <b>${e(S.pid)}</b> (shared with the pre/post-assessments). Version: ${e(D.version)}.</p></section>`;
}
function quiz() {
  const S = st(), done = last(S.quiz, () => 1);
  if (done && !/retake$/.test(location.hash)) return quizResult(done);
  return head('Hallucination and verification quiz', '10 AI statements or situations. Choose the best response, then say how sure you are. No notes, no AI — about 15 minutes.') +
  `<form id="fse-quiz" novalidate>` + D.quiz.map((q, i) => `<fieldset class="fsq-q"><legend><b>Q${i + 1}.</b> ${e(q.stem)}</legend>` +
    q.opts.map((o, k) => `<label class="fsq-o"><input type="radio" name="${q.id}" value="${k}"> <span>${'ABCD'[k]}. ${e(o)}</span></label>`).join('') +
    `<div class="fse-conf" role="radiogroup" aria-label="How sure are you about Q${i + 1}?"><span>How sure are you?</span>` + [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(c => `<label><input type="radio" name="${q.id}-c" value="${c}"> ${c}</label>`).join('') + '<span class="muted">1 = guessing · 5 = certain</span></div></fieldset>').join('') +
  '<p id="fse-msg" class="muted" aria-live="polite"></p><button class="btn primary" type="submit">Submit</button></form></section>';
}
function quizResult(a) {
  const byc = {}; D.quiz.forEach(q => { const c = a.conf[q.id], ok = a.ans[q.id] === q.key; (byc[c] = byc[c] || [0, 0])[1]++; if (ok) byc[c][0]++; });
  const over = D.quiz.filter(q => a.conf[q.id] >= 4 && a.ans[q.id] !== q.key);
  return head(`Hallucination quiz: ${a.score} / 10`, a.score >= 8 ? 'Meets the module standard (8 or more out of 10).' : 'Below the module standard of 8/10. Review the items below, then retake.') +
  `<h2>Calibration</h2><table class="tbl"><tr><th scope="col">Your confidence</th><th scope="col">Items</th><th scope="col">Correct</th></tr>` +
  [5, 4, 3, 2, 1].filter(c => byc[c]).map(c => `<tr><td>${c}</td><td>${byc[c][1]}</td><td>${byc[c][0]} (${Math.round(100 * byc[c][0] / byc[c][1])}%)</td></tr>`).join('') + '</table>' +
  (over.length ? `<p><b>Over-confident on ${over.length} item${over.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}</b> (sure, but wrong): ${over.map(q => 'Q' + (D.quiz.indexOf(q) + 1)).join(', ')}. These are the error types you are least likely to double-check.</p>` : '<p>No over-confident errors.</p>') +
  '<h2>Feedback</h2>' + D.quiz.map((q, i) => { const ok = a.ans[q.id] === q.key; return `<div class="fsq-fb ${ok ? 'ok' : 'no'}"><p><b>Q${i + 1}</b> <span class="fsr-badge">${e(q.domain)}</span> <span class="fsr-badge">${q.h} · ${e(D.hcodes[q.h])}</span></p><p>${e(q.stem)}</p><p>${ok ? '✓' : '✗ You chose ' + (a.ans[q.id] != null ? 'ABCD'[a.ans[q.id]] : '—') + ' ·'} Answer: <b>${'ABCD'[q.key]}. ${e(q.opts[q.key])}</b></p><p class="muted">${e(q.why)} Revise <a href="#t/${q.topic}">${q.topic}</a>.</p></div>`; }).join('') +
  `<p><a class="btn primary" href="#m8kit/survey/post">Next: confidence survey (after)</a> <a class="btn" href="#m8kit/quiz/retake">Retake</a></p></section>`;
}
function survey(form) {
  const S = st();
  if (form === 'post' && !last(S.survey, x => x.form === 'pre')) return head('Confidence survey — after') + '<p>Please complete the <a href="#m8kit/survey/pre">“before” survey</a> first, so change can be measured.</p></section>';
  const sc = (id, txt) => `<fieldset class="fse-lik"><legend>${e(txt)}</legend>${D.scale.map((l, k) => `<label><input type="radio" name="${id}" value="${k + 1}"> ${e(l)}</label>`).join('')}</fieldset>`;
  return head(`Confidence survey — ${form === 'pre' ? 'before Module 8' : 'after Module 8'}`, 'There are no right answers. How confident are you, today, in each of these?') +
  `<form id="fse-survey" data-form="${form}" novalidate>${D.survey.map(([id, t]) => sc(id, t)).join('')}` +
  (form === 'post' ? `<fieldset class="fse-lik"><legend><b>${e(D.direct[1])}</b></legend>${D.direct[2].map((l, k) => `<label><input type="radio" name="${D.direct[0]}" value="${k + 1}"> ${e(l)}</label>`).join('')}</fieldset>` +
    D.open.map(([id, t]) => `<p><label for="${id}">${e(t)}</label><br><textarea id="${id}" name="${id}" rows="2" maxlength="600" class="fse-ta"></textarea></p>`).join('') : '') +
  `<p class="muted">Do not write names or other personal details in the text boxes.</p><p id="fse-msg" class="muted" aria-live="polite"></p><button class="btn primary" type="submit">Submit</button></form></section>`;
}
function surveyDone(form) {
  const S = st(), pre = last(S.survey, x => x.form === 'pre'), post = last(S.survey, x => x.form === 'post');
  if (form === 'pre') return head('Thank you') + '<p>Your “before” answers are saved. Continue with Module 8; take the “after” survey once you have finished the quiz.</p><p><a class="btn primary" href="#m/8">Go to Module 8</a></p></section>';
  const m = x => D.survey.reduce((s, [id]) => s + (+x.ans[id] || 0), 0) / D.survey.length;
  return head('Thank you') + `<p>Average confidence: before ${m(pre).toFixed(2)}, after ${m(post).toFixed(2)} (scale 1–5; change ${(m(post) - m(pre) >= 0 ? '+' : '') + (m(post) - m(pre)).toFixed(2)}).</p><p>Confidence should follow skill. Compare this with your quiz calibration table: if you became much more confident but your “sure but wrong” count is not zero, keep the verification habits switched on.</p><p><a class="btn" href="#m8kit">Back to the kit</a></p></section>`;
}
function lab() {
  const S = st(), L = S.lab, rows = L.rows || {}, T = D.truth;
  const cell = (r, f) => { const v = (rows[r] || {})[f[0]] ?? ''; if (f[2] === 'yn') return `<select name="${r}|${f[0]}" aria-label="${e(f[1])} — ${e(r)}"><option value=""></option><option${v === 'yes' ? ' selected' : ''}>yes</option><option${v === 'no' ? ' selected' : ''}>no</option></select>`;
    return `<input name="${r}|${f[0]}" value="${e(v)}" size="${f[2] === 'num' ? 7 : 12}" aria-label="${e(f[1])} — ${e(r)}" ${f[2] === 'num' ? 'inputmode="decimal"' : ''}>`; };
  const who = D.tools.concat(['My own recomputation']);
  return head('Three-tool comparison lab', 'The same task, the same synthetic file, three AI tools — then your own check. Agreement between tools is not proof.') +
  `<div class="statusnote" role="note">${D.toolNote}</div>
  <h2>1 · Get the file and the task</h2><p><a class="btn" download="tutorial_scores.csv" href="data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(D.csv)}">⬇ tutorial_scores.csv</a> <span class="muted">${D.truth.rows_file} rows, synthetic.</span></p>
  <div class="promptbox"><code id="fse-task">[Paste the prompt contract from topic 1.9 first.] ${e(D.task)}</code><button class="copy btn sm" type="button" id="fse-copy">Copy</button></div>
  <h2>2 · Record what each tool reported</h2><p class="muted">Copy numbers exactly as each tool gave them. Leave a cell blank if the tool did not report it.</p>
  <form id="fse-lab"><div class="twrap"><table class="tbl fse-lab"><tr><th scope="col">Source</th>${D.labFields.map(f => `<th scope="col">${e(f[1])}</th>`).join('')}</tr>` +
  who.map(r => `<tr><th scope="row">${e(r)}</th>${D.labFields.map(f => `<td>${r === 'My own recomputation' && /date|model|code|causal/.test(f[0]) ? '—' : cell(r, f)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('') +
  `</table></div><h2>3 · Your judgement</h2><p><label for="fse-refl">Which tool(s) were wrong, on what, and how did you know? Did the tools agree on anything that was wrong?</label><br><textarea id="fse-refl" rows="4" class="fse-ta">${e(L.refl || '')}</textarea></p>
  <p><button class="btn" type="button" id="fse-save">Save</button> <button class="btn primary" type="submit">Check against the answer</button></p></form><div id="fse-labout" aria-live="polite">${L.checked ? labCheck(L) : ''}</div></section>`;
}
function labCheck(L) {
  const T = D.truth, rows = L.rows || {}, mine = rows['My own recomputation'] || {};
  if (!mine.n || !mine.meanA || !mine.meanB) return '<p class="fse-warn">Fill in your own recomputation (n, mean A, mean B) first — the answer is shown only after you have checked the data yourself.</p>';
  const near = (v, t, tol) => v !== '' && v != null && Math.abs(parseFloat(v) - t) <= tol;
  const truthRow = { n: T.n_clean, meanA: T.mean_A, meanB: T.mean_B, p: T.p, dup: 'yes', m99: 'yes', code: 'yes', causal: 'no' };
  const tol = { n: 0, meanA: 0.06, meanB: 0.06, p: 0.006 };
  const who = D.tools.concat(['My own recomputation']).filter(r => rows[r] && Object.values(rows[r]).some(v => v !== ''));
  let h = `<h2>4 · Check</h2><p>Answer (cleaned data): <b>${T.rows_file}</b> rows in the file − <b>${T.rows_dup}</b> exact duplicates − <b>${T.rows_file - T.rows_dup - T.n_clean}</b> rows with score −99 (absent) = <b>n = ${T.n_clean}</b> (A ${T.n_A}, B ${T.n_B}).
  Mean A <b>${T.mean_A}</b>, mean B <b>${T.mean_B}</b>; B − A = ${T.diff} (Welch t = ${T.t}, df ≈ ${T.df}, <b>p = ${T.p}</b>, 95% CI ${T.ci[0]} to ${T.ci[1]}). Attendance and score: r = ${T.r_attend}.</p>
  <p>Supported conclusion: <i>no clear difference between tutorial formats</i>; attendance is strongly associated with score, but students chose their format and attendance, so neither result is causal.
  Trap: keeping duplicates and −99 codes gives mean A ${T.naive_mean_A} and mean B ${T.naive_mean_B} — the <b>direction reverses</b>.</p>
  <div class="twrap"><table class="tbl"><tr><th scope="col">Source</th>${['n', 'meanA', 'meanB', 'p', 'dup', 'm99', 'code', 'causal'].map(k => `<th scope="col">${e(D.labFields.find(f => f[0] === k)[1])}</th>`).join('')}</tr>`;
  who.forEach(r => { h += `<tr><th scope="row">${e(r)}</th>` + ['n', 'meanA', 'meanB', 'p', 'dup', 'm99', 'code', 'causal'].map(k => { const v = (rows[r] || {})[k]; if (v == null || v === '' ) return '<td class="muted">—</td>';
    const ok = k in tol ? near(v, truthRow[k], tol[k]) : v === truthRow[k]; return `<td class="${ok ? 'fse-ok' : 'fse-no'}">${e(v)} ${ok ? '✓' : '✗'}</td>`; }).join('') + '</tr>'; });
  h += '</table></div>';
  const tools = D.tools.filter(r => rows[r] && rows[r].meanA); const agreeWrong = tools.length > 1 && tools.every(r => !near(rows[r].meanA, T.mean_A, .06)) && tools.every(r => Math.abs(parseFloat(rows[r].meanA) - parseFloat(rows[tools[0]].meanA)) < .06);
  if (agreeWrong) h += '<p class="fse-warn"><b>The tools agreed with each other and were all wrong.</b> This is the lesson of topic 13.2: agreement is not proof.</p>';
  return h + '<p class="muted">Keep this table in your verification log; it is the evidence for your AI-use statement.</p>';
}
function disclose() {
  const S = st(), d = S.disc;
  return head('AI-use statement', 'Fill in the six parts; the statement is assembled for you to copy into your assignment or report.') +
  `<form id="fse-disc">${D.disclose.map(([id, l, ph]) => `<p><label for="fd-${id}"><b>${e(l)}</b></label><br><textarea id="fd-${id}" name="${id}" rows="2" class="fse-ta" placeholder="${e(ph)}">${e(d[id] || '')}</textarea></p>`).join('')}</form>
  <h2>Your statement</h2><div class="fse-stmt" id="fse-stmt" aria-live="polite">${stmt(d)}</div><p><button class="btn" type="button" id="fse-dcopy">Copy</button> <button class="btn" type="button" id="fse-dtxt">⬇ Download .txt</button></p>
  <p class="muted">Follow your course’s and CUHK’s rules on AI use; this template does not replace them. A statement is only credible if the records it points to exist.</p></section>`;
}
function stmt(d) {
  const g = k => (d[k] || '').trim(); if (!g('tools')) return '<p class="muted">Start typing above.</p>';
  return `<p>AI use: I used ${e(g('tools'))}. ${g('tasks') ? 'The AI ' + e(g('tasks').replace(/^the ai /i, '')).replace(/\.?$/, '.') : ''} ${g('notai') ? 'Without AI, I ' + e(g('notai').replace(/^i /i, '')).replace(/\.?$/, '.') : ''} ${g('verify') ? 'I verified the AI output as follows: ' + e(g('verify')).replace(/\.?$/, '.') : '<b>[Verification missing — a statement without it is incomplete.]</b>'} ${g('changes') ? 'Changes and rejections: ' + e(g('changes')).replace(/\.?$/, '.') : ''} ${g('records') ? 'Records: ' + e(g('records')).replace(/\.?$/, '.') : ''} I take responsibility for the final content.</p>`;
}
function csv() {
  const S = st(), rows = [['pid', 'instrument', 'form', 'timestamp', 'item', 'response', 'correct', 'confidence']];
  S.quiz.forEach(a => D.quiz.forEach(q => rows.push([S.pid, 'hallucination_quiz', 'post', a.t, q.id, a.ans[q.id] != null ? 'ABCD'[a.ans[q.id]] : '', a.ans[q.id] === q.key ? 1 : 0, a.conf[q.id] || ''])));
  S.survey.forEach(a => D.survey.concat([[D.direct[0]]]).forEach(([id]) => { if (a.ans[id] != null) rows.push([S.pid, 'confidence_survey', a.form, a.t, id, a.ans[id], '', '']); }));
  const blob = new Blob([rows.map(r => r.join(',')).join('\n') + '\n'], { type: 'text/csv' }), l = document.createElement('a');
  l.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); l.download = `flippedstat_module8_${S.pid}.csv`; l.click();
}
function goTo(h) { if (location.hash === h) { render(); const m = document.getElementById('main'); m && m.scrollIntoView && m.scrollIntoView(); } else location.hash = h; }

  else main.innerHTML = index();
  const $ = s => main.querySelector(s), msg = t => { const m = $('#fse-msg'); if (m) m.textContent = t; };
  const fq = $('#fse-quiz'); if (fq) fq.addEventListener('submit', ev => { ev.preventDefault(); const ans = {}, conf = {}; let miss = 0;
    D.quiz.forEach(q => { const a = fq.querySelector(`input[name="${q.id}"]:checked`), c = fq.querySelector(`input[name="${q.id}-c"]:checked`); if (!a || !c) miss++; else { ans[q.id] = +a.value; conf[q.id] = +c.value; } });
    if (miss) return msg(`Please answer and rate your confidence for every question (${miss} incomplete).`);
    const s = st(); s.quiz.push({ t: Date.now(), ans, conf, score: D.quiz.filter(q => ans[q.id] === q.key).length }); save(s); goTo('#m8kit/quiz'); });

    D.survey.concat(form === 'post' ? [[D.direct[0]]] : []).forEach(([id]) => { const x = fs.querySelector(`input[name="${id}"]:checked`); if (x) ans[id] = +x.value; else miss++; });
    if (miss) return msg(`Please answer every rating (${miss} missing).`);

    $('#fse-save').addEventListener('click', () => { grab(); $('#fse-labout').innerHTML = '<p class="muted">Saved.</p>'; });
    fl.addEventListener('submit', ev => { ev.preventDefault(); const s = grab(); const mine = s.lab.rows['My own recomputation'] || {}; if (mine.n && mine.meanA && mine.meanB) { s.lab.checked = 1; save(s); } $('#fse-labout').innerHTML = labCheck(s.lab); });

  const fd = $('#fse-disc'); if (fd) { fd.addEventListener('input', () => { const s = st(); D.disclose.forEach(([id]) => { s.disc[id] = fd.querySelector('#fd-' + id).value; }); save(s); $('#fse-stmt').innerHTML = stmt(s.disc); });
    $('#fse-dcopy').addEventListener('click', () => { navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText($('#fse-stmt').innerText); $('#fse-dcopy').textContent = 'Copied ✔'; });
    $('#fse-dtxt').addEventListener('click', () => { const l = document.createElement('a'); l.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([$('#fse-stmt').innerText + '\n'], { type: 'text/plain' })); l.download = 'AI_use_statement.txt'; l.click(); }); }
  const c = $('#fse-csv'); if (c) c.addEventListener('click', csv);
}

/* FlippedStat v10.2-dev — labelled supplementary interactives (FSINT).
   Adapts interaction *patterns* from ModernDive 2e (Ismay, Kim, Valdivia),
   reimplemented with FlippedStat synthetic data. Namespace: FSINT. */
(function () {
  const D = window.FSINT_DATA || {};
  const NAVY = "#16263d", TEAL = "#277581", AMBER = "#9b5d00",
        RED = "#b23b3b", GREEN = "#2d7a4d", MUTE = "#5b6676", INK = "#1d2433";

  function el(html) {
    const t = document.createElement("div");
    t.innerHTML = html.trim();
    return t.firstElementChild;
  }
  function $(sel, root) { return (root || document).querySelector(sel); }
  function num(x) { return +x; }
  function mean(a) {
    let s = 0, n = a.length;
    if (!n) return NaN;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) s += a[i];
    return s / n;
  }
  function median(a) {
    if (!a.length) return NaN;
    const b = a.slice().sort(function (x, y) { return x - y; });
    const m = Math.floor(b.length / 2);
    return b.length % 2 ? b[m] : (b[m - 1] + b[m]) / 2;
  }
  function sd(a, mu) {
    const n = a.length;
    if (n < 2) return NaN;
    if (mu == null) mu = mean(a);
    let s = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) s += (a[i] - mu) * (a[i] - mu);
    return Math.sqrt(s / (n - 1));
  }
  function corr(xs, ys) {
    const n = xs.length;
    if (n < 3) return NaN;
    const mx = mean(xs), my = mean(ys);
    let nume = 0, dx = 0, dy = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = xs[i] - mx, b = ys[i] - my;
      nume += a * b; dx += a * a; dy += b * b;
    }
    const den = Math.sqrt(dx * dy);
    return den ? nume / den : NaN;
  }
  function rnd() { return Math.random(); }
  function sampleOne(pop) { return pop[Math.floor(rnd() * pop.length)]; }
  function sampleN(pop, n) {
    const out = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = sampleOne(pop);
    return out;
  }
  function subsample(pop, n) {
    const idx = pop.map(function (_, i) { return i; });
    for (let i = idx.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(rnd() * (i + 1));
      const t = idx[i]; idx[i] = idx[j]; idx[j] = t;
    }
    return idx.slice(0, n).map(function (i) { return pop[i]; });
  }
  function invNorm(p) {
    // Acklam approximation for a standard-normal quantile.
    const a = [-39.69683028665376, 220.9460984245205, -275.9120606263687,
      138.3577518672690, -30.66479806614716, 2.506628277459239];
    const b = [-54.47609879822406, 161.5858368580409, -155.6989798598866,
      66.80131188771972, -13.28068155288572];
    const c = [-0.007784894002430293, -0.3223964580411365, -2.400758277161838,
      -2.549732539343734, 4.374664141464968, 2.938163982698783];
    const d = [0.007784695709041462, 0.3224671290700398, 2.445134137142996, 3.754408661907416];
    const plow = 0.02425, phigh = 1 - plow;
    let q, r;
    if (p < plow) {
      q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(p));
      return (((((c[0]*q+c[1])*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5]) /
             ((((d[0]*q+d[1])*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+1);
    }
    if (p > phigh) {
      q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1 - p));
      return -(((((c[0]*q+c[1])*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5]) /
              ((((d[0]*q+d[1])*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+1);
    }
    q = p - 0.5; r = q * q;
    return (((((a[0]*r+a[1])*r+a[2])*r+a[3])*r+a[4])*r+a[5]) * q /
           (((((b[0]*r+b[1])*r+b[2])*r+b[3])*r+b[4])*r+1);
  }
  function fmt(x, d) {
    if (!isFinite(x)) return "—";
    const n = d == null ? 2 : d;
    return Number(x).toFixed(n);
  }

  function canvasOf(host) {
    const c = host.querySelector("canvas");
    const wrap = c.parentElement;
    const cssW = Math.max(240, Math.min(640, wrap.clientWidth || 640));
    const cssH = 260;
    const ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    c.style.width = cssW + "px";
    c.style.height = cssH + "px";
    c.width = Math.round(cssW * ratio);
    c.height = Math.round(cssH * ratio);
    const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
    ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
    return { c: c, ctx: ctx, w: cssW, h: cssH };
  }
  function clear(g) {
    g.ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f7fb";
    g.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, g.w, g.h);
  }
  function hist(g, values, opts) {
    clear(g);
    const padL = 36, padR = 12, padT = 16, padB = 28;
    const w = g.w, h = g.h, ctx = g.ctx;
    if (!values.length) return;
    let lo = opts.min, hi = opts.max;
    if (lo == null || hi == null) {
      lo = Math.min.apply(null, values);
      hi = Math.max.apply(null, values);
      if (lo === hi) { lo -= 1; hi += 1; }
    }
    const bins = opts.bins || 20;
    const counts = new Array(bins).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      let t = (values[i] - lo) / (hi - lo);
      if (t < 0 || t > 1) continue;
      let b = Math.floor(t * bins);
      if (b === bins) b = bins - 1;
      counts[b]++;
    }
    const maxC = Math.max(1, Math.max.apply(null, counts));
    const bw = (w - padL - padR) / bins;
    ctx.fillStyle = opts.color || TEAL;
    for (let i = 0; i < bins; i++) {
      const bh = (counts[i] / maxC) * (h - padT - padB);
      const x = padL + i * bw;
      const y = h - padB - bh;
      ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y, Math.max(1, bw - 2), bh);
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = MUTE;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padL, h - padB);
    ctx.lineTo(w - padR, h - padB);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = MUTE;
    ctx.font = "11px system-ui,sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(fmt(lo, 1), padL, h - 8);
    ctx.fillText(fmt(hi, 1), w - padR - 28, h - 8);
    if (opts.lines) {
      opts.lines.forEach(function (ln) {
        const t = (ln.x - lo) / (hi - lo);
        if (t < 0 || t > 1) return;
        const x = padL + t * (w - padL - padR);
        ctx.strokeStyle = ln.color || AMBER;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, padT);
        ctx.lineTo(x, h - padB);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = ln.color || AMBER;
        ctx.fillText(ln.label || "", x + 4, padT + 10);
      });
    }
  }
  function scatter(g, points, opts) {
    clear(g);
    const padL = 36, padR = 12, padT = 16, padB = 28;
    const w = g.w, h = g.h, ctx = g.ctx;
    if (!points.length) return;
    const xs = points.map(function (p) { return p.x; });
    const ys = points.map(function (p) { return p.y; });
    let x0 = Math.min.apply(null, xs), x1 = Math.max.apply(null, xs);
    let y0 = Math.min.apply(null, ys), y1 = Math.max.apply(null, ys);
    if (x0 === x1) { x0 -= 1; x1 += 1; }
    if (y0 === y1) { y0 -= 1; y1 += 1; }
    const xpad = 0.05 * (x1 - x0), ypad = 0.08 * (y1 - y0);
    x0 -= xpad; x1 += xpad; y0 -= ypad; y1 += ypad;
    function X(x) { return padL + (x - x0) / (x1 - x0) * (w - padL - padR); }
    function Y(y) { return h - padB - (y - y0) / (y1 - y0) * (h - padT - padB); }
    ctx.strokeStyle = MUTE;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padL, padT); ctx.lineTo(padL, h - padB); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, h - padB);
    ctx.stroke();
    const palette = opts.palette || {};
    points.forEach(function (p) {
      ctx.fillStyle = palette[p.g] || TEAL;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(X(p.x), Y(p.y), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.fillStyle = MUTE;
    ctx.font = "11px system-ui,sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(opts.xlab || "", padL, h - 8);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(12, h / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillText(opts.ylab || "", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function intervals(g, rows, mu) {
    clear(g);
    const padL = 44, padR = 10, padT = 16, padB = 16;
    const w = g.w, h = g.h, ctx = g.ctx;
    if (!rows.length) return;
    let lo = Infinity, hi = -Infinity;
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      lo = Math.min(lo, r.lo); hi = Math.max(hi, r.hi);
    });
    lo = Math.min(lo, mu); hi = Math.max(hi, mu);
    const span = hi - lo || 1;
    lo -= 0.05 * span; hi += 0.05 * span;
    function X(x) { return padL + (x - lo) / (hi - lo) * (w - padL - padR); }
    const rowH = Math.max(2, (h - padT - padB) / rows.length);
    rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
      const y = padT + i * rowH + rowH / 2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = r.hit ? GREEN : RED;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(X(r.lo), y);
      ctx.lineTo(X(r.hi), y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = r.hit ? GREEN : RED;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(X(r.mid), y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.strokeStyle = NAVY;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(X(mu), padT);
    ctx.lineTo(X(mu), h - padB);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = NAVY;
    ctx.font = "11px system-ui,sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("μ = " + fmt(mu, 2), X(mu) + 4, padT + 10);
  }

  /* ---------- widgets ---------- */
  function widgetShell(id, title, meta, controlsHtml, extraHtml) {
    return el(
      '<div class="fsint-widget" id="' + id + '" data-fsint="' + id + '">' +
      "<h3>" + title + "</h3>" +
      '<p class="fsint-meta">' + meta + "</p>" +
      '<div class="fsint-controls">' + controlsHtml + "</div>" +
      '<div class="fsint-canvas-wrap"><canvas role="img" aria-label="' + title + ' chart"></canvas></div>' +
      '<p class="fsint-readout" aria-live="polite"></p>' +
      (extraHtml || "") +
      "</div>"
    );
  }

  function wMiss(host) {
    const sleep = (D.sleep || []).slice();
    const box = widgetShell(
      "fsint-miss",
      "Missing codes can move a mean",
      "Synthetic file <code>sleep_column.csv</code> (120 rows). R treats blanks and the letters NA as missing, but keeps the code −99 as a number until you recode it. These two means are already keyed in Topic 2.2: 2.53&nbsp;h versus 7.61&nbsp;h.",
      '<button type="button" data-act="kept">Treat −99 as a number</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="alt" data-act="clean">Set −99 to missing</button>'
    );
    host.appendChild(box);
    const out = $(".fsint-readout", box);
    function values(clean) {
      const nums = [];
      sleep.forEach(function (v) {
        if (v === "" || v === "NA") return;
        const x = parseFloat(v);
        if (!isFinite(x)) return;
        if (clean && x === -99) return;
        nums.push(x);
      });
      return nums;
    }
    function show(clean) {
      const a = values(clean);
      const m = mean(a), med = median(a);
      const g = canvasOf(box);
      hist(g, a, {
        min: clean ? 3 : -110, max: clean ? 13 : 20, bins: clean ? 16 : 24,

      });
      if (clean) {
        out.innerHTML = "After recoding −99 to missing: mean <b class=\"ok\">" + fmt(m, 2) +
          " h</b> on <b>n = " + a.length + "</b> (median " + fmt(med, 1) +
          " h). Topic 2.2 keys this as 7.61&nbsp;h on 100 clean values (median 7.5&nbsp;h). " +
          "Report the n and the reason, not only the mean.";
      } else {
        out.innerHTML = "With −99 kept as a number: mean <b class=\"bad\">" + fmt(m, 2) +
          " h</b> on <b>n = " + a.length + "</b> (median " + fmt(med, 1) +
          " h). Topic 2.2 keys this as 2.53&nbsp;h on 105 values (median 7.4&nbsp;h) — impossible for sleep. " +
          "The blanks and “NA” were already dropped; the five codes were not.";
      }
    }
    box.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      const act = ev.target && ev.target.getAttribute("data-act");
      if (act === "clean") show(true);
      if (act === "kept") show(false);
    });
    show(false);
  }

  function wClt(host) {
    const pop = (D.sleep_clean || []).slice();
    const mu = mean(pop);
    const box = widgetShell(
      "fsint-clt",
      "Sampling distribution and the central limit theorem",
      "Teaching population: the <b>100 clean synthetic sleep hours</b> in <code>sleep_column.csv</code> (mean 7.61&nbsp;h). That figure is the verified clean-sample mean from Topic 2.2, used here as a finite population for sampling practice. It is not a CUHK parameter. Draw samples of size n and watch the distribution of the sample mean.",
      '<label>Sample size n <input type="range" data-k="n" min="2" max="40" value="10"><span data-v="n">10</span></label>' +
      '<label>Number of samples <input type="range" data-k="reps" min="20" max="400" step="20" value="200"><span data-v="reps">200</span></label>' +
      '<button type="button" data-act="one">Draw one sample</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="alt" data-act="many">Build the sampling distribution</button>'
    );
    host.appendChild(box);
    const out = $(".fsint-readout", box);
    const means = [];
    function val(k) { return num(box.querySelector('[data-k="' + k + '"]').value); }
    function sync() {
      box.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(function (inp) {
        const span = box.querySelector('[data-v="' + inp.getAttribute("data-k") + '"]');
        if (span) span.textContent = inp.value;
      });
    }
    function drawMany() {
      means.length = 0;
      const n = val("n"), reps = val("reps");
      for (let i = 0; i < reps; i++) means.push(mean(sampleN(pop, n)));
      const g = canvasOf(box);
      hist(g, means, {
        min: 5.5, max: 9.5, bins: 24, color: TEAL,
        lines: [{ x: mu, color: NAVY, label: "pop. mean 7.61" }]
      });
      out.innerHTML = reps + " sample means, each from n = " + n +
        ". Mean of those means: <b class=\"ok\">" + fmt(mean(means), 2) +
        " h</b>; SD of those means: " + fmt(sd(means), 2) +
        " h. The navy line is the mean of the 100 clean synthetic values (7.61&nbsp;h). As n grows, the sampling distribution usually tightens and looks more nearly normal — that is the idea of the CLT, not a promise about one small sample.";
    }
    function drawOne() {
      const n = val("n");
      const s = sampleN(pop, n);
      const m = mean(s);
      const g = canvasOf(box);
      hist(g, s, {
        min: 4, max: 12, bins: 16, color: "#8aaeb4",
        lines: [
          { x: m, color: AMBER, label: "sample mean " + fmt(m, 2) },
          { x: mu, color: NAVY, label: "pop. 7.61" }
        ]
      });
      out.innerHTML = "One sample of n = " + n + " has mean <b>" + fmt(m, 2) +
        " h</b>. That is one draw from the sampling distribution — press the teal button to see many of them.";
    }
    box.addEventListener("input", sync);
    box.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      const act = ev.target && ev.target.getAttribute("data-act");
      if (act === "one") drawOne();
      if (act === "many") drawMany();
    });
    sync();
    drawMany();
  }

  function wCI(host) {
    const pop = (D.sleep_clean || []).slice();
    const mu = mean(pop);
    const box = widgetShell(
      "fsint-ci",
      "Do repeated confidence intervals catch μ?",
      "Same teaching population as the sampling-distribution widget: the 100 clean synthetic sleep hours, whose mean 7.61&nbsp;h is treated as a known μ for this demonstration only. Each row is a 95% interval for the mean from a fresh sample of size n, using the sample SD and a normal (z = 1.96) critical value. Green intervals contain 7.61&nbsp;h; red ones miss it. The coverage count is a simulation result, not a CUHK estimate.",
      '<label>Sample size n <input type="range" data-k="n" min="8" max="40" value="20"><span data-v="n">20</span></label>' +
      '<label>Intervals drawn <input type="range" data-k="reps" min="20" max="80" step="5" value="40"><span data-v="reps">40</span></label>' +
      '<button type="button" class="alt" data-act="go">Draw intervals</button>'
    );
    host.appendChild(box);
    const out = $(".fsint-readout", box);
    function val(k) { return num(box.querySelector('[data-k="' + k + '"]').value); }
    function sync() {
      box.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(function (inp) {
        const span = box.querySelector('[data-v="' + inp.getAttribute("data-k") + '"]');
        if (span) span.textContent = inp.value;
      });
    }
    function go() {
      const n = val("n"), reps = val("reps"), z = 1.96;
      const rows = [];
      let hits = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < reps; i++) {
        const s = sampleN(pop, n);
        const m = mean(s), se = sd(s) / Math.sqrt(n);
        const lo = m - z * se, hi = m + z * se;
        const hit = lo <= mu && mu <= hi;
        if (hit) hits++;
        rows.push({ lo: lo, hi: hi, mid: m, hit: hit });
      }
      intervals(canvasOf(box), rows, mu);
      const pct = 100 * hits / reps;
      out.innerHTML = hits + " of " + reps + " intervals contained the demonstration μ = 7.61&nbsp;h (" +
        fmt(pct, 0) + "%). A 95% interval does not succeed on every sample; the long-run share should be close to 95% if the conditions hold. One red interval is not a failed method — it is the 5% you already paid for.";
    }
    box.addEventListener("input", sync);
    box.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      if (ev.target && ev.target.getAttribute("data-act") === "go") go();
    });
    sync();
    go();
  }

  function wLurk(host) {
    const rows = (D.sat || []).slice();
    const faculties = [];
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      if (faculties.indexOf(r.g) < 0) faculties.push(r.g);
    });
    faculties.sort();
    const colors = {
      "Arts": "#8a6423", "Business": "#277581", "Engineering": "#16263d",
      "Medicine": "#9b5d00", "Science": "#2d7a4d", "Social Science": "#b23b3b"
    };
    const opts = faculties.map(function (g) { return '<option value="' + g + '">' + g + "</option>"; }).join("");
    const box = widgetShell(
      "fsint-lurk",
      "An overall correlation can hide a third variable",
      "Synthetic file <code>satisfaction300.csv</code>: study hours per week versus satisfaction, with faculty as a third variable. Figures are computed in this browser from the bundled file; they are not a CUHK survey result. Colour the points, or look at one faculty, and watch r change.",
      '<label>Show <select data-k="mode"><option value="all">All points, one colour</option><option value="colour">All points, coloured by faculty</option><option value="one">One faculty only</option></select></label>' +
      '<label>Faculty <select data-k="g">' + opts + "</select></label>" +
      '<button type="button" class="alt" data-act="go">Update plot</button>'
    );
    host.appendChild(box);
    const out = $(".fsint-readout", box);
    function current() {
      const mode = box.querySelector('[data-k="mode"]').value;
      const g = box.querySelector('[data-k="g"]').value;
      let pts = rows;
      if (mode === "one") pts = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.g === g; });
      return { mode: mode, g: g, pts: pts };
    }
    function go() {
      const st = current();
      const palette = st.mode === "colour" ? colors : { };
      const g = canvasOf(box);
      const pts = st.mode === "colour" ? st.pts : st.pts.map(function (p) { return { x: p.x, y: p.y, g: "all" }; });
      scatter(g, pts, { xlab: "study hours / week", ylab: "satisfaction", palette: palette });
      const rAll = corr(rows.map(function (p) { return p.x; }), rows.map(function (p) { return p.y; }));
      let msg = "Overall r (complete cases, n = " + rows.length + ") is <b>" + fmt(rAll, 3) + "</b>.";
      if (st.mode === "one") {
        const rG = corr(st.pts.map(function (p) { return p.x; }), st.pts.map(function (p) { return p.y; }));
        msg += " In <b>" + st.g + "</b> (n = " + st.pts.length + ") r is <b class=\"warn\">" + fmt(rG, 3) + "</b>.";
      } else if (st.mode === "colour") {
        const bits = faculties.map(function (fac) {
          const sub = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.g === fac; });
          return fac + " n=" + sub.length + " r=" + fmt(corr(sub.map(function (p) { return p.x; }), sub.map(function (p) { return p.y; })), 3);
        });
        msg += " By faculty: " + bits.join("; ") + ".";
      }
      msg += " An overall r close to zero does not mean every subgroup looks the same. Always name the third variable you checked — and the ones you did not.";
      out.innerHTML = msg;
    }
    box.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      if (ev.target && ev.target.getAttribute("data-act") === "go") go();
    });
    box.addEventListener("change", go);
    go();
  }

  function wPval(host) {
    const pop = (D.sleep_clean || []).slice();
    const extra = '<ul class="fsint-claims" id="fsint-claims">' +
      "<li>P is the probability that H₀ is true. <button type=\"button\" data-claim=\"false\">Is this what p is?</button> <span data-ans></span></li>" +
      "<li>P is the probability that the result was “due to chance”. <button type=\"button\" data-claim=\"false\">Is this what p is?</button> <span data-ans></span></li>" +
      "<li>A large p-value proves H₀. <button type=\"button\" data-claim=\"false\">Is this what p is?</button> <span data-ans></span></li>" +
      "<li>P is the probability, under H₀, of a result at least as extreme as the one we saw. <button type=\"button\" data-claim=\"true\">Is this what p is?</button> <span data-ans></span></li>" +
      "</ul>";
    const box = widgetShell(
      "fsint-pval",
      "What a p-value is not",
      "Demonstration, not a CUHK test: samples of size n are drawn from the 100 clean synthetic sleep hours. The two-sided p-value is for H₀: μ = 7.61&nbsp;h — which is true for this teaching population, because 7.61 is its mean. If the test is well calibrated, p-values under a true H₀ should be roughly scattered between 0 and 1, not piled up near zero. The statements below are the course’s “what p is not” checks (Topic 8.2); they are not a scored exam.",
      '<label>Sample size n <input type="range" data-k="n" min="8" max="40" value="16"><span data-v="n">16</span></label>' +
      '<label>Tests to run <input type="range" data-k="reps" min="40" max="400" step="20" value="200"><span data-v="reps">200</span></label>' +
      '<button type="button" data-act="one">One test under H₀</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="alt" data-act="many">Many tests under H₀</button>',
      extra
    );
    host.appendChild(box);
    const out = $(".fsint-readout", box);
    const mu0 = mean(pop);
    function val(k) { return num(box.querySelector('[data-k="' + k + '"]').value); }
    function sync() {
      box.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(function (inp) {
        const span = box.querySelector('[data-v="' + inp.getAttribute("data-k") + '"]');
        if (span) span.textContent = inp.value;
      });
    }
    function pvalue(n) {
      const s = sampleN(pop, n);
      const m = mean(s), se = sd(s) / Math.sqrt(n);
      const z = (m - mu0) / se;
      const p = 2 * (1 - phi(Math.abs(z)));
      return { m: m, z: z, p: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p)) };
    }
    function phi(z) {
      // Abramowitz & Stegun 26.2.17
      const t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * Math.abs(z));
      const d = 0.3989422804 * Math.exp(-z * z / 2);
      const p = d * t * (0.319381530 + t * (-0.356563782 + t * (1.781477937 + t * (-1.821255978 + t * 1.330274429))));
      return z >= 0 ? 1 - p : p;
    }
    function drawMany() {
      const n = val("n"), reps = val("reps");
      const ps = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < reps; i++) ps.push(pvalue(n).p);
      hist(canvasOf(box), ps, {
        min: 0, max: 1, bins: 20, color: TEAL,
        lines: [{ x: 0.05, color: AMBER, label: "0.05" }]
      });
      const small = ps.filter(function (p) { return p < 0.05; }).length;
      out.innerHTML = reps + " two-sided tests, each from n = " + n +
        " under a true H₀ for this teaching population. Mean p = " + fmt(mean(ps), 2) +
        "; share with p &lt; 0.05: <b>" + fmt(100 * small / reps, 0) +
        "%</b>. A small p is possible even when H₀ is true; that is Type I error, not proof that the null is false in nature.";
    }
    function drawOne() {
      const n = val("n");
      const r = pvalue(n);
      hist(canvasOf(box), [r.p], {
        min: 0, max: 1, bins: 20, color: TEAL,
        lines: [{ x: r.p, color: AMBER, label: "this p = " + fmt(r.p, 3) }]
      });
      out.innerHTML = "One sample of n = " + n + " had mean " + fmt(r.m, 2) +
        " h and two-sided p = <b>" + fmt(r.p, 3) +
        "</b> for H₀: μ = 7.61&nbsp;h. That p is not the probability that H₀ is true. Press the teal button to see many p-values when H₀ is actually true here.";
    }
    box.addEventListener("input", sync);
    box.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      const t = ev.target;
      if (!t) return;
      const act = t.getAttribute("data-act");
      if (act === "one") drawOne();
      if (act === "many") drawMany();
      if (t.getAttribute("data-claim")) {
        const good = t.getAttribute("data-claim") === "true";
        const span = t.parentElement.querySelector("[data-ans]");
        span.innerHTML = good
          ? ' <b class="ok">Yes — this is the definition used in Topic 8.2.</b>'
          : ' <b class="bad">No. Topic 8.2 flags this as something a p-value is not.</b>';
      }
    });
    sync();
    drawMany();
  }

  function wBoot(host) {
    const pop = (D.sleep_clean || []).slice();
    const box = widgetShell(
      "fsint-boot",
      "Bootstrap the mean: a tiny n versus a decent n",
      "Demonstration with the 100 clean synthetic sleep hours. A bootstrap resamples that sample with replacement and recomputes the mean. Compare a tiny subsample (n = 8) with the full n = 100. The spread you see is a teaching picture, not a CUHK interval.",
      '<label>Tiny sample size <input type="range" data-k="tiny" min="5" max="15" value="8"><span data-v="tiny">8</span></label>' +
      '<label>Bootstrap replicates <input type="range" data-k="reps" min="100" max="500" step="50" value="300"><span data-v="reps">300</span></label>' +
      '<button type="button" data-act="tiny">Bootstrap the tiny sample</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="alt" data-act="full">Bootstrap all 100 values</button>'
    );
    host.appendChild(box);
    const out = $(".fsint-readout", box);
    let tinySample = null;
    function val(k) { return num(box.querySelector('[data-k="' + k + '"]').value); }
    function sync() {
      box.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(function (inp) {
        const span = box.querySelector('[data-v="' + inp.getAttribute("data-k") + '"]');
        if (span) span.textContent = inp.value;
      });
    }
    function boot(sample, reps) {
      const outv = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < reps; i++) outv.push(mean(sampleN(sample, sample.length)));
      return outv;
    }
    function show(which) {
      const reps = val("reps");
      if (which === "tiny") tinySample = subsample(pop, val("tiny"));
      const sample = which === "tiny" ? tinySample : pop;
      const draws = boot(sample, reps);
      const g = canvasOf(box);
      hist(g, draws, {
        min: 5.5, max: 9.5, bins: 24, color: which === "tiny" ? AMBER : TEAL,
        lines: [{ x: mean(sample), color: NAVY, label: "sample mean " + fmt(mean(sample), 2) }]
      });
      const lo = quantile(draws, 0.025), hi = quantile(draws, 0.975);
      out.innerHTML = (which === "tiny"
        ? "Tiny sample of n = " + sample.length + " drawn from the 100 clean values."
        : "Using all n = 100 clean synthetic sleep hours.") +
        " " + reps + " bootstrap means; 2.5th to 97.5th percentiles: <b>" +
        fmt(lo, 2) + " to " + fmt(hi, 2) + " h</b>. A tiny n usually gives a wider, less stable picture. This percentile range is a demonstration, not a reported course interval.";
    }
    function quantile(a, p) {
      const b = a.slice().sort(function (x, y) { return x - y; });
      const i = (b.length - 1) * p;
      const lo = Math.floor(i), hi = Math.ceil(i);
      if (lo === hi) return b[lo];
      return b[lo] * (hi - i) + b[hi] * (i - lo);
    }
    box.addEventListener("input", sync);
    box.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      const act = ev.target && ev.target.getAttribute("data-act");
      if (act === "tiny") show("tiny");
      if (act === "full") show("full");
    });
    sync();
    show("full");
  }

  const WIDGETS = {
    miss: wMiss, clt: wClt, ci: wCI, lurk: wLurk, pval: wPval, boot: wBoot
  };

  const PAGE = function () {
    return '<section class="wrap fsint" id="fsint-page">' +
      '<p class="fsint-kicker">Supplementary interactives · not an official module</p>' +
      "<h1>Try the interactive</h1>" +
      '<p class="lead">These widgets adapt a few interaction ideas from <cite>ModernDive</cite> 2e ' +
      "(Chester Ismay, Albert Y. Kim and Arturo Valdivia) and reimplement them in FlippedStat’s style, " +
      "using synthetic Hong Kong / course data already in FlippedStat. They do not reproduce ModernDive chapters, exercises or datasets. " +
      "They sit beside the official topics as an optional check — they do not replace “AI writes the code, you verify,” and they do not change hours, KPIs or official topic lists.</p>" +
      '<div class="fsint-licence"><p><b>Licence for this supplementary layer only:</b> ' +
      '<a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CC BY-NC-SA 4.0</a>. ' +
      'Source of the interaction patterns: Ismay, Kim and Valdivia, <a href="https://moderndive.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">moderndive.com</a>. ' +
      "ShareAlike and NonCommercial are stricter than some other FlippedStat materials. Official module text and the core course licence wording are otherwise unchanged.</p></div>" +
      '<div class="fsint-toc"><p><b>Widgets on this page</b></p><ol>' +
      '<li><a href="#interactives/miss">Missing codes can move a mean</a> (Topic 2.2)</li>' +
      '<li><a href="#interactives/clt">Sampling distribution and the CLT</a> (Topics 7.2–7.3)</li>' +
      '<li><a href="#interactives/ci">Confidence-interval coverage</a> (Topic 7.6)</li>' +
      '<li><a href="#interactives/lurk">Correlation and a third variable</a> (Topic 9.7)</li>' +
      '<li><a href="#interactives/pval">What a p-value is not</a> (Topics 8.1–8.2)</li>' +
      '<li><a href="#interactives/boot">Bootstrap of a mean, tiny vs decent n</a> (optional; Topics 7.5–7.6)</li>' +
      "</ol></div>" +
      '<div id="fsint-mount"></div>' +
      "</section>";
  };

  function mountAll(root) {
    const mount = $("#fsint-mount", root) || root;
    mount.innerHTML = "";
    ["miss", "clt", "ci", "lurk", "pval", "boot"].forEach(function (id) {
      WIDGETS[id](mount);
    });
  }

  function render() {
    const main = document.getElementById("main");
    if (!main) return;
    main.innerHTML = PAGE();
    mountAll(main);
    const hash = location.hash || "";
    const m = hash.match(/^#interactives\/([a-z]+)/);
    if (m) {
      const target = document.getElementById("fsint-" + m[1]);
      if (target) target.scrollIntoView();
    }
  }

  const BANNERS = D.banners || {
    "2.2": "A labelled supplementary widget lets you toggle the −99 sleep codes and recompute the mean (2.53&nbsp;h vs 7.61&nbsp;h).",
    "7.2": "A labelled supplementary widget builds a sampling distribution of the mean from the clean synthetic sleep values.",
    "7.3": "A labelled supplementary widget lets you change n and watch the sampling distribution of the mean.",
    "7.5": "An optional supplementary widget bootstraps the mean of the clean synthetic sleep values, for a tiny n and for n = 100.",
    "7.6": "A labelled supplementary widget draws many confidence intervals and counts how many catch a demonstration μ.",
    "8.1": "A labelled supplementary widget simulates p-values under a true demonstration null and contrasts that with what p is not.",
    "8.2": "A labelled supplementary widget simulates p-values under a true demonstration null and walks through “what p is not.”",
    "9.7": "A labelled supplementary widget plots study hours against satisfaction in the synthetic satisfaction file, then slices by faculty."
  };

  function banner() {
    const m = location.hash.match(/^#t\/(.+)$/);
    if (!m) return;
    const key = decodeURIComponent(m[1]);
    const text = BANNERS[key];
    const h1 = document.querySelector("#main h1");
    if (!text || !h1 || document.querySelector(".fsint-banner")) return;
    h1.insertAdjacentHTML("afterend",
      '<div class="fsint-banner"><b>Try the interactive:</b> ' + text +
      ' <a class="btn sm" href="#interactives">Open the supplementary widgets ▶</a></div>');
  }

  window.FSINT = {
    render: render, banner: banner, mount: mountAll, widgets: WIDGETS
  };
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", function () { setTimeout(banner, 0); });
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { setTimeout(banner, 0); });
})();

/* FlippedStat v9.2 module layer (FSM): official TDLEG modules, pathways, completion. */
window.FSM=(function(){
 const D=window.FSM_DATA;
 const e=s=>String(s??'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
 const done=()=>{try{return new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('fs:done'))||[]);}catch(x){return new Set();}};
 const tmap=()=>{const m={};(window.FS?FS.units:[]).forEach(u=>u.topics.forEach(t=>m[t.no]=[u,t]));return m;};
 const hrs=(list,T)=>list.reduce((a,no)=>a+(+(T[no]&&T[no][1].hours)||0),0);
 const fmt=x=>(Math.round(x*4)/4).toString();
 const prog=(list,d)=>{const k=list.filter(no=>d.has(no)).length;return [k,list.length,list.length?k/list.length:0];};
 function bar(p){return `<span class="fsm-bar" role="img" aria-label="${Math.round(p*100)}% complete"><i style="width:${Math.round(p*100)}%"></i></span>`;}
 function status(p){return p>=D.threshold?'<span class="pill st-ok">Complete</span>':(p>0?'<span class="pill">In progress</span>':'<span class="pill">Not started</span>');}
 function index(){const T=tmap(),d=done();
  let h=`<section class="wrap fsm"><h1>Official modules</h1><p>FlippedStat's ${D.modules.length} official modules group all core weeks, electives and clinics into the units reported under the TDLEG project. Each module lists its learning outcomes, essential topics and completion rule.</p><p class="fsm-note">${e(D.completion)}</p>`;
  h+=`<table class="tbl fsm-tab"><caption class="sr">Modules, hours and your progress</caption><tr><th scope="col">Module</th><th scope="col">Tier</th><th scope="col">Topics</th><th scope="col">Hours (all / essential)</th><th scope="col">Your progress</th></tr>`;
  D.modules.forEach(m=>{const [k,n,p]=prog(m.topics,d);h+=`<tr><td><a href="#m/${m.n}">Module ${m.n}: ${e(m.title)}</a></td><td>${e(m.tier)}</td><td>${n}</td><td>${fmt(hrs(m.topics,T))} h / ${fmt(hrs(m.essential,T))} h</td><td>${bar(p)} ${k}/${n} ${status(p)}</td></tr>`;});
  h+=`</table><p><a class="btn primary" href="#pathways">Choose a pathway ▶</a></p><p class="muted">The jamovi toolkit (C1) supports every module and is not counted towards any of them.</p></section>`;return h;}
 function tmix(t){if(!window.FTR)return '';if(!t.subs.length){const v=FTR.topicTier(t.no);return v?({F:'Fundamental',I:'Intermediate',X:'Extension'})[v]+' (topic)':'<span class="muted">pending</span>';}const c={F:0,I:0,X:0};let k=0;t.subs.forEach(s=>{const v=FTR.tierOf(s.no);if(v){c[v]++;k++;}});return k?`${c.F} F · ${c.I} I · ${c.X} X`:'<span class="muted">pending</span>';}
 function module(n){const m=D.modules.find(x=>x.n==n);if(!m)return index();const T=tmap(),d=done(),[k,c,p]=prog(m.topics,d);const ess=new Set(m.essential);
  let h=`<section class="wrap fsm"><p><a href="#modules">◀ All modules</a></p><h1>Module ${m.n}: ${e(m.title)}</h1><p class="muted">Proposal reference: ${e(m.proposal)} · ${e(m.tier)} tier · ${fmt(hrs(m.topics,T))} h in total · Fundamental subtopics ${(()=>{const E=essentialOf(m,T);return E.mode==='tier'?fmt(E.mins/60)+' h':'pending';})()}</p>`;
  if(m.note)h+=`<div class="statusnote" role="note"><b>Note on the proposal:</b> ${e(m.note)}</div>`;
  h+=`<h2>Learning outcomes</h2><p>When you finish this module, you should be able to:</p><ol>${m.outcomes.map(o=>`<li>${e(o)}</li>`).join('')}</ol>`;
  h+=`<h2>Your progress</h2><p>${bar(p)} ${k} of ${c} topics done ${status(p)}</p><p class="muted">Complete = at least ${Math.round(D.threshold*100)}% of topics marked done.</p><h2>Checks</h2><p>${e(m.checks)}</p><p><a class="btn primary" href="#assess/${m.n}/pre">Module pre-assessment (Form A)</a> <a class="btn" href="#assess/${m.n}/post">Module post-assessment (Form B)</a>${m.n==8?' <a class="btn primary" href="#m8kit">Module 8 kit: quiz, survey, lab, AI-use statement</a>':''}</p>`;
  h+=`<h2>Topics</h2><table class="tbl"><caption class="sr">Topics in this module</caption><tr><th scope="col">Topic</th><th scope="col">Unit</th><th scope="col">Hours</th><th scope="col">Essential</th><th scope="col">Subtopic tiers</th><th scope="col">Done</th></tr>`;
  m.topics.forEach(no=>{const x=T[no];if(!x)return;h+=`<tr><td><a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)} ${e(x[1].title)}</a></td><td>${e(x[0].id)}</td><td>${fmt(+x[1].hours||0)}</td><td>${ess.has(no)?'★ essential':''}</td><td>${tmix(x[1])}</td><td>${d.has(no)?'✓':''}</td></tr>`;});
  h+='</table>';
  if(m.related&&m.related.length)h+=`<p>Related topics in other modules: ${m.related.map(no=>T[no]?`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)} ${e(T[no][1].title)}</a>`:'').join(' · ')}</p>`;
  return h+'</section>';}
 function subsOf(m,T){return m.topics.flatMap(no=>T[no]?T[no][1].subs:[]);}
 function essentialOf(m,T){const tr=window.FTR?FTR.tierOf:()=>null;const subs=subsOf(m,T);const tiered=subs.length&&subs.every(s=>tr(s.no));
  if(tiered){const f=subs.filter(s=>tr(s.no)==='F');return {mode:'tier',subs:f,mins:f.reduce((a,s)=>a+(+s.base||+s.min||0),0)};}
  return {mode:'topic',topics:m.essential,mins:hrs(m.essential,T)*60};}
 function pathways(){const T=tmap(),d=done();let h=`<section class="wrap fsm"><h1>Learning pathways</h1><p>You do not need to study the whole site, and nothing is removed for any pathway. The Essential pathway follows the <a href="#tiers">Fundamental tier</a>: in modules whose subtopics are tiered it lists the Fundamental subtopics; elsewhere it lists the module's essential topics until tiering is finished.</p>`;
  D.pathways.forEach(pw=>{const ms=D.modules.filter(m=>pw.modules.includes(m.n));
   if(pw.use==='essential'){let tot=0;const rows=ms.map(m=>{const E=essentialOf(m,T);tot+=E.mins;
      const items=E.mode==='tier'?E.subs.map(s=>`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(s.no.split('.').slice(0,2).join('.'))}">${e(s.no)}</a>`).join(', '):E.topics.map(no=>T[no]?`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)}</a>`:'').join(', ');
      return `<li><a href="#m/${m.n}">Module ${m.n}</a> · ${E.mode==='tier'?'<span class="pill st-ok">Fundamental subtopics</span>':'<span class="pill">essential topics · tiering pending</span>'} · about ${fmt(E.mins/60)} h: ${items}</li>`;}).join('');
    h+=`<div class="card fsm-pw"><h2>${e(pw.title)}</h2><p><b>For:</b> ${e(pw.who)}</p><p><b>Contents:</b> ${e(pw.rule)} About ${fmt(tot/60)} hours of lesson time (in-depth reading and practice add more).</p><details><summary>Contents by module</summary><ul>${rows}</ul></details></div>`;return;}
   const list=ms.flatMap(m=>m.topics);const [k,n,p]=prog(list,d);
   h+=`<div class="card fsm-pw"><h2>${e(pw.title)}</h2><p><b>For:</b> ${e(pw.who)}</p><p><b>Contents:</b> ${e(pw.rule)} About ${fmt(hrs(list,T))} hours.</p><p>${bar(p)} ${k}/${n} topics done</p><details><summary>Topic list</summary><ul>${ms.map(m=>`<li><a href="#m/${m.n}">Module ${m.n}</a>: ${m.topics.map(no=>T[no]?`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)}</a>`:'').join(', ')}</li>`).join('')}</ul></details></div>`;});
  return h+'</section>';}
 return {index,module,pathways};})();

  h+=`</table><p><a class="btn primary" href="#pathways">Choose a pathway ▶</a></p><p class="muted">The jamovi toolkit (C1) supports every module and is not counted towards any of them.</p></section>`;return h;}
 function tmix(t){if(!window.FTR)return '';const c={F:0,I:0,X:0};let k=0;t.subs.forEach(s=>{const v=FTR.tierOf(s.no);if(v){c[v]++;k++;}});return k?`${c.F} F · ${c.I} I · ${c.X} X`:'<span class="muted">pending</span>';}
 function module(n){const m=D.modules.find(x=>x.n==n);if(!m)return index();const T=tmap(),d=done(),[k,c,p]=prog(m.topics,d);const ess=new Set(m.essential);
  let h=`<section class="wrap fsm"><p><a href="#modules">◀ All modules</a></p><h1>Module ${m.n}: ${e(m.title)}</h1><p class="muted">Proposal reference: ${e(m.proposal)} · ${e(m.tier)} tier · ${fmt(hrs(m.topics,T))} h in total, ${fmt(hrs(m.essential,T))} h essential</p>`;
  if(m.note)h+=`<div class="statusnote" role="note"><b>Note on the proposal:</b> ${e(m.note)}</div>`;
  h+=`<h2>Learning outcomes</h2><p>When you finish this module, you should be able to:</p><ol>${m.outcomes.map(o=>`<li>${e(o)}</li>`).join('')}</ol>`;
  h+=`<h2>Your progress</h2><p>${bar(p)} ${k} of ${c} topics done ${status(p)}</p><p class="muted">Complete = at least ${Math.round(D.threshold*100)}% of topics marked done.</p><h2>Checks</h2><p>${e(m.checks)}</p>`;
  h+=`<h2>Topics</h2><table class="tbl"><caption class="sr">Topics in this module</caption><tr><th scope="col">Topic</th><th scope="col">Unit</th><th scope="col">Hours</th><th scope="col">Essential</th><th scope="col">Subtopic tiers</th><th scope="col">Done</th></tr>`;
  m.topics.forEach(no=>{const x=T[no];if(!x)return;h+=`<tr><td><a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)} ${e(x[1].title)}</a></td><td>${e(x[0].id)}</td><td>${fmt(+x[1].hours||0)}</td><td>${ess.has(no)?'★ essential':''}</td><td>${tmix(x[1])}</td><td>${d.has(no)?'✓':''}</td></tr>`;});
  h+='</table>';
  if(m.related&&m.related.length)h+=`<p>Related topics in other modules: ${m.related.map(no=>T[no]?`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)} ${e(T[no][1].title)}</a>`:'').join(' · ')}</p>`;
  return h+'</section>';}
 function subsOf(m,T){return m.topics.flatMap(no=>T[no]?T[no][1].subs:[]);}
 function essentialOf(m,T){const tr=window.FTR?FTR.tierOf:()=>null;const subs=subsOf(m,T);const tiered=subs.length&&subs.every(s=>tr(s.no));
  if(tiered){const f=subs.filter(s=>tr(s.no)==='F');return {mode:'tier',subs:f,mins:f.reduce((a,s)=>a+(+s.base||+s.min||0),0)};}
  return {mode:'topic',topics:m.essential,mins:hrs(m.essential,T)*60};}
 function pathways(){const T=tmap(),d=done();let h=`<section class="wrap fsm"><h1>Learning pathways</h1><p>You do not need to study the whole site, and nothing is removed for any pathway. The Essential pathway follows the <a href="#tiers">Fundamental tier</a>: in modules whose subtopics are tiered it lists the Fundamental subtopics; elsewhere it lists the module's essential topics until tiering is finished.</p>`;
  D.pathways.forEach(pw=>{const ms=D.modules.filter(m=>pw.modules.includes(m.n));
   if(pw.use==='essential'){let tot=0;const rows=ms.map(m=>{const E=essentialOf(m,T);tot+=E.mins;
      const items=E.mode==='tier'?E.subs.map(s=>`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(s.no.split('.').slice(0,2).join('.'))}">${e(s.no)}</a>`).join(', '):E.topics.map(no=>T[no]?`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)}</a>`:'').join(', ');
      return `<li><a href="#m/${m.n}">Module ${m.n}</a> · ${E.mode==='tier'?'<span class="pill st-ok">Fundamental subtopics</span>':'<span class="pill">essential topics · tiering pending</span>'} · about ${fmt(E.mins/60)} h: ${items}</li>`;}).join('');
    h+=`<div class="card fsm-pw"><h2>${e(pw.title)}</h2><p><b>For:</b> ${e(pw.who)}</p><p><b>Contents:</b> ${e(pw.rule)} Current estimate about ${fmt(tot/60)} hours; it will settle as tiering is completed.</p><details><summary>Contents by module</summary><ul>${rows}</ul></details></div>`;return;}
   const list=ms.flatMap(m=>m.topics);const [k,n,p]=prog(list,d);
   h+=`<div class="card fsm-pw"><h2>${e(pw.title)}</h2><p><b>For:</b> ${e(pw.who)}</p><p><b>Contents:</b> ${e(pw.rule)} About ${fmt(hrs(list,T))} hours.</p><p>${bar(p)} ${k}/${n} topics done</p><details><summary>Topic list</summary><ul>${ms.map(m=>`<li><a href="#m/${m.n}">Module ${m.n}</a>: ${m.topics.map(no=>T[no]?`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)}</a>`:'').join(', ')}</li>`).join('')}</ul></details></div>`;});
  return h+'</section>';}
 return {index,module,pathways};})();

/* FlippedStat v9.2 module layer (FSM): official TDLEG modules, pathways, completion. */
window.FSM=(function(){
 const D=window.FSM_DATA;
 const e=s=>String(s??'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
 const done=()=>{try{return new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('fs:done'))||[]);}catch(x){return new Set();}};
 const tmap=()=>{const m={};(window.FS?FS.units:[]).forEach(u=>u.topics.forEach(t=>m[t.no]=[u,t]));return m;};
 const hrs=(list,T)=>list.reduce((a,no)=>a+(+(T[no]&&T[no][1].hours)||0),0);
 const fmt=x=>(Math.round(x*4)/4).toString();
 const prog=(list,d)=>{const k=list.filter(no=>d.has(no)).length;return [k,list.length,list.length?k/list.length:0];};
 function bar(p){return `<span class="fsm-bar" role="img" aria-label="${Math.round(p*100)}% complete"><i style="width:${Math.round(p*100)}%"></i></span>`;}
 function status(p){return p>=D.threshold?'<span class="pill st-ok">Complete</span>':(p>0?'<span class="pill">In progress</span>':'<span class="pill">Not started</span>');}
 function index(){const T=tmap(),d=done();
  let h=`<section class="wrap fsm"><h1>Official modules</h1><p>FlippedStat's ${D.modules.length} official modules group all core weeks, electives and clinics into the units reported under the TDLEG project. Each module lists its learning outcomes, essential topics and completion rule.</p><p class="fsm-note">${e(D.completion)}</p>`;
  h+=`<table class="tbl fsm-tab"><caption class="sr">Modules, hours and your progress</caption><tr><th scope="col">Module</th><th scope="col">Tier</th><th scope="col">Topics</th><th scope="col">Hours (all / essential)</th><th scope="col">Your progress</th></tr>`;
  D.modules.forEach(m=>{const [k,n,p]=prog(m.topics,d);h+=`<tr><td><a href="#m/${m.n}">Module ${m.n}: ${e(m.title)}</a></td><td>${e(m.tier)}</td><td>${n}</td><td>${fmt(hrs(m.topics,T))} h / ${fmt(hrs(m.essential,T))} h</td><td>${bar(p)} ${k}/${n} ${status(p)}</td></tr>`;});
  h+=`</table><p><a class="btn primary" href="#pathways">Choose a pathway ▶</a></p><p class="muted">The jamovi toolkit (C1) supports every module and is not counted towards any of them.</p></section>`;return h;}
 function tmix(t){if(!window.FTR)return '';if(!t.subs.length){const v=FTR.topicTier(t.no);return v?({F:'Fundamental',I:'Intermediate',X:'Extension'})[v]+' (topic)':'<span class="muted">pending</span>';}const c={F:0,I:0,X:0};let k=0;t.subs.forEach(s=>{const v=FTR.tierOf(s.no);if(v){c[v]++;k++;}});return k?`${c.F} F · ${c.I} I · ${c.X} X`:'<span class="muted">pending</span>';}
 function module(n){const m=D.modules.find(x=>x.n==n);if(!m)return index();const T=tmap(),d=done(),[k,c,p]=prog(m.topics,d);const ess=new Set(m.essential);
  let h=`<section class="wrap fsm"><p><a href="#modules">◀ All modules</a></p><h1>Module ${m.n}: ${e(m.title)}</h1><p class="muted">Proposal reference: ${e(m.proposal)} · ${e(m.tier)} tier · ${fmt(hrs(m.topics,T))} h in total · Fundamental subtopics ${(()=>{const E=essentialOf(m,T);return E.mode==='tier'?fmt(E.mins/60)+' h':'pending';})()}</p>`;
  if(m.note)h+=`<div class="statusnote" role="note"><b>Note on the proposal:</b> ${e(m.note)}</div>`;

  D.modules.forEach(m=>{const [k,n,p]=prog(m.topics,d);h+=`<tr><td><a href="#m/${m.n}">Module ${m.n}: ${e(m.title)}</a></td><td>${e(m.tier)}</td><td>${n}</td><td>${fmt(hrs(m.topics,T))} h / ${fmt(hrs(m.essential,T))} h</td><td>${bar(p)} ${k}/${n} ${status(p)}</td></tr>`;});
  h+=`</table><p><a class="btn primary" href="#pathways">Choose a pathway ▶</a></p><p class="muted">The jamovi toolkit (C1) supports every module and is not counted towards any of them.</p></section>`;return h;}
 function tmix(t){if(!window.FTR)return '';if(!t.subs.length){const v=FTR.topicTier(t.no);return v?({F:'Fundamental',I:'Intermediate',X:'Extension'})[v]+' (topic)':'<span class="muted">pending</span>';}const c={F:0,I:0,X:0};let k=0;t.subs.forEach(s=>{const v=FTR.tierOf(s.no);if(v){c[v]++;k++;}});return k?`${c.F} F · ${c.I} I · ${c.X} X`:'<span class="muted">pending</span>';}
 function module(n){const m=D.modules.find(x=>x.n==n);if(!m)return index();const T=tmap(),d=done(),[k,c,p]=prog(m.topics,d);const ess=new Set(m.essential);

  if(m.note)h+=`<div class="statusnote" role="note"><b>Note on the proposal:</b> ${e(m.note)}</div>`;
  h+=`<h2>Learning outcomes</h2><p>When you finish this module, you should be able to:</p><ol>${m.outcomes.map(o=>`<li>${e(o)}</li>`).join('')}</ol>`;
  h+=`<h2>Your progress</h2><p>${bar(p)} ${k} of ${c} topics done ${status(p)}</p><p class="muted">Complete = at least ${Math.round(D.threshold*100)}% of topics marked done.</p><h2>Checks</h2><p>${e(m.checks)}</p><p><a class="btn primary" href="#assess/${m.n}/pre">Module pre-assessment (Form A)</a> <a class="btn" href="#assess/${m.n}/post">Module post-assessment (Form B)</a>${m.n==8?' <a class="btn primary" href="#m8kit">Module 8 kit: quiz, survey, lab, AI-use statement</a>':''}</p>`;
  h+=`<h2>Topics</h2><table class="tbl"><caption class="sr">Topics in this module</caption><tr><th scope="col">Topic</th><th scope="col">Unit</th><th scope="col">Hours</th><th scope="col">Essential</th><th scope="col">Subtopic tiers</th><th scope="col">Done</th></tr>`;
  m.topics.forEach(no=>{const x=T[no];if(!x)return;h+=`<tr><td><a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)} ${e(x[1].title)}</a></td><td>${e(x[0].id)}</td><td>${fmt(+x[1].hours||0)}</td><td>${ess.has(no)?'★ essential':''}</td><td>${tmix(x[1])}</td><td>${d.has(no)?'✓':''}</td></tr>`;});
  h+='</table>';
  if(m.related&&m.related.length)h+=`<p>Related topics in other modules: ${m.related.map(no=>T[no]?`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)} ${e(T[no][1].title)}</a>`:'').join(' · ')}</p>`;
  return h+'</section>';}
 function subsOf(m,T){return m.topics.flatMap(no=>T[no]?T[no][1].subs:[]);}
 function essentialOf(m,T){const tr=window.FTR?FTR.tierOf:()=>null;const subs=subsOf(m,T);const tiered=subs.length&&subs.every(s=>tr(s.no));
  if(tiered){const f=subs.filter(s=>tr(s.no)==='F');return {mode:'tier',subs:f,mins:f.reduce((a,s)=>a+(+s.base||+s.min||0),0)};}
  return {mode:'topic',topics:m.essential,mins:hrs(m.essential,T)*60};}
 function pathways(){const T=tmap(),d=done();let h=`<section class="wrap fsm"><h1>Learning pathways</h1><p>You do not need to study the whole site, and nothing is removed for any pathway. The Essential pathway follows the <a href="#tiers">Fundamental tier</a>: in modules whose subtopics are tiered it lists the Fundamental subtopics; elsewhere it lists the module's essential topics until tiering is finished.</p>`;

      const items=E.mode==='tier'?E.subs.map(s=>`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(s.no.split('.').slice(0,2).join('.'))}">${e(s.no)}</a>`).join(', '):E.topics.map(no=>T[no]?`<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(no)}">${e(no)}</a>`:'').join(', ');

  return h+'</section>';}

/* FlippedStat v9.9 placement test (FSP) — Stage 1 S1.3. Data: window.FSP_DATA (content/placement99.py).
   Routes, does not grade. Saved in this browser only (fs:placement). Route: #placement */
(function () {
'use strict';
const D = window.FSP_DATA; if (!D) return;
const KEY = 'fs:placement', e = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
const load = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) || {}; } catch (x) { return {}; } };
const save = o => { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(o)); } catch (x) {} };
const shuffle = a => { const b = a.slice(); for (let i = b.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); [b[i], b[j]] = [b[j], b[i]]; } return b; };
const R = D.rules, MT = D.moduleTitles || {};
function label(dom, s) {
  if (dom === 'Q') return s <= R.readiness_refresher_max ? ['Refresher first', 'st-gap'] : ['Ready', 'st-ok'];
  if (s <= R.start_max) return ['Start here', 'st-gap']; if (s <= R.core_max) return ['Core route', 'st-part']; return ['Ready to move faster', 'st-ok'];
}
function pathway(sc, tot) {
  const P = R.pathway;
  if (sc.Q <= R.readiness_refresher_max || tot <= P.essential_if_total_at_most) return ['essential', 'Essential Statistical Literacy'];
  if (tot >= P.extension_if_total_at_least && P.extension_needs.every(d => sc[d] >= P.extension_domain_min)) return ['extension', 'Intermediate extensions'];
  return ['foundation', 'Foundation Certificate route'];
}
function form() {
  const S = load(); const order = shuffle(D.items.map(i => i.id)); S.order = order; S.opt = {}; save(S);
  const byId = Object.fromEntries(D.items.map(i => [i.id, i]));
  const qs = order.map((id, n) => { const it = byId[id]; const perm = shuffle([0, 1, 2, 3]); S.opt[id] = perm;
    return `<fieldset class="fsp-q"><legend><span class="fsp-n">${n + 1}.</span> ${e(it.stem)}</legend>${perm.map(k => `<label class="fsp-o"><input type="radio" name="${id}" value="${k}"> ${e(it.opts[k])}</label>`).join('')}<label class="fsp-o fsp-skip"><input type="radio" name="${id}" value="-1"> I don’t know yet</label></fieldset>`; }).join('');
  save(S);
  return `<section class="wrap prose fsp"><p><a href="#t/1.1">◀ Topic 1.1 Course map and placement</a> · <a href="#modules">Modules</a></p>
  <h1>Placement test</h1><p class="lead">20 questions, about 15 minutes. It tells you where to start; it does not grade you.</p>
  <div class="statusnote" role="note"><b>Answer on your own — no AI, no notes.</b> The route only fits you if the answers are yours. “I don’t know yet” is a good answer when it is true. Results stay in this browser.</div>
  <form id="fsp-form" novalidate>${qs}<p><button class="btn" type="submit">See my starting route</button></p><p id="fsp-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p></form></section>`;
}
function result(att) {
  const byId = Object.fromEntries(D.items.map(i => [i.id, i])); const sc = {}; D.domains.forEach(d => sc[d.id] = 0);
  const miss = {}; att.ans.forEach(a => { const it = byId[a.id]; if (a.c) sc[it.domain]++; else (miss[it.domain] = miss[it.domain] || []).push(it); });
  const tot = Object.values(sc).reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0); const [pid, ptitle] = pathway(sc, tot);
  const rows = D.domains.map(d => { const [l, cls] = label(d.id, sc[d.id]);
    const mods = d.modules.length ? d.modules.map(m => `<a href="#m/${m}">Module ${m}</a>`).join(', ') : '<a href="#t/1.1">Week 1 refresher</a>';
    const rev = (miss[d.id] || []).map(it => `<a href="#t/${it.topic}">${it.topic}</a>`).filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i).join(' · ') || '—';
    return `<tr><th scope="row">${e(d.title)}</th><td>${sc[d.id]} / 4</td><td><span class="pill ${cls}">${l}</span></td><td>${mods}</td><td>${rev}</td></tr>`; }).join('');
  const fb = att.ans.map((a, n) => { const it = byId[a.id];
    return `<li><b>${a.c ? '✓' : '✗'}</b> ${e(it.stem)}<br><small>Answer: ${e(it.opts[it.key])}. ${e(it.why)}</small></li>`; }).join('');
  return `<section class="wrap prose fsp"><p><a href="#t/1.1">◀ Topic 1.1</a></p><h1>Your starting route</h1>
  <p class="lead">Score ${tot} / 20 · suggested pathway: <a href="#pathways">${e(ptitle)}</a>. Module 8 (responsible AI) is required on every pathway.</p>
  <table class="tbl"><caption class="sr">Placement result by domain</caption><tr><th scope="col">Domain</th><th scope="col">Score</th><th scope="col">Route</th><th scope="col">Modules</th><th scope="col">Revise first</th></tr>${rows}</table>
  <h2>What the routes mean</h2><ul><li><b>Refresher first</b>: work through the percentages, tables and averages refreshers in Week 1 before Module 2.</li>
  <li><b>Start here</b>: begin with the Fundamental-tier subtopics of the module.</li><li><b>Core route</b>: take the whole module in order.</li>
  <li><b>Ready to move faster</b>: you may skip Concept and Practice topics you already know — never the labs or the AI checks. Confirm with the module’s <a href="#assess">pre-assessment</a>: ${Math.round((D.mastery || .8) * 100)}% or more means you can treat those topics as revision.</li></ul>
  <p class="muted">Cut scores are draft (awaiting academic approval). This is advice, not an exemption decision.</p>
  <p><button class="btn" id="fsp-csv">Export my answers (CSV)</button> <button class="btn ghost" id="fsp-retake">Retake</button></p>
  <details><summary>Answers and explanations</summary><ol>${fb}</ol></details></section>`;
}
function bind(m) {
  const f = m.querySelector('#fsp-form');
  if (f) f.onsubmit = ev => { ev.preventDefault(); const S = load(); const ans = [];
    for (const id of S.order) { const v = f.querySelector(`input[name="${id}"]:checked`); if (!v) { const msg = m.querySelector('#fsp-msg'); msg.textContent = 'Please answer every question (choose “I don’t know yet” if needed).'; f.querySelector(`input[name="${id}"]`).focus(); return; }
      const k = +v.value; const it = D.items.find(i => i.id === id); ans.push({ id, k, c: k === it.key ? 1 : 0 }); }
    const att = { t: Date.now(), ans }; S.attempts = (S.attempts || []).concat([att]); save(S); location.hash = '#placement/result'; };
  const c = m.querySelector('#fsp-csv'); if (c) c.onclick = () => { const S = load(); let pid = ''; try { pid = (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('fs:assess')) || {}).pid || ''; } catch (x) {}
    const lines = ['pid,timestamp,item,domain,chosen,correct']; (S.attempts || []).forEach(a => a.ans.forEach(x => lines.push([pid || 'anon', a.t, x.id, x.id.split('-')[1][0], x.k, x.c].join(','))));
    const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([lines.join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv' })); a.download = 'flippedstat_placement.csv'; a.click(); };
  const r = m.querySelector('#fsp-retake'); if (r) r.onclick = () => { location.hash = '#placement/new'; };
}
function render(sub) {
  const m = document.getElementById('main') || document.querySelector('main'); const S = load(); const last = (S.attempts || []).slice(-1)[0];
  m.innerHTML = (sub === 'result' || (!sub && last)) && last ? result(last) : form(); bind(m);
  const h = m.querySelector('h1'); if (h) { h.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); h.focus(); }
}
function topicBanner() {   // invite from Topic 1.1 (1.1.3 names this test); policy link on Topics 1.4 and 8.9
  if (/^#t\/(1\.4|8\.9)$/.test(location.hash)) { const m = document.getElementById('main'); const h = m && m.querySelector('h1');
    if (h && !m.querySelector('.fsp-pol')) { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'statusnote fsp-pol'; d.setAttribute('role', 'note');
      d.innerHTML = '<b>Controlling policy:</b> the CUHK guidelines on AI tools in teaching, learning and assessment, and your course outline. <a class="btn" href="#aipolicy">AI-use rules for FlippedStat</a>'; h.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', d); } return; }
  if (!/^#t\/1\.1$/.test(location.hash)) return; const m = document.getElementById('main') || document.querySelector('main');
  if (!m || m.querySelector('.fsp-banner')) return; const h = m.querySelector('h1'); if (!h) return;
  const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'statusnote fsp-banner'; d.setAttribute('role', 'note');
  d.innerHTML = '<b>20-item placement test (1.1.3):</b> about 15 minutes, no AI. <a class="btn" href="#placement">Take the placement test</a>';
  h.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', d);
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => setTimeout(topicBanner, 60)); window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(topicBanner, 300));
window.FSP = { render, _label: label, _pathway: pathway };
})();
