/* FlippedStat v9.5 assessment layer (FSQ): module pre/post-assessments (Stage 4).
   Data: window.FSQ_DATA (built by tools/build_assess95.py from content/assess95.py).
   Formative on this standalone edition: responses are stored in this browser only. The Moodle XML bank is the official route. */
(function () {
'use strict';
const D = window.FSQ_DATA; if (!D) return;
const KEY = 'fs:assess', e = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
const load = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) || {}; } catch (x) { return {}; } };
const save = o => localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(o));
function state() { const s = load(); if (!s.pid) { s.pid = 'anon-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8); s.attempts = []; save(s); } s.attempts = s.attempts || []; return s; }
const latest = (m, f) => state().attempts.filter(a => a.m == m && a.form === f).sort((a, b) => b.t - a.t)[0];
const pct = x => Math.round(100 * x);
function score(m, form, ans) {
  const ids = D.forms[m][form]; let k = 0; const lo = {};
  ids.forEach(id => { const it = D.items[id], ok = ans[id] === it.key; if (ok) k++; (lo[it.lo] = lo[it.lo] || [0, 0])[1]++; if (ok) lo[it.lo][0]++; });
  return { k, n: ids.length, lo };
}
function routing(m, a) {
  const miss = D.forms[m][a.form].filter(id => a.ans[id] !== D.items[id].key);
  const tps = [...new Set(miss.map(id => D.items[id].topic))];
  return tps.map(t => { const T = (window.FS ? FS.units.flatMap(u => u.topics) : []).find(x => x.no === t); return `<a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(t)}">${e(t)} ${T ? e(T.title) : ''}</a>`; });
}
function loTable(m, a) {
  const s = score(m, a.form, a.ans);
  return `<table class="tbl"><caption class="sr">Result by learning outcome</caption><tr><th scope="col">Learning outcome</th><th scope="col">Correct</th><th scope="col">Status</th></tr>` +
    D.outcomes[m].map((txt, i) => { const r = s.lo[i + 1] || [0, 0]; return `<tr><td>LO${i + 1}. ${e(txt)}</td><td>${r[0]} / ${r[1]}</td><td>${r[1] && r[0] === r[1] ? '<span class="pill st-ok">secure</span>' : '<span class="pill st-gap">revise</span>'}</td></tr>`; }).join('') + '</table>';
}
function index() {
  const S = state();
  let h = `<section class="wrap prose fsq"><h1>Assessments</h1>
  <p class="lead">Practice on this site, then (when the course is deployed) complete the official Moodle versions. Placement, module pre/post checks, and the Module 8 kit are all linked from here.</p>
  <div class="statusnote" role="note"><b>Formative on this site; official record is Moodle.</b> Results here are saved in this browser only, and the answers are part of the page, so they are not assessment evidence. Placement routing is advisory: cut scores await academic approval (human decision H3). Item wording awaits human review. Certificate wording and signatory await approval (H6). Official reportable modules are 1–8; Module 9 on this list is an optional extension and is not approved (H1).</div>
  <p>Start here: <a class="btn primary" href="#placement">20-item placement test</a> <a class="btn" href="#m8kit">Module 8 kit (quiz, survey, lab)</a> <a class="btn" href="#t/1.1">Topic 1.1 course map</a></p>
  <p class="lead">Each official module has a 10-item <b>pre-assessment (Form A)</b> and a parallel <b>post-assessment (Form B)</b>. Three anchor items appear on both forms; the other seven are matched in pairs by learning outcome and level.</p>
  <div class="statusnote" role="note"><b>Formative on this site.</b> Results are saved in this browser only and the answers are part of the page, so they are not assessment evidence. The TDLEG evaluation uses the same items delivered through CUHK Moodle (question bank exported by the project team).</div>
  <p><label>Study code <input id="fsq-pid" value="${e(S.pid)}" size="16" aria-describedby="fsq-pidhelp"></label> <span id="fsq-pidhelp" class="muted">Use the code your instructor gives you, or keep the anonymous one. Do not enter your name or student ID.</span></p>
  <table class="tbl"><caption class="sr">Your assessments by module</caption><tr><th scope="col">Module</th><th scope="col">Pre (Form A)</th><th scope="col">Post (Form B)</th><th scope="col">Gain</th></tr>`;
  Object.keys(D.forms).forEach(m => { const a = latest(m, 'pre'), b = latest(m, 'post'); const sa = a && score(m, 'pre', a.ans), sb = b && score(m, 'post', b.ans);
    h += `<tr><td><a href="#m/${m}">Module ${m}</a>: ${e(D.titles[m])}</td><td>${sa ? `${sa.k}/${sa.n} · <a href="#assess/${m}/pre">review</a>` : `<a class="btn sm" href="#assess/${m}/pre">Start</a>`}</td>
      <td>${sb ? `${sb.k}/${sb.n} · <a href="#assess/${m}/post">review</a>` : (sa ? `<a class="btn sm" href="#assess/${m}/post">Start</a>` : '<span class="muted">after the pre-assessment</span>')}</td>
      <td>${sa && sb ? `${sb.k - sa.k >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(sb.k - sa.k) * 10} points` : '—'}</td></tr>`; });
  h += `</table><p><button type="button" class="btn" id="fsq-csv">⬇ Export my responses (CSV)</button> <button type="button" class="btn ghost" id="fsq-clear">Clear my attempts</button></p>
  <p class="muted">The CSV uses the format read by the project’s analysis scripts (one row per item response). Bank version: ${e(D.version)}.</p></section>`;
  return h;
}
function test(m, form) {
  if (!D.forms[m]) return index();
  const done = latest(m, form);
  if (form === 'post' && !latest(m, 'pre')) return `<section class="wrap prose fsq"><h1>Module ${m} post-assessment</h1><p>Take the <a href="#assess/${m}/pre">pre-assessment</a> first, so your gain can be measured.</p></section>`;
  if (done && !location.hash.endsWith('/retake')) return result(m, form, done);
  const ids = D.forms[m][form];
  return `<section class="wrap prose fsq"><p><a href="#assess">◀ All assessments</a> · <a href="#m/${m}">Module ${m} page</a></p>
  <h1>Module ${m} ${form === 'pre' ? 'pre-assessment (Form A)' : 'post-assessment (Form B)'}</h1><p class="lead">${e(D.titles[m])} · 10 questions · about 10 minutes · no notes, no AI.</p>
  ${form === 'pre' ? '<p>You will see how you did on each learning outcome and which topics to study. Answers are not shown after the pre-assessment, because some questions appear again at the end.</p>' : '<p>After submitting, you will see your gain since the pre-assessment and feedback on every question.</p>'}
  <form id="fsq-form" novalidate>` + ids.map((id, i) => { const it = D.items[id];
    return `<fieldset class="fsq-q"><legend><b>Q${i + 1}.</b> ${e(it.stem)}</legend>` + it.opts.map((o, k) => `<label class="fsq-o"><input type="radio" name="${id}" value="${k}" required> <span>${'ABCD'[k]}. ${e(o)}</span></label>`).join('') + '</fieldset>'; }).join('') +
  `<p id="fsq-msg" class="muted" aria-live="polite"></p><button type="submit" class="btn primary">Submit answers</button></form></section>`;
}
function result(m, form, a) {
  const s = score(m, form, a.ans);
  let h = `<section class="wrap prose fsq"><p><a href="#assess">◀ All assessments</a> · <a href="#m/${m}">Module ${m} page</a></p>
  <h1>Module ${m} ${form === 'pre' ? 'pre-assessment' : 'post-assessment'}: ${s.k} / ${s.n}</h1><div role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>${loTable(m, a)}`;
  const r = routing(m, a);
  if (form === 'pre') {
    h += s.k / s.n >= D.mastery ? `<p><b>Strong start.</b> Study the module at the Fundamental level, check the topics below if any, then take the post-assessment.</p>` : `<p><b>Where to start.</b> Study the module from its first topic. Give extra time to the topics below.</p>`;
    h += r.length ? `<h2>Topics to revise</h2><ul>${r.map(x => `<li>${x}</li>`).join('')}</ul>` : '<p>No topics flagged.</p>';
    h += `<p><a class="btn primary" href="#m/${m}">Go to Module ${m}</a> <a class="btn" href="#assess/${m}/post">Post-assessment (when you have finished)</a></p>`;
  } else {
    const p = latest(m, 'pre'), sp = p && score(m, 'pre', p.ans);
    const anc = id => D.items[id].part === 'anchor';
    const ap = p ? D.forms[m].pre.filter(anc).filter(id => p.ans[id] === D.items[id].key).length : 0, aq = D.forms[m].post.filter(anc).filter(id => a.ans[id] === D.items[id].key).length;
    if (sp) h += `<p><b>Gain:</b> ${sp.k}/10 → ${s.k}/10 (${s.k - sp.k >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(s.k - sp.k) * 10} percentage points${sp.k ? `; ${s.k >= sp.k ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(100 * (s.k - sp.k) / sp.k)}% relative` : ''}). On the three anchor questions that appeared on both forms: ${ap}/3 → ${aq}/3.</p>`;
    h += '<h2>Feedback on every question</h2>' + D.forms[m].post.map((id, i) => { const it = D.items[id], ok = a.ans[id] === it.key;
      return `<div class="fsq-fb ${ok ? 'ok' : 'no'}"><p><b>Q${i + 1}.</b> ${e(it.stem)}</p><p>${ok ? '✓ Correct' : `✗ You chose ${a.ans[id] != null ? 'ABCD'[a.ans[id]] : '—'}`}: the answer is <b>${'ABCD'[it.key]}. ${e(it.opts[it.key])}</b></p><p class="muted">${e(it.why)} Revise <a href="#t/${encodeURIComponent(it.topic)}">${e(it.topic)}</a>.</p></div>`; }).join('');
  }
  h += `<p class="muted">Attempt saved ${new Date(a.t).toLocaleString()}. <a href="#assess/${m}/${form}/retake">Retake</a> (the latest attempt is used).</p></section>`;
  return h;
}
function csv() {
  const S = state(), rows = [['pid', 'module', 'form', 'timestamp', 'item', 'lo', 'level', 'anchor', 'chosen', 'correct']];
  S.attempts.forEach(a => D.forms[a.m][a.form].forEach(id => { const it = D.items[id], c = a.ans[id]; rows.push([S.pid, a.m, a.form, a.t, id, it.lo, it.level, it.part === 'anchor' ? 1 : 0, c != null ? 'ABCD'[c] : '', c === it.key ? 1 : 0]); }));
  const blob = new Blob([rows.map(r => r.join(',')).join('\n') + '\n'], { type: 'text/csv' }); const l = document.createElement('a');
  l.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); l.download = `flippedstat_assessments_${S.pid}.csv`; l.click();
}
function render(p, a) {
  const main = document.getElementById('main'); const parts = (a || '').split('/');
  main.innerHTML = p === 'assess' && parts[0] ? test(parts[0], parts[1] || 'pre') : index();
  const f = main.querySelector('#fsq-form');
  if (f) f.addEventListener('submit', ev => { ev.preventDefault(); const [m, form] = parts; const ans = {}; let missing = 0;
    D.forms[m][form].forEach(id => { const x = f.querySelector(`input[name="${id}"]:checked`); if (x) ans[id] = +x.value; else missing++; });
    if (missing) { main.querySelector('#fsq-msg').textContent = `Please answer all questions (${missing} unanswered).`; return; }
    const S = state(); S.attempts.push({ m, form, t: Date.now(), ans }); save(S); location.hash = `#assess/${m}/${form}`; render('assess', `${m}/${form}`); main.focus && main.focus(); });
  const pid = main.querySelector('#fsq-pid'); if (pid) pid.addEventListener('change', () => { const S = state(); S.pid = pid.value.trim().slice(0, 32) || S.pid; save(S); });
  const c = main.querySelector('#fsq-csv'); if (c) c.addEventListener('click', csv);
  const cl = main.querySelector('#fsq-clear'); if (cl) cl.addEventListener('click', () => { if (confirm('Clear all assessment attempts saved in this browser?')) { const S = state(); S.attempts = []; save(S); render('assess', ''); } });
}
window.FSQ = { render, score, data: D };
})();

FS=json.load(open('FS80.json'))
def get(k):
    return FS['lessons'].get(k) if k.count('.')==2 else FS['content'].get(k)
for arg in sys.argv[1:]:
    k,pat=arg.split('::')
    o=get(k); 
    def walk(x,path):
        if isinstance(x,str):
            for m in re.finditer(pat,x): print(k,path,'…'+x[max(0,m.start()-160):m.end()+220]+'…')
        elif isinstance(x,list):
            for i,y in enumerate(x): walk(y,path+[i])
        elif isinstance(x,dict):
            for a,y in x.items(): walk(y,path+[a])
    walk(o,[])

/* FlippedStat v9.3 time-series layer (FST): E5 widgets and the E5.12 audit lab.
   Data: window.FST_DATA (built by tools/assemble_v93.py from build/e5_data.json). All series synthetic, seeds fixed. */
(function () {
'use strict';
const D = window.FST_DATA; if (!D || !window.FSW || !window.FSPlot) return;
const { W, h, controls, slider, button, select, readout } = window.FSW, { Plot, RNG, S } = window.FSPlot;
const f1 = v => isFinite(v) ? (+v).toFixed(1) : '—', f2 = v => isFinite(v) ? (+v).toFixed(2) : '—', f3 = v => isFinite(v) ? (+v).toFixed(3) : '—';
const mean = a => { const b = a.filter(isFinite); return b.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / b.length; };
const vr = a => { const b = a.filter(isFinite), m = mean(b); return b.reduce((s, v) => s + (v - m) ** 2, 0) / (b.length - 1); };
const SER = { A: { y: D.series.A, start: 2006, name: 'Harbourside demand (GWh)', short: 'demand' }, B: { y: D.series.B, start: 2014, name: 'Rooftop solar (GWh)', short: 'solar' } };
const yr = (s, i) => s.start + i / 12;                       // decimal year for the x axis
const lbl = (s, i) => `${s.start + Math.floor(i / 12)}-${String(i % 12 + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
function rng(a) { const b = a.filter(isFinite); let lo = Math.min(...b), hi = Math.max(...b); const p = (hi - lo) * 0.06 || 1; return [lo - p, hi + p]; }
function plotSeries(host, s, ys, o) {
  const all = ys.flatMap(x => x.v); const [lo, hi] = o && o.y ? o.y : rng(all);
  const p = Plot(host, Object.assign({ xmin: s.start, xmax: s.start + s.y.length / 12, ymin: lo, ymax: hi, xlab: 'year', ylab: (o && o.ylab) || s.name, aria: (o && o.aria) || s.name, xfmt: v => String(Math.round(v)) }, o || {}));
  ys.forEach(x => { let seg = []; x.v.forEach((v, i) => { if (isFinite(v)) seg.push([yr(s, i + (x.off || 0)), v]); else if (seg.length) { p.line(seg, x.cls); seg = []; } }); if (seg.length) p.line(seg, x.cls); });
  return p;
}
function sel(c, label, opts, val, on) { const e = select(c, label, opts, on); e.value = val; return e; }
function legend(host, items) { const d = h('div', { cls: 'fst-leg' }); d.innerHTML = items.map(([c, t]) => `<span><i class="${c}"></i>${t}</span>`).join(''); host.appendChild(d); }
/* ---------- maths: moving averages, classical decomposition (same algorithm as R decompose / statsmodels seasonal_decompose) */
function trailing(y, k) { return y.map((_, i) => i < k - 1 ? NaN : mean(y.slice(i - k + 1, i + 1))); }
function centred(y, k) {
  const out = y.map(() => NaN);
  if (k % 2) { const a = (k - 1) / 2; for (let i = a; i < y.length - a; i++) out[i] = mean(y.slice(i - a, i + a + 1)); return out; }
  const a = k / 2; for (let i = a; i < y.length - a; i++) { let s = (y[i - a] + y[i + a]) / 2; for (let j = i - a + 1; j < i + a; j++) s += y[j]; out[i] = s / k; } return out;
}
function decompose(y, mult) {
  const T = centred(y, 12), det = y.map((v, i) => mult ? v / T[i] : v - T[i]);
  const m = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, j) => mean(det.filter((_, i) => i % 12 === j)));
  const c = mean(m); const sm = m.map(v => mult ? v / c : v - c);
  const Sv = y.map((_, i) => sm[i % 12]), R = y.map((v, i) => mult ? v / (T[i] * Sv[i]) : v - T[i] - Sv[i]);
  const fit = y.map((_, i) => mult ? T[i] * Sv[i] : T[i] + Sv[i]);
  const resid = y.map((v, i) => v - fit[i]);
  return { T, S: Sv, R, sm, fit, r2: 1 - vr(resid) / vr(y) };
}
function ols(x, y) { const ok = x.map((_, i) => isFinite(y[i])); const X = x.filter((_, i) => ok[i]), Y = y.filter((_, i) => ok[i]); const f = S.lm(X, Y); return { a: f.a, b: f.b, r2: f.r2 }; }
function errs(f, a) { let ae = 0, se = 0, pe = 0, n = 0; f.forEach((v, i) => { if (!isFinite(v) || !isFinite(a[i])) return; const e = v - a[i]; ae += Math.abs(e); se += e * e; pe += Math.abs(e) / a[i]; n++; }); return { mae: ae / n, rmse: Math.sqrt(se / n), mape: 100 * pe / n }; }
function forecast(y, H, method) {
  const tr = y.slice(0, y.length - H);
  if (method === 'mean') { const m = mean(tr); return Array(H).fill(m); }
  if (method === 'naive') return Array(H).fill(tr[tr.length - 1]);
  if (method === 'snaive') { const last = tr.slice(-12); return Array.from({ length: H }, (_, i) => last[i % 12]); }
  if (method === 'decomp') { const d = decompose(tr, false); const t = tr.map((_, i) => i); const f = ols(t, d.T); return Array.from({ length: H }, (_, i) => f.a + f.b * (tr.length + i) + d.sm[(tr.length + i) % 12]); }
  if (method === 'sarima') return H === D.N.H ? D.series.sarima_fm.slice() : null;
  return null;
}
const METHODS = [['snaive', 'Seasonal naive (same month last year)'], ['naive', 'Naive (last value)'], ['mean', 'Mean of training months'], ['decomp', 'Decomposition + linear trend'], ['sarima', 'SARIMA (Think Stats settings; 36-month test only)']];
function dlButton(name) { const txt = D.files[name]; const a = h('a', { cls: 'btn sm', download: name, href: 'data:text/plain;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(txt) }, '⬇ ' + name); return a; }

/* ---------- widgets ---------- */

  host.appendChild(t);

};

W.tsdecomp = host => {
  const c = controls(host); let key = 'A', mult = false;
  const box = h('div'); host.appendChild(box); legend(host, [['fst-raw', 'observed'], ['fst-fit', 'trend + season (fitted)'], ['fst-tr', 'trend']]);

    plotSeries(box, s, [{ v: s.y, cls: 'ln fst-raw' }, { v: d.fit, cls: 'ln fst-fit' }, { v: d.T, cls: 'ln fst-tr' }], { aria: 'Observed series with fitted trend plus season' });
    const res = s.y.map((v, i) => v - d.fit[i]); const [lo, hi] = rng(res); const m = Math.max(Math.abs(lo), Math.abs(hi));
    const p2 = plotSeries(box2, s, [{ v: res, cls: 'ln fst-res' }], { y: [-m, m], h: 170, ylab: 'residual (GWh)', aria: 'Residuals over time' }); p2.hline(0, 'vl');
    const firstYr = res.slice(6, 30).filter(isFinite), lastYr = res.slice(-30, -6).filter(isFinite);
    const sdA = Math.sqrt(vr(firstYr)), sdB = Math.sqrt(vr(lastYr));
    r.innerHTML = `${s.name} · <b>${mult ? 'multiplicative' : 'additive'}</b> · R² = <b>${f3(d.r2)}</b> · residual SD first two years ${f1(sdA)} vs last two years ${f1(sdB)} GWh` +
      (sdB > 2 * sdA ? ' — <span class="pill st-gap">residuals grow with the level</span>: the season is not a fixed size; try multiplicative.' : ' — residual size roughly stable.') +
      `<br>Seasonal ${mult ? 'factors (×)' : 'effects (GWh)'}: ${d.sm.map((v, j) => ['J', 'F', 'M', 'A', 'M', 'J', 'J', 'A', 'S', 'O', 'N', 'D'][j] + ' ' + (mult ? f2(v) : f1(v))).join(' · ')}`;
  };
  sel(c, 'series', [['A', 'Harbourside demand'], ['B', 'Rooftop solar']], key, v => { key = v; draw(); });
  sel(c, 'model', [['add', 'additive (T + S + R)'], ['mult', 'multiplicative (T × S × R)']], 'add', v => { mult = v === 'mult'; draw(); });
  draw();
};
function acfv(y, K) { const b = y.filter(isFinite), n = b.length, m = mean(b); const d = b.reduce((s, v) => s + (v - m) ** 2, 0); const out = []; for (let k = 1; k <= K; k++) { let s = 0; for (let t = k; t < n; t++) s += (b[t] - m) * (b[t - k] - m); out.push(s / d); } return { r: out, n }; }
W.tsacf = host => {
  const s = SER.A, c = controls(host); let mode = 'raw';
  const box = h('div'); host.appendChild(box); const r = readout(host);
  const draw = () => {
    let y = s.y; if (mode === 'diff1') y = s.y.map((v, i) => i ? v - s.y[i - 1] : NaN); if (mode === 'diff12') y = s.y.map((v, i) => i >= 12 ? v - s.y[i - 12] : NaN); if (mode === 'resid') y = decompose(s.y, false).R;
    const { r: a, n } = acfv(y, 36), b = 2 / Math.sqrt(n); box.innerHTML = '';
    const p = Plot(box, { xmin: 0, xmax: 37, ymin: -1, ymax: 1, xlab: 'lag (months)', ylab: 'autocorrelation', aria: 'Autocorrelation function bars' });
    a.forEach((v, i) => p.rect(i + 1 - 0.35, i + 1 + 0.35, 0, v, Math.abs(v) > b ? 'bar' : 'bar fst-weak')); p.hline(b, 'vl'); p.hline(-b, 'vl'); p.hline(0, 'axl');
    const over = a.filter(v => Math.abs(v) > b).length;
    r.innerHTML = `n = ${n} · band ±2/√n = ±${f3(b)} · lag 1 r = <b>${f3(a[0])}</b>, lag 6 r = ${f3(a[5])}, lag 12 r = <b>${f3(a[11])}</b> · ${over} of 36 bars outside the band` +
      (mode === 'raw' ? ' — slowly decaying with yearly peaks: trend and season dominate; difference first.' : mode === 'diff12' ?   };

    const cut = arr => arr.map((v, i) => i < show0 ? NaN : v);
    const sn = forecast(s.y, N.H, 'snaive'); const snp = s.y.map((_, i) => i >= n0 ? sn[i - n0] : NaN);
    const p = plotSeries(box, s, [{ v: cut(s.y), cls: 'ln fst-act' }, { v: cut(fit), cls: 'ln fst-fc' }, { v: snp, cls: 'ln fst-sn' }], { xmin: yr(s, show0), aria: 'Audit lab: model line against actual demand' });
    p.vline(yr(s, n0), 'vl'); p.text(yr(s, n0) + 0.1, p.o.ymax - (p.o.ymax - p.o.ymin) * 0.06, 'test months →', 'lbl', 'start');
    const msg = {
      peek: `<b>The AI’s figure.</b> Decomposition run on all ${s.y.length} months (its centred trend used the test months), then scored on the last ${N.H}: MAPE <b>${N.mape_peek}%</b>. The model had already seen these months — H4.`,
      insample: `<b>In-sample fit.</b> The honest model (fitted to ${N.train_end}) scored on its own training months: MAPE ${N.mape_decomp_insample}%. Description, not forecasting.`,
      honest: `<b>Honest holdout.</b> Fitted to ${N.train_end} only, scored on ${N.test_start} onwards: MAPE <b>${N.mape_decomp}%</b>, MAE ${N.mae_decomp} GWh.`,
      base: `<b>Baseline.</b> Repeat the last training year: MAPE <b>${N.mape_snaive}%</b>. The decomposition forecast does not beat it.`
    }[which];
    r.innerHTML = msg;
  };
  button(c, '1 · AI’s number', () => show('peek')); button(c, '2 · In-sample fit', () => show('insample')); button(c, '3 · Honest holdout', () => show('honest')); button(c, '4 · Seasonal naive', () => show('base'));
  show('peek');
}

/* FlippedStat v9.3 time-series layer (FST): E5 widgets and the E5.12 audit lab.
   Data: window.FST_DATA (built by tools/assemble_v93.py from build/e5_data.json). All series synthetic, seeds fixed. */
(function () {
'use strict';
const D = window.FST_DATA; if (!D || !window.FSW || !window.FSPlot) return;
const { W, h, controls, slider, button, select, readout } = window.FSW, { Plot, RNG, S } = window.FSPlot;
const f1 = v => isFinite(v) ? (+v).toFixed(1) : '—', f2 = v => isFinite(v) ? (+v).toFixed(2) : '—', f3 = v => isFinite(v) ? (+v).toFixed(3) : '—';
const mean = a => { const b = a.filter(isFinite); return b.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / b.length; };
const vr = a => { const b = a.filter(isFinite), m = mean(b); return b.reduce((s, v) => s + (v - m) ** 2, 0) / (b.length - 1); };
const SER = { A: { y: D.series.A, start: 2006, name: 'Harbourside demand (GWh)', short: 'demand' }, B: { y: D.series.B, start: 2014, name: 'Rooftop solar (GWh)', short: 'solar' } };
const yr = (s, i) => s.start + i / 12;                       // decimal year for the x axis
const lbl = (s, i) => `${s.start + Math.floor(i / 12)}-${String(i % 12 + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
function rng(a) { const b = a.filter(isFinite); let lo = Math.min(...b), hi = Math.max(...b); const p = (hi - lo) * 0.06 || 1; return [lo - p, hi + p]; }
function plotSeries(host, s, ys, o) {
  const all = ys.flatMap(x => x.v); const [lo, hi] = o && o.y ? o.y : rng(all);
  const p = Plot(host, Object.assign({ xmin: s.start, xmax: s.start + s.y.length / 12, ymin: lo, ymax: hi, xlab: 'year', ylab: (o && o.ylab) || s.name, aria: (o && o.aria) || s.name, xfmt: v => String(Math.round(v)) }, o || {}));
  ys.forEach(x => { let seg = []; x.v.forEach((v, i) => { if (isFinite(v)) seg.push([yr(s, i + (x.off || 0)), v]); else if (seg.length) { p.line(seg, x.cls); seg = []; } }); if (seg.length) p.line(seg, x.cls); });
  return p;
}
function sel(c, label, opts, val, on) { const e = select(c, label, opts, on); e.value = val; return e; }
function legend(host, items) { const d = h('div', { cls: 'fst-leg' }); d.innerHTML = items.map(([c, t]) => `<span><i class="${c}"></i>${t}</span>`).join(''); host.appendChild(d); }
/* ---------- maths: moving averages, classical decomposition (same algorithm as R decompose / statsmodels seasonal_decompose) */
function trailing(y, k) { return y.map((_, i) => i < k - 1 ? NaN : mean(y.slice(i - k + 1, i + 1))); }
function centred(y, k) {
  const out = y.map(() => NaN);
  if (k % 2) { const a = (k - 1) / 2; for (let i = a; i < y.length - a; i++) out[i] = mean(y.slice(i - a, i + a + 1)); return out; }
  const a = k / 2; for (let i = a; i < y.length - a; i++) { let s = (y[i - a] + y[i + a]) / 2; for (let j = i - a + 1; j < i + a; j++) s += y[j]; out[i] = s / k; } return out;
}
function decompose(y, mult) {
  const T = centred(y, 12), det = y.map((v, i) => mult ? v / T[i] : v - T[i]);
  const m = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, j) => mean(det.filter((_, i) => i % 12 === j)));
  const c = mean(m); const sm = m.map(v => mult ? v / c : v - c);
  const Sv = y.map((_, i) => sm[i % 12]), R = y.map((v, i) => mult ? v / (T[i] * Sv[i]) : v - T[i] - Sv[i]);
  const fit = y.map((_, i) => mult ? T[i] * Sv[i] : T[i] + Sv[i]);
  const resid = y.map((v, i) => v - fit[i]);
  return { T, S: Sv, R, sm, fit, r2: 1 - vr(resid) / vr(y) };
}
function ols(x, y) { const ok = x.map((_, i) => isFinite(y[i])); const X = x.filter((_, i) => ok[i]), Y = y.filter((_, i) => ok[i]); const f = S.lm(X, Y); return { a: f.a, b: f.b, r2: f.r2 }; }
function errs(f, a) { let ae = 0, se = 0, pe = 0, n = 0; f.forEach((v, i) => { if (!isFinite(v) || !isFinite(a[i])) return; const e = v - a[i]; ae += Math.abs(e); se += e * e; pe += Math.abs(e) / a[i]; n++; }); return { mae: ae / n, rmse: Math.sqrt(se / n), mape: 100 * pe / n }; }
function forecast(y, H, method) {
  const tr = y.slice(0, y.length - H);
  if (method === 'mean') { const m = mean(tr); return Array(H).fill(m); }
  if (method === 'naive') return Array(H).fill(tr[tr.length - 1]);
  if (method === 'snaive') { const last = tr.slice(-12); return Array.from({ length: H }, (_, i) => last[i % 12]); }
  if (method === 'decomp') { const d = decompose(tr, false); const t = tr.map((_, i) => i); const f = ols(t, d.T); return Array.from({ length: H }, (_, i) => f.a + f.b * (tr.length + i) + d.sm[(tr.length + i) % 12]); }
  if (method === 'sarima') return H === D.N.H ? D.series.sarima_fm.slice() : null;
  return null;
}
const METHODS = [['snaive', 'Seasonal naive (same month last year)'], ['naive', 'Naive (last value)'], ['mean', 'Mean of training months'], ['decomp', 'Decomposition + linear trend'], ['sarima', 'SARIMA (Think Stats settings; 36-month test only)']];
function dlButton(name) { const txt = D.files[name]; const a = h('a', { cls: 'btn sm', download: name, href: 'data:text/plain;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(txt) }, '⬇ ' + name); return a; }

/* ---------- widgets ---------- */

  host.appendChild(t);

  const r = readout(host); r.innerHTML = `${s.y.length} months, ${lbl(s, 0)} to ${lbl(s, s.y.length - 1)}. Min ${Math.min(...s.y)} GWh, max ${Math.max(...s.y)} GWh. <i>All four files are synthetic; the codebook states how each was generated.</i>`;
};

      `<br>Seasonal ${mult ? 'factors (×)' : 'effects (GWh)'}: ${d.sm.map((v, j) => ['J', 'F', 'M', 'A', 'M', 'J', 'J', 'A', 'S', 'O', 'N', 'D'][j] + ' ' + (mult ? f2(v) : f1(v))).join(' · ')}`;

function acfv(y, K) { const b = y.filter(isFinite), n = b.length, m = mean(b); const d = b.reduce((s, v) => s + (v - m) ** 2, 0); const out = []; for (let k = 1; k <= K; k++) { let s = 0; for (let t = k; t < n; t++) s += (b[t] - m) * (b[t - k] - m); out.push(s / d); } return { r: out, n }; }
W.tsacf = host => {
  const s = SER.A, c = controls(host); let mode = 'raw';

    const { r: a, n } = acfv(y, 36), b = 2 / Math.sqrt(n); box.innerHTML = '';

  };
  sel(c, 'series', [['raw', 'raw demand'], ['diff1', 'month-to-month difference'], ['diff12', 'year-over-year difference'], ['resid', 'decomposition residual']], mode, v => { mode = v; draw(); });

    const p = plotSeries(box, s, [{ v: cut(s.y.map((v, i) => i < n0 ? v : NaN)), cls: 'ln fst-raw' }, { v: pad(act, n0), cls: 'ln fst-act' }, { v: pad(sn, n0), cls: 'ln fst-sn' }, { v: pad(f, n0), cls: 'ln fst-fc' }],
      { xmin: yr(s, show0), aria: 'Forecast against held-back months' });
    if (m === 'sarima' && H === D.N.H) { for (let i = 0; i < H; i++) p.seg(yr(s, n0 + i), D.series.sarima_lo[i], yr(s, n0 + i), D.series.sarima_hi[i], 'seg fst-ci'); }
    p.vline(yr(s, n0), 'vl');
    const e = errs(f, act), eb = errs(sn, act);
    r.innerHTML = `Train to ${lbl(s, n0 - 1)} · test ${H} months · <b>${METHODS.find(x => x[0] === m)[1]}</b>: MAE ${f1(e.mae)} GWh · RMSE ${f1(e.rmse)} · MAPE <b>${f2(e.mape)}%</b>` +
      (m === 'snaive' ? '' : ` · seasonal naive MAPE ${f2(eb.mape)}% → ${e.mape < eb.mape ? '<span class="pill st-ok">beats the baseline</span>' : '<span class="pill st-gap">does not beat the baseline</span>'}`) + note +
      (m === 'sarima' && H === D.N.H ? ` · grey bars: 95% interval (${D.N.cover95}/${H} months covered)` : '');
  };
  sel(c, 'method', METHODS, m, v => { m = v; draw(); });
  sel(c, 'test months', [['12', '12'], ['24', '24'], ['36', '36'], ['48', '48']], String(H), v => { H = +v; draw(); });
  draw();
};
W.tsspur = host => {
  const c = controls(host); let seed = 99;
  const box = h('div'); host.appendChild(box); legend(host, [['fst-raw', 'walk 1'], ['fst-fc', 'walk 2']]); const r = readout(host);
  const walk = (g, n) => { const a = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) a.push(a[i - 1] + g.norm()); return a; };
  const draw = () => {
    const g = RNG(seed * 7919 + 1), a = walk(g, 200), b = walk(g, 200); box.innerHTML = '';
    const lo = Math.min(...a, ...b) - 1, hi = Math.max(...a, ...b) + 1;
    const p = Plot(box, { xmin: 0, xmax: 200, ymin: lo, ymax: hi, xlab: 'time', ylab: 'value', aria: 'Two independent random walks' });
    p.line(a.map((v, i) => [i, v]), 'ln fst-raw'); p.line(b.map((v, i) => [i, v]), 'ln fst-fc');
    const da = a.slice(1).map((v, i) => v - a[i]), db = b.slice(1).map((v, i) => v - b[i]);
    r.innerHTML = `Seed ${seed}: correlation of the levels r = <b>${f3(S.cor(a, b))}</b>; of the step-to-step changes r = <b>${f3(S.cor(da, db))}</b>. The walks were generated independently.`;
  };
  slider(c, 'seed', 1, 200, 1, seed, v => { seed = v; draw(); });
  button(c, 'Simulate 500 pairs', () => { let k = 0; const g = RNG(seed * 31 + 5); for (let j = 0; j < 500; j++) { const a = walk(g, 200), b = walk(g, 200); if (Math.abs(S.cor(a, b)) > 0.5) k++; } r.innerHTML += `<br>500 independent pairs: <b>${(k / 5).toFixed(1)}%</b> have |r| &gt; 0.5 (build check with 1,000 pairs: ${D.N.spur_share05}%).`; });
  draw();
};
W.tsroll = host => {
  const R = D.N.roll, c = controls(host); let k = 4;
  const box = h('div'); host.appendChild(box); legend(host, [['fst-sn', 'seasonal naive'], ['fst-fc', 'SARIMA(1,0,0)(0,1,1)₁₂']]); const r = readout(host);
  const draw = () => {
    box.innerHTML = ''; const mx = Math.max(...R.map(x => Math.max(x.sarima, x.snaive))) * 1.15;
    const p = Plot(box, { xmin: -0.5, xmax: R.length - 0.5, ymin: 0, ymax: mx, xlab: 'forecast origin', ylab: '12-month MAPE (%)', xcat: R.map((_, i) => i), xfmt: i => R[Math.round(i)] ? R[Math.round(i)].origin.slice(2) : '', aria: 'MAPE by forecast origin' });
    R.forEach((x, i) => { p.rect(i - 0.38, i - 0.02, 0, x.snaive, 'bar fst-snb' + (i === k ? ' fst-on' : '')); p.rect(i + 0.02, i + 0.38, 0, x.sarima, 'bar fst-fcb' + (i === k ? ' fst-on' : '')); });
    const x = R[k];
    r.innerHTML = `Origin <b>${x.origin}</b>: fit on data to ${x.origin}, forecast the next 12 months. SARIMA ${x.sarima}% vs seasonal naive ${x.snaive}% → ${x.sarima < x.snaive ? 'SARIMA better' : 'baseline better'}. Over ${R.length} origins: SARIMA mean ${D.N.roll_sarima_mean}%, seasonal naive ${D.N.roll_snaive_mean}%; SARIMA better at ${D.N.roll_sarima_wins} of ${R.length}.` +
      (/2019-12|2019-06/.test(x.origin) ? ' <span class="pill st-gap">This window contains the 2020 shock</span>.' : '');
  };
  slider(c, 'origin', 0, R.length - 1, 1, k, v => { k = v; draw(); });
  draw();
};

function lab(host) {
  const s = SER.A, N = D.N, n0 = s.y.length - N.H;
  host.appendChild(dlButton('harbourside_demand.csv'));
  const c = controls(host); const box = h('div'); host.appendChild(box);
  legend(host, [['fst-act', 'actual'], ['fst-fc', 'model line'], ['fst-sn', 'seasonal naive']]); const r = readout(host);
  const show = (which) => {
    box.innerHTML = ''; const fit = which === 'peek' ? D.series.peek : D.series.fitD; const show0 = n0 - 72;
    const cut = arr => arr.map((v, i) => i < show0 ? NaN : v);
    const sn = forecast(s.y, N.H, 'snaive'); const snp = s.y.map((_, i) => i >= n0 ? sn[i - n0] : NaN);
    const p = plotSeries(box, s, [{ v: cut(s.y), cls: 'ln fst-act' }, { v: cut(fit), cls: 'ln fst-fc' }, { v: snp, cls: 'ln fst-sn' }], { xmin: yr(s, show0), aria: 'Audit lab: model line against actual demand' });
    p.vline(yr(s, n0), 'vl'); p.text(yr(s, n0) + 0.1, p.o.ymax - (p.o.ymax - p.o.ymin) * 0.06, 'test months →', 'lbl', 'start');
    const msg = {
      peek: `<b>The AI’s figure.</b> Decomposition run on all ${s.y.length} months (its centred trend used the test months), then scored on the last ${N.H}: MAPE <b>${N.mape_peek}%</b>. The model had already seen these months — H4.`,
      insample: `<b>In-sample fit.</b> The honest model (fitted to ${N.train_end}) scored on its own training months: MAPE ${N.mape_decomp_insample}%. Description, not forecasting.`,
      honest: `<b>Honest holdout.</b> Fitted to ${N.train_end} only, scored on ${N.test_start} onwards: MAPE <b>${N.mape_decomp}%</b>, MAE ${N.mae_decomp} GWh.`,
      base: `<b>Baseline.</b> Repeat the last training year: MAPE <b>${N.mape_snaive}%</b>. The decomposition forecast does not beat it.`
    }[which];
    r.innerHTML = msg;
  };
  button(c, '1 · AI’s number', () => show('peek')); button(c, '2 · In-sample fit', () => show('insample')); button(c, '3 · Honest holdout', () => show('honest')); button(c, '4 · Seasonal naive', () => show('base'));
  show('peek');
}
window.FST = { lab, decompose, forecast, errs };
})();

========== FILE: ws/tools/fswebr.js ==========

/* FlippedStat v10.1-dev — FSWEBR: optional in-browser R (WebR).
   Loads from webr.r-wasm.org only on first Run or “Load WebR”.
   Course content does not require the network. */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const WEBR_BASE = 'https://webr.r-wasm.org/latest/';
  const WEBR_MOD = WEBR_BASE + 'webr.mjs';
  const BASE_PKGS = new Set([
    'base', 'stats', 'utils', 'graphics', 'grDevices', 'datasets',
    'methods', 'tools', 'grid', 'splines', 'stats4', 'parallel',
    'compiler', 'webr'
  ]);
  const PKG_NAME = /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9.]*$/;
  const MISSING_FILE_RE = /cannot open (the )?(connection|file)|No such file|does not exist|cannot find the file/i;

  const S = {
    state: 'idle',
    label: '▶ R: idle',
    webr: null,
    pkgs: new Set(),
    filesMounted: false,
    queue: Promise.resolve(),
    busy: 0,
    version: ''
  };

  function $(sel, root) { return (root || document).querySelector(sel); }
  function $$(sel, root) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((root || document).querySelectorAll(sel)); }

  function h(tag, attrs) {
    const el = document.createElement(tag);
    if (attrs) {
      Object.keys(attrs).forEach(function (k) {
        const v = attrs[k];
        if (k === 'html') el.innerHTML = v;
        else if (k === 'class') el.className = v;
        else if (k.slice(0, 2) === 'on' && typeof v === 'function') el.addEventListener(k.slice(2), v);
        else if (v === false || v == null) { /* skip */ }
        else if (v === true) el.setAttribute(k, '');
        else el.setAttribute(k, v);
      });
    }
    for (let i = 2; i < arguments.length; i++) {
      const k = arguments[i];
      if (k == null || k === false) continue;
      el.appendChild(k.nodeType ? k : document.createTextNode(k));
    }
    return el;
  }

  function setStatus(state, label) {
    S.state = state;
    S.label = label;
    const b = $('#fswebr-btn');
    if (b) {
      b.className = 'fswebr-btn ' + state;
      b.textContent = label;
    }
    const live = $('#fswebr-status');
    if (live) live.textContent = label;
  }

  async function mountFiles(w) {
    const data = window.FSWEBR_DATA || {};
    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    const names = Object.keys(data);
    for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
      const name = names[i];
      const bytes = enc.encode(data[name]);
      try { await w.FS.writeFile(name, bytes); } catch (e) { /* cwd may vary */ }
      try { await w.FS.writeFile('/home/web_user/' + name, bytes); } catch (e) { /* optional */ }
    }
    try { await w.evalRVoid('if (dir.exists("/home/web_user")) setwd("/home/web_user")'); } catch (e) { /* keep default cwd */ }
    S.filesMounted = true;
  }

  async function initWebR() {
    if (S.webr) return S.webr;
    setStatus('downloading', 'R: downloading…');
    let mod;
    try {
      mod = await import(WEBR_MOD);
    } catch (e) {
      setStatus('error', 'R ✘ error');
      throw new Error('Could not download WebR (it needs an internet connection on the first run). Course pages still work offline.');
    }
    const opts = { baseUrl: WEBR_BASE };
    if (!window.crossOriginIsolated && mod.ChannelType) {
      opts.channelType = mod.ChannelType.PostMessage;
    }
    const w = new mod.WebR(opts);
    await w.init();
    await w.evalRVoid('options(width = 100, warn = 1); View <- function(x, title) { print(utils::head(x, 20)); invisible(x) }');
    await mountFiles(w);
    try {
      S.version = await w.evalRString('paste0("R ", R.version$major, ".", R.version$minor)');
    } catch (e) {
      S.version = 'WebR';
    }
    S.webr = w;
    setStatus('ready', '▶ R: ready');
    return w;
  }

  function neededPkgs(code) {
    const need = new Set();
    let m;
    const re1 = /\b(?:library|require|requireNamespace)\(\s*["']?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9.]*)/g;
    const re2 = /\b([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9.]*)::/g;
    while ((m = re1.exec(code))) need.add(m[1]);
    while ((m = re2.exec(code))) need.add(m[1]);
    return Array.from(need).filter(function (p) {
      return PKG_NAME.test(p) && !BASE_PKGS.has(p) && !S.pkgs.has(p);
    });
  }

  async function ensurePkgs(w, code) {
    const todo = neededPkgs(code);
    const failed = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < todo.length; i++) {
      const p = todo[i];
      setStatus('installing', 'R: installing ' + p + '…');
      try {
        await w.installPackages([p], { quiet: true });
        const ok = await w.evalRBoolean('nzchar(system.file(package = "' + p + '"))');
        if (ok) S.pkgs.add(p);
        else failed.push(p);
      } catch (e) {
        failed.push(p);
      }
    }
    setStatus('ready', '▶ R: ready');
    return failed;
  }

  function mentionedFiles(code, text) {
    const found = [];
    const re = /(?:read\.csv|read\.table|read\.delim|readRDS|load)\(\s*["']([^"']+)["']/g;
    let m;
    while ((m = re.exec(code || ''))) found.push(m[1]);
    const re2 = /['"]([^'"]+\.(?:csv|txt|dat|rds|rda))['"]/gi;
    while ((m = re2.exec(text || ''))) found.push(m[1]);
    const seen = {};
    return found.filter(function (n) {
      if (seen[n]) return false;
      seen[n] = true;
      return true;
    });
  }

  function missingFileNote(text, code) {
    if (!MISSING_FILE_RE.test(text || '')) return '';
    const names = mentionedFiles(code, text);
    const who = names.length ? names.join(', ') : 'This file';
    return '\n[WebR] ' + who + ' is not in the live engine. The printed expected line on this card is the reference.';
  }

  async function webrRun(code) {
    const w = await initWebR();
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const failed = await ensurePkgs(w, code);
    const sh = await new w.Shelter();
    let text = '', status = 'ok', images = [];
    if (failed.length) {
      text += '[WebR] package(s) not available in WebR: ' + failed.join(', ') + '.\n';
    }
    try {
      const r = await sh.captureR(code, {
        withAutoprint: true,
        captureStreams: true,
        captureConditions: false,
        captureGraphics: { width: 1000, height: 620 }
      });
      text += r.output.map(function (o) { return o.data; }).join('\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
      const imgs = r.images || [];
      for (let i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
        const bmp = imgs[i];
        const c = document.createElement('canvas');
        c.width = bmp.width;
        c.height = bmp.height;
        c.getContext('2d').drawImage(bmp, 0, 0);
        images.push(c.toDataURL('image/png'));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      status = 'error';
      text += 'Error: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)) + '\n';
    } finally {
      try { await sh.purge(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
    const note = missingFileNote(text, code);
    if (note) {
      text += note;
      if (status === 'ok') status = 'error';
    }
    return { status: status, text: text, images: images, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) };
  }

  function runR(code) {
    const job = S.queue.then(function () { return webrRun(code); });
    S.queue = job.catch(function () { /* keep the queue alive */ });
    return job;
  }

  async function resetSession() {
    if (!S.webr) return;
    await S.webr.evalRVoid('rm(list = ls(envir = globalenv(), all.names = TRUE), envir = globalenv())');
    S.filesMounted = false;
    await mountFiles(S.webr);
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
  }

  function fmtOut(text) {
    return text.split('\n').map(function (l) {
      const c = /^(Error|Fehler)/.test(l) ? 'e'
        : /^(Warning|Warnung)/.test(l) ? 'w'
        : /^(Loading|Attaching|──|\[WebR\])/.test(l) ? 'm' : '';
      return c ? '<span class="fswebr-o' + c + '">' + esc(l) + '</span>' : esc(l);
    }).join('\n');
  }

  function showOut(host, res, err) {
    let o = host.querySelector(':scope > .fswebr-out');
    if (!o) {
      o = h('div', { class: 'fswebr-out', 'aria-live': 'polite' });
      host.appendChild(o);
    }
    o.hidden = false;
    o.innerHTML = '';
    const bad = err || (res && res.status === 'error');
    const head = h('div', { class: 'fswebr-outhead' + (bad ? ' bad' : ' good') },
      h('span', null, bad ? '✘ error' : ('✔ done' + (res && res.ms != null ? ' · ' + res.ms + ' ms' : ''))),
      h('button', { type: 'button', class: 'fswebr-hide', 'aria-label': 'Hide output', onclick: function () { o.hidden = true; } }, 'Hide')
    );
    o.appendChild(head);
    const txt = err ? err : ((res && res.text) || '').replace(/\s+$/, '');
    if (txt) o.appendChild(h('pre', { class: 'fswebr-outtxt', html: fmtOut(txt) }));
    else if (!(res && res.images && res.images.length)) o.appendChild(h('p', { class: 'fswebr-empty' }, '(no printed output)'));
    const imgs = (res && res.images) || [];
    for (let i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
      o.appendChild(h('img', { class: 'fswebr-plot', src: imgs[i], alt: 'Plot ' + (i + 1) + ' produced by the R code' }));
    }
  }

  function cellCode(cell) {
    const el = cell.querySelector('code.fswebr-edit') || cell.querySelector('pre > code');
    return (el ? el.innerText : '').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ');
  }

  async function runCell(cell) {
    const btn = cell.querySelector('.fswebr-run');
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '… running'; }
    S.busy++;
    try {
      const r = await runR(cellCode(cell));
      showOut(cell, r);
      return r.status !== 'error';
    } catch (e) {
      showOut(cell, null, e.message || String(e));
      if (/Could not download WebR/.test(e.message || '')) setStatus('error', 'R ✘ error');
      return false;
    } finally {
      S.busy--;
      if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '▶ Run'; }
    }
  }

  function pageCells() {
    return $$('#main [data-fswebr="1"]');
  }

  async function runToHere(cell) {
    const all = pageCells();
    const end = all.indexOf(cell);
    if (end < 0) return runCell(cell);
    const upto = all.slice(0, end + 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < upto.length; i++) {
      const d = upto[i];
      const c = cellCode(d);
      if (/install\.packages\s*\(/.test(c) && d !== cell) continue;
      const ok = await runCell(d);
      if (ok === false) break;
    }
  }

  function decorateHost(host, code) {
    if (!host || !code || host.getAttribute('data-fswebr') === '1') return;
    host.setAttribute('data-fswebr', '1');
    const orig = code.textContent;
    try {
      code.contentEditable = 'plaintext-only';
      if (code.contentEditable !== 'plaintext-only') code.contentEditable = 'true';
    } catch (e) {
      code.contentEditable = 'true';
    }
    code.spellcheck = false;
    code.classList.add('fswebr-edit');
    code.setAttribute('role', 'textbox');
    code.setAttribute('aria-multiline', 'true');
    code.setAttribute('aria-label', 'R code (editable). Press Ctrl+Enter or Shift+Enter to run.');
    const reset = h('button', {
      type: 'button',
      class: 'fswebr-restore',
      hidden: true,
      title: 'Restore the original code',
      'aria-label': 'Restore the original code',
      onclick: function () { code.textContent = orig; reset.hidden = true; }
    }, '↺ Original');
    code.addEventListener('input', function () { reset.hidden = code.textContent === orig; });
    code.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey) && e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        runCell(host);
      }
    });
    const run = h('button', {
      type: 'button',
      class: 'fswebr-run',
      title: 'Run this code in the browser (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter inside the code)',
      'aria-label': 'Run this R code in the browser',
      onclick: function () { runCell(host); }
    }, '▶ Run');
    const upto = h('button', {
      type: 'button',
      class: 'fswebr-upto',
      title: 'Run every live R block above on this page, then this one — for code that depends on earlier steps',
      'aria-label': 'Run every live R block on this page up to here',
      onclick: function () { runToHere(host); }
    }, '▶▶ Run to here');
    const bar = h('div', { class: 'fswebr-bar' }, run, upto, reset);
    const b = host.querySelector(':scope > b, :scope > summary');
    if (b && b.nextSibling) host.insertBefore(bar, b.nextSibling);
    else host.insertBefore(bar, host.firstChild);
  }

  function decorateRCall(card) {
    const blocks = $$(':scope > div', card);
    for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
      const d = blocks[i];
      const b = d.querySelector('b');
      if (b && /^\s*R call\s*$/i.test(b.textContent)) {
        const code = d.querySelector('pre > code');
        if (code) decorateHost(d, code);
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  function decorateCodeprompt(details) {
    const sum = details.querySelector('summary');
    const label = (sum && sum.textContent) || '';
    if (/Python/i.test(label)) return;
    if (!/Optional reference\s*·\s*R\b/i.test(label)) return;
    const code = details.querySelector('pre > code');
    if (code) decorateHost(details, code);
  }

  function scan() {
    const main = $('#main');
    if (!main) return;
    $$('.fsr-r', main).forEach(decorateRCall);
    $$('details.fsc-ref', main).forEach(decorateCodeprompt);
  }

  function openPanel() {
    const old = $('#fswebr-panel');
    if (old) old.remove();
    const err = h('div', { class: 'fswebr-err', 'aria-live': 'polite' });
    const st = h('div', { id: 'fswebr-status', class: 'fswebr-live', 'aria-live': 'polite' }, S.label);
    const p = h('div', { id: 'fswebr-panel', class: 'fswebr-panel', role: 'dialog', 'aria-label': 'Live R (WebR) settings' },
      h('div', { class: 'fswebr-phead' },
        h('b', null, 'Live R in this browser'),
        h('button', { type: 'button', class: 'fswebr-x', 'aria-label': 'Close', onclick: function () { p.remove(); } }, '✕')
      ),
      h('p', { class: 'fswebr-note' },
        'WebR is R compiled to WebAssembly (',
        h('a', { href: 'https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }, 'docs.r-wasm.org'),
        ' / webr.r-wasm.org). It runs in this tab. The first load needs internet (about 30 MB from webr.r-wasm.org, plus any packages). Course pages still open from disk with no network — this engine is optional, and it is the Recompute check, not a new official module.'
      ),
      st, err,
      h('div', { class: 'fswebr-pactions' },
        h('button', {
          type: 'button',
          class: 'fswebr-load',
          'aria-label': 'Load WebR now',
          onclick: async function () {
            err.textContent = '';
            try { await initWebR(); } catch (e) { err.textContent = e.message; setStatus('error', 'R ✘ error'); }
          }
        }, 'Load WebR now'),
        h('button', {
          type: 'button',
          class: 'fswebr-reset',
          'aria-label': 'Reset the R session',
          onclick: async function () {
            err.textContent = 'Resetting R…';
            try {
              await resetSession();
              err.textContent = 'Session reset: objects in the workspace were cleared. Bundled data files were remounted.';
            } catch (e) { err.textContent = e.message; }
          }
        }, 'Reset session'),
        h('button', { type: 'button', class: 'fswebr-x', onclick: function () { p.remove(); } }, 'Close')
      )
    );
    document.body.appendChild(p);
  }

  function injectHeader() {
    const top = $('header.top');
    if (!top || $('#fswebr-btn')) return;
    const contrast = $('#contrast');
    const btn = h('button', {
      id: 'fswebr-btn',
      type: 'button',
      class: 'fswebr-btn idle',
      title: 'Live R engine (WebR). Loads on first Run, or click for options.',
      'aria-label': 'Live R engine (WebR). Loads on first run.',
      onclick: function () { openPanel(); }
    }, '▶ R: idle');
    if (contrast) top.insertBefore(btn, contrast);
    else top.appendChild(btn);
    setStatus('idle', '▶ R: idle');
  }

  function init() {
    injectHeader();
    const main = $('#main');
    if (main) {
      new MutationObserver(function () {
        cancelAnimationFrame(init._t);
        init._t = requestAnimationFrame(scan);
      }).observe(main, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', function () { setTimeout(scan, 0); });
    scan();
  }

  window.FSWEBR = {
    init: init,
    scan: scan,
    initWebR: initWebR,
    runR: runR,
    resetSession: resetSession,
    state: function () { return S.state; }
  };

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();

========== END FILE: ws/tools/fswebr.js ==========

========== FILE: ws/tools/fsx.js ==========

/* FlippedStat v9.8 accessibility layer (FSX) — Stage 7, WCAG 2.2 AA remediation applied to dynamically rendered content.
   1 Interactive Plotly figures: role="img" → role="figure" (an image may not contain the chart's buttons and sliders).
   2 Form controls with no accessible name get one from their table headers, nearby label text or the widget title.
   3 MathJax blocks that scroll horizontally become keyboard-focusable; others stop being scroll regions.
   4 Links or buttons inside a <summary> are moved just after it (nested interactive controls).
   5 Focus is moved to the new page heading after a route change, so screen-reader users hear where they are. */
(function () {
'use strict';
const txt = el => (el ? (el.innerText || el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : '');
function nameOf(el) {
  if (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || el.closest('label') || (el.id && document.querySelector(`label[for="${CSS.escape(el.id)}"]`))) return null;
  const td = el.closest('td,th');
  if (td) { const tr = td.parentElement, table = td.closest('table'); const ci = [...tr.children].indexOf(td);
    let col = ''; const hr = table && (table.querySelector('thead tr') || table.querySelector('tr')); if (hr && hr !== tr && hr.children[ci]) col = txt(hr.children[ci]);
    const row = tr.children[0] && tr.children[0] !== td ? txt(tr.children[0]) : '';
    const n = [row, col].filter(Boolean).join(', '); if (n) return n.slice(0, 80); }
  let p = el.previousElementSibling; while (p && !txt(p)) p = p.previousElementSibling; if (p && txt(p).length < 80) return txt(p);
  const w = el.closest('.widget, .fsa, fieldset, .card'); const h = w && w.querySelector('h4,h5,legend,b'); return (h ? txt(h).slice(0, 60) + ' — ' : '') + (el.tagName === 'SELECT' ? 'choice' : 'value');
}
function fix(root) {
  root.querySelectorAll('.plotly-host[role="img"]').forEach(el => el.setAttribute('role', 'figure'));
  root.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=hidden]),select,textarea').forEach(el => { const n = nameOf(el); if (n) el.setAttribute('aria-label', n); });
  root.querySelectorAll('mjx-container, .dm, .twrap, figcaption, td, th, div, pre').forEach(el => { const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
    if (!/auto|scroll/.test(cs.overflowX + ' ' + cs.overflowY)) return;
    const dx = el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth, dy = el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight, mj = el.tagName === 'MJX-CONTAINER';
    if (mj && dx <= 4 && dy <= 4) { el.style.overflowX = 'visible'; el.style.overflowY = 'visible'; return; }   // glyph overhang only: nothing to scroll to
    if ((dx > 1 || dy > 1) && !el.hasAttribute('tabindex') && !el.querySelector('a[href],button,input,select,textarea')) {
      el.tabIndex = 0; el.setAttribute('role', 'region'); el.setAttribute('aria-label', mj ? 'Equation (scroll to read all of it)' : 'Scrollable content'); } });
  root.querySelectorAll('summary').forEach(sm => { const inner = sm.querySelectorAll('a[href],button'); if (!inner.length) return;
    const box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'fsx-sumlinks'; inner.forEach(a => box.appendChild(a)); sm.after(box); });
}
let t = null;
const run = () => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => { const m = document.getElementById('main'); if (m) fix(m); fix(document.querySelector('nav') || document.body); }, 120); };
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const m = document.getElementById('main'); if (!m) return; new MutationObserver(run).observe(m, { childList: true, subtree: true }); run(); });
function hookMJ() { const M = window.MathJax; if (!M || !M.typesetPromise || M.__fsx) return !!(M && M.__fsx); const o = M.typesetPromise.bind(M);
  M.typesetPromise = (...a) => o(...a).then(r => { run(); return r; }); M.__fsx = 1; return true; }
let tries = 0; const hk = setInterval(() => { if (hookMJ() || ++tries > 60) clearInterval(hk); }, 500);
document.addEventListener('toggle', run, true); window.addEventListener('load', run); window.addEventListener('resize', run);
window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => { setTimeout(run, 1500); setTimeout(run, 4000); });
window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => setTimeout(() => { const h = document.querySelector('#main h1'); if (h && !document.activeElement.closest('#main form')) { h.tabIndex = -1; h.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } }, 350));
window.FSX = { fix };
})();

========== FILE: ws/tools/fsx_statement.html ==========

<section class="wrap prose"><h1>Accessibility statement</h1>
<p class="lead">FlippedStat aims to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA.</p>
<h2>How this site was checked</h2>
<ul><li>Automated audit of every page with axe-core 4.10.2 (WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA rules), plus checks of reflow at 320 px, 200% zoom and keyboard focus on a sample of pages (November 2026, version 9.8).</li>
<li>Problems found were fixed in version 9.8: colour contrast of text and badges, names for form controls in interactive widgets, interactive charts exposed as figures, keyboard access to wide equations, focus hidden under the top bar, and pages that scrolled sideways on narrow screens.</li>
<li><b>Not yet done:</b> testing by people using screen readers (NVDA, VoiceOver), screen magnifiers and voice control. Automated tools find only part of the barriers that affect real users.</li></ul>
<h2>Known limitations</h2>
<ul><li>Charts: each chart has a text description, but the full data behind some charts is not yet available as a table.</li>
<li>Mathematics is rendered with MathJax; how well formulas are read aloud depends on the screen reader.</li>
<li>Some embedded textbook figures are described only by their captions.</li>
<li>The site follows your system’s light appearance only; use the ◐ button for high contrast.</li></ul>
<h2>Tell us about a problem</h2>
<p>If something on this site is hard to use, please tell the course team (contact details to be added by the department) and say which page and what you were trying to do.</p></section>

========== FILE: ws/tools/ftr.js ==========

/* FlippedStat v9.3 tier layer (FTR): Fundamental / Intermediate / Extension.
   Nothing is removed. Every subtopic can carry a tier (FTR_DATA.sub) and every block on every lesson page gets a tier from
   its type (FTR_DATA.blocks). The learner's study level hides higher-tier material behind a "show" bar; it is one click away.
   Data: window.FTR_DATA (built by tools/assemble_v93.py from content/tiers.py). */
(function () {
'use strict';
const D = window.FTR_DATA || { sub: {}, topic: {}, blocks: [], why: {} }; D.topic = D.topic || {}; D.why = D.why || {};
const KEY = 'fs:tierlevel', ORDER = { F: 1, I: 2, X: 3 };
const NAME = { F: 'Fundamental', I: 'Intermediate', X: 'Extension' };
const level = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) || 'X'; } catch (e) { return 'X'; } };
const setLevel = v => { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(v)); apply(); };
function apply() { document.body.classList.remove('tl-F', 'tl-I', 'tl-X'); document.body.classList.add('tl-' + level()); document.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => { i.checked = i.value === level(); }); }
function badge(t) { return `<span class="ftr-b ftr-${t}" title="${NAME[t]} tier">${NAME[t]}</span>`; }
function bar(t, what) { const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'ftr-bar ftr-bar-' + t; b.dataset.t = t;
  b.innerHTML = `▸ ${NAME[t]} ${what} hidden at your study level — show`; return b; }
function tagBlocks(root) {
  D.blocks.forEach(([sel, t, what]) => root.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el => {
    if (el.dataset.tier) return; el.dataset.tier = t; const b = bar(t, what || 'block');
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { el.classList.add('ftr-open'); b.remove(); if (el.tagName === 'DETAILS') el.open = true; window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')); });
    el.parentNode.insertBefore(b, el);
  }));
}
function tagLessons(root) {
  root.querySelectorAll('article.lesson').forEach(a => {
    const sid = a.querySelector('.lhead .sid'); if (!sid || a.dataset.subtier) return; const no = sid.textContent.trim(); const t = D.sub[no]; if (!t) return;
    a.dataset.subtier = t; a.querySelector('.lhead h3').insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', badge(t));
    if (t !== 'F') { const b = bar(t, 'subtopic'); b.classList.add('ftr-subbar'); b.addEventListener('click', () => { a.classList.add('ftr-open'); b.remove(); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')); }); a.querySelector('.lhead').after(b); }
  });
}
function controlsHTML() {
  return `<div class="ftr-lv" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Study level"><b>Study level</b>` +
    [['F', 'Fundamental only'], ['I', 'Fundamental + Intermediate'], ['X', 'Everything (default)']].map(([v, l]) => `<label><input type="radio" name="ftr-lv" value="${v}"> ${l}</label>`).join('') +
    `<a href="#tiers" class="ftr-help">What do the tiers mean?</a></div>`;
}
function topicSummary(root) {
  const m = location.hash.match(/^#t\/(.+)$/); if (!m) return; const no = decodeURIComponent(m[1]);
  const subs = [...root.querySelectorAll('article.lesson .lhead .sid')].map(x => x.textContent.trim());
  const c = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }; let any = 0; subs.forEach(s => { const t = D.sub[s]; if (t) { c[t]++; any++; } });
  const host = root.querySelector('h1'); if (!host || root.querySelector('.ftr-lv')) return;
  const tt = D.topic[no]; if (tt) { host.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', badge(tt)); host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', controlsHTML() + `<p class="ftr-mix">Companion topic tier: <b>${NAME[tt]}</b> — ${D.why[no.split('.')[0]] || ''}. ${ORDER[tt] > ORDER[level()] ? 'It is above your study level, but stays fully open here.' : ''}</p>`); root.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', () => setLevel(i.value))); return; }
  host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', controlsHTML() + (any ? `<p class="ftr-mix">Subtopics in this topic: ${c.F} Fundamental · ${c.I} Intermediate · ${c.X} Extension</p>` : `<p class="ftr-mix muted">Subtopic tiers for this topic are being assigned (see <a href="#tiers">tiering status</a>). Block tiers below already apply.</p>`));
  root.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', () => setLevel(i.value)));
}
function page() {
  const tot = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }, mins = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }; let all = 0, done = 0;
  let ct = 0; const ctot = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 };
  (window.FS ? FS.units : []).forEach(u => u.topics.forEach(t => { if (!t.subs.length && D.topic[t.no]) { ct++; ctot[D.topic[t.no]]++; } t.subs.forEach(s => { all++; const k = D.sub[s.no]; if (k) { done++; tot[k]++; mins[k] += (+s.base || +s.min || 0); } }); }));
  const units = (window.FS ? FS.units : []).map(u => { const n = u.topics.reduce((a, t) => a + t.subs.length, 0), k = u.topics.reduce((a, t) => a + t.subs.filter(s => D.sub[s.no]).length, 0);
    if (!n) { const kt = u.topics.filter(t => D.topic[t.no]).length; return `<tr><td>${u.id}</td><td>${u.title}</td><td>${kt}/${u.topics.length} topics (companion unit, no subtopics)</td><td>${kt === u.topics.length ? '<span class="pill st-ok">tiered</span>' : '<span class="pill st-gap">pending</span>'}</td></tr>`; }
    const c = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }; u.topics.forEach(t => t.subs.forEach(s => { if (D.sub[s.no]) c[D.sub[s.no]]++; }));
    return `<tr><td>${u.id}</td><td>${u.title}</td><td>${k}/${n} (${c.F} F · ${c.I} I · ${c.X} X)</td><td>${k === n ? '<span class="pill st-ok">tiered</span>' : k ? '<span class="pill">partly</span>' : '<span class="pill st-gap">pending</span>'}</td></tr>`; }).join('');
  return `<section class="wrap prose"><h1>Study tiers</h1><p class="lead">Every lesson stays on the site. Tiers tell you what to study first; your study level folds higher tiers behind a “show” bar so you can open them any time.</p>
  <table class="tbl"><tr><th>Tier</th><th>Meaning</th><th>Typical blocks</th></tr>
  <tr><td>${badge('F')}</td><td>The ideas every learner needs to use statistics and AI safely; required for the Essential pathway.</td><td>Bridge, concept, interpretation, worked problem, picture-it, try-it, quick check, summary; “Before you start”, “Build the basics” and “Work it through” stages.</td></tr>
  <tr><td>${badge('I')}</td><td>Fuller understanding for coursework and projects: the mechanics, more practice and software routes.</td><td>Equation blackboard; “Why it works”, “Use it” and “Practise” stages; Intermediate-tier subtopics.</td></tr>
  <tr><td>${badge('X')}</td><td>Depth for interested or specialist learners: proofs, advanced variants, optional reading.</td><td>“Go deeper” stages, optional stages, Challenge-level items; Extension-tier subtopics.</td></tr></table>
  ${controlsHTML()}
  <h2>Tiering status</h2><p>${done} of ${all} subtopics have a subtopic tier (${tot.F} Fundamental, ${tot.I} Intermediate, ${tot.X} Extension). Block tiers apply on every page already. Fundamental subtopics total about ${Math.round(mins.F/60)} h of lesson time, Intermediate ${Math.round(mins.I/60)} h, Extension ${Math.round(mins.X/60)} h (lesson minutes only; in-depth reading adds more). Companion topics: ${ct} tiered (${ctot.F} F · ${ctot.I} I · ${ctot.X} X). Tiers are drafted by Copilot and need academic approval.</p>
  <table class="tbl"><tr><th>Unit</th><th>Title</th><th>Subtopics tiered</th><th>Status</th></tr>${units}</table></section>`;
}
function run() {
  apply(); const root = document.getElementById('main'); if (!root) return;
  if (location.hash === '#tiers') { root.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', () => setLevel(i.value))); apply(); return; }
  if (!/^#t\//.test(location.hash)) return;
  topicSummary(root); tagLessons(root); tagBlocks(root); apply();
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => setTimeout(run, 0));
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => setTimeout(run, 0));
window.FTR = { page, level, setLevel, tierOf: no => D.sub[no] || D.topic[no] || null, topicTier: no => D.topic[no] || null, data: D, run };
})();

/* FlippedStat v9.3 tier layer (FTR): Fundamental / Intermediate / Extension.
   Nothing is removed. Every subtopic can carry a tier (FTR_DATA.sub) and every block on every lesson page gets a tier from
   its type (FTR_DATA.blocks). The learner's study level hides higher-tier material behind a "show" bar; it is one click away.
   Data: window.FTR_DATA (built by tools/assemble_v93.py from content/tiers.py). */
(function () {
'use strict';
const D = window.FTR_DATA || { sub: {}, blocks: [], names: {} };
const KEY = 'fs:tierlevel', ORDER = { F: 1, I: 2, X: 3 };
const NAME = { F: 'Fundamental', I: 'Intermediate', X: 'Extension' };
const level = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) || 'X'; } catch (e) { return 'X'; } };
const setLevel = v => { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(v)); apply(); };
function apply() { document.body.classList.remove('tl-F', 'tl-I', 'tl-X'); document.body.classList.add('tl-' + level()); document.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => { i.checked = i.value === level(); }); }
function badge(t) { return `<span class="ftr-b ftr-${t}" title="${NAME[t]} tier">${NAME[t]}</span>`; }
function bar(t, what) { const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'ftr-bar ftr-bar-' + t; b.dataset.t = t;
  b.innerHTML = `▸ ${NAME[t]} ${what} hidden at your study level — show`; return b; }
function tagBlocks(root) {
  D.blocks.forEach(([sel, t, what]) => root.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el => {
    if (el.dataset.tier) return; el.dataset.tier = t; const b = bar(t, what || 'block');
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { el.classList.add('ftr-open'); b.remove(); if (el.tagName === 'DETAILS') el.open = true; window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')); });
    el.parentNode.insertBefore(b, el);
  }));
}
function tagLessons(root) {
  root.querySelectorAll('article.lesson').forEach(a => {
    const sid = a.querySelector('.lhead .sid'); if (!sid || a.dataset.subtier) return; const no = sid.textContent.trim(); const t = D.sub[no]; if (!t) return;
    a.dataset.subtier = t; a.querySelector('.lhead h3').insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', badge(t));
    if (t !== 'F') { const b = bar(t, 'subtopic'); b.classList.add('ftr-subbar'); b.addEventListener('click', () => { a.classList.add('ftr-open'); b.remove(); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')); }); a.querySelector('.lhead').after(b); }
  });
}
function controlsHTML() {
  return `<div class="ftr-lv" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Study level"><b>Study level</b>` +
    [['F', 'Fundamental only'], ['I', 'Fundamental + Intermediate'], ['X', 'Everything (default)']].map(([v, l]) => `<label><input type="radio" name="ftr-lv" value="${v}"> ${l}</label>`).join('') +
    `<a href="#tiers" class="ftr-help">What do the tiers mean?</a></div>`;
}
function topicSummary(root) {
  const m = location.hash.match(/^#t\/(.+)$/); if (!m) return; const no = decodeURIComponent(m[1]);
  const subs = [...root.querySelectorAll('article.lesson .lhead .sid')].map(x => x.textContent.trim());
  const c = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }; let any = 0; subs.forEach(s => { const t = D.sub[s]; if (t) { c[t]++; any++; } });
  const host = root.querySelector('h1'); if (!host || root.querySelector('.ftr-lv')) return;
  host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', controlsHTML() + (any ? `<p class="ftr-mix">Subtopics in this topic: ${c.F} Fundamental · ${c.I} Intermediate · ${c.X} Extension</p>` : `<p class="ftr-mix muted">Subtopic tiers for this topic are being assigned (see <a href="#tiers">tiering status</a>). Block tiers below already apply.</p>`));
  root.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', () => setLevel(i.value)));
}
function page() {
  const tot = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }, mins = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }; let all = 0, done = 0;
  (window.FS ? FS.units : []).forEach(u => u.topics.forEach(t => t.subs.forEach(s => { all++; const k = D.sub[s.no]; if (k) { done++; tot[k]++; mins[k] += (+s.base || +s.min || 0); } })));
  const units = (window.FS ? FS.units : []).map(u => { const n = u.topics.reduce((a, t) => a + t.subs.length, 0), k = u.topics.reduce((a, t) => a + t.subs.filter(s => D.sub[s.no]).length, 0); return `<tr><td>${u.id}</td><td>${u.title}</td><td>${k}/${n}</td><td>${n ? (k === n ? '<span class="pill st-ok">tiered</span>' : k ? '<span class="pill">partly</span>' : '<span class="pill st-gap">pending</span>') : '—'}</td></tr>`; }).join('');
  return `<section class="wrap prose"><h1>Study tiers</h1><p class="lead">Every lesson stays on the site. Tiers tell you what to study first; your study level folds higher tiers behind a “show” bar so you can open them any time.</p>
  <table class="tbl"><tr><th>Tier</th><th>Meaning</th><th>Typical blocks</th></tr>
  <tr><td>${badge('F')}</td><td>The ideas every learner needs to use statistics and AI safely; required for the Essential pathway.</td><td>Bridge, concept, interpretation, worked problem, picture-it, try-it, quick check, summary; “Before you start”, “Build the basics” and “Work it through” stages.</td></tr>
  <tr><td>${badge('I')}</td><td>Fuller understanding for coursework and projects: the mechanics, more practice and software routes.</td><td>Equation blackboard; “Why it works”, “Use it” and “Practise” stages; Intermediate-tier subtopics.</td></tr>
  <tr><td>${badge('X')}</td><td>Depth for interested or specialist learners: proofs, advanced variants, optional reading.</td><td>“Go deeper” stages, optional stages, Challenge-level items; Extension-tier subtopics.</td></tr></table>
  ${controlsHTML()}
  <h2>Tiering status</h2><p>${done} of ${all} subtopics have a subtopic tier (${tot.F} Fundamental, ${tot.I} Intermediate, ${tot.X} Extension). Block tiers apply on every page already. Subtopic tiers are drafted by Copilot and need academic approval.</p>
  <table class="tbl"><tr><th>Unit</th><th>Title</th><th>Subtopics tiered</th><th>Status</th></tr>${units}</table></section>`;
}
function run() {
  apply(); const root = document.getElementById('main'); if (!root) return;
  if (location.hash === '#tiers') { root.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', () => setLevel(i.value))); apply(); return; }
  if (!/^#t\//.test(location.hash)) return;
  topicSummary(root); tagLessons(root); tagBlocks(root); apply();
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => setTimeout(run, 0));
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => setTimeout(run, 0));
window.FTR = { page, level, setLevel, tierOf: no => D.sub[no] || null, data: D, run };
})();

  const m = location.hash.match(/^#t\/(.+)$/); if (!m) return; const no = decodeURIComponent(m[1]);
  const subs = [...root.querySelectorAll('article.lesson .lhead .sid')].map(x => x.textContent.trim());
  const c = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }; let any = 0; subs.forEach(s => { const t = D.sub[s]; if (t) { c[t]++; any++; } });
  const host = root.querySelector('h1'); if (!host || root.querySelector('.ftr-lv')) return;
  const tt = D.topic[no]; if (tt) { host.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', badge(tt)); host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', controlsHTML() + `<p class="ftr-mix">Companion topic tier: <b>${NAME[tt]}</b> — ${D.why[no.split('.')[0]] || ''}. ${ORDER[tt] > ORDER[level()] ? 'It is above your study level, but stays fully open here.' : ''}</p>`); root.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', () => setLevel(i.value))); return; }
  host.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', controlsHTML() + (any ? `<p class="ftr-mix">Subtopics in this topic: ${c.F} Fundamental · ${c.I} Intermediate · ${c.X} Extension</p>` : `<p class="ftr-mix muted">Subtopic tiers for this topic are being assigned (see <a href="#tiers">tiering status</a>). Block tiers below already apply.</p>`));
  root.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', () => setLevel(i.value)));
}
function page() {
  const tot = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }, mins = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }; let all = 0, done = 0;
  let ct = 0; const ctot = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 };
  (window.FS ? FS.units : []).forEach(u => u.topics.forEach(t => { if (!t.subs.length && D.topic[t.no]) { ct++; ctot[D.topic[t.no]]++; } t.subs.forEach(s => { all++; const k = D.sub[s.no]; if (k) { done++; tot[k]++; mins[k] += (+s.base || +s.min || 0); } }); }));
  const units = (window.FS ? FS.units : []).map(u => { const n = u.topics.reduce((a, t) => a + t.subs.length, 0), k = u.topics.reduce((a, t) => a + t.subs.filter(s => D.sub[s.no]).length, 0);
    if (!n) { const kt = u.topics.filter(t => D.topic[t.no]).length; return `<tr><td>${u.id}</td><td>${u.title}</td><td>${kt}/${u.topics.length} topics (companion unit, no subtopics)</td><td>${kt === u.topics.length ? '<span class="pill st-ok">tiered</span>' : '<span class="pill st-gap">pending</span>'}</td></tr>`; }
    const c = { F: 0, I: 0, X: 0 }; u.topics.forEach(t => t.subs.forEach(s => { if (D.sub[s.no]) c[D.sub[s.no]]++; }));
    return `<tr><td>${u.id}</td><td>${u.title}</td><td>${k}/${n} (${c.F} F · ${c.I} I · ${c.X} X)</td><td>${k === n ? '<span class="pill st-ok">tiered</span>' : k ? '<span class="pill">partly</span>' : '<span class="pill st-gap">pending</span>'}</td></tr>`; }).join('');
  return `<section class="wrap prose"><h1>Study tiers</h1><p class="lead">Every lesson stays on the site. Tiers tell you what to study first; your study level folds higher tiers behind a “show” bar so you can open them any time.</p>
  <table class="tbl"><tr><th>Tier</th><th>Meaning</th><th>Typical blocks</th></tr>
  <tr><td>${badge('F')}</td><td>The ideas every learner needs to use statistics and AI safely; required for the Essential pathway.</td><td>Bridge, concept, interpretation, worked problem, picture-it, try-it, quick check, summary; “Before you start”, “Build the basics” and “Work it through” stages.</td></tr>
  <tr><td>${badge('I')}</td><td>Fuller understanding for coursework and projects: the mechanics, more practice and software routes.</td><td>Equation blackboard; “Why it works”, “Use it” and “Practise” stages; Intermediate-tier subtopics.</td></tr>
  <tr><td>${badge('X')}</td><td>Depth for interested or specialist learners: proofs, advanced variants, optional reading.</td><td>“Go deeper” stages, optional stages, Challenge-level items; Extension-tier subtopics.</td></tr></table>
  ${controlsHTML()}
  <h2>Tiering status</h2><p>${done} of ${all} subtopics have a subtopic tier (${tot.F} Fundamental, ${tot.I} Intermediate, ${tot.X} Extension). Block tiers apply on every page already. Fundamental subtopics total about ${Math.round(mins.F/60)} h of lesson time, Intermediate ${Math.round(mins.I/60)} h, Extension ${Math.round(mins.X/60)} h (lesson minutes only; in-depth reading adds more). Companion topics: ${ct} tiered (${ctot.F} F · ${ctot.I} I · ${ctot.X} X). Tiers are drafted by Copilot and need academic approval.</p>
  <table class="tbl"><tr><th>Unit</th><th>Title</th><th>Subtopics tiered</th><th>Status</th></tr>${units}</table></section>`;
}
function run() {
  apply(); const root = document.getElementById('main'); if (!root) return;
  if (location.hash === '#tiers') { root.querySelectorAll('.ftr-lv input').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', () => setLevel(i.value))); apply(); return; }

}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => setTimeout(run, 0));

})();
