========== FILE: ws/fsrw/apply.py ==========
"""python apply.py <week-file> <rw module files...> : applies rewrites, validates, writes patched content file."""
import sys,runpy,copy,json,importlib.util,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/mnt/data/fsrw'); import fsrw_lib as F
def load(p):
    s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
def setp(o,p,v):
    for k in p[:-1]: o=o[k]
    o[p[-1]]=v
def run(content, mods):
    A=runpy.run_path(content)['A']; total=[]; n=0
    for mp in mods:
        m=load(mp); orig=A[m.L]; new=copy.deepcopy(orig)
        valid=dict(F.strings(orig))
        for p,v in m.R.items():
            if p not in valid: total.append((m.L,'STRAY',p)); continue
            setp(new,p,v); n+=1
        for it in F.check(orig,new,getattr(m,'FLAGS',{})):
            if it[0]=='NUM' and set(it[2])<=getattr(m,'DROP_NUMS',{}).get(it[1],set()): continue
            total.append((m.L,)+it)
    return n,total
if __name__=='__main__':
    n,iss=run(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:])
    for i in iss: print(*i)
    print('applied',n,'issues',len(iss))

"""Compile FlippedStat v11 from the pristine v10.9-dev HTML plus every FSRW layer available.
python build_v11.py <out.html>
Layers: legacy/rw_w1,rw_w2 (lesson paths 'les|a/b'), legacy/rw_e1,rw_e2 (+SRCPATCH),
        rw/wNN_*.py (tuple paths; BASE='ws' -> workspace absorb file, 'html' -> HTML lessons),
        emb/rw/eNN*.py (embedded items)."""
import sys,json,glob,copy,re,importlib.util
sys.path[:0]=['/mnt/data/fsrw','/mnt/data/fsrw/emb','/mnt/data/fsrw/legacy']
import fsrw_lib as F, html_lessons as H, emb_check as EC, legacy_lessons as LL
SRC_HTML='/mnt/data/FlippedStat_v10.9-dev_standalone.html'
def load(p):
    s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
def lesson_layer(L):
    out,rep=LL.run(L,['/mnt/data/fsrw/legacy/rw_w1.py','/mnt/data/fsrw/legacy/rw_w2.py'])
    rep=[r for r in rep if r[0] in('STRAY','SRC')]
    weeks=sorted({int(p.split('/')[-1][1:3]) for p in glob.glob('/mnt/data/fsrw/rw/w*_*.py')})
    for w in weeks:
        mods=[load(p) for p in sorted(glob.glob(f'/mnt/data/fsrw/rw/w{w:02d}_*.py'))]
        ws=[m for m in mods if getattr(m,'BASE','ws')=='ws']; hs=[m for m in mods if getattr(m,'BASE','ws')=='html']
        if ws:
            base='/mnt/data/fsrw/absorb_w03.reverted.py' if w==3 else f'/mnt/data/fsrw/base/absorb_w{w:02d}.py'
            o,st=H.apply(L,H.mapping(w,base))
            for k,(a,b) in st.items():
                if a<b-1: rep.append(('UNMATCHED',k,a,b))
            out.update(o)
        for m in hs:
            les=copy.deepcopy(out.get(m.L,L[m.L])); valid=dict(F.strings(L[m.L]))
            for p,v in m.R.items():
                if p not in valid: rep.append(('STRAY',m.L,p)); continue
                o=les
                for k in p[:-1]: o=o[k]
                o[p[-1]]=v
            for it in F.check(L[m.L],les,getattr(m,'FLAGS',{})):
                if it[0]=='NUM' and set(it[2])<=getattr(m,'DROP_NUMS',{}).get(it[1],set()): continue
                if it[0] in('SAME',) or (it[0]=='SRC' and it[1] not in m.R): continue
                rep.append((m.L,)+it)
            out[m.L]=les
    for p in sorted(glob.glob('/mnt/data/fsrw/rw/x*_*.py')):
        m=load(p); les=copy.deepcopy(out.get(m.L,L[m.L])); valid=dict(F.strings(L[m.L]))
        for pp,v in m.R.items():
            if pp not in valid: rep.append(('STRAY',m.L,pp)); continue
            o=les
            for k in pp[:-1]: o=o[k]
            o[pp[-1]]=v
        for it in F.check(L[m.L],les,getattr(m,'FLAGS',{})):
            if it[0]=='NUM' and set(it[2])<=getattr(m,'DROP_NUMS',{}).get(it[1],set()): continue
            if it[0] in('SAME',) or (it[0]=='SRC' and it[1] not in m.R): continue
            rep.append((m.L,)+it)
        out[m.L]=les
    tidy={'Python route (Think Stats)':'Python route','Python (Think Stats code, MIT licence)':'Python code (MIT licence)'}
    def walk(o):
        if isinstance(o,dict):
            for k,v in o.items():
                if isinstance(v,str) and v in tidy and k in('h','box'): o[k]=tidy[v]
                else: walk(v)
        elif isinstance(o,list): [walk(v) for v in o]
    for k in list(out): walk(out[k])
    return out,rep
def emb_layer():
    P={}; SP=[]; rep=[]
    O,p,iss=EC.check(1,['/mnt/data/fsrw/legacy/rw_e1.py','/mnt/data/fsrw/legacy/rw_e2.py'],src='/mnt/data/fsrw/emb/e12.json'); P.update(p); rep+=iss
    SP+=load('/mnt/data/fsrw/legacy/rw_e1.py').SRCPATCH
    for w in range(3,15):
        mods=sorted(glob.glob(f'/mnt/data/fsrw/emb/rw/e{w:02d}*.py'))
        if mods:
            O,p,iss=EC.check(w,mods); P.update(p); rep+=iss
            for m in mods: SP+=getattr(load(m),'SRCPATCH',[])
    for g in ['C1','C2','C3','C4','D1','E1','E2','E4','E5']:
        mods=sorted(glob.glob(f'/mnt/data/fsrw/emb/rw/x{g}*.py'))
        if mods:
            O,p,iss=EC.check(g,mods); P.update(p); rep+=iss
    return P,SP,rep
if __name__=='__main__':
    dst=sys.argv[1]; s=open(SRC_HTML,encoding='utf8').read(); dec=json.JSONDecoder()
    i=s.find('window.FSA_DATA=')+len('window.FSA_DATA='); FSA,_=dec.raw_decode(s,i)
    LES,r1=lesson_layer(FSA['lessons']); P,SP,r2=emb_layer()
    for r in r1+r2: print('  ',*r)
    i=s.find('/* content2.js'); j=s.find('</script>',i); seg=s[i:j]
    for a,b in SP:
        c=seg.count(a); assert c==1,(c,a); seg=seg.replace(a,b)
    s=s[:i]+seg+s[j:]
    J=lambda o: json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False).replace('</','<\\/')
    j=s.find('</script>',s.find('/* content2.js'))+9
    s=s[:j]+'<script>/* FlippedStat v11 FSRW-E: bespoke unified-voice rewrites of embedded exercises, quizzes, guides and refreshers. Generated by fsrw/build_v11.py. */\n(function(){var P='+J(P)+';var n=0;for(var k in P){var ks=k.split("."),o=window[ks[0]];for(var t=1;t<ks.length-1&&o;t++)o=o[ks[t]];if(o&&ks[ks.length-1] in o){o[ks[ks.length-1]]=P[k];n++;}}window.FSRW_E={applied:n,total:Object.keys(P).length};})();</script>'+s[j:]
    j=s.find('</script>',s.find('window.FSA_DATA='))+9
    s=s[:j]+'<script>/* FlippedStat v11 FSRW-L: bespoke unified-voice lesson prose. Credits and data unchanged. */\n(function(){var R='+J(LES)+';if(window.FSA_DATA&&FSA_DATA.lessons){for(var k in R)FSA_DATA.lessons[k]=R[k];}window.FSRW_L=Object.keys(R).length;})();</script>'+s[j:]
    s=s.replace('v10.9-dev','v11.1-dev')

"""Embed all rw modules into their content files (as a final override block) and write a new bundle + backup copy.
python bundle.py <base_bundle> <out_tag>"""
import sys,glob,importlib.util,re,hashlib,shutil
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/mnt/data/fsrw'); from apply import run
base,tag=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
WEEKMAP={}  # content file -> rw modules
for p in sorted(glob.glob('/mnt/data/fsrw/rw/w*_*.py')):
    w=int(Path(p).name[1:3]); WEEKMAP.setdefault(f'content/absorb_w{w:02d}.py',[]).append(p)
src=Path(base).read_text('utf-8'); report=[]
MARK='\n# ==== FSRW bespoke rewrite block (generated by fsrw/bundle.py) ====\n'
for cf,mods in WEEKMAP.items():
    name='ws/'+cf; s0=f'========== FILE: {name} ==========\n'; e0=f'========== END FILE: {name} =========='
    a=src.index(s0)+len(s0); b=src.index(e0,a); body=src[a:b]
    body=body.split(MARK)[0].rstrip()+'\n'
    blk=[MARK,'def _fsrw_put(o,p,v):\n    for k in p[:-1]: o=o[k]\n    o[p[-1]]=v\n']
    for m in mods:
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m',m); M=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(M)
        blk.append(f'_R={M.R!r}\nfor _p,_v in _R.items(): _fsrw_put(A[{M.L!r}],_p,_v)\n')
    newbody=body+''.join(blk)
    tmp=Path('/tmp')/('check_'+Path(cf).name); tmp.write_text(newbody,'utf-8')
    n,iss=run(str(tmp),[])  # syntax/load check
    src=src[:a]+newbody+src[b:]; report.append((cf,len(mods)))
out=Path(f'/mnt/data/FlippedStat_all_text_and_scripts_FSRW_{tag}.txt'); out.write_text(src,'utf-8')
bk=Path(f'/mnt/data/FlippedStat_all_text_and_scripts_backup_{tag}.txt'); shutil.copyfile(out,bk)
h=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print(report); print(out.name,out.stat().st_size,h(out)); print(bk.name,h(bk)==h(out))

========== END FILE: ws/fsrw/bundle.py ==========

========== FILE: ws/fsrw/emb/emb_check.py ==========
"""Validate an embedded-item rewrite module (dict R: path -> new text) against n<week>.json originals."""
import json,re,sys,importlib.util
NUM=lambda s:set(re.findall(r'\d+(?:[.,]\d+)*',re.sub(r'<[^>]+>|\\\(.*?\\\)','',s)))
MATH=lambda s:set(re.findall(r'\\\(.*?\\\)',s))
MARK=lambda s:sorted(re.findall(r'\{[a-z]\|',s))
TAG=lambda s:sorted(re.findall(r'<(ol|li|table|div|span|code|em|sub|sup|a)\b',s))
SRC=re.compile(r'OpenIntro|Navarro|Foxcroft|Think Stats|Downey|\bthe book|\bbook\b|\bbook\'s',re.I)
NOREWRITE=re.compile(r'\.(kind|type|tags\.\d+|params\..*|formulas\.\d+|formal\.\d+|src|title|titleh)$')
def load(p):
    s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
def check(week,mods,src=None):
    O=json.load(open(src or f'/mnt/data/fsrw/emb/n{week}.json')); out={}; iss=[]
    for mp in mods:
        m=load(mp); keep=getattr(m,'DROP_NUMS',{})
        for k,v in m.R.items():
            if k not in O: iss.append(('STRAY',k)); continue
            o=O[k]
            if isinstance(v,list):
                t=o
                for a,b in v:
                    if a not in t:
                        mm=re.search(r'\s+'.join(re.escape(w) for w in a.split()),t)
                        if not mm: iss.append(('PAIR',k,a[:40])); continue
                        a=mm.group(0)
                    t=t.replace(a,b)
                v=t
            lost=NUM(o)-NUM(v)-keep.get(k,set())
            if lost: iss.append(('NUM',k,sorted(lost)))
            if MATH(o)-MATH(v): iss.append(('MATH',k,MATH(o)-MATH(v)))
            if MARK(o)!=MARK(v) and set(MARK(o))-set(MARK(v)): iss.append(('MARK',k))
            if set(TAG(o))-set(TAG(v)): iss.append(('TAG',k))
            if SRC.search(re.sub(r'<span class="cite".*?</span></span>','',v,flags=re.S)) and k not in getattr(m,'FLAGS',{}): iss.append(('SRC',k,SRC.findall(v)))
            if v==o and len(o.split())>4: iss.append(('SAME',k))
            out[k]=v
    return O,out,iss
def coverage(week,out):
    O=json.load(open(f'/mnt/data/fsrw/emb/n{week}.json'))
    return [k for k,o in O.items() if k not in out and not NOREWRITE.search(k) and len(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',o).split())>3]
if __name__=='__main__':
    w=sys.argv[1]; O,out,iss=check(w,sys.argv[2:])
    for i in iss: print(*i)
    print('rewritten',len(out),'issues',len(iss))

========== END FILE: ws/fsrw/emb/emb_check.py ==========

function strings(o,p,out){ if(typeof o==='string'){ if(o.trim()&&/[A-Za-z]{3}/.test(o.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,''))) out.push([p,o]); return;}

  if(b.k==='rev'){ const j=bc.review.findIndex(x=>x.id===b.key); return [['OISD.book.chapters.'+(c-1)+'.review.'+j, bc.review[j]]]; }
  const A=OISD.auth.chapters[c-1];

  if(b.k==='proof') return [['OISD.auth.chapters.'+(c-1)+'.proofs.'+b.key, A.proofs[+b.key]]];
  if(b.k==='oboot') return [['OISD.common.boot.'+b.key, OISD.common.boot[+b.key]]];

  return [];

function embsOf(w){ const acc=[]; const walk=o=>{ if(Array.isArray(o)) o.forEach(walk); else if(o&&typeof o==='object'){ if(typeof o.emb==='string') acc.push(o.emb); Object.values(o).forEach(walk);} };
 for(const k in L) if(k.split('.')[0]===String(w)) walk(L[k]); return [...new Set(acc)]; }
module.exports={resolve,strings,embsOf,BY};

========== FILE: ws/fsrw/fsrw_lib.py ==========
"""FSRW bespoke-rewrite helpers for content/absorb_wNN.py lesson dicts (A[lesson] structure)."""
import re, json, runpy, copy
SKIP={'src','credit','emb','fig','f','k','lv','kind','opt','eq','id'}
SRC=re.compile(r'OpenIntro|Navarro|Foxcroft|Think Stats|Downey|Learning Statistics with jamovi|\bthe book\b|\bthe textbook\b|\bthis book\b',re.I)
def strings(o,p=()):
    if isinstance(o,str):
        if re.search(r'[A-Za-z]{3}',re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',o)): yield p,o
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for i,v in enumerate(o): yield from strings(v,p+(i,))
    elif isinstance(o,dict):
        for k,v in o.items():
            if k not in SKIP: yield from strings(v,p+(k,))
def nums(s): return set(re.findall(r'\d+(?:[.,]\d+)*',re.sub(r'<[^>]+>|\\\(.*?\\\)|\\\[.*?\\\]','',s)))
def maths(s): return set(re.findall(r'\\\(.*?\\\)|\\\[.*?\\\]',s))
def tags(s): return set(re.findall(r'<(code|ol|ul|table|pre|a|sub|sup)\b',s))
def codes(s): return set(re.findall(r'<code>(.*?)</code>',s))
def check(orig,new,flags=()):
    """orig/new: lesson dicts. Returns list of issues."""
    O=dict(strings(orig)); N=dict(strings(new)); iss=[]
    for p,o in O.items():
        n=N.get(p)
        if n is None: iss.append(('LOST',p)); continue
        lost=nums(o)-nums(n)
        if lost: iss.append(('NUM',p,sorted(lost)))
        if maths(o)-maths(n): iss.append(('MATH',p,sorted(maths(o)-maths(n))))
        if tags(o)-tags(n): iss.append(('TAG',p,tags(o)-tags(n)))
        if codes(o)-codes(n): iss.append(('CODE',p,codes(o)-codes(n)))
        if SRC.search(n) and p not in flags: iss.append(('SRC',p,SRC.findall(n)))
        if n==o and len(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',o).split())>4: iss.append(('SAME',p,o[:70]))
    # structural keys untouched
    def struct(o):
        if isinstance(o,dict): return {k:(v if k in SKIP else struct(v)) for k,v in o.items()}
        if isinstance(o,list): return [struct(v) for v in o]
        return None
    if json.dumps(struct(orig),sort_keys=True)!=json.dumps(struct(new),sort_keys=True): iss.append(('STRUCT',))
    return iss
def dump(lesson,lid):
    out=[]
    for p,s in strings(lesson): out.append(f'## {p!r}\n{s}\n')
    return f'===== {lid}\n'+'\n'.join(out)

========== END FILE: ws/fsrw/fsrw_lib.py ==========
========== FILE: ws/fsrw/html_lessons.py ==========
"""Map workspace rewrites onto HTML FSA_DATA lessons by exact original-string match."""
import runpy,json,glob,importlib.util,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/mnt/data/fsrw'); import fsrw_lib as F
def load(p):
    s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
def mapping(week,base):
    A=runpy.run_path(base)['A']; M={}
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(f'/mnt/data/fsrw/rw/w{week:02d}_*.py')):
        m=load(p); O=dict(F.strings(A[m.L]))
        for path,new in m.R.items():
            M.setdefault(m.L,{})[O[path]]=new
            for alt in getattr(m,'HTML_ALIAS',{}).get(path,[]): M[m.L][alt]=new
    return M
def apply(L,M):
    stats={}
    def walk(o):
        if isinstance(o,list):
            for i,v in enumerate(o):
                if isinstance(v,str) and v in cur: o[i]=cur[v]; hit.add(v)
                else: walk(v)
        elif isinstance(o,dict):
            for k,v in o.items():
                if k in ('credit','src'): continue
                if isinstance(v,str) and v in cur: o[k]=cur[v]; hit.add(v)
                else: walk(v)
    out={}
    for lid,cur in M.items():
        hit=set(); les=json.loads(json.dumps(L[lid])); walk(les); out[lid]=les; stats[lid]=(len(hit),len(cur))
    return out,stats

========== FILE: ws/fsrw/inject.py ==========
"""Inject FSRW layers for given weeks into a FlippedStat standalone HTML.
python inject.py <in.html> <out.html> <week> [<week> ...]
Adds, per run, one lesson-override script (after FSA_DATA) and one embedded-item patch script (after content2.js / prior FSRW-E).
Lesson overrides are computed from the HTML's own lesson objects (string-matched), so v10.x additions are preserved."""
import sys,json,re,glob,importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,'/mnt/data/fsrw'); sys.path.insert(0,'/mnt/data/fsrw/emb')
import html_lessons as H, emb_check as EC
src,dst,weeks=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2],[int(w) for w in sys.argv[3:]]
s=open(src,encoding='utf8').read(); dec=json.JSONDecoder()
i=s.find('window.FSA_DATA=')+len('window.FSA_DATA='); FSA,_=dec.raw_decode(s,i); L=FSA['lessons']
# apply any earlier FSRW-L overrides already present in the file, so string matching sees current text
for m in re.finditer(r'FSRW-L[^\n]*\n\(function\(\)\{var R=',s):
    R,_=dec.raw_decode(s,m.end()); L.update(R)
LES={}; EMB={}; rep=[]
for w in weeks:
    base=f'/mnt/data/fsrw/absorb_w{w:02d}.base.py'
    if w==3: base='/mnt/data/fsrw/absorb_w03.reverted.py'
    if glob.glob(f'/mnt/data/fsrw/rw/w{w:02d}_*.py'):
        out,st=H.apply(L,H.mapping(w,base)); LES.update(out); rep.append(('lessons',w,st))
    mods=sorted(glob.glob(f'/mnt/data/fsrw/emb/rw/e{w:02d}*.py'))
    if mods:
        O,P,iss=EC.check(w,mods); assert not iss,iss; EMB.update(P); rep.append(('emb',w,len(P)))
# heading tidy-up for Python-route panels inside overridden lessons (book name kept in links/licence notes)
for les in LES.values():
    def walk(o):
        if isinstance(o,dict):
            for k,v in o.items():
                if k=='h' and v=='Python route (Think Stats)': o[k]='Python route'
                elif k=='box' and v=='Python (Think Stats code, MIT licence)': o[k]='Python code (MIT licence)'
                else: walk(v)
        elif isinstance(o,list): [walk(v) for v in o]
    walk(les)
tag='W'+'-'.join(map(str,weeks)); J=lambda o: json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False).replace('</','<\\/')
if LES:
    j=s.find('</script>',s.find('window.FSA_DATA='))+9
    s=s[:j]+f'<script>/* FlippedStat FSRW-L {tag}: bespoke unified-voice lesson prose. Credits and data unchanged. */\n(function(){{var R={J(LES)};if(window.FSA_DATA&&FSA_DATA.lessons){{for(var k in R)FSA_DATA.lessons[k]=R[k];}}window.FSRW_L_{tag.replace("-","_")}=Object.keys(R).length;}})();</script>'+s[j:]
if EMB:
    anchor=s.rfind('FSRW-E'); anchor=anchor if anchor>0 else s.find('/* content2.js')
    j=s.find('</script>',anchor)+9
    s=s[:j]+f'<script>/* FlippedStat FSRW-E {tag}: bespoke rewrites of embedded exercises, quizzes, guides and refreshers. */\n(function(){{var P={J(EMB)};var n=0;for(var k in P){{var ks=k.split("."),o=window[ks[0]];for(var t=1;t<ks.length-1&&o;t++)o=o[ks[t]];if(o&&ks[ks.length-1] in o){{o[ks[ks.length-1]]=P[k];n++;}}}}window.FSRW_E_{tag.replace("-","_")}={{applied:n,total:Object.keys(P).length}};}})();</script>'+s[j:]
open(dst,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
for r in rep: print(*r[:2], r[2] if not isinstance(r[2],dict) else sum(a for a,b in r[2].values()),'strings')

========== FILE: ws/fsrw/legacy/legacy_lessons.py ==========
"""Apply legacy (v11.0-dev) lesson rewrites keyed 'lesson|a/b/c' to HTML FSA_DATA lessons, with validation."""
import json,re,copy,importlib.util,sys
SKIP={'eq','k','emb','lv','fig','src','credit','opt','kind','f'}
AUTOREPL={'Python route (Think Stats)':'Python route','Python (Think Stats code, MIT licence)':'Python code (MIT licence)'}
AUTOKEEP=re.compile(r'^\s*(<p><code>|<div class="fsr-|<pre|<p class="fsanote"|<h5>|<p class="fsr-jamlab"|<code>)')
SRC=re.compile(r'OpenIntro|\bthe book\b|Navarro|Think Stats|Downey|Foxcroft|Hyndman|the textbook',re.I)
NUM=lambda s:set(re.findall(r'\d+(?:\.\d+)?',re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',s)))
def walk(o,p,out):
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        for k,v in o.items():
            if k not in SKIP: walk(v,p+[k],out)
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for i,v in enumerate(o): walk(v,p+[i],out)
    elif isinstance(o,str) and o.strip(): out.append(('/'.join(map(str,p)),o))
def setp(o,path,v):
    ks=[int(x) if x.isdigit() else x for x in path.split('/')]
    for k in ks[:-1]: o=o[k]
    o[ks[-1]]=v
def load(p):
    s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
def run(L,modpaths):
    out={}; rep=[]
    for mp in modpaths:
        M=load(mp); lessons=sorted({k.split('|')[0] for k in M.R}|{k.split('|')[0] for k in M.KEEP})
        for les in lessons:
            new=copy.deepcopy(L[les]); ss=[]; walk(L[les],[],ss); valid={p for p,_ in ss}
            for p,s in ss:
                key=f'{les}|{p}'
                if key in M.KEEP: continue
                if key in M.R:
                    t=M.R[key]
                    lost=NUM(s)-NUM(t)
                    if lost and not all(re.fullmatch(r'\d+\.\d+',x) for x in lost): rep.append(('NUM',key,lost))
                    if SRC.search(t) and key not in M.FLAGS: rep.append(('SRC',key))
                    setp(new,p,t)
                elif s in AUTOREPL: setp(new,p,AUTOREPL[s])
                elif AUTOKEEP.match(s) or (len(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',s).split())<=3 and not SRC.search(s)) or (s.strip().endswith('level') and len(s)<20): pass
                else: rep.append(('MISSING',key,s[:60]))
            for k in M.R:
                if k.split('|')[0]==les and k.split('|',1)[1] not in valid: rep.append(('STRAY',k))
            out[les]=new
    return out,rep
if __name__=='__main__':
    L=json.load(open('/mnt/data/fsrw/emb/fsa.json'))['lessons']
    out,rep=run(L,sys.argv[1:])
    for r in rep: print(*r)
    print('lessons',len(out),'issues',len(rep))

========== FILE: ws/fsrw/pw.py ==========
import sys,asyncio,glob
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
exe='/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome'
async def main(path,routes,checks):
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b=await p.chromium.launch(executable_path=exe) if exe else await p.chromium.launch(); pg=await b.new_page(); errs=[]
        pg.on('pageerror',lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:200]))
        await pg.goto('file://'+path); await pg.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        for r in routes:
            await pg.evaluate(f"location.hash='{r}'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
            await pg.evaluate("document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d=>d.open=true)"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(800)
            for _ in range(12): await pg.mouse.wheel(0,3000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
            t=await pg.evaluate("document.body.innerText")
            print(r,'chars',len(t),[ (c, c in t) for c in checks])
        print('pageerrors',errs[:5]); await b.close()
asyncio.run(main(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2].split(','),sys.argv[3:]))

import sys,asyncio,glob
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
exe='/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome'
async def main(path,routes,checks):
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b=await p.chromium.launch(executable_path=exe) if exe else await p.chromium.launch(); pg=await b.new_page(); errs=[]
        pg.on('pageerror',lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:200]))
        await pg.goto('file://'+path); await pg.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        for r in routes:
            await pg.evaluate(f"location.hash='{r}'"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
            await pg.evaluate("document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d=>d.open=true)"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(800)
            for _ in range(12): await pg.mouse.wheel(0,3000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
            t=await pg.evaluate("document.body.textContent")
            print(r,'chars',len(t),[ (c, c in t) for c in checks])
        print('pageerrors',errs[:5]); await b.close()

('stages',0,'h'):'From sums of squares to F',
('stages',0,'body',0):'<b>Degrees of freedom.</b> Within groups, N observations vary around G group means, so df<sub>w</sub> = N − G. ('stages',1,'h'):'A caution: automation is not thinking',
('stages',1,'body',0):'Automated selection is tempting because it looks objective. Yet there is little agreement about the criterion: F-tests, AIC, BIC (which simulation studies often prefer to AIC), normalised maximum likelihood, Bayesian posterior odds and others. AIC is an approximation that holds for large samples under certain assumptions. Most criteria agree when the answer is obvious and disagree when it is difficult. If the model that makes sense loses narrowly to one that makes no sense, trust your judgement, because interpretability matters.',

('intro',):'“A wise man proportions his belief to the evidence” (David Hume). So far the course has taught frequentist inference, the approach that dominates published research. ('stages',1,'h'):'The umbrella problem: prior and likelihood',
('stages',1,'body',0):'From a Bayesian point of view, inference is <b>belief revision</b>. Begin with some candidate hypotheses h and beliefs about how plausible each is, observe data d, then strengthen belief in the hypotheses consistent with d and weaken it in the rest.',
('stages',1,'body',1):'<b>The problem.</b> Imagine a friend says, “I’m carrying an umbrella. Do you think it will rain?” There is one datum, d = umbrella, and two hypotheses, rain or dry.',
('stages',1,'body',2):'<b>The prior P(h)</b> is what you believed beforehand. Suppose your friend lives in Adelaide, which has a Mediterranean climate, and it is January, the middle of summer there, when about 4.4 of the month’s 31 days are rainy. Then P(rain) ≈ 0.15 and P(dry) ≈ 0.85.',
('stages',1,'body',4):'<b>The likelihood P(d | h)</b> is a theory about the data. Your friend means to carry an umbrella only on rainy days but is forgetful, remembering it on 30% of rainy days, and carries one by habit on 5% of dry days.',
('stages',1,'body',5,'cap'):'The likelihood: P(umbrella | rain) = 0.30 and P(umbrella | dry) = 0.05.',
('stages',1,'body',6,'box'):'A note on the word “likelihood”',
('stages',1,'body',6,'p',0):'Bayesians borrowed the term from frequentists and use it slightly differently: a Bayesian “likelihood function” usually means one row of this table (h fixed, d varying), while a frequentist one usually means a column. The distinction does not matter here.',
('stages',2,'h'):'From a joint probability to Bayes’ rule',
('stages',2,'body',0):'Multiply the prior by the likelihood to obtain the joint probability of a hypothesis and the data:',
('stages',2,'body',1,'say'):'before any data are seen, there is a 4.5% chance of “rain and an umbrella”.',
('stages',2,'body',2):'Do the same for all four combinations and add the margins:',
('stages',2,'body',3,'cap'):'All four joint probabilities.',
('stages',2,'body',4,'cap'):'With row and column totals: P(umbrella) = 0.045 + 0.0425 = 0.0875, and everything adds up to 1.',
('stages',2,'body',5,'cap'):'The same table written in notation, with d₁, d₂ for the data and h₁, h₂ for the hypotheses.',
('stages',2,'body',6):'The row totals simply reproduce the prior, which is a useful check. The column totals give something new: the overall probability of seeing an umbrella, 8.75%.',

('intro',):'What follows is an argument, not a settled fact: whether to be a frequentist or a Bayesian is ultimately each analyst’s own decision. Read it as one side of a debate, and notice where it is strongest and where it criticises how methods are used rather than the methods themselves.',

('stages',0,'body',0):'“You keep using that word. I do not think it means what you think it means.” (Inigo Montoya, <i>The Princess Bride</i>.) ('stages',0,'body',1):'Even professionals slip. An official Newspoll report from 2013 said that a change significant at the 95% level meant “a 95 percent probability that a real change has occurred”. ('stages',1,'h'):'Argument 2: how strict is p < .05?',
('stages',1,'body',0):'Fisher (1925) wrote that with a conventional line at .05, “we shall not often be astray”. Johnson (2013) argues that for t-tests, p < .05 corresponds roughly to a Bayes factor of only 3:1 to 5:1. If the null is true about half the time, rejecting at p < .05 is right only about 80% of the time, wrong in one decision out of five. Johnson’s own recommendation is not that everyone become a Bayesian but that the conventional threshold be stricter, around p < .01.',
('stages',2,'h'):'Argument 3: optional stopping undermines p-values',

('stages',2,'body',1,'cap'):'The decisions the orthodox theory allows.',
('stages',2,'body',2,'cap'):'The decisions researchers actually make.',
('stages',2,'body',3,'t'):'The trigger-happy researcher: a simulation',
('stages',2,'body',3,'steps',0):'The null is true. The researcher tests after every new observation, stops as soon as p < .05, and gives up at N = 1000.',
('stages',2,'body',3,'steps',1):'The Type I error rate is about 50%, not 5%. Peeking every 10 observations gives 36%, and every 50 gives 28%.',
('stages',2,'body',3,'steps',2):'The same researcher stopping when a Bayes factor reaches 3:1 in either direction (a lax standard, chosen to be generous to p) has a rate of 16%, falling to 8% when peeking every 10 and 2% every 50.',

('stages',3,'body',1):'<ul><li><b>Bootstrapping.</b> Many standard sampling distributions are approximations known to fail, such as the χ² test with small samples. ('stages',2,'body',0):'<b>Attrition.</b> <i>Homogeneous</i> attrition, the same in every condition, mainly makes the sample unrepresentative, costing external validity. <i>Differential</i> attrition is a selection bias created by the study itself. ('stages',3,'body',0):'“It is difficult to get a man to understand something, when his salary depends on his not understanding it” (Upton Sinclair). ('stages',3,'body',1):'<ul><li><b>Fabricating data</b>: allegations or findings against Cyril Burt, Andrew Wakefield (the MMR vaccine and autism) and Hwang Woo-suk (stem cells).</li><li><b>Hoaxes</b>, often intended to be discovered or to discredit a field, such as Piltdown man and the Sokal affair.</li><li><b>Misrepresenting data</b>, usually through unsophisticated analysis rather than dishonesty: pooled data that tell a different story from data split into groups (Simpson’s paradox, Week 9.2), or inconvenient variables left out.</li><li><b>“Misdesigned” studies</b>: genuine, correctly analysed data from a study built so that the desired effect is easy to find, for example by letting participants guess what they are “supposed” to do.</li><li><b>Data mining and hypothesising after the event</b>: running analysis after analysis until one works and presenting it as the only one, with a hypothesis invented afterwards (Week 8.9; the “garden of forking paths”). # FSRW v11.2 bundle — restore guide
Contents: original v10.9 workspace (ws/...), the bespoke rewrite layer for ALL core weeks 1-14 and ALL electives
(C1-C4, D1, E1, E2, E4, E5) under ws/fsrw/, plus the final report.
- ws/fsrw/legacy/rw_w1.py, rw_w2.py, rw_e1.py, rw_e2.py : Weeks 1-2 lessons + embedded items (+ SRCPATCH)
- ws/fsrw/rw/wNN_*.py : core lessons Weeks 3-14 (164 core lessons total incl. W1-2)
- ws/fsrw/rw/x<GROUP>_*.py : elective lessons (75)
- ws/fsrw/emb/rw/eNN*.py, x<GROUP>.py : embedded book passages (2,202)
- build_v11.py : builds the site from FlippedStat_v10.9-dev_standalone.html
Restore: 1) python restore_flippedstat.py <this file> <outdir>  (or split on "========== FILE:" markers)

   (snippet at top of emb/emb_extract.js usage), then run node emb/emb_extract.js / emb_groups.js to regenerate n*.json

========== FILE: ws/stage8/slides/tex2pptx.py ==========
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Convert generated FlippedStat Beamer sources into editable PPTX decks (frame by frame).
Added 2026-11-20: environment has pdflatex but no beamer/pgf; CTAN blocked.
Usage: python3 tex2pptx.py OUTDIR texfile [texfile ...]
"""
import re, sys
from pathlib import Path
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR

NAVY = RGBColor(0x1B, 0x2A, 0x4A); TEAL = RGBColor(0x0F, 0x7C, 0x80)
AMBER = RGBColor(0xB3, 0x6B, 0x00); RED = RGBColor(0xB3, 0x26, 0x1E)
GREEN = RGBColor(0x2E, 0x7D, 0x32); LIGHT = RGBColor(0xEE, 0xF5, 0xF5)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF); GREY = RGBColor(0x5F, 0x6B, 0x7A)
BLOCK = {"block": (TEAL, LIGHT), "alertblock": (AMBER, RGBColor(0xFB, 0xF2, 0xE6)),
         "exampleblock": (GREEN, RGBColor(0xEE, 0xF6, 0xEE))}
SYM = {r"\rightarrow": "→", r"\leftarrow": "←", r"\approx": "≈", r"\cdot": "·", r"\times": "×",
       r"\pm": "±", r"\neq": "≠", r"\geq": "≥", r"\ge": "≥", r"\leq": "≤", r"\le": "≤", r"\mu": "μ",
       r"\sigma": "σ", r"\Sigma": "Σ", r"\chi": "χ", r"\lambda": "λ", r"\beta": "β", r"\alpha": "α",
       r"\varepsilon": "ε", r"\theta": "θ", r"\rho": "ρ", r"\eta": "η", r"\cap": "∩", r"\cup": "∪",
       r"\mid": "|", r"\surd": "√", r"\circ": "°", r"\log": "log", r"\infty": "∞", r"\ldots": "…",
       r"\dots": "…", r"\sum": "Σ", r"\to": "→", r"\in": "∈", r"\sim": "~", r"\Delta": "Δ",
       r"\delta": "δ", r"\pi": "π", r"\gamma": "γ", r"\phi": "φ", r"\tau": "τ", r"\epsilon": "ε",
       r"\,": " ", r"\;": " ", r"\!": "", r"\quad": "  "}
SUP = str.maketrans("0123456789+-n()", "⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹⁺⁻ⁿ⁽⁾")
SUB = str.maketrans("0123456789+-()", "₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉₊₋₍₎")


def math(s):
    s = re.sub(r"\\sqrt\{([^{}]*)\}", r"√(\1)", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\hat\{([^{}]*)\}", lambda k: k.group(1) + "\u0302", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\hat\s*([A-Za-z])", lambda k: k.group(1) + "\u0302", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\bar\{([^{}]*)\}", lambda k: "".join(c + "\u0304" for c in k.group(1)), s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\bar\s*([A-Za-z])", lambda k: k.group(1) + "\u0304", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\(?:text|mathrm|textrm|operatorname)\{([^{}]*)\}", r"\1", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\frac\{([^{}]*)\}\{([^{}]*)\}", r"(\1)/(\2)", s)
    for k in sorted(SYM, key=len, reverse=True):
        s = re.sub(re.escape(k) + r"(?![A-Za-z])", SYM[k], s)
    s = s.replace("^{*}", "*").replace("^{\\ast}", "*")
    s = re.sub(r"\^\{([^{}]*)\}", lambda k: k.group(1).translate(SUP) if all(c in "0123456789+-n()" for c in k.group(1)) else "^(" + k.group(1) + ")", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\^([0-9n])", lambda k: k.group(1).translate(SUP), s)
    s = re.sub(r"_\{([^{}]*)\}", lambda k: k.group(1).translate(SUB) if all(c in "0123456789+-()" for c in k.group(1)) else "_" + k.group(1), s)
    s = re.sub(r"_([0-9])", lambda k: k.group(1).translate(SUB), s)
    return s.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")


def runs(text):
    text = re.sub(r"\$([^$]*)\$", lambda m: "\x00M" + math(m.group(1)) + "\x00", text)
    for a, b in [("~", " "), ("---", "—"), ("--", "–"), ("``", "“"), ("''", "”"), (r"\%", "%"), (r"\$", "$"),
                 (r"\&", "&"), (r"\#", "#"), (r"\_", "_"), (r"\textasciicircum{}", "^"), (r"\textasciicircum", "^"), (r"\\", " ")]:
        text = text.replace(a, b)
    text = re.sub(r"\\vspace\{[^}]*\}", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\\(small|footnotesize|scriptsize|tiny|normalsize|large|Large)\b\s*", "", text)
    out = []; i = 0; bold = mono = False; col = None; stack = []; buf = ""

    def flush():
        nonlocal buf
        if buf: out.append((buf, bold, mono, col)); buf = ""
    while i < len(text):
        if text.startswith("\x00M", i):
            j = text.index("\x00", i + 2); flush(); out.append((text[i + 2:j], bold, mono, col)); i = j + 1; continue
        m = re.match(r"\\(textbf|texttt|textit|emph|color\{(\w+)\})\s*\{", text[i:])
        m2 = re.match(r"\\color\{(\w+)\}", text[i:])
        if m:
            flush(); stack.append((bold, mono, col)); c = m.group(1)
            if c == "textbf": bold = True
            elif c == "texttt": mono = True
            elif c.startswith("color"): col = m.group(2)
            i += m.end(); continue
        if m2:
            flush(); col = m2.group(1); i += m2.end(); continue
        c = text[i]
        if c == "{": flush(); stack.append((bold, mono, col)); i += 1; continue
        if c == "}": flush(); bold, mono, col = stack.pop() if stack else (False, False, None); i += 1; continue
        if c == "\\":
            m3 = re.match(r"\\([A-Za-z]+)\s?", text[i:]); i += m3.end() if m3 else 2; continue
        buf += c; i += 1
    flush()
    return [(re.sub(r" ([.,;:!?)])", r"\1", re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)), b, mo, co) for s, b, mo, co in out if s]


def parse(tex):
    meta = {k: (re.search(r"\\" + k + r"\{(.*?)\}\n", tex) or [None, ""])[1] for k in ("title", "subtitle", "date")}
    frames = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"\\begin\{frame\}(\[[^\]]*\])?\{(.*?)\}\n(.*?)\\end\{frame\}", tex, re.S):
        items = []; cur = None
        for line in m.group(3).split("\n"):
            s = line.strip()
            if not s: continue
            b = re.match(r"\\begin\{(block|alertblock|exampleblock)\}\{(.*)\}$", s)
            if b: cur = b.group(1); items.append(("btitle", b.group(2), cur)); continue
            if re.match(r"\\end\{(block|alertblock|exampleblock)\}", s): cur = None; continue
            if s in ("\\begin{itemize}", "\\end{itemize}"): continue
            s = s.replace("\\end{itemize}", "")
            if s.startswith("\\item"): items.append(("item", s[5:].strip(), cur))
            elif items and items[-1][0] == "item" and not s.startswith(("\\", "{")): items[-1] = ("item", items[-1][1] + " " + s, cur)
            else: items.append(("para", s, cur))
        frames.append((m.group(2), items))
    return meta, frames


def add_text(tf, kind, text, blk, size):
    p = tf.add_paragraph() if tf.paragraphs[0].runs or len(tf.paragraphs) > 1 else tf.paragraphs[0]
    if kind == "item":
        r = p.add_run(); r.text = "•  "; r.font.color.rgb = BLOCK[blk][0] if blk else TEAL; r.font.size = Pt(size)
    for s, b, mo, co in runs(text):
        r = p.add_run(); r.text = s; r.font.size = Pt(size); r.font.bold = b
        if mo: r.font.name = "Consolas"
        r.font.color.rgb = {"FSteal": TEAL, "FSred": RED, "FSgreen": GREEN, "FSamber": AMBER}.get(co, NAVY)
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT; p.space_after = Pt(6)


def bar(slide, prs, text, top, h, fill, size, color=WHITE, bold=True, left=0, width=None):
    sh = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width or prs.slide_width, h)
    sh.fill.solid(); sh.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill; sh.line.fill.background()
    tf = sh.text_frame; tf.margin_left = Inches(0.35); tf.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE; tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    for s, b, mo, co in runs(text):
        r = p.add_run(); r.text = s; r.font.size = Pt(size); r.font.bold = bold; r.font.color.rgb = color


def footer(slide, prs, modno, n, total):
    bar(slide, prs, f"FlippedStat  |  Module {modno}  |  Self-paced draft; not an institutional approval", prs.slide_height - Inches(0.3), Inches(0.3), NAVY, 9, bold=False)
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(prs.slide_width - Inches(1.0), prs.slide_height - Inches(0.3), Inches(0.9), Inches(0.3))
    p = tb.text_frame.paragraphs[0]; p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.RIGHT
    r = p.add_run(); r.text = f"{n}/{total}"; r.font.size = Pt(9); r.font.color.rgb = WHITE


def chunk_frames(frames, maxlines=9):
    out = []
    for title, items in frames:
        cur, w, part = [], 0, 0
        for it in items:
            wt = 1 + len(it[1]) // 110
            if cur and w + wt > maxlines and it[0] == "item":
                out.append((title + (" (cont.)" if part else ""), cur)); part += 1; cur, w = [], 0
            cur.append(it); w += wt
        if part and len(cur) < 3 and out: out[-1] = (out[-1][0], out[-1][1] + cur)
        else: out.append((title + (" (cont.)" if part else ""), cur))
    return out


def build(texpath, outdir):
    tex = Path(texpath).read_text(encoding="utf8")
    meta, frames = parse(tex)
    mm = re.search(r"\\renewcommand\{\\FSmodulenumber\}\{(\d+)\}", tex) or re.search(r"Module (\d+)", meta["title"] + meta["subtitle"])
    modno = mm.group(1) if mm else ""
    frames = chunk_frames(frames)
    prs = Presentation(); prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333); prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)
    blank = prs.slide_layouts[6]; total = len(frames) + 1
    s = prs.slides.add_slide(blank)
    bar(s, prs, "FlippedStat", Inches(0.6), Inches(0.5), TEAL, 16, left=Inches(0.6), width=Inches(2.6))
    tf = s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(2.0), Inches(12.1), Inches(3.5)).text_frame; tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, (txt, sz, colr, b) in enumerate([(meta["title"], 36, NAVY, True), (meta["subtitle"], 18, TEAL, False),
                                            ("FlippedStat course team · The Chinese University of Hong Kong", 14, NAVY, False),
                                            ("Self-paced resource. This draft is not itself an institutional approval.", 12, GREY, False),
                                            (meta["date"], 12, GREY, False)]):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph(); p.space_after = Pt(10)
        for st, bb, mo, co in runs(txt):
            r = p.add_run(); r.text = st; r.font.size = Pt(sz); r.font.bold = b; r.font.color.rgb = colr
    footer(s, prs, modno, 1, total)
    for n, (title, items) in enumerate(frames, start=2):
        s = prs.slides.add_slide(blank)
        bar(s, prs, title, 0, Inches(0.85), NAVY, 24)
        nch = sum(len(t) for _, t, _ in items)
        size = 26 if nch < 350 else 22 if nch < 600 else 20 if nch < 850 else 18 if nch < 1150 else 16 if nch < 1500 else 14
        y = Inches(1.1); avail = prs.slide_height - Inches(1.5) - y
        groups = []
        for it in items:
            if not groups or it[0] == "btitle" or groups[-1][0] != it[2]: groups.append([it[2], []])
            groups[-1][1].append(it)
        cpl = 1900 / size
        need = [Emu(int(Pt(size) * 1.5 * sum(1 + int(len(t) / cpl) for _, t, _ in g[1]))) + Inches(0.3) for g in groups]
        scale = min(1.0, avail / max(1, sum(need)))
        for (blk, its), nh in zip(groups, need):
            h = int(nh * scale); left, width = Inches(0.5), prs.slide_width - Inches(1.0)
            if blk:
                head = its[0] if its[0][0] == "btitle" else None
                fill, body = BLOCK[blk]; th = Inches(0.45) if head else 0
                if head: bar(s, prs, head[1], y, th, fill, size, left=left, width=width)
                box = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, y + th, width, max(h - th, Inches(0.5)))
                box.fill.solid(); box.fill.fore_color.rgb = body; box.line.fill.background()
                tf = box.text_frame; tf.word_wrap = True; tf.margin_left = tf.margin_right = Inches(0.25); tf.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.TOP
                for k, t, b in its:
                    if k != "btitle": add_text(tf, k, t, b, size)
            else:
                tf = s.shapes.add_textbox(left, y, width, h).text_frame; tf.word_wrap = True
                for k, t, b in its: add_text(tf, k, t, b, size)
            y += h + Inches(0.08)
        footer(s, prs, modno, n, total)
    out = Path(outdir) / (Path(texpath).stem + ".pptx"); out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    prs.save(out); return out, total


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for f in sys.argv[2:]:
        o, t = build(f, sys.argv[1]); print(o, t)
========== END FILE: ws/stage8/slides/tex2pptx.py ==========

========== FILE: ws/stage8/render_review_cuts.py ==========
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render REVIEW CUTS (animatics) of the 32 programme-map videos.
Storyboard card per beat (BEATS.md) + espeak-ng placeholder voice (NARRATION.md) + captions
re-timed to audio. NOT finished films. Usage: python3 render_review_cuts.py OUTDIR [V-ID ...]
"""
import re, subprocess, sys, wave
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent; SCRIPTS = HERE / "scripts"
FONT = "/usr/share/fonts/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"; FONTB = "/usr/share/fonts/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
NAVY = (27, 42, 74); TEAL = (15, 124, 128); AMBER = (179, 107, 0); LIGHT = (238, 245, 245); GREY = (95, 107, 122)
W, H = 1920, 1080
f = lambda sz, b=False: ImageFont.truetype(FONTB if b else FONT, sz)
clean = lambda s: re.sub(r"\*\*|`", "", s).strip()


def parse(vdir):
    bm = (vdir / "BEATS.md").read_text(encoding="utf8"); nm = (vdir / "NARRATION.md").read_text(encoding="utf8")
    g = lambda k: (re.search(r"\*\*" + k + r":\*\*\s*(.+?)\s*$", bm, re.M) or [None, ""])[1]
    rows = {}
    for line in bm.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"\|\s*(\d+)\s*\|([^|]*)\|([^|]*)\|([^|]*)\|([^|]*)\|", line)
        if m: rows[int(m.group(1))] = dict(screen=clean(m.group(3)), words=clean(m.group(5)))
    narr = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r"^## Beat (\d+)[^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", nm, re.S | re.M):
        narr[int(m.group(1))] = clean(" ".join(l.strip() for l in m.group(2).strip().splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.startswith("#")))
    return g("Title"), g("Module / outcome"), rows, narr


def wrap(d, text, font, width):
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in text.split():
        t = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        if d.textlength(t, font=font) <= width: cur = t
        else: lines.append(cur); cur = w
    return lines + ([cur] if cur else [])


def card(path, vid, title, module, n, nb, row):
    im = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "white"); d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.rectangle([0, 0, W, 120], fill=NAVY)
    d.text((60, 30), f"{vid}  ·  {title}", font=f(44, True), fill="white"); d.text((W - 330, 42), f"Beat {n} of {nb}", font=f(34), fill="white")
    d.text((60, 160), "ON SCREEN (storyboard — to be animated)", font=f(30, True), fill=TEAL)
    lines = wrap(d, row.get("screen", ""), f(38), W - 180)[:9]
    d.rectangle([60, 210, W - 60, 250 + 50 * len(lines)], fill=LIGHT); y = 230
    for l in lines: d.text((90, y), l, font=f(38), fill=NAVY); y += 50
    y += 50
    if row.get("words"):
        d.text((60, y), "On-screen words / colour", font=f(30, True), fill=TEAL); y += 46
        for l in wrap(d, row["words"], f(32), W - 160)[:4]: d.text((60, y), l, font=f(32), fill=GREY); y += 42
    d.rectangle([0, H - 150, W, H - 100], fill=AMBER)
    d.text((60, H - 143), "REVIEW CUT — synthetic placeholder voice; motion graphics, screencasts and human narration not yet produced", font=f(28, True), fill="white")
    d.text((60, H - 80), module[:150], font=f(26), fill=GREY)
    im.resize((1280, 720)).save(path)


def dur(w):
    with wave.open(str(w)) as x: return x.getnframes() / x.getframerate()


def ts(t, vtt=True):
    h, r = divmod(t, 3600); m, s = divmod(r, 60)
    return f"{int(h):02d}:{int(m):02d}:{s:06.3f}" if vtt else f"{int(h):02d}:{int(m):02d}:{s:06.3f}".replace(".", ",")


def split_caps(text):
    caps = []
    for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text):
        while len(s) > 84:
            c = s.rfind(" ", 0, 84); c = c if c > 30 else 84; caps.append(s[:c]); s = s[c:].strip()
        if s: caps.append(s)
    return caps


def run(*a): subprocess.run(list(a), check=True)


def render(vdir, out):
    vid = vdir.name; title, module, rows, narr = parse(vdir)
    work = out / "_work" / vid; work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    segs, cues, t0 = [], [], 0.0; beats = sorted(narr)
    for n in beats:
        wav, pad, png, seg = (work / f"b{n:02d}{x}" for x in (".wav", "p.wav", ".png", ".mp4"))
        run("espeak-ng", "-v", "en-gb", "-s", "150", "-g", "4", "-w", str(wav), narr[n])
        run("ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", str(wav), "-af", "apad=pad_dur=0.6", "-ar", "22050", "-ac", "1", str(pad))
        card(png, vid, title, module, n, len(beats), rows.get(n, {})); d = dur(pad)
        run("ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-loop", "1", "-framerate", "1", "-t", f"{d:.3f}", "-i", str(png),
            "-vf", "format=yuv420p", "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "ultrafast", "-tune", "stillimage", "-crf", "28", "-r", "1", str(seg))
        caps = split_caps(narr[n]); tot = sum(map(len, caps)); t = t0
        for c in caps: dt = (d - 0.6) * len(c) / tot; cues.append((t, t + dt, c)); t += dt
        segs.append((seg, pad)); t0 += d
    (work / "list.txt").write_text("".join(f"file '{s}'\n" for s, _ in segs))
    (work / "alist.txt").write_text("".join(f"file '{a}'\n" for _, a in segs))
    (out / f"{vid}_review_cut.vtt").write_text("WEBVTT\n\n" + "".join(f"{i}\n{ts(a)} --> {ts(b)}\n{c}\n\n" for i, (a, b, c) in enumerate(cues, 1)))
    (work / "cap.srt").write_text("".join(f"{i}\n{ts(a, 0)} --> {ts(b, 0)}\n{c}\n\n" for i, (a, b, c) in enumerate(cues, 1)))
    run("ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", str(work / "alist.txt"), "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-b:a", "48k", str(work / "audio.mp3"))
    run("ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", str(work / "list.txt"), "-i", str(work / "audio.mp3"),
        "-i", str(work / "cap.srt"), "-map", "0:v", "-map", "1:a", "-map", "2:s", "-c:v", "copy", "-c:a", "copy", "-c:s", "mov_text",
        "-metadata:s:s:0", "language=eng", "-metadata", f"title={vid} {title} (review cut)", str(out / f"{vid}_review_cut.mp4"))
    return vid, title, t0, len(beats), len(cues)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = Path(sys.argv[1]); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); rep = out / "render_log.csv"
    if not rep.exists(): rep.write_text("video_id,title,duration_s,beats,caption_cues\n")
    for v in sys.argv[2:] or sorted(p.name for p in SCRIPTS.glob("V-*") if p.is_dir()):
        if (out / f"{v}_review_cut.mp4").exists(): continue
        r = render(SCRIPTS / v, out)
        with rep.open("a") as fh: fh.write(f'{r[0]},"{r[1]}",{r[2]:.1f},{r[3]},{r[4]}\n')
        print(r[0], round(r[2]), flush=True)
========== END FILE: ws/stage8/render_review_cuts.py ==========

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Rebuild FlippedStat v11.3-dev from v11.2.
Usage: python ws/site_layer/build_v113.py FlippedStat_v11.2_complete_with_electives.html FlippedStat_v11.3-dev_standalone.html
Appends layout_v113.css/js before </body>, adds release row, bumps release-page version. Lesson content untouched."""
import sys,os
H=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
h=open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf8').read()
js=open(os.path.join(H,'layout_v113.js'),encoding='utf8').read(); css=open(os.path.join(H,'layout_v113.css'),encoding='utf8').read()
h=h.replace("This file is a development build: <b>v11.1-dev</b>","This file is a development build: <b>v11.3-dev</b>")
rel='<tr><td>11.3-dev</td><td>2026-11-20</td><td>Layout coherence pass. Module-first navigation (Start here, Official Modules 1-8, Check your learning, Tools), module position bar with previous/next on every topic, route panel and module cards on the home page, official counts only (8 modules, 153 topics). Module 9 labelled as an optional draft not counted in progress or KPIs; supplementary units, teaching-week view, reference and project pages grouped in collapsible sections. Footer version and dataset statement corrected. No lesson text, data, keys, assessment items, cut scores or certificate wording changed.</td></tr>'
k=h.find('"release":"<tr>'); assert k>0, 'release table not found'
h=h[:k+11]+rel.replace('"','\\"')+h[k+11:]
i=h.rfind('</body>'); h=h[:i]+'<style id="fs13css">'+css+'</style>\n<script id="fs13js">'+js+'</script>\n'+h[i:]
open(sys.argv[2],'w',encoding='utf8').write(h); print('wrote',sys.argv[2],len(h))
